**Goal:** make a Predictive Studio training run honest end to end — it learns from the declared prediction unit's
resolved rows only, reads every input as it stood at each row's decision date, freezes what it read in a fingerprinted
Training Snapshot, and is graded by an Evaluation Protocol saved before any search, whose three-outcome gate
(`model` / `keep-simple-baseline` / `no-signal`) is stored on the run.

**Architecture:** four new or rebuilt components behind existing seams. **C1 Prediction Unit** (`MJ: Prediction
Units`, immutable versions) declares rows, decision date, outcome rule, window, censoring and task type; training reads
the unit's rows instead of "every row of the target entity". **C2 As-of Feature Assembly** (one function for training
and scoring) reads only dated sources — Record Changes history, immutable fields, windowed aggregates over dated child
tables, declared series lags, pinned Feature Values — and writes a **Training Snapshot** (`MJ: Training Snapshots` +
three `MJ: Files` through `FileStorageBase`) with a content hash and per-value provenance. **C3 Evaluation Protocol**
(`MJ: Evaluation Protocols`, immutable versions) replaces the pipeline's `ValidationStrategy`/`LeakageGuard` JSON.
**C4 Trainer/Evaluator** (the Python sidecar's evaluation loop, rewritten) runs the protocol and returns proper scores,
baselines, intervals, calibration, audit, importance and the gate decision.

**Tech stack:** TypeScript (ESM, vitest) in `@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core`, `@memberjunction/predictive-studio`,
`@memberjunction/core-entities-server`, `@memberjunction/storage`; Python 3.11 (FastAPI, scikit-learn, xgboost,
lightgbm, numpy, pandas, scipy) in the sidecar; T-SQL (one product migration, one truth-suite test-schema migration);
MJ metadata JSON; Angular (M11).

```bash
cd $MJ
cp .env .env.MJ_PS_PR3_<agent>
# edit .env.MJ_PS_PR3_<agent>:
```


For the trainer milestones (M5–M10):

- Python tests run through the package script, which sets `cwd=src/python` and `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH` for libomp:
  `cd packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Sidecar && pnpm run test:python -- -p no:cacheprovider <pytest args>`.
- Gate tests (`tests/gates/`, pytest nodes of the sidecar package) read PR 2's planted-truth data from its
  generated-data cache: `$TRUTH_DATA_DIR` (default `TruthSuite/.data`), one directory per seed,
  `DataCache.Dir(root, kind, id, specHash, seed)` (`TruthSuite/src/data/cache.ts`), filled by
  `DatasetCatalog.EnsureGenerated` or the CLI. Generate the base seeds and W2 s100–s159 once:
  `cd $MJ/packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/TruthSuite && pnpm run truth:data -- --set base && pnpm run truth:data -- --set t2 --only W2-noise`.
  A seed missing from the cache fails the test, never skips. They run in the TruthSuite venv
  (`pnpm --filter @memberjunction/predictive-studio-truth-suite run setup:python`; its `python/requirements.txt` is the
  sidecar's pins plus mypy) with `truthsuite` on the path:
  `export PREDICTIVE_STUDIO_PYTHON=$MJ/packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/TruthSuite/.venv/bin/python; export PYTHONPATH=$MJ/packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/TruthSuite/python`
  (`src/python`, the cwd `run-pytest.mjs` sets, stays first on `sys.path`, so the sidecar's own `app` and `tests`
  still win). A gate measured by pytest is a `NamedCheck` that runs its node ids through `PsGatePytest.Run` (§2.7),
  which sets the same variables.
- PR 2 as merged ships none of the Python truth readers this plan's gate tests were written against: no
  `truthsuite.paths`, no `truthsuite.refpipe`, no `TruthSuite/fixtures/reference/p5-golden.json`, no
  `TruthSuite/fixtures/real/`, no `n400` seed set (`SeedSetName` is `'base' | 't2'`), and no `pyarrow`/`statsmodels`
  in either venv (§8.3 B-NOT-SHIPPED, A-PR2-VENV). PR 3 builds them in the TruthSuite package (owner decision
  2026-10-26, D3-73): M2.1 Step 0 pins `pyarrow==25.0.1` in the TruthSuite venv; M5.2 creates `truthsuite.paths`, the
  `truthsuite.refpipe` port, `fixtures/reference/p5-golden.json`, `fixtures/real/`, the `n400` seed set and the
  `statsmodels==0.15.0` pin; M6.8, M8.3 and M10.5 generate the `n400` sets they first read.
- A local sidecar for runtime checks: `cd packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Sidecar/src/python &&
  DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib ../../.venv/bin/python server.py 4391` (prints
  `PREDICTIVE_STUDIO_SIDECAR_PORT=4391`), then `until curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:4391/health;
  do sleep 2; done; echo UP`; stop it with `pkill -f "server.py 4391"`. With `PS_SIDECAR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4391` the
  gate tests POST to that server instead of running in-process (`tests/gates/conftest.py::completed`, M6.8).
- No new sidecar Python dependency beyond `threadpoolctl==3.7.0` (M5.3); `pyarrow` (M2.1) and `statsmodels` (M5.2) are
  pinned in the TruthSuite venv only, never the sidecar's (AR(1) is fitted by conditional least squares, M8.1). The restricted unpickler's allow-list grows only by exact
  `(module, name)` pairs, recorded by loading every family (M6.4).

`metadata-optional/integration-test/tests/gates/.gate-W1-S5.4.json` +
`packages/TestingFramework/integration-test-suite/src/checks/ps-gate-w1-s5-4.checks.ts`. There is no gate registry
file, runner script, lanes, outcome model, status beyond a row's `Active`/`Pending`, or CI wiring beyond the tiers.

**A gate is one `MJ: Tests` row plus one `NamedCheck` bundle**, both written, registered and joined to a suite in the
commit that flips the gate (§4.2's milestone), never earlier. Naming, with `<dataset>` and `<criterion>` exactly as
§4.1's "Test name" column writes them (`C1`, `N1c`, `R2-real`; `S1.1`, `S-T.1`), and a second or third gate on the
same pair carrying `#2`/`#3` (`W4 -> S2.1 #2`):

| What | Name |
|---|---|
| Row file | `metadata-optional/integration-test/tests/gates/.gate-<dataset>-<criterion>.json` (`#k` → `-k`: `.gate-W4-S2.1-2.json`) |
| `Name` | `"<dataset> -> <criterion>"` (ASCII `->`; `"W4 -> S2.1 #2"`) — the "Test name" of §4.1 |
| `Tags` | `["gate","G<id>","owner:PR3","phase:<1\|2>","dataset:<dataset>","criterion:<criterion>"]` (`criterion:S2.1#2`) |
| `Configuration` | `{ "tier": "mutation"\|"live-model", "transport": "client", "checks": [{ "type": "ps-gate-<dataset-lc>-<criterion-dashed>" }] }` |
| `Status` | `"Active"` (written by the milestone that flips the gate; see "Pending" below) |
| `Description` / `ExpectedOutcomes.summary` | the threshold verbatim and what it proves / one sentence of the pass condition (the shipped rows' form) |
| `primaryKey.ID` | from `uuidgen` |
| Check type / bundle | `ps-gate-<dataset-lc>-<criterion-dashed>`: lower case, `.` and `#` → `-` (`ps-gate-c1-s1-1`, `ps-gate-t3-s-t-1`, `ps-gate-w4-s2-1-2`, `ps-gate-r2-real-s4-4`) |
| Check file | `packages/TestingFramework/integration-test-suite/src/checks/ps-gate-<dataset-lc>-<criterion-dashed>.checks.ts` |
| Export | `PsGate<Dataset><Criterion>Checks: NamedCheck[]` — `-`, `.` removed, the letter after `-` upper-cased, `#k` → `No<k>` (`PsGateC1S11Checks`, `PsGateT3ST1Checks`, `PsGateW4S21No2Checks`, `PsGateR2RealS44Checks`) |
| Check | `Id: 'ps-gate-<…>.G<id>'`, `Name: 'G<id> <dataset> → <criterion>: <one-line threshold>'`, `RequiresMutation: true` on every `mutation`-tier gate (`RequiresLiveModel: true` on a `live-model` one) |
| Registration | `for (const c of PsGate<…>Checks) IntegrationCheckRegistry.Instance.Register(c);` and `IntegrationCheckRegistry.Instance.RegisterLifecycle('ps-gate-<…>', PsGate.Lifecycle);` |
| Barrel | one `export * from './checks/ps-gate-<…>.checks';` line in `integration-test-suite/src/index.ts` |
| Pinned counts | `src/__tests__/check-registry.test.ts`: `'ps-gate-<…>': 1` in `EXPECTED_BUNDLE_COUNTS`, the bundle total (`toHaveLength(154)` at `6e2b57017b`: 151 at `479ee0d93d` + 3 FLS bundles `next` added) + 1, and `'ps-gate-<…>.G<id>'` in the gated-skip snapshot's `RequiresMutation` list |
| Suite membership | one `MJ: Test Suite Tests` entry (`TestID: "@lookup:MJ: Tests.Name=<dataset> -> <criterion>"`, next `Sequence`, `Status: "Active"`, `uuidgen` key) in the gate's suite file |

Suites (`metadata-optional/integration-test/test-suites/`, each `Status: "Active"`, its `Description` ending in its
run command, as the shipped suites do):

| Suite file | Suite name | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| `.ps-gates-prediction-units-suite.json` | `Predictive Studio Gates — Prediction Units` | G1.1–G1.12 (12) |
| `.ps-gates-training-suite.json` | `Predictive Studio Gates — Training` | the deterministic G2.x gates (35) |
| `.ps-gates-training-statistical-suite.json` | `Predictive Studio Gates — Training (statistical)` | G2.1, G2.2, G2.3, G2.13, G2.35 (400 seeds) and G2.4 (60 seeds) (6); each member row's `MaxExecutionTimeMS` is set from a measured run; it runs and passes on the final head before merge (owner, 2026-10-26; M12) |
| `.ps-gates-training-live-model-suite.json` | `Predictive Studio Gates — Training (live model)` | `live-model`-tier gates; PR 3 has none (0 of 53), so the file is not created unless a refresh assigns one |

**Pending.** The shipped guard `integration-test-suite/src/__tests__/sibling-parity.test.ts` fails the build for a
gate row joined to no `.ps-gates-*.json` suite and for a row whose `checks[].type` names no registered bundle. A PR 3
gate therefore has no row before its check exists: row, check file, barrel line, pinned counts and suite membership
land together, `Status: "Active"`, in the flipping commit (D3-62). A flipped gate later found unable to pass on `next`
moves to the shipped `Predictive Studio Gates — Pending` suite with `Status: "Pending"` only with the owner's explicit
yes (D-062) and a §9.1 decision, and never a gate of `Training (statistical)` (those pass before merge, D3-63); that
is the only use of `Pending` in this PR. PR 2's G0.2, G0.3 (owned by PR 4) and G0.6 stay there; PR 3 never activates them.

**Mutation evidence** (D-064). Each flipped gate's mutation run is recorded twice: the plan's step line
`**Mutation check <gate id>:** <product change> → \`<dataset> -> <criterion>\` fails` (written in advance, §6), and, once
run, the failing `PsGate.Assert` text in the milestone's §11 handoff entry as its own line
`**Mutation output G<id>:** <pasted assertion>`. `tools/milestone-exit.mjs` fails the milestone for a changed gate row
whose id lacks either line.

**A check body** (the shipped form; G0.10 is the model):

```ts
export const PsGateC1S11Checks: NamedCheck[] = [
  {
    Id: 'ps-gate-c1-s1-1.G1.1', Name: 'G1.1 C1 → S1.1: the renewal unit yields the reference keys, 4,873 of 4,873, 0 extra', RequiresMutation: true,
    Fn: async (ctx) => {
      const h = await PsGate.Harness(ctx);                 // TruthHarness on the check's client provider
      // … drive the product through h, count what the threshold names …
      PsGate.Assert({ Passed: matched === 4873 && extra === 0 && matched > 0, Measured: { matched, extra }, Detail: `${matched} of 4873 matched, ${extra} extra` });
    },
  },
];
for (const c of PsGateC1S11Checks) IntegrationCheckRegistry.Instance.Register(c);
IntegrationCheckRegistry.Instance.RegisterLifecycle('ps-gate-c1-s1-1', PsGate.Lifecycle);
```

A body fails, never passes, when the harness throws or it measures zero rows (D-064: `Passed` is computed from counts
the body also requires to be non-zero). Helpers shared by several of one subject's checks are statics of a
subject-named class in `src/checks/ps-gates/ps-gate-<subject>.ts` (`PsGateSpecs` is the shipped one: `PsGateSpecs.W`,
`PsGateSpecs.Ref`); no file or class name carries plan vocabulary (program D-049).

**The harness** `h: TruthHarness` (`packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/TruthSuite/src/harness/types.ts`), built by
`RunFixtures.HarnessFor(provider, user)` (`run-fixtures.ts`; `PsGate.Harness(ctx)` calls it) and cleaned by
`RunFixtures.CleanupRun(user)` (`PsGate.Lifecycle.Teardown`). Shipped members: `Provider`, `User`, `RunID`, `Created`,
`EnsureLoaded(ref)` (→ `LoadedDataset { Ref, Dir, Entity, RowCount, RowsSha256 }`; tables `pstruth.W<n>_…` /
`pstruth.Scn_<ID>`), `CreatePipeline(spec)`, `Train(pipeline, opts?)` (→ `TrainAttempt`; never throws for a refusal),
`RunBuilderAgent(plan)`, `ReadModel(modelId)` (→ `CandidateModel`, `Trust` is Core's verdict),
`ModelsForPipelineNamePrefix(prefix)`, `Promote(modelId, target, reason)` (→ `PromoteAttempt { Promoted, Status }`),
`Score(modelId, req)` (→ `ScoreAttempt`), `ScoreViaRecordProcess(modelId, dataset, extraFilter)`,
`CountNonNull(dataset, column)`, `ResetColumn(dataset, column)`, `GenerateStory(modelId)`, `Judge(module, args)`,
`WriteArtifact(name, data)`. Shipped fixtures PR 3's checks reuse, never duplicate: `RunFixtures.TrainedModel(h, tag,
dataset)`, `RunFixtures.W1S42Model(h)`, `RunFixtures.W1S42ValidatedModel(h)`, `HarnessDatasets.FirstRowIDs`,
`HarnessDatasets.LabelCounts`, `PsGateSpecs.W`, `PsGateSpecs.Ref`, `ContainmentProbe.WasRefusedBeforeTraining`.
PR 3 adds four members, as interface members in `types.ts` and lines in the one harness literal
(`RunFixtures.harnessFrom`, where a missing member is a compile error) delegating to statics of `harness/` owner
classes (§5.4): `ReadWorldTruth(dataset)` (M2.7), `SampleRowIds(dataset, n, seed)`, `ResolveProvenance(p, value)`,
`UseSuiteSidecar()` (M4.6). These four names are fixed (ruling PR3-R5).

**Refusals** are codes, never message text: `TrainAttempt.RefusalCode` and `ScoreAttempt.RefusalCode` are
`PredictiveStudioRefusalCode | null` (the operation's `RemoteOpResult.ResultCode`; `Core/src/refusal-codes.ts`,
today `READ_CAP_EXCEEDED`, `AS_OF_NO_EFFECT`, `MODEL_NOT_SCORABLE`, `MODEL_NEEDS_TRAINING`,
`EXPERIMENT_SESSIONS_UNAVAILABLE`, `INVALID_EVALUATION_SETTING`). PR 3 appends `PROTOCOL_REQUIRED`, `UNIT_REQUIRED`,
`AS_OF_SOURCE_UNDATED` and `BUDGET_EXCEEDED` to `REFUSAL_CODES` in the milestone that first refuses with each; a check
asserts `ContainmentProbe.WasRefusedBeforeTraining(attempt, '<CODE>')`. The run row's
`ValidationResults.refusal` keeps the detailed `{ kind, stage }` (§5.1) for people and the UI (D3-60).

**A Python-side gate** measures through `PsGatePytest.Run(nodeIds: readonly string[]): Promise<PytestRunResult>`
(`src/checks/ps-gates/ps-gate-pytest.ts`, written in M5; §5.4): it spawns
`node scripts/run-pytest.mjs -- --junitxml <tmp> <nodeIds>` in `packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Sidecar` with
`PREDICTIVE_STUDIO_PYTHON` and `PYTHONPATH` of §2.4 and `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`, parses the JUnit XML and returns
`{ Collected, Passed, Failed, Errors, NotCollected }`. The check passes only when `NotCollected` is empty,
`Failed + Errors === 0` and `Passed === Collected > 0`; a renamed or uncollected node fails the gate, a missing report
throws. No other runner is written (D3-61).

Commands (each with the agent's env file loaded, MJAPI started on the truth sidecar as in §2.3, and
`pnpm run truth:provision` done):

```bash
cd $MJ
# a whole suite → every member passes (n of n; record the counts the run prints)
MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "<suite name>"
# one gate (by its row Name)
MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test run "<dataset> -> <criterion>"
# the keep-list (PR 2's containment gates) → 10 of 10 pass
MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — Containment"
# the bundle pins and the row/suite parity after adding a gate → all passed
cd packages/TestingFramework/integration-test-suite && pnpm test
```

`mj test run` takes the row `Name` as its argument (an ID miss falls back to the name). A `fail` anywhere exits
non-zero. Seed sets for the statistical gates are generated with PR 2's `DatasetCatalog.EnsureGenerated` /
`DatasetSeeds.SeedSet` (sets `base`, `t2`, and `n400`, which M5.2 adds, D3-73) in the milestone that first needs each set.

## 3. Context

### 3.1 The problem in plain words

Today a Predictive Studio pipeline names one entity and one column, and training learns from **every row of that
entity as it stands today**. Nothing says what one row is (a member-year? a member?), when the prediction is made, how
long the outcome takes to be known, or whether it is known yet. So members whose renewal is not due yet are taught to
the model as "did not renew" (W5: 1,735 + 412 such rows; mean prediction 0.0006 for a cohort whose true rate is 0.80);
the "as-of" setting changes nothing (every feature is read at today's value, so a column restating the outcome looks
like a brilliant predictor); a text or date column bound as a number silently becomes 0.0 (MoreCheese Course
Completion scores all 4,276 enrollments identically); and there is no record of which rows and values a model was
trained on.

Grading is worse. The "holdout" is the trailing 20% of rows in primary-key order (on MoreCheese the newest members
only); the tournament picks its winner on that same holdout and reports a fabricated "CV" (holdout × 0.98); metrics
are single points with no interval, no proper score, no baseline; a majority-class model is graded "Excellent", a model
as good as the planted truth is graded "Poor", and on pure noise 19% of small tournaments publish. Forecasts are graded
on random months inside the training period.

This PR rebuilds the training side (assessment roadmap Phases 1 and 2): a declared unit, dated inputs, a frozen
snapshot, a protocol written before the search, and a trainer that reports honest, interval-bearing comparisons
against fixed baselines and decides one of three outcomes.

that hides or refuses the defect earlier; this PR fixes it. Merged findings close with the finding they were merged

### 3.3 Target design (copied from `reference/architecture.md` C1–C4 and §5; P10 at `ps-review` `d47dfb8`)

**Design rules that bind this PR.** MJ is the system of record: units, protocols, snapshots, runs and models are MJ
entities, files are `MJ: Files` written through `FileStorageBase`; PS builds no storage, audit or permission system of
its own. The sidecar is stateless: it receives a frozen snapshot and a protocol and returns results and artifact bytes
with their SHA-256. Types are a convenience layer — the guarantees are run-time refusals (assembly, trainer, record
`Validate()`), so every refusal below is code, not a comment.

**C1 Prediction Unit + Temporal Spec.** A metadata entity every pipeline references exactly once, by the ID of an
immutable version row (D-014). It declares what one row is (`grain`: one row per grain record with a decision-date
rule; `grain-x-periods`: one row per grain record per period of a dated child entity, decision date = the period's
date), the outcome rule and its window (`windowDays` after the decision date, `gapDays` before the window starts), the
declared task type, censoring (rows whose window has not closed at the data cutoff are excluded and counted), the group
key, the Temporal Spec for series (time column, horizon, lags and rolling windows, every lag ≥ horizon; D-016: part of
the unit row), the decision it serves (action, actor, capacity per period) and the incumbent heuristic. `labelVersion`
is bumped on any change to the outcome rule, window, gap or task type. The scored class and adverse direction are
**derived** by `TaskTypeRules.ScoreSemantics(task)`, never stored twice. Refusals: `single-valued-target`, `task-type-mismatch`,
`unresolved-reference`, `lag-inside-horizon`, `rolling-window-inside-horizon`. Prevents FM-1 (one-valued target with
perfect scores), FM-3 (unresolved rows taught as answers), FM-12 (forecast without a time index), FM-18/19 (adverse class
cannot name a class the artifact lacks).

**C2 As-of Feature Assembly and the Training Snapshot.** The **one** assembly function for training and scoring, now
reading dated history only; there is no "today's value" path. Sources: `record-changes` (a field updated in place,
replayed from `MJ: Record Changes` as of the decision date, with a coverage record), `immutable-field` (read directly
only when metadata declares it immutable and Record Changes confirm no later update), `feature-value` (effective-dated
`MJ: Feature Values` pinned to a pipeline version; pins delivered by PR 5), `windowed-aggregate` (count, sum, mean,
distinct, days-since over a dated child entity), `series` (a declared lag or rolling window, read only from periods
≤ t − h). Change-history coverage: a record's history counts only from its earliest `Create` or `Snapshot` change row; a
decision date before it cannot be replayed (refused, or excluded and counted); a continuity check replays each covered
record to now and compares it with the stored value; external-source rows are replayed at detection time or declared
ineligible. Column encoding is chosen from the field type — `numeric` (non-numeric value fails), `categorical` (cap and
method), `date-parts`, `boolean`, `identifier` (excluded); **no variant maps a date, ID or string to 0**; every column
gets an in-fold imputer **and** a missing indicator. Reads are complete or paged with a count check; a truncated read
is a refusal. Refusals name what is wrong and there is no partial matrix: `select-changes-after-decision-date`,
`decision-date-before-change-history`, `truncated-read`, `non-numeric-in-numeric-column`, `future-period-lag`,
`unpinned-feature-version`, `scope-entity-mismatch`. The output is an immutable **Training Snapshot**: matrix and row
manifest files (row id, entity key, decision date, group key, period, role `development`|`locked-holdout`), a content
hash over the file hashes, schema hash and the unit/label/feature-spec/protocol versions, per-column provenance, rows
read (`readComplete: true` is the only admissible value), censored/uncovered/duplicate counts, class balance and the data
cutoff. Prevents FM-2, FM-3 (count), FM-4, FM-6, FM-11 (stored holdout keys), FM-15 (no cross-entity hydration).

**C3 Evaluation Protocol.** A versioned entity saved **before any search**; every run references the exact version.
It declares the locked holdout (`date-carved`: rows after a cutoff, optional separate new-entity report; or
`rolling-origin` for series: ≥ 5 origins, horizon, gap, minimum training periods), inner validation over development
rows only (repeated stratified, grouped or blocked-time folds; fixed seed), `holdoutAccessBudget = 1`, a primary
**proper** score per family (binary log-loss/Brier, multiclass log-loss, continuous RMSE/MAE, count Poisson deviance,
non-negative Tweedie deviance, forecast MASE/RMSE) with secondary metrics that never rank, fixed baselines (dummy,
one-feature, GLM of the family, naive/seasonal-naive, the unit's incumbent heuristic), calibration on a disjoint fold,
in-fold-only resampling, interval and paired-test methods, the promotion rule (margin ≥ 0, paired lower bound on the
same holdout rows, decision table Q13+Q14+Q15), the allowed outcomes `['model','keep-simple-baseline','no-signal']`, the
leakage audit, slices, prediction intervals, residual diagnostics, retrain triggers, search strategy and hard budgets.
Guard fields (holdout, promotion, leakage audit, exclusions, budgets, and the `GuardFieldsEditableBy` setting itself)
pass the same validation whoever authors a version, and are set in protocol configuration — the UI, a non-agent API
caller, a scheduled job, the system's defaults or shipped metadata — never by an agent tool call (G3.11): the
`GuardFieldsEditableBy` setting is `non-agent` (the default) or `human-only` (optional: only a user-authored version,
D3-40). Defaults and shipped protocols set them automatically, so no step needs a person. It replaces the pipeline's
`ValidationStrategy` and `LeakageGuard` JSON. Prevents FM-5, FM-7, FM-8, FM-9, FM-10, FM-11, FM-12.

**C4 Sidecar Trainer / Evaluator.** The stateless `/train` extended to take a `TrainerRequest` (snapshot files as
pre-authorised downloads with SHA-256, the protocol, the task, candidates, seed, threads, timeout) and return a
`TrainerResult`: code version (git SHA, sidecar and library versions, threads, seed); per-candidate inner-CV means with
intervals over development rows (`optimistic: true`); one finalist; one logged holdout access; holdout primary and
secondary metrics with intervals; baselines with intervals; paired comparisons keyed like refpipe (`modelVsDummy`,
`<member>VsDummy`, `modelVs:<member>`); the incumbent diff; calibration; slices; the operating point at the unit's
capacity; held-out permutation importance per source column; leakage flags; prediction-interval coverage; residual
diagnostics; real `computeSeconds`; the `GateDecision`; artifacts for the finalist and every simple member the gate
could ship. `failed` carries a stage (`load-snapshot`, `inner-cv`, `holdout`, `baselines`, `timeout`,
`budget-exceeded`) and never partial metrics. Every preprocessing step is fit inside the fold it serves.

**The publishing gate (decided here, enforced at publish by PR 4).** "X beats Y" ⇔ the lower bound of the paired 95%
interval of (Y's loss − X's loss) on the same holdout rows is strictly greater than the margin. Rows in order, first
match wins (Core `GateRules.DecideGate` — contracts.ts `decideGate` under MJ's PascalCase rule, D3-24 — a line-for-line
transcription of refpipe `gate_decision`):

| # | Condition | outcome | branch | shipped |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `deliveredMember` null and model beats dummy and model beats best simple | `model` | `a:beats-best-simple` | the model |
| 2 | model beats dummy and no simple member beats the dummy | `model` | `a:Q15-only-model-beats-dummy` | the model |
| 3 | at least one simple member beats the dummy | `keep-simple-baseline` | `b:keep-simple-baseline` | eligible member with the lowest primary score (ties → name) |
| 4 | otherwise | `no-signal` | `c:no-signal` | nothing |

The run stores the paired **intervals** (`StoredGateIntervals`), not booleans, plus the incumbent diff and the decision
(D-015: the gate decision lives in the run's results JSON in PR 3; PR 4's model row carries the registered `Delivery`).

```ts
  | { readonly kind: 'truncated-read'; readonly entity: EntityName; readonly rowsExpected: number; readonly rowsRead: number }
```

## 4. Acceptance

### 4.1 Gates owned (53)

Each gate is one `MJ: Tests` row and one `NamedCheck` bundle (§2.7, D-063), written, registered, joined to its suite
and set `Active` in the task in "Flipped in" (§4.2), all in one commit. Thresholds are verbatim from the program's
gate reference (plans repo `reference/`). "Test name" is the row `Name`; "Check file" is under
`packages/TestingFramework/integration-test-suite/src/checks/` and names what its body measures: the harness (TS) or
sidecar pytest nodes through `PsGatePytest.Run` (paths relative to `Sidecar/src/python/`; "written M<k>" marks a node
that exists before its gate does). "Suite" abbreviates `Predictive Studio Gates — <Suite>`. "Mutation check" names the
product change under which the check fails (D-064); the flipping task records it as `**Mutation check G<id>:** …` and
its failing output in §11 as `**Mutation output G<id>:** <pasted assertion>`. The statistical gates' mutation checks run at a reduced seed count (owner, 2026-10-26).
Every gate is tier `mutation` (it trains, promotes or writes); none needs a live model.

Assignment notes (recorded as D3-11):
- A gate whose threshold includes a gate *outcome* (`model`/`keep-simple-baseline`/`no-signal`) belongs to M10, even
  when most of its work is baselines or intervals (G2.8 C2 → S4.5, G2.22 C1 → S1.3).
- G2.30 (W1 → S5.3) is selection on inner folds (no pruning while the upper bound reaches the leader, winner labelled
  optimistic) → M9; M5 provides the repeated folds it ranks on.
- G2.26 (T2p → S-T.4, blocked inner folds with gap and entity grouping on a panel) → M8 (series/panel validation).
- G2.24/G2.25 (new-entity mode, 0 shared keys) → M9 (holdout carve), using M5's grouped folds.
- F-PIT-2 closes in M3: M2 lets the label come from another entity (child-event and next-period rules), M3 lets
  features come from other entities (windowed aggregates, cross-entity selects).
- F-PIT-7 closes in M3 by refusing the Train operation's `asOf`/`labelEventDates` inputs by name; M11 removes the
  fields from the remote-operation type.
- A gate's pytest node may be written before its owning milestone because the code it measures exists earlier
  (D3-21): G2.30 (written M5.12), G2.4, G2.1, G2.2, G2.3 and G2.8 (written M6.8). The node runs under pytest from
  then on; the gate's row and check do not exist until the owner flips it — G2.30 and G2.4 in M9.6, G2.1–G2.3 and G2.8
  in M10.5 — so each gate is flipped exactly once, in the milestone this table names. Checks a later milestone adds for a gate it does not own (M9.1 for G2.28,
  M10.5's stored-row checks for G2.21, G2.33, G2.36, G2.37) are additional coverage, not flips.

### 4.4 Out of scope (owner)

- Model Registry columns on `MJ: ML Models` (`PredictionUnitID`, `EvaluationProtocolID`, `TrainingSnapshotID`,
  `TrainingRunID`, `ArtifactSha256`, `SnapshotHash`, `CodeVersion`, `FeatureSchemaHash`, `Delivery`), `PublishRules.ReverifyPublish`,
  the Status `PreSave` hook, `IncumbentCheck`, durable artifacts, scoring refusals and `ScoredRow` provenance,
  monitoring, publish records (approver `automated-gate` or a named user; a human sign-off only as the optional,
  default-off `PromotionRule.requiresHumanSignOff`, D-029), `MJ: ML Output Bindings` — **PR 4** (D-015). PR 3 stores lineage only in the model's existing
  `Lineage` JSON and the gate decision in the run's `ValidationResults`.
- Feature Pipelines writing effective-dated values and version pins in model lineage — **PR 5** (D-018). PR 3 adds the
  `EffectiveAsOf`/`InputAsOf` columns and reads them through the `feature-value` source when a pin is supplied.
- Model predictions stored as Feature Values — **PR 4** (D-058). PR 4 adds `'Model'` to `Source`, the nullable lineage
  columns `MLModelScoringBindingID`, `MLModelID`, `MLScoringRunID` and `InTraining`, makes `RecordProcessID` nullable
  with a CHECK by `Source` (`Pipeline`/`Human` rows require `RecordProcessID`; `Model` rows require the binding, model and
  run IDs, `InTraining` and `EffectiveAsOf`), and the `Model`-row key and read index. A `Model` row's `EffectiveAsOf` is PR 3's
  column, holding the scoring as-of date. PR 3 adds no constraint that ties `EffectiveAsOf` or `InputAsOf` to
  `RecordProcessID` or `Source`, so those changes need no PR 3 change.
- Agent token/cost/iteration caps, experiment `TokensUsed`, search-strategy policy (gates C1 → C3.1, W1 → C3.2) —
  **PR 5** (D-019). PR 3 records real compute (`ComputeSeconds`) and enforces the protocol's trainer budgets.
- The `decision-derived` feature *step* and its version pin — **PR 5** (D-013); PR 3 adds the `FeatureKind`.
- Shipped MoreCheese models and data fixes — **PR 6**.

  (`DECIMAL(18,3)`, D-019). `ComputeCost` stays: written as `ComputeSeconds × PS_COMPUTE_USD_PER_SECOND` from M5.11 on,

  Values`: Feature Pipeline rows (written effective-dated from PR 5) and the `Source = 'Model'` prediction rows PR 4

  (`CK_FeatureValue_InputAsOf`), so PR 4's nullable `RecordProcessID` and its `Source` CHECK sit beside them unchanged.

**JSON shapes stored in columns** (Core types, §5.4): `UnitRows`, `LabelRule`, `TaskType`, `CensoringRule`
(`Censoring`), `ChangeHistoryPolicy`, `TemporalSpec`, `DecisionSpec`, `IncumbentHeuristic`, `Actor` (`AuthoredBy`);
protocol columns hold `HoldoutSplit`, `InnerValidation`, `ProperScore`, `SecondaryMetric[]`, `BaselineSpec[]`,
`CalibrationMethod`, `ResamplingSpec`, `IntervalSpec`, `PromotionRule`, `AllowedOutcomes` (the literal tuple),
`LeakageAuditSpec`, `ProtocolExclusions`, `SliceSpec`, `PredictionIntervalSpec | null`, `ResidualDiagnosticsSpec |
null`, `RetrainTrigger[]`, `SearchStrategy`, `Budgets`; snapshot columns hold `FeatureColumnSpec[]` (`FeatureSpec`),
`SnapshotFeatureSchema` (`FeatureSchema`), `ColumnProvenance[]`, `FeatureVersionPin[]`, `UncoveredRowsCount[]`,
`ClassBalanceEntry[] | null`.

**`MJ: ML Training Runs.ValidationResults`** holds `TrainingRunResults` (Core `training-run-results.ts`, schema tag
`'ps-run-results/v2'`, D3-28): `{ schema, status: 'refused', refusal: TrainingRefusal }` or `{ schema, status:
'completed', unitResolution: UnitResolutionCounts, … }`. The `completed` variant gains members by milestone:
`legacy: LegacyTrainerMetrics | null` (M2), `legacyRequest: LegacyRequestConfig | null` (M4), `trainer:
StoredTrainerResult | null` and `trainerRequest: TrainerRequestConfig | null` (M6.7), `carve: HoldoutCarveSummary | null`
(M9.3), `gate: StoredGateRecord | null` (M10.3 — the gate decision lives here, D-015); M11.3 removes `legacy` and
`legacyRequest`. `TrainingRefusal` stages: `pipeline`, `unit`, `assembly` (M2), `trainer` (M6.7: `trainer-failed`,
`lineage-incomplete`; M9.4: `selection-invalid`), `carve` (M9.3), `gate` (M10.3: `sidecar-gate-mismatch`,
`missing-comparison`); `PipelineRefusal` gains `too-many-candidates`, `protocol-created-after-run`,
`protocol-unit-mismatch`, `protocol-invalid` (M9.2). Each new kind extends `TrainingRefusedError.DescribeTrainingRefusal` in the same task.
From M4 on, `unitResolution` is a copy of the snapshot's counts kept for reading convenience; the snapshot columns are
authoritative. Artifact bytes are never stored here (`StoredArtifactRef.fileId` points at `MJ: Files`).

**`MJ: ML Models.Lineage`** (existing JSON) gains: `predictionUnitId`, `predictionUnitVersion`, `labelVersion`,
`featureSpecVersion`, `trainingSnapshotId` (M4), `snapshotContentHash` (M4), `evaluationProtocolId` and
`artifactFormat: 'ps-predictor/v2'` (M6.7, trainer-path models), and keeps the legacy keys. PR 4 promotes these to FK columns.

**Casing per module (D-067; one casing per interface, never mixed).** camelCase + the
`case-violation-ok-legacy-back-compat` marker only for the persisted or wire shapes that mirror
`reference/contracts/contracts.ts`: `prediction-unit.ts` (C1, the unit columns), `assembly-contract.ts` (C2, snapshot
columns and files), `evaluation-protocol.ts` (C3, the protocol columns), `trainer-contract.ts` (C4, the sidecar wire),
the `StoredTrainerResult`/`StoredGateRecord`/`HoldoutCarveSummary`/`TrainingRunResults` stores (D3-04, D3-28) and
`GateInputs` (the parity case files, D3-57), `task-type.ts`'s `TaskType` (the C1 task-type column), `gate.ts`'s stored
and parity shapes `PairedComparison`, `GateDecision`, `GateReason`, `StoredInterval`, `StoredGateIntervals`,
`GateGuardInputs`, `GateGuardRefusal`, `store-schemas.ts`'s `RowProvenance` (`provenance.jsonl`) and
`snapshot-serialization.ts`'s `SnapshotFeatureColumnHeader` / `SnapshotMatrixHeader` (`matrix.jsonl` line 1). PascalCase
for every other new type and every class, interface method and static: `json-value.ts`, `task-type.ts` (`TaskTypeRules`,
`ScoreSemanticsResult`), `gate.ts` (`GateRules`, `GuardedGateDecision`, `IntervalsFromResult`), `incumbent-heuristic.ts`,
`store-schemas.ts` (`StoreSchemas`), `metrics-util.ts`, `evaluation-protocol-rules.ts` (`ProtocolRefusal`,
`EvaluationProtocolRules`), `holdout-carve.ts` (`CarveRow`), `selection.ts`, `trust.ts`, the M11 L0 helpers, every Engine
module below, the harness additions and the gate checks (§5.4 lists each type it introduces with its casing). The naming
check also walks type literals nested in an exported alias (`Extract<X, { kind: … }>`), so such a line carries the marker
on the line above (M3.3's `SeriesFeatureRef`); members of an exported interface are judged by name only.

**Names this section replaces** (D3-03, D3-20): runs reference `TrainingSnapshotID` and `EvaluationProtocolID`; there are
no snapshot-, protocol- or unit-version integer columns (read `Version` through the FK) and no pipeline or unit
reference on a protocol row (D3-06).

**`TrainingDeps` (Engine `training/types.ts`) gains optional seams**, each with a production default built from
`provider`/`contextUser`: `predictionUnits?: IPredictionUnitStore`, `assemblyMetadata?: IAssemblyMetadata`,
`dataAccess?: ICountingDataAccess`, `now?: () => Date` (M2); `history?: IRecordHistoryReader` (M3);
`snapshotFiles?: ISnapshotFileStore`, `holdoutCarver?: IHoldoutCarver` (M4); `trainer?: ITrainerEvaluator` (M6.7);
`protocolSource?: IEvaluationProtocolSource` (M9.2).

**Training engine flow** (D3-27): `resolvePipeline` (from M9.2 a unit pipeline without a bound protocol is refused
before a run row exists; from M11.3 every pipeline needs a unit and a protocol) → `createRunRow` →
`PredictionUnitRowReader.Read` → `UnitTargetValidator.ValidateUnitTargets` → `AsOfFeatureAssembler.Assemble` → `IHoldoutCarver.AssignRoles`
(M4 `TrailingFractionCarver`; **M9.3** the protocol's carver) → `TrainingSnapshotBuilder.Build` (M6.7 passes
`IncumbentScore`/`SliceFields` from the protocol) → **M4** `SnapshotRetrainer.TrainOnSnapshot` (legacy `TrainRequest`), or **M6.7**
`TrainerRequestBuilder.BuildTrainerRequest` → `ITrainerEvaluator.RunTrainer` → `TrainerRunRecorder.ApplyTrainerResultToRun` → store `trainer`/`trainerRequest`
(only path from M9.2) → **M10.3** `GateRecords.BuildStoredGateRecord` (TypeScript decision, sidecar mismatch refused) →
`createModelRow` (M6.7: finalist artifact; M10.3: the shipped artifact, none under `no-signal` or a heuristic member)
→ `finalizeRunSuccess`. Refusals at any step end in `finalizeRunRefused` (run `Status = 'Failed'`,
`ValidationResults.status = 'refused'`, `Notes` = the refusal's sentence) and a thrown `TrainingRefusedError`.

### 5.2 Data model — the migration (exact T-SQL)

File: `migrations/v6/V<yyyymmddhhmm>__v6.<minor>.x__PS_Honest_Training_Schema.sql`, named by M1.3 at execution time:
`<yyyymmddhhmm>` is the current UTC time when M1.3 starts, and it must sort after the newest `V…` file in
`migrations/v6/` at that moment (§8.2 A-SERIES timestamp check); `<minor>` is the newest series on `next` (today
`v6.2.x`; the folder is `v6` either way). Example: at the kickoff cut the newest file is
`V202610252000__v6.2.x__Content_Pipeline_Framework.sql`, so a migration written at 2026-10-27 09:15 UTC is
`V202610270915__v6.2.x__PS_Honest_Training_Schema.sql`. The §2.5 allowlist matches it as
`migrations/v6/V*__v6.*.x__PS_Honest_Training_Schema.sql`. This is the hand-written part;
§5.3 appends the CodeGen output. All new tables keep `TrackRecordChanges = 1` (CodeGen's default for new entities), so
every unit, protocol and snapshot write is audited in `MJ: Record Changes`.

```sql
/**************************************************************************************************
 * Migration: Predictive Studio — honest training (Prediction Units, Evaluation Protocols, Training Snapshots)
 *
 *   1. PredictionUnit      (MJ: Prediction Units)       — what one training row is, its decision date,
 *                                                         outcome rule, window, censoring, task type.
 *                                                         Immutable versions; Temporal Spec inside.
 *   2. EvaluationProtocol  (MJ: Evaluation Protocols)   — the grading rules, saved before any search.
 *                                                         Immutable versions.
 *   3. TrainingSnapshot    (MJ: Training Snapshots)     — the frozen, fingerprinted training data of a run.
 *   4. MLTrainingPipeline  + PredictionUnitID, EvaluationProtocolID
 *   5. MLTrainingRun       + TrainingSnapshotID, EvaluationProtocolID, CodeVersion, ComputeSeconds
 *   6. FeatureValue        + EffectiveAsOf, InputAsOf (the as-of column shared by pipeline rows and
 *                             PR 4's Source = 'Model' rows, D-058)
 *
 * A version row is never updated: "editing" inserts the next version (Version + 1, same LineageRootID).
 * Version 1's LineageRootID is its own ID (the client supplies the ID on insert).
 **************************************************************************************************/

-- ============================================================================
-- 1. PredictionUnit
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[PredictionUnit] (
    [ID]                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_PredictionUnit_ID] DEFAULT (newsequentialid()),
    [LineageRootID]       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    [Version]             INT              NOT NULL,
    [Name]                NVARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL,
    [Description]         NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    [UnitRows]            NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [LabelRule]           NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [LabelWindowDays]     INT              NOT NULL,
    [LabelGapDays]        INT              NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_PredictionUnit_LabelGapDays] DEFAULT (0),
    [TaskType]            NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [LabelVersion]        INT              NOT NULL,
    [Censoring]           NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [ChangeHistoryPolicy] NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [GroupKey]            NVARCHAR(255)    NULL,
    [TemporalSpec]        NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    [DecisionSpec]        NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [IncumbentHeuristic]  NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [AuthoredBy]          NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_PredictionUnit] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [UQ_PredictionUnit_Lineage_Version] UNIQUE ([LineageRootID], [Version]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_PredictionUnit_LineageRoot] FOREIGN KEY ([LineageRootID])
        REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[PredictionUnit] ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_PredictionUnit_Version] CHECK ([Version] >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_PredictionUnit_LineageRoot] CHECK (([Version] = 1 AND [LineageRootID] = [ID]) OR ([Version] > 1 AND [LineageRootID] <> [ID])),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_PredictionUnit_LabelVersion] CHECK ([LabelVersion] >= 1 AND [LabelVersion] <= [Version]),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_PredictionUnit_LabelWindowDays] CHECK ([LabelWindowDays] > 0),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_PredictionUnit_LabelGapDays] CHECK ([LabelGapDays] >= 0)
);
GO

EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'A Prediction Unit: what one training row is (one grain record, or one grain record per period of a dated child entity), its decision date, the outcome rule and the window over which the outcome is observed, how unresolved rows are censored, and the declared task type. Every ML Training Pipeline references exactly one version. Versions are immutable rows: editing a unit inserts the next version with the same LineageRootID, so a trained model keeps pointing at the version it used.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'ID of version 1 of this unit. Version 1 points at itself; every later version points at version 1.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LineageRootID';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Version number within the lineage, starting at 1. A saved version is never updated.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Version';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Display name of the unit, e.g. "Member renewal (person x membership period)".', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Name';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'What the unit predicts and for whom, in plain words.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Description';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON UnitRows: {kind:"grain", grainEntity, decisionDate, filter} or {kind:"grain-x-periods", grainEntity, childEntity, foreignKey, periodDate, filter}. Defines what one row is and its decision date.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'UnitRows';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON LabelRule: how the outcome of a row is read — a column on the row, the next period of the same grain record, or an event in a dated child entity — always within the window that starts LabelGapDays after the decision date and lasts LabelWindowDays.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LabelRule';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Length in days of the outcome window. A row whose window ends after the data cutoff is censored (excluded and counted).', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LabelWindowDays';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Days between the decision date and the start of the outcome window.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LabelGapDays';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON TaskType: binary {classOrder, adverseIndex}, multiclass {classOrder, adverseIndices}, continuous, count, non-negative {tweediePower}, or forecast {valueKind}. Which class a score refers to and the adverse direction are derived from it, never stored separately.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'TaskType';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Outcome-definition version: equals the previous version''s LabelVersion when LabelRule, LabelWindowDays, LabelGapDays and TaskType are unchanged, and that plus one otherwise.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LabelVersion';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON CensoringRule: {rule:"exclude-unresolved", cutoff} where cutoff is {kind:"corpus-end", entity, field}, {kind:"now"} or {kind:"fixed", at}. Rows whose outcome window has not closed at the cutoff are excluded and counted.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Censoring';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON ChangeHistoryPolicy: {onUncoveredRow:"refuse"|"exclude-and-count", externalSourceRows:"as-of-detection-time"|"ineligible"} — what as-of assembly does when a decision date precedes the change history of a field updated in place.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'ChangeHistoryPolicy';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Field on the row whose value keeps one entity''s rows together in grouped folds and the new-entity report; NULL means the grain record key.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'GroupKey';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON TemporalSpec for series and panels: timeColumn, horizonPeriods, lags, rollingWindows, period, seasonality. Every lag and rolling-window endLag is at least horizonPeriods. Required when TaskType is forecast. Versioned with the unit.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'TemporalSpec';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON DecisionSpec: the action the prediction serves, the actor role, the capacity per period (for precision at capacity) and the period.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'DecisionSpec';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON IncumbentHeuristic: {kind:"none"} or {kind:"rule", name, scoreExpression} — today''s rule of thumb, scored as a named comparator on the same holdout.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'IncumbentHeuristic';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON Actor who authored this version: {kind:"human", userId} (a user), or an automated author {kind:"agent", agentRunId}, {kind:"scheduled-job", scheduledJobRunId} or {kind:"system", component}.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'PredictionUnit', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'AuthoredBy';
GO

-- ============================================================================
-- 2. EvaluationProtocol
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[EvaluationProtocol] (
    [ID]                    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_EvaluationProtocol_ID] DEFAULT (newsequentialid()),
    [LineageRootID]         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    [Version]               INT              NOT NULL,
    [Name]                  NVARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL,
    [Description]           NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    [Holdout]               NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [InnerValidation]       NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [Seed]                  INT              NOT NULL,
    [HoldoutAccessBudget]   INT              NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_EvaluationProtocol_HoldoutAccessBudget] DEFAULT (1),
    [PrimaryScore]          NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [SecondaryMetrics]      NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [Baselines]             NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [Calibration]           NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [Resampling]            NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [Intervals]             NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [Promotion]             NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [AllowedOutcomes]       NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [LeakageAudit]          NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [Exclusions]            NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [Slices]                NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [PredictionIntervals]   NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    [ResidualDiagnostics]   NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    [RetrainTriggers]       NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [SearchStrategy]        NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [Budgets]               NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [MinMinorityClassRows]  INT              NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_EvaluationProtocol_MinMinorityClassRows] DEFAULT (20),
    [GuardFieldsEditableBy] NVARCHAR(20)     NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_EvaluationProtocol_GuardFieldsEditableBy] DEFAULT (N'non-agent'),
    [AuthoredBy]            NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_EvaluationProtocol] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [UQ_EvaluationProtocol_Lineage_Version] UNIQUE ([LineageRootID], [Version]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_EvaluationProtocol_LineageRoot] FOREIGN KEY ([LineageRootID])
        REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[EvaluationProtocol] ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_EvaluationProtocol_Version] CHECK ([Version] >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_EvaluationProtocol_LineageRoot] CHECK (([Version] = 1 AND [LineageRootID] = [ID]) OR ([Version] > 1 AND [LineageRootID] <> [ID])),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_EvaluationProtocol_HoldoutAccessBudget] CHECK ([HoldoutAccessBudget] = 1),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_EvaluationProtocol_MinMinorityClassRows] CHECK ([MinMinorityClassRows] >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_EvaluationProtocol_GuardFieldsEditableBy] CHECK ([GuardFieldsEditableBy] IN (N'non-agent', N'human-only'))
);
GO

EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'An Evaluation Protocol: the grading rules of a pipeline, saved before any candidate trains — the locked holdout, inner validation, primary proper score, fixed baselines, calibration, intervals, promotion rule and the three allowed outcomes (model, keep-simple-baseline, no-signal), the leakage audit, slices and budgets. Every training run references the exact version it was graded under. Versions are immutable rows; editing inserts the next version. Replaces the ValidationStrategy and LeakageGuard JSON of ML Training Pipelines.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'ID of version 1 of this protocol. Version 1 points at itself.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LineageRootID';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Version number within the lineage, starting at 1. A saved version is never updated.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Version';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Display name of the protocol.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Name';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'What the protocol is for, in plain words.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Description';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON HoldoutSplit (guard field): {kind:"date-carved", dateColumn, cutoff, holdoutEnd, newEntityReport} or {kind:"rolling-origin", origins (>= 5), horizonPeriods, gapPeriods, minTrainPeriods, window}.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Holdout';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON InnerValidation over development rows only: repeated-stratified-kfold, grouped-kfold or blocked-time.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'InnerValidation';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Random seed for every split, fold, bootstrap and estimator of a run under this protocol.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Seed';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'How many times the locked holdout may be scored per run: always 1, for one declared finalist.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'HoldoutAccessBudget';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON ProperScore {family, metric}: the only metric that ranks candidates and gates outcomes. Its family must equal the pipeline unit''s task kind.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'PrimaryScore';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON array of secondary metric keys (auc, accuracy, f1, precision, recall, r2, calibration-slope); reported with intervals, never used to rank.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'SecondaryMetrics';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON array of BaselineSpec fitted on every run: dummy, one-feature, glm, naive, seasonal-naive, incumbent-heuristic.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Baselines';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON CalibrationMethod: platt, isotonic or auto, always fit on a disjoint calibration fold; not-applicable for regression.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Calibration';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON ResamplingSpec: {kind:"none"} or {kind:"in-fold", method}; resampling never touches holdout rows.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Resampling';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON IntervalSpec: level 0.95, method, resamples and the paired test for model-versus-comparator differences.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Intervals';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON PromotionRule (guard field): comparators, incumbent, margin (>= 0), lowerBoundLevel 0.95, pairedOn same-holdout-rows, decisionTable Q13+Q14+Q15.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Promotion';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON array, exactly ["model","keep-simple-baseline","no-signal"]: a protocol cannot omit no-signal.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'AllowedOutcomes';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON LeakageAuditSpec (guard field): held-out single-feature AUC ceiling, time-shifted-label test, drop-column test, per-source-column importance aggregation, high-cardinality ID check.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LeakageAudit';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON ProtocolExclusions (guard field): {denyFields, denySources} — columns and sources that never enter the feature matrix (the former LeakageGuard deny lists).', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Exclusions';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON SliceSpec: {outOfTime, subgroups} — each slice is reported with the primary score and its interval.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Slices';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON PredictionIntervalSpec {method, nominalCoverage} for continuous, count and non-negative tasks; NULL when not requested.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'PredictionIntervals';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON ResidualDiagnosticsSpec {acfLags, ljungBoxAlpha} for series and panels; NULL otherwise.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'ResidualDiagnostics';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON array of RetrainTrigger declared for monitoring (outcome-degradation, calibration-drift).', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'RetrainTriggers';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON SearchStrategy: {kind:"random", candidates} or {kind:"guided", method, equalCostComparisonId}.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'SearchStrategy';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON Budgets (guard field): maxComputeSeconds, maxTokens, maxCandidates, hardStop true.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'Budgets';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Smallest minority-class row count in the locked holdout for which a classification gate may return model; below it the gate cannot ship a model.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'MinMinorityClassRows';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'Who may change the guard fields (Holdout, Promotion, LeakageAudit, Exclusions, Budgets and this setting) in the next version: non-agent (default: any author except an agent tool call — a user, a non-agent API caller, a scheduled job or the system) or human-only (optional: only a version authored by a user). Every author''s version passes the same guard-field validation.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'GuardFieldsEditableBy';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'JSON Actor who authored this version.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'EvaluationProtocol', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'AuthoredBy';
GO

-- ============================================================================
-- 3. MLTrainingPipeline + unit and protocol references (before TrainingSnapshot, which references pipelines)
-- ============================================================================
ALTER TABLE [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[MLTrainingPipeline]
    ADD [PredictionUnitID]     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
        [EvaluationProtocolID] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL;
GO
ALTER TABLE [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[MLTrainingPipeline]
    ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MLTrainingPipeline_PredictionUnit] FOREIGN KEY ([PredictionUnitID])
            REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[PredictionUnit] ([ID]),
        CONSTRAINT [FK_MLTrainingPipeline_EvaluationProtocol] FOREIGN KEY ([EvaluationProtocolID])
            REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[EvaluationProtocol] ([ID]);
GO
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'The exact Prediction Unit version this pipeline trains on. NULL only on a pipeline created before Predictive Studio 6.3 that has not been migrated; such a pipeline cannot be trained.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'MLTrainingPipeline', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'PredictionUnitID';
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'The exact Evaluation Protocol version every training run of this pipeline is graded under. Its primary score family must equal the unit''s task kind.', @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'${flyway:defaultSchema}', @level1type = N'TABLE', @level1name = N'MLTrainingPipeline', @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'EvaluationProtocolID';
GO

-- ============================================================================
-- 4. TrainingSnapshot
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[TrainingSnapshot] (
    [ID]                           UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_TrainingSnapshot_ID] DEFAULT (newsequentialid()),
    [ContentHash]                  NVARCHAR(64)     NOT NULL,
    [PipelineID]                   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    [PredictionUnitID]             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    [LabelVersion]                 INT              NOT NULL,
    [FeatureSpecVersion]           INT              NOT NULL,
    [EvaluationProtocolID]         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    [StorageProviderID]            UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    [MatrixFileID]                 UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    [MatrixSha256]                 NVARCHAR(64)     NOT NULL,
    [MatrixSizeBytes]              BIGINT           NOT NULL,
    [RowManifestFileID]            UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    [RowManifestSha256]            NVARCHAR(64)     NOT NULL,
    [RowManifestSizeBytes]         BIGINT           NOT NULL,
    [ProvenanceFileID]             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    [ProvenanceSha256]             NVARCHAR(64)     NOT NULL,
    [ProvenanceSizeBytes]          BIGINT           NOT NULL,
    [ManifestRowCount]             INT              NOT NULL,
    [HoldoutRowCount]              INT              NOT NULL,
    [FeatureSpec]                  NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [FeatureSchema]                NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [FeatureSchemaHash]            NVARCHAR(64)     NOT NULL,
    [ColumnProvenance]             NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    [PinnedFeatureVersions]        NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_TrainingSnapshot_PinnedFeatureVersions] DEFAULT (N'[]'),
    [RowsRead]                     INT              NOT NULL,
    [ReadComplete]                 BIT              NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_TrainingSnapshot_ReadComplete] DEFAULT (1),

    [DuplicateRowsRemoved]         INT              NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_TrainingSnapshot_DuplicateRowsRemoved] DEFAULT (0),
    [ClassBalance]                 NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    [DataCutoff]                   DATETIMEOFFSET   NOT NULL,
    [AssemblyCodeVersion]          NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_TrainingSnapshot] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [UQ_TrainingSnapshot_ContentHash] UNIQUE ([ContentHash]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_TrainingSnapshot_Pipeline] FOREIGN KEY ([PipelineID])
        REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[MLTrainingPipeline] ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_TrainingSnapshot_PredictionUnit] FOREIGN KEY ([PredictionUnitID])
        REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[PredictionUnit] ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_TrainingSnapshot_EvaluationProtocol] FOREIGN KEY ([EvaluationProtocolID])
        REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[EvaluationProtocol] ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_TrainingSnapshot_StorageProvider] FOREIGN KEY ([StorageProviderID])
        REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[FileStorageProvider] ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_TrainingSnapshot_MatrixFile] FOREIGN KEY ([MatrixFileID])
        REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[File] ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_TrainingSnapshot_RowManifestFile] FOREIGN KEY ([RowManifestFileID])
        REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[File] ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_TrainingSnapshot_ProvenanceFile] FOREIGN KEY ([ProvenanceFileID])
        REFERENCES [${flyway:defaultSchema}].[File] ([ID]),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_TrainingSnapshot_ReadComplete] CHECK ([ReadComplete] = 1),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_TrainingSnapshot_HashLengths] CHECK (LEN([ContentHash]) = 64 AND LEN([MatrixSha256]) = 64 AND LEN([RowManifestSha256]) = 64 AND LEN([ProvenanceSha256]) = 64 AND LEN([FeatureSchemaHash]) = 64),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_TrainingSnapshot_Counts] CHECK ([ManifestRowCount] >= 0 AND [HoldoutRowCount] >= 0 AND [HoldoutRowCount] <= [ManifestRowCount] AND [RowsRead] >= [ManifestRowCount] AND [CensoredRowsExcluded] >= 0 AND [LabelKnownRowsExcluded] >= 0 AND [EmptyLabelRowsExcluded] >= 0 AND [DuplicateRowsRemoved] >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT [CK_TrainingSnapshot_Versions] CHECK ([LabelVersion] >= 1 AND [FeatureSpecVersion] >= 1)
);
GO
```

### 5.3 How the CodeGen output is generated and appended (M1.3)

1. On your own database, built clean to `next` (§2.3), with the migration file containing **only** §5.2:
   `pnpm mj migrate` → `pnpm mj codegen` (full run: it writes entity/field metadata, views, procs, the TypeScript
   entities and Angular forms, and a SQL capture `migrations/v6/CodeGen_Run_<timestamp>.sql`).
2. Append the capture to the migration after **at least 50 blank lines** and the standard header:
   ```bash
   M=$(ls migrations/v6/V*__v6.*.x__PS_Honest_Training_Schema.sql)   # the one file M1.3 Step 2 created (§5.2 naming)
   C=$(ls migrations/v6/CodeGen_Run_*.sql)
   { for i in $(seq 1 60); do echo; done
     printf '/* =====================================================================================\n'
     printf ' * EVERYTHING BELOW THIS BLOCK WAS GENERATED BY THE MEMBERJUNCTION CODEGEN TOOL.\n'
     printf ' *\n * Entity and EntityField metadata for MJ: Prediction Units, MJ: Evaluation Protocols and\n'
     printf ' * MJ: Training Snapshots; new fields of MJ: ML Training Pipelines, MJ: ML Training Runs and\n'
     printf ' * MJ: Feature Values; base views, spCreate/spUpdate/spDelete, permissions, extended properties.\n'
     printf ' * Do NOT edit by hand: if the DDL above changes, re-run CodeGen and replace this section.\n'
     printf ' * ===================================================================================== */\n\n'
     cat "$C"; } >> "$M"
   rm "$C"
   ```
3. Gates: `node .github/scripts/check-migration-entityfield-sequence.mjs` → no finding (every `EntityField` INSERT uses
   `(SELECT COALESCE(MAX([Sequence]), 0) + 1 FROM … WHERE [EntityID] = '<id>')`); `npm run check:codegen-tail` → pass.
4. Clean-room proof: drop and recreate your database, then `pnpm mj migrate` → `pnpm mj codegen --skipfiles` →
   `pnpm mj sync push --dir=metadata --ci` → `pnpm mj codegen --skipdb`. Expected: no new `CodeGen_Run_*.sql`, and
   `git status --short packages/MJCoreEntities packages/MJServer packages/Angular` shows no change against the files
   step 1 generated.
5. Commit the generated TypeScript (`packages/MJCoreEntities/src/generated/entities/__mj.ts`,
   `packages/MJServer/src/generated/**`, `packages/Angular/Explorer/core-entity-forms/src/lib/generated/**`, and the
   four `mj-class-registrations.ts` manifests §2.5 lists when the prebuild changes them) with the migration; never `packages/MJAPI/src/generated/**`, `packages/GeneratedEntities/**`, `mj.config.*`.

The same procedure applies to any later milestone that adds DDL. None is planned after M1: M2–M12 add no table or
column (M9–M11 add metadata JSON only). A milestone that finds it needs a column stops and asks the owner (D-062): a
second migration is a scope addition, written under this procedure only after the owner's explicit yes (recorded in
§9.3).

### 5.4 Interfaces and types (signatures; implementations are in the milestone tasks)

Every exported type this section introduces carries its one casing (program D-067): PascalCase for in-process shapes;
camelCase only for persisted or wire shapes that mirror a shipped contract, each member line marked
`// case-violation-ok-legacy-back-compat: contracts.ts wire name` (§2.5). No interface mixes the two.

```ts
// ---- Core/src/prediction-unit.ts (M1) ----
// Casing: camelCase + marker (persisted shape mirroring `reference/contracts/contracts.ts` C1, stored in `MJ: Prediction Units` columns)
export type DecisionDateRule =
  | { readonly kind: 'column'; readonly column: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'column-offset'; readonly column: string; readonly offsetDays: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'fixed'; readonly date: string; readonly advance?: 'each-run' };   // yyyy-mm-dd, cross-sectional data; 'each-run' = the engine re-versions the unit to the run day (D3-43)
// Casing: camelCase + marker (persisted shape mirroring `reference/contracts/contracts.ts` C1, stored in `MJ: Prediction Units` columns)
export interface RowFilter { readonly field: string; readonly op: 'eq' | 'neq' | 'in' | 'not-null' | 'is-null'; readonly values: readonly (string | number | boolean)[] }
// Casing: camelCase + marker (persisted shape mirroring `reference/contracts/contracts.ts` C1, stored in `MJ: Prediction Units` columns)
export type UnitRows =
  | { readonly kind: 'grain'; readonly grainEntity: string; readonly decisionDate: DecisionDateRule; readonly filter: readonly RowFilter[] }
  | { readonly kind: 'grain-x-periods'; readonly grainEntity: string; readonly childEntity: string; readonly foreignKey: string; readonly periodDate: string; readonly filter: readonly RowFilter[] };
// Casing: camelCase + marker (persisted shape mirroring `reference/contracts/contracts.ts` C1, stored in `MJ: Prediction Units` columns)
export type LabelRule =
  | { readonly kind: 'column'; readonly column: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'next-period'; readonly periodIndexField: string; readonly offset: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'child-event'; readonly childEntity: string; readonly foreignKey: string; readonly ownerKeyField: string | null;
      readonly dateField: string; readonly aggregate: 'exists' | 'count' | 'sum'; readonly valueField: string | null; readonly filter: readonly RowFilter[] };
// Casing: camelCase + marker (persisted shape mirroring `reference/contracts/contracts.ts` C1, stored in `MJ: Prediction Units` columns)
export type CensoringCutoff = { readonly kind: 'corpus-end'; readonly entity: string; readonly field: string } | { readonly kind: 'now' } | { readonly kind: 'fixed'; readonly at: string };
// Casing: camelCase + marker (persisted shape mirroring `reference/contracts/contracts.ts` C1, stored in `MJ: Prediction Units` columns)
export interface CensoringRule { readonly rule: 'exclude-unresolved'; readonly cutoff: CensoringCutoff }
// Casing: camelCase + marker (persisted shape mirroring `reference/contracts/contracts.ts` C1, stored in `MJ: Prediction Units` columns)
export interface ChangeHistoryPolicy { readonly onUncoveredRow: 'refuse' | 'exclude-and-count'; readonly externalSourceRows: 'as-of-detection-time' | 'ineligible' }
// Casing: camelCase + marker (persisted shape mirroring `reference/contracts/contracts.ts` C1, stored in `MJ: Prediction Units` columns)
export interface PredictionUnitSpec {
  readonly id: string; readonly lineageRootId: string; readonly version: number; readonly name: string;
  readonly rows: UnitRows;
  readonly label: { readonly rule: LabelRule; readonly windowDays: number; readonly gapDays: number; readonly outcome: TaskType; readonly labelVersion: number };
  readonly censoring: CensoringRule; readonly history: ChangeHistoryPolicy; readonly groupKey: string | null;
  readonly temporal: TemporalSpec | null; readonly decision: DecisionSpec; readonly incumbent: IncumbentHeuristic; readonly authoredBy: Actor;
}
// Casing: PascalCase (static members on the owning class)
export class PredictionUnit {   // static members on one owner (coding standards §2)
  static ParsePredictionUnitRow(row: PredictionUnitColumns): ParseResult<PredictionUnitSpec>;
  static UnitRowEntityName(rows: UnitRows): string;              // grainEntity or childEntity
  static DescribeLabelRule(spec: PredictionUnitSpec): string;    // the legacy TargetVariable text
  static LabelDefinitionChanged(previous: PredictionUnitSpec, next: PredictionUnitSpec): boolean;
  static UnitReferencedFields(spec: PredictionUnitSpec): readonly { readonly entity: string; readonly field: string | null }[];
}

// ---- Core/src/assembly-contract.ts (M1) ----
// Casing: camelCase + marker (persisted shape mirroring `reference/contracts/contracts.ts` C2, stored in snapshot columns and files)
export interface WindowedAggregateSource {
  readonly kind: 'windowed-aggregate'; readonly childEntity: string; readonly foreignKey: string; readonly ownerKeyField: string | null;
  readonly dateField: string; readonly endDateField: string | null; readonly voidedAtField: string | null;
  readonly aggregate: 'count' | 'sum' | 'mean' | 'distinct' | 'days-since' | 'active-at';
```
