### 5.5 Remote operations, Actions, backward compatibility

- **Train Model operation / Action** (`PredictiveStudio.TrainModel`, `Train ML Model`): input unchanged until M11.
  From M3 a non-empty `asOf` or `labelEventDates` is refused by name (`TrainingRefusedError`, F-PIT-7); `maxRows` is
  refused for unit pipelines (a capped read is not a complete read). M11 removes the three fields from the
  remote-operation type (`metadata/remote-operations/types/predictive-studio-train-model.input.ts`) and adds the
  read-only output fields `trainingSnapshotId`, `gateOutcome`.
- **Legacy pipelines** (`PredictionUnitID IS NULL`): M2–M10 keep the existing path (target entity rows, the existing
  executor, trailing-fraction holdout) so the integration tier and existing demo pipelines keep training, with two
  refusals added in M3: a legacy pipeline whose `AsOfStrategy.Mode` is `column` or `offset` is refused
  (`unit-required`: as-of now lives only in a unit; keeps G0.8 green), and a legacy pipeline cannot be graded by a
  protocol. **M11** migrates every existing pipeline (creates a unit from `TargetEntity`/`TargetVariable`/`ProblemType`/
  `AsOfStrategy` and a protocol from `ValidationStrategy`/`LeakageGuard`) and then deletes the legacy path; from M11 a
  pipeline with a NULL unit or protocol is refused (`unit-required`, `protocol-required`).
- **Existing models** keep scoring through the legacy executor (their lineage has no `predictionUnitId`); unit-based
  models score through `AsOfFeatureAssembler`. PR 4 re-evaluates or demotes pre-change models (M2 of the source plan).
- `ProblemType` columns on `MJ: ML Training Pipelines` and `MJ: ML Models` stay, written from the unit's task
  (`TaskTypeRules.LegacyProblemTypeForTask`) and checked by the pipeline's `ValidateAsync`; PR 4 decides their removal.

### 5.6 UI surfaces (owned by M10.4 and M11; listed so earlier milestones keep names stable)

M11.1 adds its components beside the existing Predictive Studio components, in
`packages/Angular/Explorer/dashboards/src/PredictiveStudio/components/` (owner, 2026-10-26: no new package; they are
written to the L1 discipline — inputs in, events out, no data access in L1, L2 composites reading data only through
`BaseAngularComponent` — so a later extraction of the whole PS widget set is a mechanical move and its own decision): `mj-ps-evaluation-results`, `mj-ps-protocol-summary`, `mj-ps-protocol-editor`,
`mj-ps-unit-summary`, `mj-ps-unit-editor`, `mj-ps-run-evaluation`, `mj-ps-versioned-list` and the lineage and
pipeline-binding components, and the L0 Core helpers of §5.1 (`protocol-rows.ts`, `protocol-edit.ts`, `unit-edit.ts`).
M11.2 builds the L3 surfaces in `packages/Angular/Explorer/dashboards/src/PredictiveStudio/` only (owner, 2026-10-26,
D3-74: the record panels live beside the widgets in `record-panels/` and register with the Predictive Studio chunk;
`ng-core-entity-forms` is not modified): Studio sections `units` and `protocols`, record panels for unit and
protocol versions (draft → save as next version; history from `LineageRootID`; the editor previews the server's
refusals, including the `GuardFieldsEditableBy` author rule of D3-40, and edits that setting), the pipeline-bindings panel (one unit version and one protocol version per pipeline), and the
model form's evaluation panel showing the snapshot counts (resolved/censored/label-known/empty/uncovered) and the
protocol results (scores with intervals, baselines, comparisons, the gate outcome, branch and reason). M10.4 rewrites
the trust verdict as a rendering of the stored decision and updates its consumers. They read only the names in §5.1.

## 6. Milestones

Sequence: **M1 → M2 → M3 → M4 → M5 → M6 → M7 → M8 → M9 → M10 → M11 → M12**, one milestone at a time on the PR
branch (M7 and M8 edit the sidecar modules M6 creates, so they are not parallel-safe). Only M11 splits: M11.1–M11.2
(UI) and M11.3–M11.5 (server, operations, guide) may run on two sub-branches (conventions §3). Every milestone opens
with its **Milestone start** line and closes with **Exit tests**, **Milestone exit**, the **Milestone end** sequence and
its **Checkpoint commit** (conventions §3; `templates/plan-template.md`). The pieces every milestone shares are fixed
here; the milestones name their own values (counts, gates, suites).

**Milestone start** (every milestone, conventions §3): `git fetch origin && git merge origin/next`; resolve conflicts;
rebuild the touched packages; run refresh trigger (c) if the merge touched an anchored file (§5.7); then
`git diff --name-only HEAD..origin/next -- migrations/ metadata-optional/integration-test/` and record the output in the
§11 entry — a re-timed migration or a bundle added on `next` changes this milestone's `check-registry.test.ts` total
(add the bundles `next` added to every total this plan states).

**Gate commands** (§2.7; run from `$MJ` with the agent's env file loaded, MJAPI on 4031 started on the truth sidecar
(§2.3) and `pnpm --filter @memberjunction/predictive-studio-truth-suite run truth:provision` done):

```bash
cd $MJ
# one gate, by its row Name (§4.1 "Test name") → it passes
MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test run "<dataset> -> <criterion>"
# one suite → every member passes (n of n)
MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — <Suite>"
# bundle pins and row/suite parity → 0 failed
cd packages/TestingFramework/integration-test-suite && pnpm run build && pnpm test; cd $MJ
# the active PR 3 gate rows in the database → the cumulative count the milestone names
sqlcmd -S "$DB_HOST,$DB_PORT" -U "$DB_USERNAME" -P "$DB_PASSWORD" -C -d "$DB_DATABASE" -h -1 -W -Q "SET NOCOUNT ON; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM __mj.Test WHERE Tags LIKE '%owner:PR3%' AND Status='Active'"
```

**The keep-list run** (§4.3; every milestone's exit tests run it and state its counts):

```bash
MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — Containment"       # → 10 of 10 passed
MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — Feature Pipelines" # → 5 of 5 passed (RUN_AGENT_TESTS=0: 4 passed, 1 skipped)
MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Integration Tests — Deterministic"           # → 117 tests; the pass/fail/skip counts M1's start recorded, no new failure
```

**Gate flip** (§2.7, D3-62, D3-59). A gate task flips each of its gates with these steps, in the milestone's one
checkpoint commit, with the names §4.1 and the task's gate table fix (row file, `Name`, check type, check file, export):

1. **Row** `metadata-optional/integration-test/tests/gates/<row file>`, the shipped G0.10 row's shape
   (`.gate-W1-S5.4.json`): `TypeID` `"@lookup:MJ: Test Types.Name=Integration Test"`, `Name` `"<dataset> -> <criterion>"`,
   `Description` `"Gate G<id> (phase <1|2>, dataset <dataset>, criterion <criterion>): <§4.1 threshold
   verbatim>. It fails when <§4.1 "Mutation check">."` (what it proves), `Status` `"Active"`, `Tags`
   `"[\"gate\",\"G<id>\",\"owner:PR3\",\"phase:<1|2>\",\"dataset:<dataset>\",\"criterion:<criterion>\"]"` (a `#k` criterion without its space: `criterion:S2.1#2`),
   `InputDefinition` `{}`, `ExpectedOutcomes` `{ "summary": "<one sentence of the pass condition>" }`, `Configuration`
   `{ "tier": "mutation", "transport": "client", "checks": [{ "type": "<check type>" }] }`, `primaryKey.ID` from `uuidgen`.
   The row is written `Active`: there is no earlier `Pending` row (D3-62).
2. **Check file** `packages/TestingFramework/integration-test-suite/src/checks/<check type>.checks.ts`: one `NamedCheck`
   in `export const <export>: NamedCheck[]`, `Id: '<check type>.G<id>'`, `Name: 'G<id> <dataset> → <criterion>: <the
   task table's one-line threshold>'`, `RequiresMutation: true`, its `Fn` as the task gives it (a harness body or a
   pytest body, below), then `for (const c of <export>) IntegrationCheckRegistry.Instance.Register(c);` and
   `IntegrationCheckRegistry.Instance.RegisterLifecycle('<check type>', PsGate.Lifecycle);`.
3. **Barrel**: `export * from './checks/<check type>.checks';` appended to `integration-test-suite/src/index.ts`.
4. **Pins** in `integration-test-suite/src/__tests__/check-registry.test.ts`: `'<check type>': 1` in
   `EXPECTED_BUNDLE_COUNTS`, the `toHaveLength(<n>)` bundle total the task states (154 at `6e2b57017b`, + 1 per gate,
   + any bundle `next` added), and `'<check type>.G<id>'` in the gated-skip snapshot's `RequiresMutation` list.
5. **Suite entry** in the gate's suite file (§2.7 table): one `MJ: Test Suite Tests` element
   `{ "fields": { "SuiteID": "@parent:ID", "TestID": "@lookup:MJ: Tests.Name=<dataset> -> <criterion>", "Sequence": <next>, "Status": "Active" }, "primaryKey": { "ID": "<uuidgen>" } }`.
   The first gate into a suite creates its file in the shipped Containment suite's shape (`[{ "fields": { "Name",
   "Description" (what it holds, "Needs MJAPI and the truth sidecar running and `pnpm run truth:provision` done. Run
   with: MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite \"<suite name>\""), "Status": "Active" },
   "relatedEntities": { "MJ: Test Suite Tests": [ … ] }, "primaryKey": { "ID": "<uuidgen>" } }]`).
6. **Runtime check**: the pins/parity command (→ 0 failed), `pnpm mj sync push --dir=metadata-optional/integration-test --ci`
   (→ exit 0), restart MJAPI (§2.3), the one-gate command (→ pass, its `Detail` and `Measured` recorded in §11).
7. **Mutation check** — its own step line of the form `**Mutation check <gate id>:** <§4.1's product change> → \`<dataset> -> <criterion>\` fails`:
   make the product change, run the one-gate command once, record the failing `PsGate.Assert` text in §11 (the
   milestone's handoff entry) as its own line `**Mutation output G<id>:** <pasted assertion>`, undo the change, re-run →
   pass (D-064, conventions §5a). `tools/milestone-exit.mjs`'s `mutation-checks` passes a changed gate row only when the
   plan has its mutation-check step line AND §11 has its non-empty `**Mutation output G<id>:**` line.

**Gate bodies.** A harness body is the task's measurement, verbatim, as a static of the subject's helper class in
`integration-test-suite/src/checks/ps-gates/ps-gate-<subject>.ts` returning the truth suite's `GateMeasurement`
(`PsGateSpecs` is the shipped precedent; §2.7), and the check's `Fn` is

```ts
Fn: async (ctx) => {
  const h = await PsGate.Harness(ctx);
  PsGate.Assert(await <Subject>.<Measure>(h));
},
```

A pytest body (D3-61; node ids relative to `Sidecar/src/python/`, §4.1 "Check file") is

```ts
Fn: async () => {
  const nodes = ['tests/gates/<file>.py::<test>'] as const;
  const expectedCases = <n>;   // the task table's case count: a parametrized node contributes one case per parameter set
  const r = await PsGatePytest.Run(nodes);
  PsGate.Assert({
    Passed: r.Failed === 0 && r.Errors === 0 && r.NotCollected.length === 0 && r.Collected === expectedCases && r.Passed === expectedCases,
    Measured: { collected: r.Collected, passed: r.Passed, failed: r.Failed, errors: r.Errors, notCollected: r.NotCollected.join(' ') },
    Detail: `${r.Passed} of ${expectedCases} pytest case(s) passed; not collected: ${r.NotCollected.join(', ') || 'none'}`,
  });
},
```

with `import { PsGatePytest } from './ps-gates/ps-gate-pytest';` (M5.12). A **statistical pytest body** (G2.1, G2.2, G2.3,
G2.13, G2.35 with `seedSet = 400`; G2.4 with `seedSet = 60`) is the pytest body plus the seed trace, so a run under
`PS_SEED_LIMIT` can never pass as the full gate unnoticed (D3-63):

```ts
  const seedSet = <400 | 60>;
  const limit = Number(process.env.PS_SEED_LIMIT ?? '0');            // the variable test_seeds400.py reads (M6.8)
  const seedsRun = limit > 0 ? Math.min(limit, seedSet) : seedSet;
  // … Run and Passed as the pytest body …
  Measured: { …the pytest body's fields, seedSet, seedsRun, seedLimit: process.env.PS_SEED_LIMIT ?? null },
  Detail: `${r.Passed} of ${expectedCases} pytest case(s) passed over ${seedsRun} of ${seedSet} seeds${limit > 0 ? ` (PS_SEED_LIMIT=${limit})` : ''}`,
```

A body reads a refusal as
`TrainAttempt.RefusalCode` / `ScoreAttempt.RefusalCode` (`ContainmentProbe.WasRefusedBeforeTraining(attempt, '<CODE>')`)
and the run row's `ValidationResults.refusal` for the detailed `{ kind, stage }` (D3-60). The pytest nodes read PR 2's
generated-data cache (§2.4); the milestone that first needs a seed set generates it with
`cd $MJ/packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/TruthSuite && pnpm run truth:data -- --set <base|t2|n400> [--only <id>]` (`base`
M5.2; `t2` and C2's `n400` M6.8; T2p's `n400` M8.3; N1c's, N1r's and W2-noise's `n400` M10.5). PR 2's CLI takes
`base | t2`; M5.2 adds `n400` (D3-73).

**Coding-standards invariants enforced at every milestone (`npm run check:standards` + step 2 self-audit):**
- **CamelCase wire/persisted interface lines (D-039, D-067):** `npm run check:standards` (`naming-conventions`, severity `error` in `.mj-standards.json`) judges every member of every exported interface, type literal and enum. Only the persisted/wire shapes that §5.1's "Casing per module" paragraph lists as camelCase keep camelCase, and there every camelCase property line carries `// case-violation-ok-legacy-back-compat: contracts.ts wire name` on the line or the line above (as shown in M10.3's `run-evaluation.ts`); every other new exported type is PascalCase. The plan's snippets do not repeat the marker on every line — add it when writing the file.
- **Deprecated aliases in touched files (§2.5, D-053):** when a task edits an existing file that carries `@deprecated` lowercase aliases (by the task that first edits each, verified on `origin/next` @ `6e2b57017b`: `Engine/src/index.ts` in M2.3 (`isModelingPlanApproved`), `operations/delegation.ts` in M2.6 (eight stubs), `scoring/ml-model-inference-processor.ts` in M3.6 (`matrixToFeatureRows`; its test moves to `MLModelInferenceProcessor.MatrixToFeatureRows`), `metrics-util.ts` / `maintenance-engine.ts` / `maintenance/metrics.ts` / `experiment/seams.ts` in M6.2, `ml-sidecar.ts` in M6.6, `evaluation-record.ts` / `importance-display.ts` in M7.2, `agent/pipeline-builder-agent.ts` (four aliases; its test moves to the `PipelineBuilderAgent` statics) and `ml-experiment-results-viewer.component.ts` + `.html` (`formatScore`, `formatImportance`; the template's three bindings become `FormatScore` / `FormatImportance`) in M9.4, `pipeline-builder.ts` / `business-predictions.view-models.ts` / `ps-predictions-resource.component.ts` / `predictive-studio-agent-context.ts` (six aliases) in M10.4, `predictive-studio.nav.ts` / `ps-studio-resource.component.ts` in M11.2), delete the `@deprecated` aliases in that file and update any remaining callers (including inline Angular template bindings) in the same commit. No tool enforces this; the milestone self-audit runs `git grep -n "@deprecated" -- <touched files>` and records 0 lines.
- **No plan/finding/gate IDs in product code or comments (D-043, D-049):** product files in `packages/` (outside `TruthSuite` and `integration-test-suite/src/checks/ps-*`) must not contain plan IDs (`M1`–`M12`, `D3-xx`, `PR 3`), finding IDs (`F-LK-1`, `F-TR-6`, `F-PIT-1`, etc.), or gate/criterion IDs (`G1.x`, `G2.x`, `S1.x`) in identifiers, strings, or comments — state the domain rule in plain words when writing the file from the plan snippet.

**Milestone end** (every milestone, in this order, conventions §3): (1) the milestone's exit tests, each count recorded
in its §11 entry; (2) the standards self-audit of `git diff origin/next...HEAD` for this milestone's commits against
`$PLANS/reference/coding-standards.md` (findings fixed first), recorded in the §11 entry; (3) every task step of the
milestone ticked (`- [x]`); (4) the §11 handoff entry `### <date> — <agent> — M<k>` (`templates/handoff-entry.md`);
(5) the **Milestone exit** command → exit 0, its summary pasted into the commit body; (6) one checkpoint commit with the
milestone's message, files staged by name (`git add <file>`; never `-A`); (7) `git branch -vv` shows
`[origin/ps/pr-3-honest-training]` (M11 sub-branches: their own upstream), then `git push`.

### M1 — Schema and contracts  ·  parallel-safe: no  ·  depends on: PR 2 merged (refresh trigger b done)

**Outcome:** the three new tables and six new columns exist with their CodeGen output appended; the generated entity
classes are committed; Core exports `TaskType` (replacing `ProblemType` as the declared task), the unit, assembly and
protocol contract types with browser-safe parsers, and `FeatureKind` includes `decision-derived` (D-013); the server
entity subclasses refuse any update of a saved unit, protocol or snapshot version and refuse a pipeline whose unit and
protocol disagree. #4166/#4104 reconciliation is recorded (D3-01).

**Milestone start:** the §6 preamble's steps; M1 is the first, so before any change it also records in §11 the
baseline the later milestones compare with: the keep-list run's three counts (Containment 10 of 10, Feature Pipelines
5 of 5, Deterministic: its pass/fail/skip counts of 117 — the run-based count is taken here) and

```ts
/**
 * @module json-value
 *
 * Typed JSON values and the small helpers the persisted-shape parsers share. Browser-safe, no runtime dependencies.
 * Every Predictive Studio JSON column is parsed into a {@link JsonValue} first and then narrowed with these helpers,
 * so no parser ever casts.
 */

/** Any JSON value, as `JSON.parse` produces it. */
export type JsonValue = string | number | boolean | null | JsonValue[] | JsonObject;
/** A JSON object. */
export interface JsonObject {
  readonly [key: string]: JsonValue;
}

/** The typed value, or every problem found (each a full sentence naming the column or field). */
export type ParseResult<T> = { readonly Ok: true; readonly Value: T } | { readonly Ok: false; readonly Errors: readonly string[] };

/**
 * The typed readers every persisted-shape parser shares: the ParseResult factories, the JSON-text parser and the
 * field readers that narrow a JsonObject without casting. Static members on one owner (coding standards §2) so
 * callers write JsonParse.JsonString(o, key).
 */
export class JsonParse {
  /** A successful parse carrying its typed value. */
  public static ParseOk<T>(value: T): ParseResult<T> {
    return { Ok: true, Value: value };
  }

  /** A failed parse carrying every problem found (each a full sentence). */
  public static ParseFail<T>(...errors: string[]): ParseResult<T> {
    return { Ok: false, Errors: errors };
  }

  /** Parse a JSON column. A blank or malformed text is a failure naming the column. */
  public static ParseJsonText(text: string | null | undefined, column: string): ParseResult<JsonValue> {
    if (text === null || text === undefined || text.trim().length === 0) {
      return JsonParse.ParseFail(`${column} is empty; it must hold JSON`);
    }
    try {
      const value: JsonValue = JSON.parse(text);
      return JsonParse.ParseOk(value);
    } catch (e) {
      return JsonParse.ParseFail(`${column} is not valid JSON (${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)})`);
    }
  }

  /** True for a JSON object (not an array, not null). */
  public static IsJsonObject(v: JsonValue | undefined): v is JsonObject {
    return typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
  }

  /** A non-blank string property, else null. */
  public static JsonString(o: JsonObject, key: string): string | null {
    const v = o[key];
    return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0 ? v : null;
  }

  /** A finite number property, else null. */
  public static JsonNumber(o: JsonObject, key: string): number | null {
    const v = o[key];
    return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
  }

  /** An integer property, else null. */
  public static JsonInteger(o: JsonObject, key: string): number | null {
    const v = JsonParse.JsonNumber(o, key);
    return v !== null && Number.isInteger(v) ? v : null;
  }

  /** A boolean property, else null. */
  public static JsonBoolean(o: JsonObject, key: string): boolean | null {
    const v = o[key];
    return typeof v === 'boolean' ? v : null;
  }

  /** An array of strings, else null (any non-string element fails the whole array). */
  public static JsonStringArray(o: JsonObject, key: string): string[] | null {
    const v = o[key];
    if (!Array.isArray(v)) return null;
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (const x of v) {
      if (typeof x !== 'string') return null;
      out.push(x);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** An array of integers, else null. */
  public static JsonIntegerArray(o: JsonObject, key: string): number[] | null {
    const v = o[key];
    if (!Array.isArray(v)) return null;
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (const x of v) {
      if (typeof x !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(x)) return null;
      out.push(x);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** A nested object, else null. */
  public static JsonObjectField(o: JsonObject, key: string): JsonObject | null {
    const v = o[key];
    return JsonParse.IsJsonObject(v) ? v : null;
  }

  /** A nested array, else null. */
  public static JsonArrayField(o: JsonObject, key: string): JsonValue[] | null {
    const v = o[key];
    return Array.isArray(v) ? v : null;
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * @module task-type
 *
 * The declared task type of a Prediction Unit (C1). It replaces the two-valued `ProblemType` as the statement of
 * what is predicted. Class order is stated once, in artifact order; the scored class and the adverse class are
 * indices into it and are derived by {@link ScoreSemantics}, never stored as a second copy that could disagree.
 */
import { JsonParse, type JsonObject, type JsonValue, type ParseResult } from './json-value';

export type TaskType =
  | { readonly kind: 'binary'; readonly classOrder: readonly [string, string]; readonly adverseIndex: 0 | 1 }
  | { readonly kind: 'multiclass'; readonly classOrder: readonly string[]; readonly adverseIndices: readonly number[] }
  | { readonly kind: 'continuous' }
  | { readonly kind: 'count' }
  | { readonly kind: 'non-negative'; readonly tweediePower: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'forecast'; readonly valueKind: 'continuous' | 'count' | 'non-negative' };

export type TaskKind = TaskType['kind'];

export const TASK_KINDS: readonly TaskKind[] = ['binary', 'multiclass', 'continuous', 'count', 'non-negative', 'forecast'];

export interface ScoreSemanticsResult {
  readonly ScoreRefersTo: string | null;
  readonly AdverseDirection: 'higher-score-is-adverse' | 'lower-score-is-adverse' | 'not-applicable';
}

/**
 * The rules derived from a declared TaskType: score semantics, classification test, the legacy ProblemType value,
 * and the TaskType parser (static members on one owner, coding standards §2).
 */
export class TaskTypeRules {
  /** The one derivation of score semantics; UI and scoring call this, never store a copy. */
  public static ScoreSemantics(task: TaskType): ScoreSemanticsResult {
    switch (task.kind) {
      case 'binary':
        return {
          ScoreRefersTo: task.classOrder[1],
          AdverseDirection: task.adverseIndex === 1 ? 'higher-score-is-adverse' : 'lower-score-is-adverse',
        };
      case 'multiclass':
      case 'continuous':
      case 'count':
      case 'non-negative':
      case 'forecast':
        return { ScoreRefersTo: null, AdverseDirection: 'not-applicable' };
    }
  }

  /** True for the kinds whose labels are classes. */
  public static IsClassificationTask(task: TaskType): task is Extract<TaskType, { kind: 'binary' | 'multiclass' }> {
    return task.kind === 'binary' || task.kind === 'multiclass';
  }

  /** The value written to the legacy `ProblemType` columns of pipelines and models (CHECK: classification|regression). */
  public static LegacyProblemTypeForTask(task: TaskType): 'classification' | 'regression' {
    return TaskTypeRules.IsClassificationTask(task) ? 'classification' : 'regression';
  }

  /** Parse a `TaskType` JSON value; every problem is reported. */
  public static ParseTaskType(v: JsonValue): ParseResult<TaskType> {
    if (!JsonParse.IsJsonObject(v)) {
      return JsonParse.ParseFail('TaskType must be a JSON object with a "kind"');
    }
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    switch (kind) {
      case 'binary':
        return TaskTypeRules.parseBinary(v);
      case 'multiclass':
        return TaskTypeRules.parseMulticlass(v);
      case 'continuous':
        return JsonParse.ParseOk({ kind: 'continuous' });
      case 'count':
        return JsonParse.ParseOk({ kind: 'count' });
      case 'non-negative': {
        const power = JsonParse.JsonNumber(v, 'tweediePower');
        return power !== null && power > 1 && power < 2
          ? JsonParse.ParseOk({ kind: 'non-negative', tweediePower: power })
          : JsonParse.ParseFail('non-negative tweediePower must be a number strictly between 1 and 2');
      }
      case 'forecast': {
        const valueKind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'valueKind');
        return valueKind === 'continuous' || valueKind === 'count' || valueKind === 'non-negative'
          ? JsonParse.ParseOk({ kind: 'forecast', valueKind })
          : JsonParse.ParseFail('forecast valueKind must be continuous, count or non-negative');
      }
      default:
        return JsonParse.ParseFail(`TaskType kind "${kind || ''}" is not one of ${TASK_KINDS.join(', ')}`);
    }
  }

  private static binaryIndex(v: JsonValue | undefined): 0 | 1 | null {
    return v === 0 ? 0 : v === 1 ? 1 : null;
  }

  private static parseBinary(v: JsonObject): ParseResult<TaskType> {
    const order = JsonParse.JsonStringArray(v, 'classOrder');
    const adverse = TaskTypeRules.binaryIndex(v['adverseIndex']);
    const errors: string[] = [];
    if (order === null || order.length !== 2) {
      errors.push('binary classOrder must list exactly two class labels, in artifact order');
    } else if (order[0] === order[1]) {
      errors.push('binary classOrder labels must differ');
    }
    if (adverse === null) {
      errors.push('binary adverseIndex must be 0 or 1');
    }
    if (errors.length > 0 || order === null || adverse === null) {
      return { Ok: false, Errors: errors };
    }
    return JsonParse.ParseOk({ kind: 'binary', classOrder: [order[0], order[1]], adverseIndex: adverse });
  }

  private static parseMulticlass(v: JsonObject): ParseResult<TaskType> {
    const order = JsonParse.JsonStringArray(v, 'classOrder');
    const adverse = JsonParse.JsonIntegerArray(v, 'adverseIndices');
    const errors: string[] = [];
    if (order === null || order.length < 3) {
      errors.push('multiclass classOrder must list at least three class labels (two classes is a binary task)');
    } else if (new Set(order).size !== order.length) {
      errors.push('multiclass classOrder labels must be unique');
    }
    if (adverse === null) {
      errors.push('multiclass adverseIndices must be an array of integers');
    } else if (order !== null && adverse.some((i) => i < 0 || i >= order.length)) {
      errors.push(`multiclass adverseIndices must index classOrder (0..${order.length - 1})`);
    }
    if (errors.length > 0 || order === null || adverse === null) {
      return { Ok: false, Errors: errors };
    }
    return JsonParse.ParseOk({ kind: 'multiclass', classOrder: order, adverseIndices: adverse });
  }
}
```

```ts
    expect(problems).toContain('Promotion margin must be a finite number >= 0');
    expect(problems).toContain('Holdout rolling-origin needs at least 5 origins (4 given)');
  });
  it('refuses a primary score whose metric does not belong to its family', () => {
    const problems = EvaluationProtocol.GetEvaluationProtocolShapeProblems(protocolRow({ PrimaryScore: JSON.stringify({ family: 'count', metric: 'rmse' }) }));
    expect(problems).toContain('PrimaryScore metric "rmse" is not a proper score of family "count" (allowed: poisson-deviance)');
  });
});

describe('ToNonNegative', () => {
  it('throws below zero', () => {
    expect(() => EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(-1)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(0)).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * @module prediction-unit
 *
 * The Prediction Unit (C1): what one training row is, its decision date, the outcome rule and window, censoring,
 * task type, Temporal Spec, decision and incumbent heuristic. These are the persisted JSON shapes of the
 * `MJ: Prediction Units` columns and their browser-safe parser. A unit version is immutable; the Temporal
 * Spec is part of the row and versioned with it.
 */
import { UUIDsEqual } from '@memberjunction/global';
import {
  JsonParse,
  type JsonObject, type JsonValue, type ParseResult,
} from './json-value';
import { TaskTypeRules, type TaskKind, type TaskType } from './task-type';

export type DecisionDateRule =
  | { readonly kind: 'column'; readonly column: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'column-offset'; readonly column: string; readonly offsetDays: number }
  /** One decision date for every row (cross-sectional data). `advance: 'each-run'` = before each run the engine saves the
   *  next unit version with the run's UTC day as the date; absent = the date never moves. */
  | { readonly kind: 'fixed'; readonly date: string; readonly advance?: 'each-run' };

export interface RowFilter {
  readonly field: string;
  readonly op: 'eq' | 'neq' | 'in' | 'not-null' | 'is-null';
  readonly values: readonly (string | number | boolean)[];
}

export type UnitRows =
  | { readonly kind: 'grain'; readonly grainEntity: string; readonly decisionDate: DecisionDateRule; readonly filter: readonly RowFilter[] }
  | {
      readonly kind: 'grain-x-periods';
      readonly grainEntity: string;
      readonly childEntity: string;
      readonly foreignKey: string;
      readonly periodDate: string;
      readonly filter: readonly RowFilter[];
    };

export type LabelRule =
  | { readonly kind: 'column'; readonly column: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'next-period'; readonly periodIndexField: string; readonly offset: number }
  | {
      readonly kind: 'child-event';
      readonly childEntity: string;
      readonly foreignKey: string;
      /** Field on the unit row whose value the child's foreign key matches; null = the row's entity key. */
      readonly ownerKeyField: string | null;
      readonly dateField: string;
      readonly aggregate: 'exists' | 'count' | 'sum';
      readonly valueField: string | null;
      readonly filter: readonly RowFilter[];
    };

export type CensoringCutoff =
  | { readonly kind: 'corpus-end'; readonly entity: string; readonly field: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'now' }
  | { readonly kind: 'fixed'; readonly at: string };

export interface CensoringRule {
  readonly rule: 'exclude-unresolved';
  readonly cutoff: CensoringCutoff;
}

export interface ChangeHistoryPolicy {
  readonly onUncoveredRow: 'refuse' | 'exclude-and-count';
  readonly externalSourceRows: 'as-of-detection-time' | 'ineligible';
}

export interface TemporalSpec {
  readonly timeColumn: string;
  readonly horizonPeriods: number;
  readonly lags: readonly number[];
  readonly rollingWindows: readonly { readonly endLag: number; readonly periods: number; readonly aggregate: 'mean' | 'sum' | 'min' | 'max' }[];
  readonly period: 'day' | 'week' | 'month' | 'year';
  readonly seasonality: number | null;
}

export interface DecisionSpec {
  readonly action: string;
  readonly actorRole: string;
  readonly capacityPerPeriod: number | null;
  readonly period: 'day' | 'week' | 'month' | 'quarter' | 'year';
}

export type IncumbentHeuristic = { readonly kind: 'none' } | { readonly kind: 'rule'; readonly name: string; readonly scoreExpression: string };

/**
 * Who authored a version or started an action — data, never a permission by itself. `human` is a user; `agent`,
 * `scheduled-job` and `system` are the automated authors, and every rule in this PR accepts them unless a protocol
 * opts into `GuardFieldsEditableBy: 'human-only'`. The publish record adds the `automated-gate` approver
 * (an automatic publish).
 */
export type Actor =
  | { readonly kind: 'human'; readonly userId: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'agent'; readonly agentRunId: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'scheduled-job'; readonly scheduledJobRunId: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'system'; readonly component: string };

/** The `MJ: Prediction Units` columns the parser reads (the generated entity satisfies this structurally). */
export interface PredictionUnitColumns {
  ID: string;
  LineageRootID: string;
  Version: number;
  Name: string;
  UnitRows: string;
  LabelRule: string;
  LabelWindowDays: number;
  LabelGapDays: number;
  TaskType: string;
  LabelVersion: number;
  Censoring: string;
  ChangeHistoryPolicy: string;
  GroupKey: string | null;
  TemporalSpec: string | null;
  DecisionSpec: string;
  IncumbentHeuristic: string;
  AuthoredBy: string;
}

export interface PredictionUnitSpec {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly lineageRootId: string;
  readonly version: number;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly rows: UnitRows;
  readonly label: { readonly rule: LabelRule; readonly windowDays: number; readonly gapDays: number; readonly outcome: TaskType; readonly labelVersion: number };
  readonly censoring: CensoringRule;
  readonly history: ChangeHistoryPolicy;
  readonly groupKey: string | null;
  readonly temporal: TemporalSpec | null;
  readonly decision: DecisionSpec;
  readonly incumbent: IncumbentHeuristic;
  readonly authoredBy: Actor;
}

export type UnitRefusal =
  | { readonly kind: 'single-valued-target'; readonly value: string; readonly rows: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'task-type-mismatch'; readonly declared: TaskKind; readonly observed: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'unresolved-reference'; readonly entity: string; readonly field: string | null }
  | { readonly kind: 'lag-inside-horizon'; readonly lag: number; readonly horizonPeriods: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'rolling-window-inside-horizon'; readonly endLag: number; readonly horizonPeriods: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'missing-decision-date'; readonly entity: string; readonly rows: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'no-resolved-rows'; readonly censored: number; readonly labelKnown: number; readonly emptyLabel: number };

export type UnitValidation =
  | { readonly status: 'valid'; readonly observedLevels: number; readonly eligibleRows: number; readonly censoredRows: number }
  | { readonly status: 'refused'; readonly reason: UnitRefusal };

const ISO_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

/**
 * The Prediction Unit's parser and derivations: parse a unit row, name its row entity, describe its label rule,
 * detect an outcome-definition change and list the fields it references (static members on one owner, coding
 * standards §2).
 */
export class PredictionUnit {
  /** Parse every JSON column of a unit row and check the cross-field rules; all problems are reported. */
  public static ParsePredictionUnitRow(row: PredictionUnitColumns): ParseResult<PredictionUnitSpec> {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const json = (text: string | null, column: string): JsonValue | null => {
      const r = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(text, column);
      if (!r.Ok) {
        errors.push(...r.Errors);
        return null;
      }
      return r.Value;
    };
    const rows = PredictionUnit.parseUnitRows(json(row.UnitRows, 'UnitRows'), errors);
    const rule = PredictionUnit.parseLabelRule(json(row.LabelRule, 'LabelRule'), errors);
    const taskJson = json(row.TaskType, 'TaskType');
    const task = taskJson === null ? null : PredictionUnit.collect(TaskTypeRules.ParseTaskType(taskJson), errors);
    const censoring = PredictionUnit.parseCensoring(json(row.Censoring, 'Censoring'), errors);
    const history = PredictionUnit.parseHistoryPolicy(json(row.ChangeHistoryPolicy, 'ChangeHistoryPolicy'), errors);
    const temporal = row.TemporalSpec === null || row.TemporalSpec.trim().length === 0 ? null : PredictionUnit.parseTemporalSpec(json(row.TemporalSpec, 'TemporalSpec'), errors);
    const decision = PredictionUnit.parseDecisionSpec(json(row.DecisionSpec, 'DecisionSpec'), errors);
    const incumbent = PredictionUnit.parseIncumbent(json(row.IncumbentHeuristic, 'IncumbentHeuristic'), errors);
    const authoredBy = PredictionUnit.parseActor(json(row.AuthoredBy, 'AuthoredBy'), errors);
    PredictionUnit.checkScalarColumns(row, errors);
    if (rule?.kind === 'next-period' && rows !== null && rows.kind !== 'grain-x-periods') errors.push('LabelRule next-period requires UnitRows kind grain-x-periods');
    if (task?.kind === 'forecast' && temporal === null) errors.push('A forecast task requires a TemporalSpec');

    if (errors.length > 0 || rows === null || rule === null || task === null || censoring === null || history === null || decision === null || incumbent === null || authoredBy === null) {
      return { Ok: false, Errors: errors.length > 0 ? errors : ['Prediction Unit row is incomplete'] };
    }
    return {
      Ok: true,
      Value: {
        id: row.ID,
        lineageRootId: row.LineageRootID,
        version: row.Version,
        name: row.Name,
        rows,
        label: { rule, windowDays: row.LabelWindowDays, gapDays: row.LabelGapDays, outcome: task, labelVersion: row.LabelVersion },
        censoring,
        history,
        groupKey: row.GroupKey,
        temporal,
        decision,
        incumbent,
        authoredBy,
      },
    };
  }

  /** The entity whose rows are the unit's rows. */
  public static UnitRowEntityName(rows: UnitRows): string {
    return rows.kind === 'grain' ? rows.grainEntity : rows.childEntity;
  }

  /** The text written to the legacy `TargetVariable` column. */
  public static DescribeLabelRule(spec: PredictionUnitSpec): string {
    const rule = spec.label.rule;
    const window = `within ${spec.label.windowDays} days${spec.label.gapDays > 0 ? ` after a ${spec.label.gapDays}-day gap` : ''}`;
    switch (rule.kind) {
      case 'column':
        return `${rule.column} ${window}`;
      case 'next-period':
        return `next period (${rule.periodIndexField} + ${rule.offset}) ${window}`;
      case 'child-event':
        return `${rule.aggregate} of ${rule.childEntity}.${rule.valueField || rule.dateField} ${window}`;
    }
  }

  /** True when the outcome definition (rule, window, gap or task type) differs — the LabelVersion must then be bumped. */
  public static LabelDefinitionChanged(previous: PredictionUnitSpec, next: PredictionUnitSpec): boolean {
    const key = (s: PredictionUnitSpec): string => JSON.stringify([s.label.rule, s.label.windowDays, s.label.gapDays, s.label.outcome]);
    return key(previous) !== key(next);
  }

  /** Every entity (and field, where one is named) the unit refers to — checked against metadata at save. */
  public static UnitReferencedFields(spec: PredictionUnitSpec): readonly { readonly entity: string; readonly field: string | null }[] {
    const out: { entity: string; field: string | null }[] = [];
    const rowEntity = PredictionUnit.UnitRowEntityName(spec.rows);
    out.push({ entity: spec.rows.grainEntity, field: null });
    if (spec.rows.kind === 'grain') {
      if (spec.rows.decisionDate.kind !== 'fixed') out.push({ entity: rowEntity, field: spec.rows.decisionDate.column });
    } else {
      out.push({ entity: rowEntity, field: spec.rows.foreignKey }, { entity: rowEntity, field: spec.rows.periodDate });
    }
    for (const f of spec.rows.filter) out.push({ entity: rowEntity, field: f.field });
    const rule = spec.label.rule;
    if (rule.kind === 'column') out.push({ entity: rowEntity, field: rule.column });
    if (rule.kind === 'next-period') out.push({ entity: rowEntity, field: rule.periodIndexField });
    if (rule.kind === 'child-event') {
      out.push({ entity: rule.childEntity, field: rule.foreignKey }, { entity: rule.childEntity, field: rule.dateField });
      if (rule.valueField) out.push({ entity: rule.childEntity, field: rule.valueField });
      if (rule.ownerKeyField) out.push({ entity: rowEntity, field: rule.ownerKeyField });
    }
    if (spec.censoring.cutoff.kind === 'corpus-end') out.push({ entity: spec.censoring.cutoff.entity, field: spec.censoring.cutoff.field });
    if (spec.groupKey) out.push({ entity: rowEntity, field: spec.groupKey });
    if (spec.temporal) out.push({ entity: rowEntity, field: spec.temporal.timeColumn });
    return out;
  }

  /** The non-JSON column rules: version and lineage root, label version, window, gap and group key. */
  private static checkScalarColumns(row: PredictionUnitColumns, errors: string[]): void {
    // Case-insensitive: SQL Server returns upper-case UUIDs, PostgreSQL lower-case.
    const isOwnRoot = UUIDsEqual(row.LineageRootID, row.ID);
    if (!Number.isInteger(row.Version) || row.Version < 1) errors.push(`Version must be an integer >= 1 (${row.Version})`);
    if (row.Version === 1 && !isOwnRoot) errors.push('Version 1 must be its own lineage root (LineageRootID = ID)');
    if (row.Version > 1 && isOwnRoot) errors.push('A version above 1 must point at version 1 of its lineage, not at itself');
    if (row.LabelVersion < 1 || row.LabelVersion > row.Version) errors.push(`LabelVersion must be between 1 and Version (${row.LabelVersion} > ${row.Version})`);
    if (!Number.isInteger(row.LabelWindowDays) || row.LabelWindowDays <= 0) errors.push('LabelWindowDays must be a positive integer');
    if (!Number.isInteger(row.LabelGapDays) || row.LabelGapDays < 0) errors.push('LabelGapDays must be an integer >= 0');
    if (row.GroupKey !== null && row.GroupKey.trim().length === 0) errors.push('GroupKey must be NULL or a field name');
  }

  private static collect<T>(r: ParseResult<T>, errors: string[]): T | null {
    if (r.Ok) return r.Value;
    errors.push(...r.Errors);
    return null;
  }

  private static parseDecisionDate(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): DecisionDateRule | null {
    if (v === null) {
      errors.push('UnitRows.decisionDate must be an object');
      return null;
    }
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    if (kind === 'column') {
      const column = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'column');
      if (column) return { kind, column };
    } else if (kind === 'column-offset') {
      const column = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'column');
      const offsetDays = JsonParse.JsonInteger(v, 'offsetDays');
      if (column && offsetDays !== null) return { kind, column, offsetDays };
    } else if (kind === 'fixed') {
      const date = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'date');
      const advance = v['advance'];
      if (date && ISO_DATE.test(date) && advance === undefined) return { kind, date };
      if (date && ISO_DATE.test(date) && advance === 'each-run') return { kind, date, advance };
    }
    errors.push('UnitRows.decisionDate must be {kind:"column",column}, {kind:"column-offset",column,offsetDays} or {kind:"fixed",date:"yyyy-mm-dd",advance?:"each-run"}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseFilters(v: JsonValue[] | null, where: string, errors: string[]): RowFilter[] {
    if (v === null) return [];
    const out: RowFilter[] = [];
    for (const item of v) {
      if (!JsonParse.IsJsonObject(item)) {
        errors.push(`${where} filter entries must be objects`);
        continue;
      }
      const field = JsonParse.JsonString(item, 'field');
      const op = JsonParse.JsonString(item, 'op');
      const rawValues = JsonParse.JsonArrayField(item, 'values') || [];
      const values: (string | number | boolean)[] = [];
      for (const x of rawValues) {
        if (typeof x === 'string' || typeof x === 'number' || typeof x === 'boolean') values.push(x);
      }
      if (!field || (op !== 'eq' && op !== 'neq' && op !== 'in' && op !== 'not-null' && op !== 'is-null')) {
        errors.push(`${where} filter needs a field and an op of eq, neq, in, not-null or is-null`);
        continue;
      }
      if ((op === 'eq' || op === 'neq') && values.length !== 1) errors.push(`${where} filter ${field} ${op} needs exactly one value`);
      if (op === 'in' && values.length === 0) errors.push(`${where} filter ${field} in needs at least one value`);
      out.push({ field, op, values });
    }
    return out;
  }

  private static parseUnitRows(v: JsonValue | null, errors: string[]): UnitRows | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    if (!JsonParse.IsJsonObject(v)) {
      errors.push('UnitRows must be a JSON object');
      return null;
    }
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    const grainEntity = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'grainEntity');
    const filter = PredictionUnit.parseFilters(JsonParse.JsonArrayField(v, 'filter'), 'UnitRows', errors);
    if (kind === 'grain' && grainEntity) {
      const decisionDate = PredictionUnit.parseDecisionDate(JsonParse.JsonObjectField(v, 'decisionDate'), errors);
      return decisionDate ? { kind, grainEntity, decisionDate, filter } : null;
    }
    if (kind === 'grain-x-periods' && grainEntity) {
      const childEntity = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'childEntity');
      const foreignKey = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'foreignKey');
      const periodDate = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'periodDate');
      if (childEntity && foreignKey && periodDate) return { kind, grainEntity, childEntity, foreignKey, periodDate, filter };
    }
    errors.push('UnitRows must be {kind:"grain", grainEntity, decisionDate, filter} or {kind:"grain-x-periods", grainEntity, childEntity, foreignKey, periodDate, filter}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseLabelRule(v: JsonValue | null, errors: string[]): LabelRule | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    if (!JsonParse.IsJsonObject(v)) {
      errors.push('LabelRule must be a JSON object');
      return null;
    }
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    if (kind === 'column') {
      const column = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'column');
      if (column) return { kind, column };
    } else if (kind === 'next-period') {
      const periodIndexField = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'periodIndexField');
      const offset = JsonParse.JsonInteger(v, 'offset');
      if (periodIndexField && offset !== null && offset >= 1) return { kind, periodIndexField, offset };
    } else if (kind === 'child-event') {
      const childEntity = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'childEntity');
      const foreignKey = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'foreignKey');
      const dateField = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'dateField');
      const aggregate = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'aggregate');
      const valueField = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'valueField');
      if (childEntity && foreignKey && dateField && (aggregate === 'exists' || aggregate === 'count' || aggregate === 'sum')) {
        if (aggregate === 'sum' && !valueField) {
          errors.push('LabelRule child-event sum needs a valueField');
          return null;
        }
        return {
          kind, childEntity, foreignKey, dateField, aggregate, valueField,
          ownerKeyField: JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'ownerKeyField'),
          filter: PredictionUnit.parseFilters(JsonParse.JsonArrayField(v, 'filter'), 'LabelRule', errors),
        };
      }
    }
    errors.push('LabelRule must be {kind:"column",column}, {kind:"next-period",periodIndexField,offset>=1} or {kind:"child-event",childEntity,foreignKey,dateField,aggregate,valueField,ownerKeyField,filter}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseCensoring(v: JsonValue | null, errors: string[]): CensoringRule | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const cutoff = JsonParse.IsJsonObject(v) && JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'rule') === 'exclude-unresolved' ? JsonParse.JsonObjectField(v, 'cutoff') : null;
    if (cutoff !== null) {
      const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(cutoff, 'kind');
      if (kind === 'now') return { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind } };
      if (kind === 'fixed') {
        const at = JsonParse.JsonString(cutoff, 'at');
        if (at && ISO_DATE.test(at)) return { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind, at } };
      }
      if (kind === 'corpus-end') {
        const entity = JsonParse.JsonString(cutoff, 'entity');
        const field = JsonParse.JsonString(cutoff, 'field');
        if (entity && field) return { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind, entity, field } };
      }
    }
    errors.push('Censoring must be {rule:"exclude-unresolved", cutoff} with cutoff {kind:"corpus-end",entity,field}, {kind:"now"} or {kind:"fixed",at:"yyyy-mm-dd"}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseHistoryPolicy(v: JsonValue | null, errors: string[]): ChangeHistoryPolicy | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    if (JsonParse.IsJsonObject(v)) {
      const onUncoveredRow = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'onUncoveredRow');
      const externalSourceRows = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'externalSourceRows');
      if ((onUncoveredRow === 'refuse' || onUncoveredRow === 'exclude-and-count') && (externalSourceRows === 'as-of-detection-time' || externalSourceRows === 'ineligible')) {
        return { onUncoveredRow, externalSourceRows };
      }
    }
    errors.push('ChangeHistoryPolicy must be {onUncoveredRow:"refuse"|"exclude-and-count", externalSourceRows:"as-of-detection-time"|"ineligible"}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseTemporalSpec(v: JsonValue | null, errors: string[]): TemporalSpec | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    if (!JsonParse.IsJsonObject(v)) {
      errors.push('TemporalSpec must be a JSON object');
      return null;
    }
    const timeColumn = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'timeColumn');
    const horizon = JsonParse.JsonInteger(v, 'horizonPeriods');
    const lags = JsonParse.JsonIntegerArray(v, 'lags');
    const period = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'period');
    const seasonality = v['seasonality'] === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonInteger(v, 'seasonality');
    const windowsRaw = JsonParse.JsonArrayField(v, 'rollingWindows') || [];
    const before = errors.length;
    if (!timeColumn) errors.push('TemporalSpec.timeColumn is required');
    if (horizon === null || horizon < 1) errors.push('TemporalSpec.horizonPeriods must be an integer >= 1');
    if (lags === null) errors.push('TemporalSpec.lags must be an array of integers');
    if (period !== 'day' && period !== 'week' && period !== 'month' && period !== 'year') errors.push('TemporalSpec.period must be day, week, month or year');
    const rollingWindows: { endLag: number; periods: number; aggregate: 'mean' | 'sum' | 'min' | 'max' }[] = [];
    for (const w of windowsRaw) {
      const endLag = JsonParse.IsJsonObject(w) ? JsonParse.JsonInteger(w, 'endLag') : null;
      const periods = JsonParse.IsJsonObject(w) ? JsonParse.JsonInteger(w, 'periods') : null;
      const aggregate = JsonParse.IsJsonObject(w) ? JsonParse.JsonString(w, 'aggregate') : null;
      if (endLag === null || periods === null || periods < 1 || (aggregate !== 'mean' && aggregate !== 'sum' && aggregate !== 'min' && aggregate !== 'max')) {
        errors.push('TemporalSpec.rollingWindows entries need endLag, periods >= 1 and aggregate mean|sum|min|max');
        continue;
      }
      rollingWindows.push({ endLag, periods, aggregate });
    }
    if (horizon !== null && lags !== null) {
      for (const lag of lags) if (lag < horizon) errors.push(`TemporalSpec lag ${lag} is inside the horizon of ${horizon} periods (lag-inside-horizon)`);
      for (const w of rollingWindows) if (w.endLag < horizon) errors.push(`TemporalSpec rolling window endLag ${w.endLag} is inside the horizon of ${horizon} periods (rolling-window-inside-horizon)`);
    }
    if (errors.length > before || !timeColumn || horizon === null || lags === null || (period !== 'day' && period !== 'week' && period !== 'month' && period !== 'year')) return null;
    return { timeColumn, horizonPeriods: horizon, lags, rollingWindows, period, seasonality };
  }

  private static parseDecisionSpec(v: JsonValue | null, errors: string[]): DecisionSpec | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    if (JsonParse.IsJsonObject(v)) {
      const action = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'action');
      const actorRole = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'actorRole');
      const capacity = v['capacityPerPeriod'] === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonInteger(v, 'capacityPerPeriod');
      const period = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'period');
      if (action && actorRole && (period === 'day' || period === 'week' || period === 'month' || period === 'quarter' || period === 'year') && (capacity === null || capacity > 0)) {
        return { action, actorRole, capacityPerPeriod: capacity, period };
      }
    }
    errors.push('DecisionSpec must be {action, actorRole, capacityPerPeriod (null or > 0), period day|week|month|quarter|year}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseIncumbent(v: JsonValue | null, errors: string[]): IncumbentHeuristic | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    if (JsonParse.IsJsonObject(v)) {
      const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
      if (kind === 'none') return { kind };
      const name = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'name');
      const scoreExpression = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'scoreExpression');
      if (kind === 'rule' && name && scoreExpression) return { kind, name, scoreExpression };
    }
    errors.push('IncumbentHeuristic must be {kind:"none"} or {kind:"rule", name, scoreExpression}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseActor(v: JsonValue | null, errors: string[]): Actor | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    if (JsonParse.IsJsonObject(v)) {
      const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
      const userId = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'userId');
      const agentRunId = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'agentRunId');
      const scheduledJobRunId = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'scheduledJobRunId');
      const component = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'component');
      if (kind === 'human' && userId) return { kind, userId };
      if (kind === 'agent' && agentRunId) return { kind, agentRunId };
      if (kind === 'scheduled-job' && scheduledJobRunId) return { kind, scheduledJobRunId };
      if (kind === 'system' && component) return { kind, component };
    }
    errors.push('AuthoredBy must be an Actor: {kind:"human",userId}, {kind:"agent",agentRunId}, {kind:"scheduled-job",scheduledJobRunId} or {kind:"system",component}');
    return null;
  }
}
```

`Core/src/assembly-contract.ts` (types only; values below are the only runtime exports):

```ts
/**
 * @module assembly-contract
 *
 * The As-of Feature Assembly contract (C2): where a feature's dated value comes from, how it is encoded, the read
 * policy, every refusal, per-value provenance and the Training Snapshot's row manifest. There is no "today's value"
 * source. Extends `contracts.ts` with `keyField`/`ownerKeyField` (reading another entity of the same row),
 * windowed-aggregate `filter`/`voidedAtField`/`endDateField`/`active-at`, and the refusals `unresolved-column` and
 * `unsupported-step-kind`.
 */
import type { RowFilter } from './prediction-unit';

export const LABEL_COLUMN = '__ps_label';

export interface FeatureVersionPin {
  readonly featurePipelineRecordProcessId: string;
  readonly pipelineVersion: number | null;
  readonly promptVersionHash: string | null;
  readonly aiModelId: string | null;   // the pin's `MJ: AI Models` ID, not a vendor model name
  readonly parametersHash: string | null;
}

export interface WindowedAggregateSource {
  readonly kind: 'windowed-aggregate';
  readonly childEntity: string;
  readonly foreignKey: string;
  /** Field on the unit row whose value the child's foreignKey matches; null = the row's entity key. */
  readonly ownerKeyField: string | null;
  readonly dateField: string;
  /** For `active-at`: the child row is active on day d when dateField <= d and (endDateField is null or >= d). */
  readonly endDateField: string | null;
  /** A child row stops counting from the day this date field reaches (e.g. the order's reversal date). */
  readonly voidedAtField: string | null;
  readonly aggregate: 'count' | 'sum' | 'mean' | 'distinct' | 'days-since' | 'active-at';
  readonly valueField: string | null;
  /** Window (d − windowDays, d]; null = everything on or before d. */
  readonly windowDays: number | null;
  readonly filter: readonly RowFilter[];
}

export type DatedSource =
  | { readonly kind: 'record-changes'; readonly entity: string; readonly field: string; readonly keyField: string | null }
  | { readonly kind: 'immutable-field'; readonly entity: string; readonly field: string; readonly keyField: string | null }
  | { readonly kind: 'feature-value'; readonly featureName: string; readonly pin: FeatureVersionPin | null }
  | WindowedAggregateSource
  | { readonly kind: 'series'; readonly feature: { readonly kind: 'lag'; readonly index: number } | { readonly kind: 'rolling'; readonly index: number } };

export interface ChangeHistoryCoverage {
  readonly entity: string;
  readonly historyStart: string | null;
  readonly continuity: { readonly checkedAt: string; readonly recordsReplayed: number; readonly recordsMismatched: number };
  readonly externalSourceRows: 'as-of-detection-time' | 'ineligible';
  readonly onUncoveredRow: 'refuse' | 'exclude-and-count';
}

export type ColumnEncoding =
  | { readonly kind: 'numeric'; readonly nonNumericValue: 'fail' }
  | { readonly kind: 'categorical'; readonly cardinalityCap: number; readonly method: 'onehot' | 'hashed' | 'target-in-fold' }
  | { readonly kind: 'date-parts'; readonly parts: readonly ('year' | 'month' | 'dow' | 'days-since-decision')[] }
  | { readonly kind: 'boolean' }
  | { readonly kind: 'identifier'; readonly policy: 'exclude' };
export type ColumnEncodingKind = ColumnEncoding['kind'];

export interface MissingValuePolicy {
  readonly impute: 'median' | 'mode' | 'constant';
  readonly indicator: true;
  readonly constant: string | number | null;
}

export interface FeatureColumnSpec {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly source: DatedSource;
  readonly encoding: ColumnEncoding;
  readonly missing: MissingValuePolicy;
}

export type ReadPolicy = { readonly mode: 'complete' } | { readonly mode: 'paged'; readonly pageSize: number };

export type AssemblyRefusal =
  | { readonly kind: 'select-changes-after-decision-date'; readonly entity: string; readonly field: string; readonly changesAfter: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'decision-date-before-change-history'; readonly entity: string; readonly field: string; readonly historyStart: string | null; readonly rowsAffected: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'truncated-read'; readonly entity: string; readonly rowsExpected: number; readonly rowsRead: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'non-numeric-in-numeric-column'; readonly column: string; readonly sampleValue: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'future-period-lag'; readonly column: string; readonly lag: number; readonly horizonPeriods: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'unpinned-feature-version'; readonly featureName: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'scope-entity-mismatch'; readonly modelEntity: string; readonly scopeEntity: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'unresolved-column'; readonly entity: string; readonly field: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'unsupported-step-kind'; readonly stepId: string; readonly stepKind: string };

export interface ColumnProvenance {
  readonly column: string;
  readonly source: DatedSource['kind'];
  readonly sourceRef: string;
  readonly sourceVersion: string;
}

export interface ValueProvenance {
  readonly column: string;
  readonly source: DatedSource['kind'];
  readonly sourceRef: string;
  readonly sourceVersion: string;
  readonly computedAt: string;
}

export interface SnapshotFeatureColumn {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly encoding: ColumnEncodingKind;
  readonly sourceColumn: string;
}

export interface SnapshotFeatureSchema {
  readonly columns: readonly SnapshotFeatureColumn[];
  readonly schemaHash: string;
}

export type SnapshotRowRole = 'development' | 'locked-holdout';

export interface SnapshotRowKey {
  readonly rowId: string;
  readonly entityKey: string;
  readonly decisionDate: string;
  readonly groupKey: string | null;
  readonly period: string | null;
  readonly role: SnapshotRowRole;
}

export interface UncoveredRowsCount {
  readonly entity: string;
  readonly field: string;
  readonly rows: number;
}

export interface ClassBalanceEntry {
  readonly label: string;
  readonly rows: number;
}
```

`Core/src/evaluation-protocol.ts` — the protocol JSON types copied from `contracts.ts` L415–L573 with these product
changes: no `pipeline`/`unit` references (D3-06), plus `ProtocolExclusions`, `ResamplingSpec`, `SliceSpec`,
`PredictionIntervalSpec`, `ResidualDiagnosticsSpec`, and `EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative` instead of `nonNegative`:

```ts
/**
 * @module evaluation-protocol
 *
 * The Evaluation Protocol (C3) column shapes and their shape checks, the typed protocol (`EvaluationProtocolSpec`,
 * `ParseEvaluationProtocolRow`); the protocol's behaviour rules are in `evaluation-protocol-rules.ts`, the gate in `gate.ts`.
 */
import { UUIDsEqual } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { JsonParse, type JsonValue } from './json-value';

declare const nonNegativeBrand: unique symbol;
/** A number >= 0, produced only by {@link EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative}. */
export type NonNegative = number & { readonly [nonNegativeBrand]: 'NonNegative' };

export interface Interval { readonly level: number; readonly lower: number; readonly upper: number }
export interface MetricWithInterval { readonly metric: MetricKey; readonly value: number; readonly interval: Interval; readonly n: number }

export type ProperScore =
  | { readonly family: 'binary'; readonly metric: 'log-loss' | 'brier' }
  | { readonly family: 'multiclass'; readonly metric: 'multiclass-log-loss' }
  | { readonly family: 'continuous'; readonly metric: 'rmse' | 'mae' }
  | { readonly family: 'count'; readonly metric: 'poisson-deviance' }
  | { readonly family: 'non-negative'; readonly metric: 'tweedie-deviance' }
  | { readonly family: 'forecast'; readonly metric: 'mase' | 'rmse' };
export type SecondaryMetric = 'auc' | 'accuracy' | 'f1' | 'precision' | 'recall' | 'r2' | 'calibration-slope';
export type MetricKey = ProperScore['metric'] | SecondaryMetric;
export type MetricDirection = 'lower-is-better' | 'higher-is-better' | 'closer-to-one';
export const METRIC_DIRECTION: { readonly [K in MetricKey]: MetricDirection } = {
  'log-loss': 'lower-is-better', brier: 'lower-is-better', 'multiclass-log-loss': 'lower-is-better', rmse: 'lower-is-better',
  mae: 'lower-is-better', 'poisson-deviance': 'lower-is-better', 'tweedie-deviance': 'lower-is-better', mase: 'lower-is-better',
  auc: 'higher-is-better', accuracy: 'higher-is-better', f1: 'higher-is-better', precision: 'higher-is-better',
  recall: 'higher-is-better', r2: 'higher-is-better', 'calibration-slope': 'closer-to-one',
};
/** The proper scores allowed per family (one source for the shape check and the protocol rules). */
export const PROPER_SCORES_BY_FAMILY: { readonly [F in ProperScore['family']]: readonly Extract<ProperScore, { family: F }>['metric'][] } = {
  binary: ['log-loss', 'brier'], multiclass: ['multiclass-log-loss'], continuous: ['rmse', 'mae'],
  count: ['poisson-deviance'], 'non-negative': ['tweedie-deviance'], forecast: ['mase', 'rmse'],
};

export type BaselineSpec =
  | { readonly kind: 'dummy'; readonly name: 'base-rate' | 'mean' | 'training-window-mean' }
  | { readonly kind: 'one-feature'; readonly selection: 'best-single-feature-inner-cv' }
  | { readonly kind: 'glm'; readonly family: 'logistic' | 'multinomial' | 'gaussian' | 'poisson' | 'tweedie'; readonly penalty: 'l2' }
  | { readonly kind: 'naive' }
  | { readonly kind: 'seasonal-naive'; readonly season: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'incumbent-heuristic'; readonly name: string };
export type BaselineRole = 'dummy' | 'simple';
export type HoldoutSplit =
  | {
      readonly kind: 'date-carved'; readonly dateColumn: string; readonly cutoff: string;
      /** Optional end (exclusive) of the holdout window; rows on or after it are in neither role (C1's 1,205 reference test keys are reproduced with it). */
      readonly holdoutEnd: string | null;
      readonly newEntityReport: { readonly groupKey: string; readonly holdoutFraction: number } | null;
    }
  | { readonly kind: 'rolling-origin'; readonly origins: number; readonly horizonPeriods: number; readonly gapPeriods: number; readonly minTrainPeriods: number; readonly window: 'expanding' | 'sliding' };
export type InnerValidation =
  | { readonly kind: 'repeated-stratified-kfold'; readonly folds: number; readonly repeats: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'grouped-kfold'; readonly folds: number; readonly repeats: number; readonly groupKey: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'blocked-time'; readonly folds: number; readonly gapPeriods: number; readonly groupKey: string | null };
export type CalibrationMethod =
  | { readonly kind: 'platt'; readonly fitOn: 'disjoint-calibration-fold' }
  | { readonly kind: 'isotonic'; readonly fitOn: 'disjoint-calibration-fold' }
  | { readonly kind: 'auto'; readonly thresholdRows: number; readonly fitOn: 'disjoint-calibration-fold' }
  | { readonly kind: 'not-applicable'; readonly reason: 'regression-task' };
export type ResamplingSpec = { readonly kind: 'none' } | { readonly kind: 'in-fold'; readonly method: 'class-weight' | 'undersample' | 'oversample' };
export interface IntervalSpec {
  readonly level: 0.95;
  readonly method: 'bootstrap' | 'cluster-bootstrap' | 'block-bootstrap' | 'delong';
  readonly resamples: number;
  readonly pairedTest: 'paired-bootstrap' | 'delong' | 'corrected-resampled-t' | 'diebold-mariano';
}
export interface LeakageAuditSpec {
  readonly singleFeatureHeldOutAucMax: number;
  readonly timeShiftedLabelTest: true;
  readonly dropColumnTest: true;
  readonly importanceAggregation: 'per-source-column';
  readonly highCardinalityIdCheck: true;
}
export type SearchStrategy =
  | { readonly kind: 'random'; readonly candidates: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'guided'; readonly method: 'bayesian' | 'successive-halving'; readonly equalCostComparisonId: string };
export interface Budgets { readonly maxComputeSeconds: number; readonly maxTokens: number; readonly maxCandidates: number; readonly hardStop: true }
export interface PromotionRule {
  readonly comparators: readonly BaselineSpec[];
  readonly incumbent: 'current-published' | 'none';
  readonly margin: NonNegative;
  readonly lowerBoundLevel: 0.95;
  readonly pairedOn: 'same-holdout-rows';
  readonly decisionTable: 'Q13+Q14+Q15';
}
export type GateOutcome = 'model' | 'keep-simple-baseline' | 'no-signal';
export const ALLOWED_OUTCOMES: readonly ['model', 'keep-simple-baseline', 'no-signal'] = ['model', 'keep-simple-baseline', 'no-signal'];
/**
 * Who may change the guard fields (holdout, promotion, leakage audit, exclusions, budgets) in the next version of a
 * protocol. `non-agent` (default): every author except an agent tool call (an agent may not relax its own
 * guardrails, G3.11); `human-only` (optional): only a version authored by a user. Either way every version passes the
 * same guard-field validation.
 */
export type GuardFieldsEditableBy = 'non-agent' | 'human-only';
export const GUARD_FIELDS_EDITABLE_BY: readonly GuardFieldsEditableBy[] = ['non-agent', 'human-only'];
export interface ProtocolExclusions { readonly denyFields: readonly string[]; readonly denySources: readonly string[] }
export interface SliceSpec { readonly outOfTime: boolean; readonly subgroups: readonly string[] }
export interface PredictionIntervalSpec { readonly method: 'split-conformal' | 'quantile'; readonly nominalCoverage: readonly number[] }
export interface ResidualDiagnosticsSpec { readonly acfLags: number; readonly ljungBoxAlpha: number }
export type RetrainTrigger =
  | { readonly kind: 'outcome-degradation'; readonly margin: NonNegative; readonly consecutivePeriods: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'calibration-drift'; readonly slopeOutside: readonly [number, number]; readonly consecutivePeriods: number };

/** The `MJ: Evaluation Protocols` columns the checks read (the generated entity satisfies this structurally). */
export interface EvaluationProtocolColumns {
  ID: string; LineageRootID: string; Version: number; Name: string;
  Holdout: string; InnerValidation: string; Seed: number; HoldoutAccessBudget: number;
  PrimaryScore: string; SecondaryMetrics: string; Baselines: string; Calibration: string; Resampling: string;
  Intervals: string; Promotion: string; AllowedOutcomes: string; LeakageAudit: string; Exclusions: string;
  Slices: string; PredictionIntervals: string | null; ResidualDiagnostics: string | null; RetrainTriggers: string;
  SearchStrategy: string; Budgets: string; MinMinorityClassRows: number; GuardFieldsEditableBy: string; AuthoredBy: string;
}

/**
 * The Evaluation Protocol's column checks and its typed parser: static members on one owner (coding
 * standards §2). The protocol behaviour rules live in EvaluationProtocolRules (evaluation-protocol-rules.ts).
 */
export class EvaluationProtocol {
  /** contracts.ts `nonNegative`: the only producer of a {@link NonNegative} (a margin or a budget). */
  public static ToNonNegative(x: number): NonNegative {
    if (!Number.isFinite(x) || x < 0) {
      throw new RangeError(`expected a finite number >= 0, got ${String(x)}`);
    }
    return x as NonNegative;
  }

  /** Narrows a stored `GuardFieldsEditableBy` column value to its union. */
  public static IsGuardFieldsEditableBy(v: string): v is GuardFieldsEditableBy {
    return v === 'non-agent' || v === 'human-only';
  }

  /**
   * The shape checks run by `MJEvaluationProtocolEntityServer.Validate()`: every JSON column parses, the fixed
   * fields hold their only admissible values, the primary score is proper for its family, the margin is >= 0,
   * rolling-origin has >= 5 origins and no-signal cannot be omitted. The full typed parse and the save-time rules are separate members.
   */
  public static GetEvaluationProtocolShapeProblems(row: EvaluationProtocolColumns): string[] {
    const problems: string[] = [];
    const json = (text: string | null, column: string, required: boolean): JsonValue | null => {
      if (!required && (text === null || text.trim().length === 0)) return null;
      const r = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(text, column);
      if (!r.Ok) {
        problems.push(...r.Errors);
        return null;
      }
      return r.Value;
    };
    for (const [column, text] of [
      ['InnerValidation', row.InnerValidation], ['SecondaryMetrics', row.SecondaryMetrics], ['Baselines', row.Baselines],
      ['Calibration', row.Calibration], ['Resampling', row.Resampling], ['Intervals', row.Intervals],
      ['LeakageAudit', row.LeakageAudit], ['Exclusions', row.Exclusions], ['Slices', row.Slices],
      ['RetrainTriggers', row.RetrainTriggers], ['SearchStrategy', row.SearchStrategy], ['Budgets', row.Budgets], ['AuthoredBy', row.AuthoredBy],
    ] as const) {
      json(text, column, true);
    }
    json(row.PredictionIntervals, 'PredictionIntervals', false);
    json(row.ResidualDiagnostics, 'ResidualDiagnostics', false);
    EvaluationProtocol.checkFixedColumns(row, problems);
    EvaluationProtocol.checkAllowedOutcomes(json(row.AllowedOutcomes, 'AllowedOutcomes', true), problems);
    EvaluationProtocol.checkPrimaryScore(json(row.PrimaryScore, 'PrimaryScore', true), problems);
    EvaluationProtocol.checkPromotionMargin(json(row.Promotion, 'Promotion', true), problems);
    EvaluationProtocol.checkHoldoutShape(json(row.Holdout, 'Holdout', true), problems);
    return problems;
  }

  /** The scalar columns with one admissible value or range, and the version-1 lineage root. */
  private static checkFixedColumns(row: EvaluationProtocolColumns, problems: string[]): void {
    if (row.HoldoutAccessBudget !== 1) problems.push('HoldoutAccessBudget must be 1');
    if (!EvaluationProtocol.IsGuardFieldsEditableBy(row.GuardFieldsEditableBy)) problems.push('GuardFieldsEditableBy must be non-agent or human-only');
    if (!Number.isInteger(row.MinMinorityClassRows) || row.MinMinorityClassRows < 1) problems.push('MinMinorityClassRows must be an integer >= 1');
    // Case-insensitive UUID comparison (SQL Server returns upper-case UUIDs, PostgreSQL lower-case).
    if (row.Version === 1 && !UUIDsEqual(row.LineageRootID, row.ID)) problems.push('Version 1 must be its own lineage root (LineageRootID = ID)');
  }

  /** A protocol cannot omit no-signal: the outcomes are exactly ALLOWED_OUTCOMES. */
  private static checkAllowedOutcomes(outcomes: JsonValue | null, problems: string[]): void {
    if (outcomes !== null && JSON.stringify(outcomes) !== JSON.stringify(ALLOWED_OUTCOMES)) {
      problems.push('AllowedOutcomes must be exactly ["model","keep-simple-baseline","no-signal"]');
    }
  }

  /** The primary score's metric must be a proper score of its family. */
  private static checkPrimaryScore(primary: JsonValue | null, problems: string[]): void {
    if (primary === null) return;
    const family = JsonParse.IsJsonObject(primary) ? JsonParse.JsonString(primary, 'family') : null;
    const metric = JsonParse.IsJsonObject(primary) ? JsonParse.JsonString(primary, 'metric') : null;
    const allowed: readonly string[] | null = family !== null && EvaluationProtocol.isProperScoreFamily(family) ? PROPER_SCORES_BY_FAMILY[family] : null;
    if (allowed === null) problems.push(`PrimaryScore family "${family || ''}" is not one of ${Object.keys(PROPER_SCORES_BY_FAMILY).join(', ')}`);
    else if (metric === null || !allowed.includes(metric)) problems.push(`PrimaryScore metric "${metric || ''}" is not a proper score of family "${family}" (allowed: ${allowed.join(', ')})`);
  }

  /** The promotion margin is a finite number >= 0. */
  private static checkPromotionMargin(promotion: JsonValue | null, problems: string[]): void {
    if (promotion === null) return;
    const margin = JsonParse.IsJsonObject(promotion) ? JsonParse.JsonNumber(promotion, 'margin') : null;
    if (margin === null || margin < 0) problems.push('Promotion margin must be a finite number >= 0');
  }

  /** Narrows a family string to a key of PROPER_SCORES_BY_FAMILY without a cast. */
  private static isProperScoreFamily(family: string): family is ProperScore['family'] {
    return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(PROPER_SCORES_BY_FAMILY, family);
  }

  /** A date-carved holdout names its date column and cutoff (and an end after it); rolling-origin needs >= 5 origins. */
  private static checkHoldoutShape(holdout: JsonValue | null, problems: string[]): void {
    if (holdout === null || !JsonParse.IsJsonObject(holdout)) return;
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(holdout, 'kind');
    if (kind === 'rolling-origin') {
      const origins = JsonParse.JsonInteger(holdout, 'origins');
      if (origins === null || origins < 5) problems.push(`Holdout rolling-origin needs at least 5 origins (${origins === null ? 'none' : origins} given)`);
    } else if (kind === 'date-carved') {
      const cutoff = JsonParse.JsonString(holdout, 'cutoff') || '';
      if (!JsonParse.JsonString(holdout, 'dateColumn') || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(cutoff)) problems.push('Holdout date-carved needs dateColumn and cutoff yyyy-mm-dd');
      const end = holdout['holdoutEnd'];
      if (end !== undefined && end !== null && (typeof end !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(end) || end <= cutoff)) problems.push('Holdout date-carved holdoutEnd must be null or a yyyy-mm-dd date after cutoff');
    } else {
      problems.push('Holdout kind must be date-carved or rolling-origin');
    }
  }
}
```

`isProperScoreFamily` (in the class above) replaces a cast when the family string is narrowed to a key.

```ts
import { BaseEntity, ValidationErrorInfo, ValidationErrorType, type ValidationResult } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { RegisterClass } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { MJPredictionUnitEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { PredictionUnit } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';

/**
 * The immutable-version guard shared by the unit, protocol and snapshot subclasses: one implementation of
 * "a saved version is never updated", so the three entities cannot drift apart.
 */
export class VersionedRowGuard {
  /** The refusal for a write to a saved version row; null for a new row or a saved row with no change. Pure. */
  public static GetVersionedRowUpdateProblem(entityName: string, isSaved: boolean, dirtyFields: readonly string[]): string | null {
    if (!isSaved || dirtyFields.length === 0) return null;
    return `${entityName} rows are immutable versions; ${dirtyFields.join(', ')} cannot be changed on a saved version. Save a new version instead (Version + 1, same LineageRootID).`;
  }

  /**
   * Adds the update refusal (on `updateField`) or, for a new row, the row's own problems (on `rowField`) to `result`.
   * `rowProblems` runs only when the write is not an update of a saved version.
   */
  public static AddProblems(entity: BaseEntity, result: ValidationResult, updateField: string, rowField: string, rowProblems: () => readonly string[]): ValidationResult {
    const dirty = entity.Fields.filter((f) => f.Dirty).map((f) => f.Name);
    const update = VersionedRowGuard.GetVersionedRowUpdateProblem(entity.EntityInfo.Name, entity.IsSaved, dirty);
    const problems: readonly { field: string; message: string }[] = update
      ? [{ field: updateField, message: update }]
      : rowProblems().map((message) => ({ field: rowField, message }));
    for (const p of problems) {
      result.Success = false;
      result.Errors.push(new ValidationErrorInfo(p.field, p.message, null, ValidationErrorType.Failure));
    }
    return result;
  }
}

/**
 * `MJ: Prediction Units`: a version row is written once and never updated, and must parse; `ValidateAsync`
 * checks that references resolve against metadata and LabelVersion follows the previous version.
 */
@RegisterClass(BaseEntity, 'MJ: Prediction Units')
export class MJPredictionUnitEntityServer extends MJPredictionUnitEntity {
  /** Shape problems of a unit row (all JSON columns parse; cross-field rules hold). Pure. */
  public static GetPredictionUnitRowProblems(row: MJPredictionUnitEntity): readonly string[] {
    const parsed = PredictionUnit.ParsePredictionUnitRow(row);
    return parsed.Ok ? [] : parsed.Errors;
  }

  public override Validate(): ValidationResult {
    return VersionedRowGuard.AddProblems(this, super.Validate(), 'Version', 'UnitRows', () => MJPredictionUnitEntityServer.GetPredictionUnitRowProblems(this));
  }
}
```
