```ts
import { BaseEntity, type ValidationResult } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { RegisterClass } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { MJTrainingSnapshotEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { VersionedRowGuard } from './MJPredictionUnitEntityServer.server';

export type SnapshotHashFields = Pick<MJTrainingSnapshotEntity, 'ReadComplete' | 'ContentHash' | 'MatrixSha256' | 'RowManifestSha256' | 'ProvenanceSha256' | 'FeatureSchemaHash'>;

/** `MJ: Training Snapshots`: written once by the snapshot builder, never updated. */
@RegisterClass(BaseEntity, 'MJ: Training Snapshots')
export class MJTrainingSnapshotEntityServer extends MJTrainingSnapshotEntity {
  private static readonly SHA256_HEX = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;

  /** A snapshot exists only for a complete read and carries five well-formed hashes. Pure. */
  public static GetTrainingSnapshotRowProblems(row: SnapshotHashFields): string[] {
    const problems: string[] = [];
    if (row.ReadComplete !== true) problems.push('ReadComplete must be true: a snapshot exists only for a complete read');
    for (const [name, value] of [
      ['ContentHash', row.ContentHash], ['MatrixSha256', row.MatrixSha256], ['RowManifestSha256', row.RowManifestSha256],
      ['ProvenanceSha256', row.ProvenanceSha256], ['FeatureSchemaHash', row.FeatureSchemaHash],
    ] as const) {
      if (!MJTrainingSnapshotEntityServer.SHA256_HEX.test(value)) problems.push(`${name} must be 64 lower-case hex characters`);
    }
    return problems;
  }

  public override Validate(): ValidationResult {
    return VersionedRowGuard.AddProblems(this, super.Validate(), 'ContentHash', 'ContentHash', () => MJTrainingSnapshotEntityServer.GetTrainingSnapshotRowProblems(this));
  }
}
```

In `MJMLTrainingPipelineEntityServer.server.ts` add the pure check as a public static of the class (coding standards
§2: logic on the owning class, not a free function) and call it from `ValidateAsync` (after the existing leakage-guard
block, before `return result`):

```ts
import { RunView } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { UUIDsEqual } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { PredictionUnit, JsonParse, TaskTypeRules } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { MJEvaluationProtocolEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';

/** What the pipeline check needs to know about its unit (resolved by ValidateAsync). */
export interface PipelineUnitFacts { readonly TaskType: string; readonly RowEntityID: string; readonly DescribedLabel: string }

  // ---- inside MJMLTrainingPipelineEntityServer (a public static, so tests call it without an entity) ----
  /**
   * A pipeline that names a unit must agree with it (legacy TargetEntityID/ProblemType/TargetVariable are derived from
   * the unit), and a protocol it names must score the unit's task family. Pure.
   */
  public static GetPipelineUnitProtocolProblems(
    pipeline: Pick<MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, 'TargetEntityID' | 'ProblemType' | 'TargetVariable'>,
    unit: PipelineUnitFacts,
    protocol: Pick<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity, 'PrimaryScore'> | null,
  ): string[] {
    const problems: string[] = [];
    const taskJson = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(unit.TaskType, 'TaskType');
    const task = taskJson.Ok ? TaskTypeRules.ParseTaskType(taskJson.Value) : null;
    const taskKind = task?.Ok ? task.Value.kind : null;
    if (!UUIDsEqual(pipeline.TargetEntityID, unit.RowEntityID)) {
      problems.push(`TargetEntityID must be the unit's row entity (${unit.RowEntityID}) when PredictionUnitID is set`);
    }
    // One derivation of the legacy value (TaskTypeRules), shared with every writer of ProblemType.
    const expectedProblemType = task?.Ok ? TaskTypeRules.LegacyProblemTypeForTask(task.Value) : 'regression';
    if (pipeline.ProblemType !== expectedProblemType) problems.push(`ProblemType must be ${expectedProblemType} for a ${taskKind || 'unknown'} unit`);
    if (pipeline.TargetVariable !== unit.DescribedLabel) problems.push(`TargetVariable must read "${unit.DescribedLabel}" (the unit's outcome rule)`);
    if (protocol) {
      const primary = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(protocol.PrimaryScore, 'PrimaryScore');
      const family = primary.Ok && JsonParse.IsJsonObject(primary.Value) ? JsonParse.JsonString(primary.Value, 'family') : null;
      if (family !== taskKind) {
        problems.push(`The Evaluation Protocol scores family "${family || 'unknown'}" but the Prediction Unit declares task "${taskKind || 'unknown'}"; ranking a ${taskKind || 'unknown'} model by a ${family || 'unknown'} score is refused`);
      }
    }
    return problems;
  }
```

and inside the class a private method called from `ValidateAsync` (after the leakage-guard block, before
`return result`), plus a type guard on `VersionedRowGuard` (one guard for every PS server subclass) that replaces the
file's existing `this.ProviderToUse as unknown as IMetadataProvider` cast (remove that cast in `buildValidationContext`
too):

```ts
import type { IEntityDataProvider } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { MJPredictionUnitEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';

  // ---- inside VersionedRowGuard (MJPredictionUnitEntityServer.server.ts), shared by every PS server subclass ----
  /** Every MJ data provider is also a metadata provider; a test double may not be. */
  public static IsMetadataProvider(p: IEntityDataProvider | null | undefined): p is IEntityDataProvider & IMetadataProvider {
    return !!p && 'EntityByName' in p && typeof p.EntityByName === 'function' && 'Entities' in p;
  }

  // ---- inside MJMLTrainingPipelineEntityServer ----
  private async checkUnitAndProtocol(result: ValidationResult): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.PredictionUnitID) return;
    const provider = this.ProviderToUse;
    if (!VersionedRowGuard.IsMetadataProvider(provider)) return;
    const { unitRow, protocol } = await this.loadUnitAndProtocol(provider);
    if (!unitRow) {
      this.fail(result, 'PredictionUnitID', `Prediction Unit ${this.PredictionUnitID} was not found`);
      return;
    }
    if (this.EvaluationProtocolID && !protocol) {
      this.fail(result, 'EvaluationProtocolID', `Evaluation Protocol ${this.EvaluationProtocolID} was not found`);
      return;
    }
    const spec = PredictionUnit.ParsePredictionUnitRow(unitRow);
    if (!spec.Ok) {
      this.fail(result, 'PredictionUnitID', `Prediction Unit ${this.PredictionUnitID} does not parse: ${spec.Errors.join('; ')}`);
      return;
    }
    const rowEntityName = PredictionUnit.UnitRowEntityName(spec.Value.rows);
    const facts: PipelineUnitFacts = {
      TaskType: unitRow.TaskType,
      RowEntityID: provider.EntityByName(rowEntityName)?.ID || `(unknown entity ${rowEntityName})`,
      DescribedLabel: PredictionUnit.DescribeLabelRule(spec.Value),
    };
    for (const problem of MJMLTrainingPipelineEntityServer.GetPipelineUnitProtocolProblems(this, facts, protocol)) {
      this.fail(result, 'PredictionUnitID', problem);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reads the bound unit row (every column, for the parser) and the bound protocol's primary score, in parallel, as
   * plain rows (nothing is mutated). A failed read is reported as "not found" by the caller.
   */
  private async loadUnitAndProtocol(provider: IEntityDataProvider & IMetadataProvider): Promise<{ unitRow: MJPredictionUnitEntity | null; protocol: Pick<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity, 'PrimaryScore'> | null }> {
    const rv = RunView.FromMetadataProvider(provider);
    const [units, protocols] = await Promise.all([
      rv.RunView<MJPredictionUnitEntity>(
        { EntityName: 'MJ: Prediction Units', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(this.PredictionUnitID)}'`, ResultType: 'simple' },
        this.ContextCurrentUser,
      ),
      this.EvaluationProtocolID
        ? rv.RunView<Pick<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity, 'PrimaryScore'>>(
            { EntityName: 'MJ: Evaluation Protocols', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(this.EvaluationProtocolID)}'`, Fields: ['PrimaryScore'], ResultType: 'simple' },
            this.ContextCurrentUser,
          )
        : null,
    ]);
    return {
      unitRow: units.Success ? units.Results[0] || null : null,
      protocol: protocols !== null && protocols.Success ? protocols.Results[0] || null : null,
    };
  }

  private fail(result: ValidationResult, field: string, message: string): void {
    result.Success = false;
    result.Errors.push(new ValidationErrorInfo(field, message, null, ValidationErrorType.Failure));
  }
```

```python
"""Build the C1 corpus fixture from the pinned MoreCheese generated corpus.

usage: python -I build_c1_corpus.py <more-cheese>/generated <person_years.parquet> <out-dir>

Writes one CSV per table plus SHA256SUMS. IDs are UUIDv5 under a fixed namespace, so a rebuild is byte-identical.
Every count asserted here is the reference's (ps-review evidence/07-reference-model.md:93, logs/P3/build.txt:11).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import glob
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import uuid
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd

NS = uuid.UUID("5b3c9d0e-6f6a-4f51-9d0c-1c1f0c3a7e21")
PERIOD_RE = re.compile(r"-P(\d+)$")
Record = dict[str, Any]


def load(g: str, d: str) -> list[Record]:
    out: list[Record] = []
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(g, d, ".*.json"))):
        if not f.endswith(".mj-sync.json"):
            with open(f) as fh:
                out.extend(json.load(fh))
    return out


def day(s: str | None) -> str:
    return s[:10] if s else ""


def uid(*parts: str) -> str:
    return str(uuid.uuid5(NS, "|".join(parts))).upper()


def write(out: str, name: str, header: list[str], rows: list[list[str]]) -> None:
    for r in rows:
        for v in r:
            if any(c in v for c in ',"\n\r'):
                raise ValueError(f"{name}: value {v!r} needs quoting; the fixture format forbids it")
    with open(os.path.join(out, name), "w", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh, quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE, lineterminator="\n")
        w.writerow(header)
        w.writerows(rows)


class CorpusCountMismatch(ValueError):
    """A built table's row count differs from the reference's (the fixture would not reproduce the gates)."""


def require_count(name: str, rows: list[list[str]], expected: int) -> None:
    if len(rows) != expected:
        raise CorpusCountMismatch(f"{name}: {len(rows)} rows, the reference has {expected}")


def build_orders(g: str) -> tuple[list[list[str]], list[list[str]], list[list[str]]]:
    """Order headers, final-valid dues periods (one per person and period) and confirmed non-dues lines."""
    sku = {p["primaryKey"]["ID"]: p["fields"]["SKU"] for p in load(g, "products")}
    orders = load(g, "orders")
    reversed_on = {o["fields"]["ReversesOrderHeaderID"]: day(o["fields"]["OrderDate"])
                   for o in orders if o["fields"].get("ReversesOrderHeaderID")}
    order_rows: list[list[str]] = []
    dues_rows: list[list[str]] = []
    nondues_rows: list[list[str]] = []
    seen_periods: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()
    for o in orders:
        f = o["fields"]
        oid = o["primaryKey"]["ID"]
        pid = f["BillToPersonID"]
        od = day(f["OrderDate"])
        order_rows.append([oid.upper(), pid.upper(), od, f["Status"], f["OrderType"], (f.get("ReversesOrderHeaderID") or "").upper(), reversed_on.get(oid, "")])
        is_sale_confirmed = f["Status"] == "Confirmed" and f["OrderType"] == "Sale" and not f.get("ReversesOrderHeaderID")
        final_valid = is_sale_confirmed and oid not in reversed_on
        for i, line in enumerate((o.get("collections") or {}).get("Lines", [])):
            s = sku.get(line["fields"]["ProductID"], "")
            if s.startswith("PROD-MEM"):
                m = PERIOD_RE.search(f["OrderNumber"] or "")
                if final_valid and m:
                    k = int(m.group(1))
                    if (pid, k) in seen_periods:
                        raise CorpusCountMismatch(f"duplicate period {k} for {pid}")
                    seen_periods.add((pid, k))
                    dues_rows.append([uid("dues", oid, str(i)), pid.upper(), str(k), od, s, oid.upper()])
            elif is_sale_confirmed:
                amount = float(line["fields"].get("LineTotalNet") or 0)
                nondues_rows.append([uid("line", oid, str(i)), pid.upper(), oid.upper(), od, f"{amount:.2f}", reversed_on.get(oid, "")])
    require_count("dues_periods", dues_rows, 6673)
    return order_rows, dues_rows, nondues_rows


def build_people(g: str, dues_rows: list[list[str]]) -> list[list[str]]:
    """One row per dues payer, with the profile's join date, segment and region."""
    profiles = {r["fields"]["PersonID"].upper(): r["fields"] for r in load(g, "member-profiles")}
    return [[p, day((profiles.get(p) or {}).get("JoinDate")), (profiles.get(p) or {}).get("Segment") or "",
             (profiles.get(p) or {}).get("Region") or ""] for p in sorted({r[1] for r in dues_rows})]


def build_activity(g: str) -> dict[str, list[list[str]]]:
    """The dated child tables the windowed aggregates read: attendances, completions, certifications, committees."""
    events = {e["primaryKey"]["ID"]: day(e["fields"]["EventDate"]) for e in load(g, "events")}
    return {
        "event_attendances": [[uid("att", r["primaryKey"]["ID"] if "ID" in r["primaryKey"] else r["fields"]["RegKey"]), r["fields"]["PersonID"].upper(), events[r["fields"]["EventID"]]]
                              for r in load(g, "event-registrations") if r["fields"].get("Attended") and events.get(r["fields"]["EventID"])],
        "course_completions": [[uid("course", r["fields"]["EnrollKey"]), r["fields"]["PersonID"].upper(), day(r["fields"]["CompletedOn"])]
                               for r in load(g, "enrollments") if r["fields"]["Status"] == "Completed" and r["fields"].get("CompletedOn")],
        "certifications": [[uid("cert", r["fields"]["MemberCertKey"]), r["fields"]["PersonID"].upper(), day(r["fields"].get("AwardedOn")), day(r["fields"].get("ExpiresOn"))]
                           for r in load(g, "member-certifications")],
        "committee_memberships": [[uid("cm", r["fields"]["PersonID"], str(i), r["fields"].get("StartDate") or ""), r["fields"]["PersonID"].upper(), day(r["fields"].get("StartDate")), day(r["fields"].get("EndDate"))]
                                  for i, r in enumerate(load(g, "committee-memberships"))],
    }


def build_keys(parquet: str) -> list[list[str]]:
    """The reference's 4,873 resolved person-year keys."""
    keys = pd.read_parquet(parquet, columns=["person_id", "period_index"])
    rows = [[str(p).upper(), str(int(k))] for p, k in zip(keys.person_id, keys.period_index)]
    require_count("person_years_keys", rows, 4873)
    return rows


def write_sums(out: str) -> None:
    with open(os.path.join(out, "SHA256SUMS"), "w") as fh:
        for name in sorted(n for n in os.listdir(out) if n.endswith(".csv")):
            with open(os.path.join(out, name), "rb") as b:
                fh.write(f"{hashlib.sha256(b.read()).hexdigest()}  {name}\n")


def main(g: str, parquet: str, out: str) -> None:
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    order_rows, dues_rows, nondues_rows = build_orders(g)
    people_rows = build_people(g, dues_rows)
    activity = build_activity(g)
    key_rows = build_keys(parquet)
    write(out, "people.csv", ["PersonID", "JoinDate", "Segment", "Region"], people_rows)
    write(out, "order_headers.csv", ["OrderID", "PersonID", "OrderDate", "Status", "OrderType", "ReversesOrderID", "ReversedOn"], order_rows)
    write(out, "dues_periods.csv", ["DuesPeriodID", "PersonID", "PeriodIndex", "OrderDate", "TierSKU", "OrderID"], dues_rows)
    write(out, "nondues_lines.csv", ["LineID", "PersonID", "OrderID", "OrderDate", "LineTotalNet", "ReversedOn"], nondues_rows)
    write(out, "event_attendances.csv", ["AttendanceID", "PersonID", "EventDate"], activity["event_attendances"])
    write(out, "course_completions.csv", ["CompletionID", "PersonID", "CompletedOn"], activity["course_completions"])
    write(out, "certifications.csv", ["CertificationID", "PersonID", "AwardedOn", "ExpiresOn"], activity["certifications"])
    write(out, "committee_memberships.csv", ["CommitteeMembershipID", "PersonID", "StartDate", "EndDate"], activity["committee_memberships"])
    write(out, "person_years_keys.csv", ["person_id", "period_index"], key_rows)
    write_sums(out)
    print(f"dues_periods={len(dues_rows)} people={len(people_rows)} orders={len(order_rows)} nondues_lines={len(nondues_rows)} "
          + " ".join(f"{k}={len(v)}" for k, v in activity.items()) + f" keys={len(key_rows)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
```

  `DeleteType: "Hard"`, `AllowDirectSQLInsert: true`, `AllowDirectSQLUpdate: true`, `AllowDirectSQLDelete: true`; and in

  The loader `TruthSuite/src/fixtures/c1-corpus-loader.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Loads the C1 corpus fixture into the pstruth C1 tables. Touches only the eight C1 tables, so a world
 * or scenario loaded by the world and scenario loaders stays in place. Bulk insert through `mssql` (a TruthSuite dependency).
 */
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import sql from 'mssql';

export const C1_CORPUS_DIR = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', '..', 'fixtures', 'c1-corpus');

export interface C1CsvTable { readonly Header: readonly string[]; readonly Rows: readonly Readonly<Record<string, string>>[] }

/**
 * The C1 corpus fixture: read and verify its committed CSVs and load them into the pstruth C1 tables (static members
 * on one owner, coding standards §2).
 */
export class C1CorpusFixture {
  /** Parse one fixture CSV (unquoted by construction: the builder refuses values needing quotes). */
  public static async ReadC1CorpusCsv(path: string): Promise<C1CsvTable> {
    const text = await readFile(path, 'utf8');
    const lines = text.split('\n').filter((l) => l.length > 0);
    const header = lines[0].split(',');
    const rows = lines.slice(1).map((line) => {
      const cells = line.split(',');
      if (cells.length !== header.length) throw new Error(`${path}: row has ${cells.length} cells, header has ${header.length}`);
      const row: Record<string, string> = {};
      header.forEach((h, i) => { row[h] = cells[i]; });
      return row;
    });
    return { Header: header, Rows: rows };
  }

  /**
   * Throws naming `truth:provision` unless every table's `PS Truth:` entity sanctions direct inserts and deletes
   * (`.claude/rules/data-access.md`). A physical read of `__mj.Entity`, parameterised.
   */
  public static async RequireDirectSQLOptIn(pool: sql.ConnectionPool, tables: readonly string[]): Promise<void> {
    const request = pool.request();
    tables.forEach((name, i) => request.input(`t${i}`, sql.NVarChar(128), name));
    const placeholders = tables.map((_, i) => `@t${i}`).join(', ');
    const res = await request.query<{ BaseTable: string }>(`SELECT BaseTable FROM __mj.Entity WHERE SchemaName = 'pstruth' AND BaseTable IN (${placeholders}) AND AllowDirectSQLInsert = 1 AND AllowDirectSQLDelete = 1`);
    const sanctioned = new Set(res.recordset.map((r) => r.BaseTable));
    const missing = tables.filter((name) => !sanctioned.has(name));
    if (missing.length > 0) throw new Error(`direct SQL is not sanctioned on pstruth.${missing.join(', pstruth.')}: run truth:provision (it pushes TruthSuite/metadata)`);
  }

  /** Files whose SHA-256 differs from SHA256SUMS (empty when the fixture is intact). */
  public static async VerifyC1CorpusChecksums(dir: string): Promise<string[]> {
    const sums = (await readFile(join(dir, 'SHA256SUMS'), 'utf8')).split('\n').filter((l) => l.length > 0);
    const bad: string[] = [];
    for (const line of sums) {
      const [expected, name] = line.split(/\s+/);
      const actual = createHash('sha256').update(await readFile(join(dir, name))).digest('hex');
      if (actual !== expected) bad.push(name);
    }
    return bad;
  }

  /** Replace the C1 tables' contents with the fixture; returns the row count per table. Refuses a corrupted fixture. */
  public static async LoadC1Corpus(pool: sql.ConnectionPool, dir: string = C1_CORPUS_DIR): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
    const bad = await C1CorpusFixture.VerifyC1CorpusChecksums(dir);
    if (bad.length > 0) throw new Error(`C1 corpus fixture checksum mismatch: ${bad.join(', ')}`);
    // Bulk DML is these entities' declared path: `metadata/entities/.pstruth-c1-entities.json` sets their
    // AllowDirectSQLInsert/Delete (with TrackRecordChanges and server-cache trust off, DeleteType Hard), and the loader
    // checks the flags before any DML. Nothing outside the eight C1 tables is touched; product entities are always
    // written through BaseEntity.
    const deleteOrder = ['C1DuesPeriod', 'C1Person', 'C1OrderHeader', 'C1NonduesLine', 'C1EventAttendance', 'C1CourseCompletion', 'C1Certification', 'C1CommitteeMembership'];
    await C1CorpusFixture.RequireDirectSQLOptIn(pool, deleteOrder);
    for (const t of deleteOrder) await pool.request().query(`DELETE FROM [pstruth].[${t}]`);
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const load of LOADS) {
      const csv = await C1CorpusFixture.ReadC1CorpusCsv(join(dir, load.Csv));
      const table = new sql.Table(`[pstruth].[${load.Table}]`);
      for (const c of load.Columns) {
        const type = c.Type === 'uuid' ? sql.UniqueIdentifier : c.Type === 'date' ? sql.Date : c.Type === 'int' ? sql.Int : c.Type === 'decimal' ? sql.Decimal(18, 2) : sql.NVarChar(50);
        table.columns.add(c.Column, type, { nullable: true });
      }
      for (const row of csv.Rows) {
        table.rows.add(...load.Columns.map((c) => {
          const v = row[c.Csv];
          if (v === '') return null;
          if (c.Type === 'int') return Number.parseInt(v, 10);
          if (c.Type === 'decimal') return Number.parseFloat(v);
          if (c.Type === 'date') return new Date(`${v}T00:00:00Z`);
          return v;
        }));
      }
      await pool.request().bulk(table);
      const n = await pool.request().query<{ n: number }>(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM [pstruth].[${load.Table}]`);
      counts[load.Table] = n.recordset[0].n;
      if (counts[load.Table] !== csv.Rows.length) throw new Error(`${load.Table}: loaded ${counts[load.Table]} of ${csv.Rows.length} rows`);
    }
    return counts;
  }
}


interface TableLoad { readonly Csv: string; readonly Table: string; readonly Columns: readonly { readonly Csv: string; readonly Column: string; readonly Type: 'uuid' | 'date' | 'int' | 'decimal' | 'text' }[] }

const LOADS: readonly TableLoad[] = [
  { Csv: 'people.csv', Table: 'C1Person', Columns: [{ Csv: 'PersonID', Column: 'ID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'JoinDate', Column: 'JoinDate', Type: 'date' }, { Csv: 'Segment', Column: 'Segment', Type: 'text' }, { Csv: 'Region', Column: 'Region', Type: 'text' }] },
  { Csv: 'order_headers.csv', Table: 'C1OrderHeader', Columns: [{ Csv: 'OrderID', Column: 'ID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'PersonID', Column: 'PersonID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'OrderDate', Column: 'OrderDate', Type: 'date' }, { Csv: 'Status', Column: 'Status', Type: 'text' }, { Csv: 'OrderType', Column: 'OrderType', Type: 'text' }, { Csv: 'ReversesOrderID', Column: 'ReversesOrderID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'ReversedOn', Column: 'ReversedOn', Type: 'date' }] },
  { Csv: 'dues_periods.csv', Table: 'C1DuesPeriod', Columns: [{ Csv: 'DuesPeriodID', Column: 'ID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'PersonID', Column: 'PersonID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'PeriodIndex', Column: 'PeriodIndex', Type: 'int' }, { Csv: 'OrderDate', Column: 'OrderDate', Type: 'date' }, { Csv: 'TierSKU', Column: 'TierSKU', Type: 'text' }, { Csv: 'OrderID', Column: 'OrderID', Type: 'uuid' }] },
  { Csv: 'nondues_lines.csv', Table: 'C1NonduesLine', Columns: [{ Csv: 'LineID', Column: 'ID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'PersonID', Column: 'PersonID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'OrderID', Column: 'OrderID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'OrderDate', Column: 'OrderDate', Type: 'date' }, { Csv: 'LineTotalNet', Column: 'LineTotalNet', Type: 'decimal' }, { Csv: 'ReversedOn', Column: 'ReversedOn', Type: 'date' }] },
  { Csv: 'event_attendances.csv', Table: 'C1EventAttendance', Columns: [{ Csv: 'AttendanceID', Column: 'ID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'PersonID', Column: 'PersonID', Type: 'uuid' }, { Csv: 'EventDate', Column: 'EventDate', Type: 'date' }] },
```

```ts
/**
 * Declares which test-schema fields are immutable after creation (`MJ: Entity Fields.AllowUpdateAPI = false`), the
 * metadata the As-of Feature Assembly reads as "may be read directly". Fields not listed stay updatable, so the
 * assembly must replay them from Record Changes (PersonStatusNow on W4 is the planted example).
 */
import { RunView, type IMetadataProvider, type UserInfo } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { EscapeSQLString, NormalizeUUID } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { MJEntityFieldEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';

export interface ImmutableFieldDeclaration { readonly BaseTable: string; readonly Fields: readonly string[] }

export const TRUTH_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS: readonly ImmutableFieldDeclaration[] = [
  { BaseTable: 'C1Person', Fields: ['JoinDate', 'Segment', 'Region'] },
  { BaseTable: 'C1OrderHeader', Fields: ['PersonID', 'OrderDate', 'Status', 'OrderType', 'ReversesOrderID', 'ReversedOn'] },
  { BaseTable: 'C1DuesPeriod', Fields: ['PersonID', 'PeriodIndex', 'OrderDate', 'TierSKU', 'OrderID'] },
  { BaseTable: 'C1NonduesLine', Fields: ['PersonID', 'OrderID', 'OrderDate', 'LineTotalNet', 'ReversedOn'] },
  { BaseTable: 'C1EventAttendance', Fields: ['PersonID', 'EventDate'] },
  { BaseTable: 'C1CourseCompletion', Fields: ['PersonID', 'CompletedOn'] },
  { BaseTable: 'C1Certification', Fields: ['PersonID', 'AwardedOn', 'ExpiresOn'] },
  { BaseTable: 'C1CommitteeMembership', Fields: ['PersonID', 'StartDate', 'EndDate'] },
  { BaseTable: 'MembershipYear', Fields: ['PersonID', 'Year', 'StartDate', 'Plan', 'EventsAttended', 'IncomeK', 'AutoRenew', 'Region', 'PostalCode', 'MemberNumber', 'Noise1', 'Noise2', 'Noise3', 'Noise4', 'Noise5', 'Renewed', 'Status', 'WorldID', 'Seed'] },
  { BaseTable: 'Person', Fields: ['MemberNumber', 'Region', 'PostalCode', 'IncomeK', 'AutoRenew', 'WorldID', 'Seed'] },
];

export class ImmutableFieldDeclarations {
  /**
   * Set AllowUpdateAPI = false on the declared pstruth fields; returns how many fields changed. MJAPI must restart after.
   * One RunView reads every declared field of every provisioned table (no read per table); the saves run in parallel
   * and each result is checked.
   */
  public static async Apply(provider: IMetadataProvider, user: UserInfo, schema: string = 'pstruth'): Promise<number> {
    const declared = new Map<string, ReadonlySet<string>>();   // entity ID (lower-case) → declared field names
    for (const decl of TRUTH_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS) {
      const entity = provider.Entities.find((e) => e.SchemaName === schema && e.BaseTable === decl.BaseTable);
      if (entity) declared.set(NormalizeUUID(entity.ID), new Set(decl.Fields)); // absent = that dataset is not provisioned here
    }
    if (declared.size === 0) return 0;
    const ids = [...declared.keys()].map((id) => `'${EscapeSQLString(id)}'`).join(',');
    const fields = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(provider).RunView<MJEntityFieldEntity>(
      { EntityName: 'MJ: Entity Fields', ExtraFilter: `EntityID IN (${ids}) AND AllowUpdateAPI = 1`, ResultType: 'entity_object' }, user);
    if (!fields.Success) throw new Error(`Reading the declared pstruth fields failed: ${fields.ErrorMessage}`);
    const toChange = fields.Results.filter((f) => declared.get(NormalizeUUID(f.EntityID))?.has(f.Name) === true);
    const saved = await Promise.all(toChange.map(async (f) => {
      f.AllowUpdateAPI = false;
      return { f, ok: await f.Save() };
    }));
    const failed = saved.filter((s) => !s.ok);
    if (failed.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(`Saving ${failed.length} field(s) failed: ${failed.map((s) => `${s.f.Entity}.${s.f.Name}: ${s.f.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'unknown error'}`).join('; ')}`);
    }
    return toChange.length;
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { ICountingDataAccess, CountRowsResult, FetchRowsParams, FetchRowsResult, SourceRow } from '../data-access';

/** Serves `rows` but stops at `cap` per read when set, like a silently capped view; counts report every row. */
class FakeCountingDataAccess implements ICountingDataAccess {
  public Reads: FetchRowsParams[] = [];
  constructor(private readonly rows: SourceRow[], private readonly cap: number | null = null) {}
  async fetchRows(params: FetchRowsParams): Promise<FetchRowsResult> {
    this.Reads.push(params);
    // Ordinal, like the database's key order (localeCompare would order by locale rules).
    let rows = [...this.rows].sort((a, b) => OrdinalCompare(String(a.ID), String(b.ID)));
    const after = /\[ID\] > '([^']+)'/.exec(params.ExtraFilter || '')?.[1];
    if (after) rows = rows.filter((r) => String(r.ID) > after);
    const limit = Math.min(params.MaxRows ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, this.cap ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
    return { Success: true, Rows: rows.slice(0, limit) };
  }
  async fetchEmbedding(): Promise<number[] | null> { return null; }
  async CountRows(): Promise<CountRowsResult> { return { Success: true, Count: this.rows.length }; }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * @module feature-assembly/read-policy
 *
 * Complete reads (C2 `ReadPolicy`, FM-4): the source is counted, read in full (or paged by key), and the rows read
 * are compared with the count. A short read is the refusal `truncated-read`, never a silently smaller matrix.
 */
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { AssemblyRefusal, ReadPolicy } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { ICountingDataAccess, SourceRow } from './data-access';

export interface CompleteReadParams {
  readonly EntityName: string;
  /** The single primary-key field; paged reads continue after the last key read. */
  readonly KeyField: string;
  readonly ExtraFilter?: string;
  readonly Fields?: readonly string[];
}

export type CompleteReadOutcome =
  | { readonly Status: 'read'; readonly Rows: SourceRow[]; readonly Expected: number }
  | { readonly Status: 'refused'; readonly Refusal: AssemblyRefusal };

/**
 * Complete reads (C2 ReadPolicy): count, read in full or paged by key, compare. Static members on one owner (coding
 * standards §2).
 */
export class CompleteReader {
  public static async ReadCompletely(dataAccess: ICountingDataAccess, params: CompleteReadParams, policy: ReadPolicy): Promise<CompleteReadOutcome> {
    const counted = await dataAccess.CountRows({ EntityName: params.EntityName, ExtraFilter: params.ExtraFilter });
    if (!counted.Success) {
      throw new Error(`Counting ${params.EntityName} failed: ${counted.ErrorMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
    }
    const rows = policy.mode === 'complete' ? await CompleteReader.readAll(dataAccess, params) : await CompleteReader.readPaged(dataAccess, params, policy.pageSize);
    if (rows.length === counted.Count) {
      return { Status: 'read', Rows: rows, Expected: counted.Count };
    }
    // A concurrent insert or delete moves the count; accept only when a recount agrees with what was read.
    const recount = await dataAccess.CountRows({ EntityName: params.EntityName, ExtraFilter: params.ExtraFilter });
    if (recount.Success && recount.Count === rows.length) {
      return { Status: 'read', Rows: rows, Expected: recount.Count };
    }
    return { Status: 'refused', Refusal: { kind: 'truncated-read', entity: params.EntityName, rowsExpected: counted.Count, rowsRead: rows.length } };
  }

  private static fieldsWithKey(params: CompleteReadParams): string[] | undefined {
    if (!params.Fields) return undefined;
    return params.Fields.includes(params.KeyField) ? [...params.Fields] : [params.KeyField, ...params.Fields];
  }

  private static async readAll(dataAccess: ICountingDataAccess, params: CompleteReadParams): Promise<SourceRow[]> {
    const res = await dataAccess.fetchRows({ EntityName: params.EntityName, ExtraFilter: params.ExtraFilter, Fields: CompleteReader.fieldsWithKey(params), OrderBy: `[${params.KeyField}]` });
    if (!res.Success) throw new Error(`Reading ${params.EntityName} failed: ${res.ErrorMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
    return res.Rows;
  }

  private static async readPaged(dataAccess: ICountingDataAccess, params: CompleteReadParams, pageSize: number): Promise<SourceRow[]> {
    const out: SourceRow[] = [];
    let last: string | null = null;
    for (;;) {
      const keyFilter = last === null ? null : `[${params.KeyField}] > '${EscapeSQLString(last)}'`;
      const filter = [params.ExtraFilter, keyFilter].filter((f): f is string => !!f && f.length > 0).map((f) => `(${f})`).join(' AND ');
      const res = await dataAccess.fetchRows({ EntityName: params.EntityName, ExtraFilter: filter, Fields: CompleteReader.fieldsWithKey(params), OrderBy: `[${params.KeyField}]`, MaxRows: pageSize });
      if (!res.Success) throw new Error(`Reading ${params.EntityName} failed: ${res.ErrorMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
      out.push(...res.Rows);
      if (res.Rows.length < pageSize) return out;
      const key = res.Rows[res.Rows.length - 1][params.KeyField];
      // An absent key would page on the literal "undefined" (String(undefined)) and silently skip rows.
      if (key === null || key === undefined) throw new Error(`Reading ${params.EntityName}: a row has no ${params.KeyField}, so paging cannot continue`);
      last = key instanceof Date ? key.toISOString() : String(key);
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * @module feature-assembly/assembly-metadata
 *
 * The narrow view of entity metadata the unit reader and the as-of assembly need, so both are testable with plain
 * objects. `ProviderAssemblyMetadata` adapts the provider's `EntityInfo`.
 */
import type { IMetadataProvider } from '@memberjunction/core';

export interface AssemblyFieldInfo {
  readonly Name: string;
  readonly SqlType: string;
  readonly TSType: 'string' | 'number' | 'Date' | 'boolean';
  /** `false` = declared immutable after creation (`MJ: Entity Fields.AllowUpdateAPI`). */
  readonly AllowUpdateAPI: boolean;
  readonly IsPrimaryKey: boolean;
  readonly RelatedEntity: string | null;
  readonly IsVirtual: boolean;
}

export interface AssemblyEntityInfo {
  readonly ID: string;
  readonly Name: string;
  readonly PrimaryKey: string;
  readonly TrackRecordChanges: boolean;
  readonly Fields: readonly AssemblyFieldInfo[];
}

export interface IAssemblyMetadata {
  /** The entity, or null when it is not registered or has a composite primary key (PS units need one key). */
  Entity(name: string): AssemblyEntityInfo | null;
}

export class ProviderAssemblyMetadata implements IAssemblyMetadata {
  constructor(private readonly provider: IMetadataProvider) {}

  public Entity(name: string): AssemblyEntityInfo | null {
    const e = this.provider.EntityByName(name);
    if (!e || e.PrimaryKeys.length !== 1) return null;
    return {
      ID: e.ID,
      Name: e.Name,
      PrimaryKey: e.PrimaryKeys[0].Name,
      TrackRecordChanges: e.TrackRecordChanges === true,
      Fields: e.Fields.map((f) => ({
        Name: f.Name,
        SqlType: f.Type,
        TSType: f.TSType,
        AllowUpdateAPI: f.AllowUpdateAPI !== false,
        IsPrimaryKey: f.IsPrimaryKey === true,
        RelatedEntity: f.RelatedEntity || null,
        IsVirtual: f.IsVirtual === true,
      })),
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * @module training-run-results
 *
 * What a unit-based training run stores in `MJ: ML Training Runs.ValidationResults` (schema `ps-run-results/v2`).
 * The `completed` variant carries the unit resolution, the trainer result and request, the holdout carve and the gate
 * record (the gate decision lives here).
 */
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { AssemblyRefusal } from './assembly-contract';
import type { UnitRefusal } from './prediction-unit';
import { TASK_KINDS, type TaskKind } from './task-type';
import { JsonParse, type ParseResult } from './json-value';

export const TRAINING_RUN_RESULTS_SCHEMA = 'ps-run-results/v2';

export type PipelineRefusal =
  | { readonly kind: 'unit-required'; readonly pipelineId: string; readonly why: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'protocol-required'; readonly pipelineId: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'input-not-accepted'; readonly input: 'asOf' | 'labelEventDates' | 'maxRows'; readonly why: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'unit-invalid'; readonly unitId: string; readonly errors: readonly string[] };

export type TrainingRefusal =
  | { readonly stage: 'pipeline'; readonly reason: PipelineRefusal }
  | { readonly stage: 'unit'; readonly reason: UnitRefusal }
  | { readonly stage: 'assembly'; readonly reason: AssemblyRefusal };

export interface UnitResolutionCounts {
  readonly rowsRead: number;
  readonly censoredRowsExcluded: number;
  readonly labelKnownRowsExcluded: number;
  readonly emptyLabelRowsExcluded: number;
  readonly duplicateRowsRemoved: number;
  readonly resolvedRows: number;
  readonly dataCutoff: string;
}

export interface LegacyTrainerMetrics {
  readonly metrics: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
  readonly holdoutMetrics: Readonly<Record<string, number>> | null;
  readonly trainingRowCount: number;
  readonly holdoutRowCount: number;
}

export type TrainingRunResults =
  | { readonly schema: typeof TRAINING_RUN_RESULTS_SCHEMA; readonly status: 'refused'; readonly refusal: TrainingRefusal }
  | { readonly schema: typeof TRAINING_RUN_RESULTS_SCHEMA; readonly status: 'completed'; readonly unitResolution: UnitResolutionCounts; readonly legacy: LegacyTrainerMetrics | null };

// The stored envelope is parsed with zod, never `JSON.parse(...) as T`: the column is text any writer
// (a migration, a hand edit, an older build) can change, so every member is checked before the type is trusted.
// Each schema is annotated with the TypeScript type it parses, so `tsc` refuses a schema whose output does not fit it.
// Every later task that adds an envelope member, a refusal stage or a refusal kind extends these schemas in the same
// task and adds a case to `training-run-results.test.ts` (the union cannot make `tsc` notice a missing variant).
const pipelineRefusalSchema: z.ZodType<PipelineRefusal> = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('unit-required'), pipelineId: z.string(), why: z.string() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('protocol-required'), pipelineId: z.string() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('input-not-accepted'), input: z.enum(['asOf', 'labelEventDates', 'maxRows']), why: z.string() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('unit-invalid'), unitId: z.string(), errors: z.array(z.string()) }),
]);
const unitRefusalSchema: z.ZodType<UnitRefusal> = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('single-valued-target'), value: z.string(), rows: z.number() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('task-type-mismatch'), declared: z.enum(TASK_KINDS as [TaskKind, ...TaskKind[]]), observed: z.string() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('unresolved-reference'), entity: z.string(), field: z.string().nullable() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('lag-inside-horizon'), lag: z.number(), horizonPeriods: z.number() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('rolling-window-inside-horizon'), endLag: z.number(), horizonPeriods: z.number() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('missing-decision-date'), entity: z.string(), rows: z.number() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('no-resolved-rows'), censored: z.number(), labelKnown: z.number(), emptyLabel: z.number() }),
]);
const assemblyRefusalSchema: z.ZodType<AssemblyRefusal> = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('select-changes-after-decision-date'), entity: z.string(), field: z.string(), changesAfter: z.number() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('decision-date-before-change-history'), entity: z.string(), field: z.string(), historyStart: z.string().nullable(), rowsAffected: z.number() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('truncated-read'), entity: z.string(), rowsExpected: z.number(), rowsRead: z.number() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('non-numeric-in-numeric-column'), column: z.string(), sampleValue: z.string() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('future-period-lag'), column: z.string(), lag: z.number(), horizonPeriods: z.number() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('unpinned-feature-version'), featureName: z.string() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('scope-entity-mismatch'), modelEntity: z.string(), scopeEntity: z.string() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('unresolved-column'), entity: z.string(), field: z.string() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('unsupported-step-kind'), stepId: z.string(), stepKind: z.string() }),
]);
const trainingRefusalSchema: z.ZodType<TrainingRefusal> = z.discriminatedUnion('stage', [
  z.object({ stage: z.literal('pipeline'), reason: pipelineRefusalSchema }),
  z.object({ stage: z.literal('unit'), reason: unitRefusalSchema }),
  z.object({ stage: z.literal('assembly'), reason: assemblyRefusalSchema }),
]);
const unitResolutionCountsSchema: z.ZodType<UnitResolutionCounts> = z.object({
  rowsRead: z.number(), censoredRowsExcluded: z.number(), labelKnownRowsExcluded: z.number(),
  emptyLabelRowsExcluded: z.number(), duplicateRowsRemoved: z.number(), resolvedRows: z.number(), dataCutoff: z.string(),
});
const legacyTrainerMetricsSchema: z.ZodType<LegacyTrainerMetrics> = z.object({
  metrics: z.record(z.number()), holdoutMetrics: z.record(z.number()).nullable(),
  trainingRowCount: z.number(), holdoutRowCount: z.number(),
});
const trainingRunResultsSchema: z.ZodType<TrainingRunResults> = z.discriminatedUnion('status', [
  z.object({ schema: z.literal(TRAINING_RUN_RESULTS_SCHEMA), status: z.literal('refused'), refusal: trainingRefusalSchema }),
  z.object({ schema: z.literal(TRAINING_RUN_RESULTS_SCHEMA), status: z.literal('completed'), unitResolution: unitResolutionCountsSchema, legacy: legacyTrainerMetricsSchema.nullable() }),
]);

/** Reads the ValidationResults envelope of a unit-based run (static member, coding standards §2). */
export class TrainingRunResultsParser {
  /** Reads the v2 envelope with its zod schema; a legacy (pre-v2) blob or any member of the wrong shape is reported as an error. */
  public static ParseTrainingRunResults(text: string | null): ParseResult<TrainingRunResults> {
    const json = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(text, 'ValidationResults');
    if (!json.Ok) return json;
    if (!JsonParse.IsJsonObject(json.Value) || JsonParse.JsonString(json.Value, 'schema') !== TRAINING_RUN_RESULTS_SCHEMA) {
      return { Ok: false, Errors: ['ValidationResults is not a ps-run-results/v2 envelope'] };
    }
    const parsed = trainingRunResultsSchema.safeParse(json.Value);
    return parsed.success
      ? { Ok: true, Value: parsed.data }
      : { Ok: false, Errors: parsed.error.issues.map((i) => `ValidationResults.${i.path.join('.')}: ${i.message}`) };
  }
}
```

```ts
/** Day arithmetic in UTC: every decision date, window end and cutoff is a UTC midnight. */
export const MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000;

export type CellValue = string | number | boolean | Date | null | undefined;

/** UTC-day conversion and arithmetic (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class UtcDay {
  /** The UTC day a value denotes: `yyyy-mm-dd…` strings by their date part (as the reference builder reads them), Dates by their UTC date. */
  public static ToUtcDay(value: CellValue): Date | null {
    if (value instanceof Date) {
      return Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? null : new Date(Date.UTC(value.getUTCFullYear(), value.getUTCMonth(), value.getUTCDate()));
    }
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(value.trim());
      if (m) return new Date(Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3])));
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** `day` plus `days` whole days (negative moves back). */
  public static AddUtcDays(day: Date, days: number): Date {
    return new Date(day.getTime() + days * MS_PER_DAY);
  }

  /** The `yyyy-mm-dd` form of a UTC day. */
  public static UtcDayIso(day: Date): string {
    return day.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}
```

  `Engine/src/prediction-unit/unit-row-reader.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * @module prediction-unit/unit-row-reader
 *
 * Reads a Prediction Unit's rows (C1): one per grain record, or one per grain record × period. Each row gets its
 * decision date, outcome window end, group key, period and label. Rows are excluded — and counted — in this order:
 * censored (window ends after the cutoff), label known at the decision (next-period rule: the outcome was recorded
 * on or before the decision date), empty label. Exact duplicates of (entity key, decision date, period) are removed
 * and counted. The source is read completely or the read is refused.
 */
import { OrdinalCompare } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { TaskTypeRules, PredictionUnit, type LabelRule, type PredictionUnitSpec, type ReadPolicy, type RowFilter, type TaskType, type TrainingRefusal, type UnitRefusal, type UnitResolutionCounts, type UnitRows } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { ICountingDataAccess, SourceRow } from '../feature-assembly/data-access';
import { CompleteReader } from '../feature-assembly/read-policy';
import type { AssemblyEntityInfo, IAssemblyMetadata } from '../feature-assembly/assembly-metadata';
import { UtcDay, type CellValue } from './utc-day';

export type CanonicalLabelValue = string | number;

export interface UnitRow {
  readonly RowId: string;
  readonly EntityKey: string;
  readonly DecisionDate: Date;
  readonly WindowEnd: Date;
  readonly GroupKey: string | null;
  readonly Period: Date | null;
  readonly Label: CanonicalLabelValue;
  readonly Source: SourceRow;
}

export interface UnitReadDeps {
  readonly DataAccess: ICountingDataAccess;
  readonly Metadata: IAssemblyMetadata;
  readonly Read: ReadPolicy;
  /** The clock for `cutoff.kind = 'now'` (injected so tests are deterministic). */
  readonly Now: Date;
}

export type UnitRowReadResult =
  | { readonly Status: 'read'; readonly Rows: readonly UnitRow[]; readonly Counts: UnitResolutionCounts; readonly DataCutoff: Date; readonly RowEntity: AssemblyEntityInfo }
  | { readonly Status: 'refused'; readonly Refusal: TrainingRefusal };

interface ResolvedLabel { readonly Label: CanonicalLabelValue | null; readonly Known: boolean }
type Labeler = (row: SourceRow, entityKey: string, decision: Date, windowStart: Date, windowEnd: Date) => ResolvedLabel;
interface ResolvedRows { readonly Rows: UnitRow[]; readonly Censored: number; readonly LabelKnown: number; readonly EmptyLabel: number }

export class PredictionUnitRowReader {
  /** Labels in one canonical form: classes are trimmed strings (booleans → '1'/'0'); numeric tasks are numbers. Empty → null. */
  public static CanonicalLabel(value: CellValue, task: TaskType): CanonicalLabelValue | null {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
    if (TaskTypeRules.IsClassificationTask(task)) {
      if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value ? '1' : '0';
      if (typeof value === 'number') return Number.isFinite(value) ? String(value) : null;
      if (value instanceof Date) return UtcDay.UtcDayIso(value);
      const t = value.trim();
      return t.length === 0 ? null : t;
    }
    if (typeof value === 'number') return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
    if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value ? 1 : 0;
    if (value instanceof Date) return null;
    const t = value.trim();
    if (t.length === 0) return null;
    const n = Number(t);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : t;
  }

  /** In-memory filter (no SQL is built from unit JSON). */
  public static MatchesRowFilters(row: SourceRow, filters: readonly RowFilter[]): boolean {
    return filters.every((f) => {
      const v = row[f.field];
      const s = v instanceof Date ? UtcDay.UtcDayIso(v) : v;
      switch (f.op) {
        case 'not-null': return s !== null && s !== undefined && s !== '';
        case 'is-null': return s === null || s === undefined || s === '';
        case 'eq': return s === f.values[0] || String(s) === String(f.values[0]);
        case 'neq': return !(s === f.values[0] || String(s) === String(f.values[0]));
        case 'in': return f.values.some((x) => s === x || String(s) === String(x));
      }
    });
  }

  private static unitRefusal(reason: UnitRefusal): UnitRowReadResult {
    return { Status: 'refused', Refusal: { stage: 'unit', reason } };
  }

  /** A day that the code path guarantees (validated date strings, Dates, rows already checked for a decision date). */
  private static requireDay(day: Date | null, what: string): Date {
    if (day === null) throw new Error(`PredictionUnitRowReader: ${what} is not a date`);
    return day;
  }

  /**
   * A row's key value as a string. An absent key would otherwise become the literal "undefined"/"null" (the
   * String(undefined) bug class) and group unrelated rows under one fake entity, so it fails loudly instead.
   */
  private static requireKey(value: CellValue, what: string): string {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') throw new Error(`PredictionUnitRowReader: ${what} is empty`);
    return value instanceof Date ? UtcDay.UtcDayIso(value) : String(value);
  }

  /** Lower-cased key for in-memory matching. `??` keeps a legitimate 0/false key value; only null/undefined become ''. */
  private static keyOf(v: CellValue): string {
    return (v instanceof Date ? UtcDay.UtcDayIso(v) : String(v ?? '')).toLowerCase();
  }

  public async Read(unit: PredictionUnitSpec, deps: UnitReadDeps): Promise<UnitRowReadResult> {
    const rowEntityName = PredictionUnit.UnitRowEntityName(unit.rows);
    const rowEntity = deps.Metadata.Entity(rowEntityName);
    if (!rowEntity) return PredictionUnitRowReader.unitRefusal({ kind: 'unresolved-reference', entity: rowEntityName, field: null });
    if (!deps.Metadata.Entity(unit.rows.grainEntity)) return PredictionUnitRowReader.unitRefusal({ kind: 'unresolved-reference', entity: unit.rows.grainEntity, field: null });

    const read = await CompleteReader.ReadCompletely(deps.DataAccess, { EntityName: rowEntity.Name, KeyField: rowEntity.PrimaryKey }, deps.Read);
    if (read.Status === 'refused') return { Status: 'refused', Refusal: { stage: 'assembly', reason: read.Refusal } };

    const cutoff = await this.resolveCutoff(unit, deps);
    if ('Status' in cutoff) return cutoff;
    const labeler = await this.buildLabeler(unit, rowEntity, read.Rows, deps);
    if ('Status' in labeler) return labeler;

    const candidates = read.Rows.filter((r) => PredictionUnitRowReader.MatchesRowFilters(r, unit.rows.filter));
    const undated = candidates.filter((r) => this.decisionDate(unit, r) === null).length;
    if (undated > 0) return PredictionUnitRowReader.unitRefusal({ kind: 'missing-decision-date', entity: rowEntity.Name, rows: undated });

    const resolved = this.resolveRows(unit, rowEntity, candidates, cutoff, labeler);
    const rows = this.removeDuplicates(resolved.Rows);
    return {
      Status: 'read',
      Rows: rows,
      DataCutoff: cutoff,
      RowEntity: rowEntity,
      Counts: {
        rowsRead: read.Rows.length,
        censoredRowsExcluded: resolved.Censored,
        labelKnownRowsExcluded: resolved.LabelKnown,
        emptyLabelRowsExcluded: resolved.EmptyLabel,
        duplicateRowsRemoved: resolved.Rows.length - rows.length,
        resolvedRows: rows.length,
        dataCutoff: UtcDay.UtcDayIso(cutoff),
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Applies the exclusions in their documented order — censored, label known at the decision, empty label — and
   * builds the unit rows, sorted by decision date then row id (ordinal).
   */
  private resolveRows(unit: PredictionUnitSpec, rowEntity: AssemblyEntityInfo, candidates: readonly SourceRow[], cutoff: Date, labeler: Labeler): ResolvedRows {
    let censored = 0;
    let labelKnown = 0;
    let emptyLabel = 0;
    const resolved: UnitRow[] = [];
    for (const row of candidates) {
      const rowId = PredictionUnitRowReader.requireKey(row[rowEntity.PrimaryKey], `${rowEntity.Name}.${rowEntity.PrimaryKey}`);
      const decision = PredictionUnitRowReader.requireDay(this.decisionDate(unit, row), `decision date of ${rowEntity.Name} ${rowId}`);
      const windowStart = UtcDay.AddUtcDays(decision, unit.label.gapDays);
      const windowEnd = UtcDay.AddUtcDays(windowStart, unit.label.windowDays);
      if (windowEnd.getTime() > cutoff.getTime()) { censored++; continue; }
      const entityKey = unit.rows.kind === 'grain' ? rowId : PredictionUnitRowReader.requireKey(row[unit.rows.foreignKey], `${rowEntity.Name}.${unit.rows.foreignKey} of ${rowId}`);
      const label = labeler(row, entityKey, decision, windowStart, windowEnd);
      if (label.Known) { labelKnown++; continue; }
      if (label.Label === null) { emptyLabel++; continue; }
      resolved.push({
        RowId: rowId,
        EntityKey: entityKey,
        DecisionDate: decision,
        WindowEnd: windowEnd,
        GroupKey: unit.groupKey ? PredictionUnitRowReader.keyOf(row[unit.groupKey]) : entityKey.toLowerCase(),
        Period: unit.rows.kind === 'grain-x-periods' ? decision : unit.temporal ? UtcDay.ToUtcDay(row[unit.temporal.timeColumn]) : null,
        Label: label.Label,
        Source: row,
      });
    }
    resolved.sort((a, b) => a.DecisionDate.getTime() - b.DecisionDate.getTime() || OrdinalCompare(a.RowId, b.RowId));
    return { Rows: resolved, Censored: censored, LabelKnown: labelKnown, EmptyLabel: emptyLabel };
  }

  /** Keeps the first row of each (entity key, decision date, period); the caller counts the rest as duplicates. */
  private removeDuplicates(resolved: readonly UnitRow[]): UnitRow[] {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const rows: UnitRow[] = [];
    for (const r of resolved) {
      const k = `${r.EntityKey.toLowerCase()}|${UtcDay.UtcDayIso(r.DecisionDate)}|${r.Period ? UtcDay.UtcDayIso(r.Period) : ''}`;
      if (seen.has(k)) continue;
      seen.add(k);
      rows.push(r);
    }
    return rows;
  }

  private decisionDate(unit: PredictionUnitSpec, row: SourceRow): Date | null {
    if (unit.rows.kind === 'grain-x-periods') return UtcDay.ToUtcDay(row[unit.rows.periodDate]);
    const rule = unit.rows.decisionDate;
    switch (rule.kind) {
      case 'column': return UtcDay.ToUtcDay(row[rule.column]);
      case 'column-offset': {
        const d = UtcDay.ToUtcDay(row[rule.column]);
        return d === null ? null : UtcDay.AddUtcDays(d, rule.offsetDays);
      }
      case 'fixed': return UtcDay.ToUtcDay(rule.date);
    }
  }

  private async resolveCutoff(unit: PredictionUnitSpec, deps: UnitReadDeps): Promise<Date | UnitRowReadResult> {
    const cutoff = unit.censoring.cutoff;
    if (cutoff.kind === 'now') return PredictionUnitRowReader.requireDay(UtcDay.ToUtcDay(deps.Now), 'the current day');
    if (cutoff.kind === 'fixed') return PredictionUnitRowReader.requireDay(UtcDay.ToUtcDay(cutoff.at), `the fixed cutoff ${cutoff.at}`);
    const entity = deps.Metadata.Entity(cutoff.entity);
    // The field name comes from unit JSON; it is used in SQL text only after it matched a metadata field name.
    if (!entity || !entity.Fields.some((f) => f.Name === cutoff.field)) return PredictionUnitRowReader.unitRefusal({ kind: 'unresolved-reference', entity: cutoff.entity, field: cutoff.field });
    const res = await deps.DataAccess.fetchRows({ EntityName: entity.Name, Fields: [cutoff.field], ExtraFilter: `[${cutoff.field}] IS NOT NULL`, OrderBy: `[${cutoff.field}] DESC`, MaxRows: 1 });
    if (!res.Success) throw new Error(`Reading the corpus end from ${entity.Name}.${cutoff.field} failed: ${res.ErrorMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
    const end = res.Rows.length > 0 ? UtcDay.ToUtcDay(res.Rows[0][cutoff.field]) : null;
    if (end === null) return PredictionUnitRowReader.unitRefusal({ kind: 'unresolved-reference', entity: cutoff.entity, field: cutoff.field });
    return end;
  }

  private async buildLabeler(unit: PredictionUnitSpec, rowEntity: AssemblyEntityInfo, rows: readonly SourceRow[], deps: UnitReadDeps): Promise<Labeler | UnitRowReadResult> {
    const rule: LabelRule = unit.label.rule;
    switch (rule.kind) {
      case 'column':
        if (!rowEntity.Fields.some((f) => f.Name === rule.column)) return PredictionUnitRowReader.unitRefusal({ kind: 'unresolved-reference', entity: rowEntity.Name, field: rule.column });
        return (row) => ({ Label: PredictionUnitRowReader.CanonicalLabel(row[rule.column], unit.label.outcome), Known: false });
      case 'next-period':
        if (unit.rows.kind !== 'grain-x-periods') return PredictionUnitRowReader.unitRefusal({ kind: 'unresolved-reference', entity: rowEntity.Name, field: rule.periodIndexField });
        return this.nextPeriodLabeler(rule, unit.rows, rows);
      case 'child-event':
        return this.childEventLabeler(rule, unit.label.outcome, deps);
    }
  }

  /** next-period: 1 when the period `offset` later falls in the window; label known when it is on or before the decision. */
  private nextPeriodLabeler(rule: Extract<LabelRule, { kind: 'next-period' }>, unitRows: Extract<UnitRows, { kind: 'grain-x-periods' }>, rows: readonly SourceRow[]): Labeler {
    const byKey = new Map<string, Map<number, Date>>();
    for (const r of rows) {
      const idx = Number(r[rule.periodIndexField]);
      const d = UtcDay.ToUtcDay(r[unitRows.periodDate]);
      if (!Number.isInteger(idx) || d === null) continue;
      const k = PredictionUnitRowReader.keyOf(r[unitRows.foreignKey]);
      const m = byKey.get(k) || new Map<number, Date>();
      m.set(idx, d);
      byKey.set(k, m);
    }
    return (row, entityKey, decision, windowStart, windowEnd) => {
      const next = byKey.get(entityKey.toLowerCase())?.get(Number(row[rule.periodIndexField]) + rule.offset);
      if (next !== undefined && next.getTime() <= decision.getTime()) return { Label: null, Known: true };
      const inWindow = next !== undefined && next.getTime() > windowStart.getTime() && next.getTime() <= windowEnd.getTime();
      return { Label: inWindow ? '1' : '0', Known: false };
    };
  }

  /** child-event: exists / count / sum of the owner's child events inside the window. */
  private async childEventLabeler(rule: Extract<LabelRule, { kind: 'child-event' }>, task: TaskType, deps: UnitReadDeps): Promise<Labeler | UnitRowReadResult> {
    const child = deps.Metadata.Entity(rule.childEntity);
    if (!child) return PredictionUnitRowReader.unitRefusal({ kind: 'unresolved-reference', entity: rule.childEntity, field: null });
    const read = await CompleteReader.ReadCompletely(deps.DataAccess, { EntityName: child.Name, KeyField: child.PrimaryKey }, deps.Read);
    if (read.Status === 'refused') return { Status: 'refused', Refusal: { stage: 'assembly', reason: read.Refusal } };
    const events = new Map<string, { readonly Day: Date; readonly Value: number }[]>();
    for (const r of read.Rows) {
      if (!PredictionUnitRowReader.MatchesRowFilters(r, rule.filter)) continue;
      const d = UtcDay.ToUtcDay(r[rule.dateField]);
      if (d === null) continue;
      const k = PredictionUnitRowReader.keyOf(r[rule.foreignKey]);
      const list = events.get(k) || [];
      list.push({ Day: d, Value: rule.valueField ? Number(r[rule.valueField] || 0) : 1 });
      events.set(k, list);
    }
    return (row, entityKey, _decision, windowStart, windowEnd) => {
      const owner = rule.ownerKeyField ? PredictionUnitRowReader.keyOf(row[rule.ownerKeyField]) : entityKey.toLowerCase();
      const hits = (events.get(owner) || []).filter((e) => e.Day.getTime() > windowStart.getTime() && e.Day.getTime() <= windowEnd.getTime());
      if (rule.aggregate === 'exists') return { Label: PredictionUnitRowReader.CanonicalLabel(hits.length > 0 ? '1' : '0', task), Known: false };
      if (rule.aggregate === 'count') return { Label: hits.length, Known: false };
      return { Label: hits.reduce((s, e) => s + e.Value, 0), Known: false };
    };
  }
}
```

  `requireDay` never throws on a validated unit (fixed dates are checked by the parser, decision dates by the
  `missing-decision-date` refusal above); it exists so no assertion is needed. `requireKey` throws on a row whose
  primary or foreign key is empty instead of keying it as the string "undefined" (coding standards §2, the
  `String(undefined)` bug class).

```ts
/**
 * @module prediction-unit/target-validation
 *
 * Target validation before training (source plan C3; F-MC-4, F-SC-12, FM-1, FM-8): fewer than two classes, labels
 * outside the declared class order, a count declared continuous, and negative values for count/non-negative tasks
 * are refused with the unit refusal that names them. Empty labels never get here (the reader excludes and counts them).
 */
import type { TaskType, UnitResolutionCounts, UnitValidation } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { UnitRow } from './unit-row-reader';

/** A continuous target that looks like this is a count: integers >= 0 that include 0 and take fewer distinct values. */
export const COUNT_SIGNATURE_MAX_DISTINCT = 50;

type UnitRefusalReason = Extract<UnitValidation, { status: 'refused' }>['reason'];

/** Target validation before training (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class UnitTargetValidator {
  private static refused(reason: UnitRefusalReason): UnitValidation {
    return { status: 'refused', reason };
  }

  public static ValidateUnitTargets(rows: readonly UnitRow[], task: TaskType, counts: UnitResolutionCounts): UnitValidation {
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      return UnitTargetValidator.refused({ kind: 'no-resolved-rows', censored: counts.censoredRowsExcluded, labelKnown: counts.labelKnownRowsExcluded, emptyLabel: counts.emptyLabelRowsExcluded });
    }
    return task.kind === 'binary' || task.kind === 'multiclass' ? UnitTargetValidator.validateClasses(rows, task, counts) : UnitTargetValidator.validateNumeric(rows, task, counts);
  }

  /** Classification: at least two observed classes, every one of them in the declared class order. */
  private static validateClasses(rows: readonly UnitRow[], task: Extract<TaskType, { kind: 'binary' | 'multiclass' }>, counts: UnitResolutionCounts): UnitValidation {
    const levels = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const r of rows) levels.set(String(r.Label), (levels.get(String(r.Label)) || 0) + 1);
    if (levels.size < 2) {
      const [value, n] = [...levels.entries()][0];
      return UnitTargetValidator.refused({ kind: 'single-valued-target', value, rows: n });
    }
    const unknown = [...levels.keys()].filter((l) => !task.classOrder.includes(l)).sort();
    if (unknown.length > 0) {
      return UnitTargetValidator.refused({ kind: 'task-type-mismatch', declared: task.kind, observed: `labels ${unknown.join(', ')} are not in classOrder [${task.classOrder.join(', ')}]` });
    }
    return { status: 'valid', observedLevels: levels.size, eligibleRows: rows.length, censoredRows: counts.censoredRowsExcluded };
  }

  /** Numeric tasks: numbers only, more than one value, the count signature refused as continuous, no negatives where declared. */
  private static validateNumeric(rows: readonly UnitRow[], task: Exclude<TaskType, { kind: 'binary' | 'multiclass' }>, counts: UnitResolutionCounts): UnitValidation {
    const values: number[] = [];
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (typeof r.Label !== 'number') return UnitTargetValidator.refused({ kind: 'task-type-mismatch', declared: task.kind, observed: `non-numeric label "${r.Label}"` });
      values.push(r.Label);
    }
    const distinct = new Set(values);
    if (distinct.size < 2) return UnitTargetValidator.refused({ kind: 'single-valued-target', value: String(values[0]), rows: values.length });
    const valueKind = task.kind === 'forecast' ? task.valueKind : task.kind;
    const allNonNegativeIntegers = values.every((v) => Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0);
    if (valueKind === 'continuous' && allNonNegativeIntegers && distinct.has(0) && distinct.size < COUNT_SIGNATURE_MAX_DISTINCT) {
      return UnitTargetValidator.refused({ kind: 'task-type-mismatch', declared: task.kind, observed: `count (non-negative integers including 0, ${distinct.size} distinct values)` });
    }
    if (valueKind === 'count' && !allNonNegativeIntegers) {
      return UnitTargetValidator.refused({ kind: 'task-type-mismatch', declared: task.kind, observed: values.some((v) => v < 0) ? 'negative values' : 'non-integer values (continuous)' });
    }
    if (valueKind === 'non-negative' && values.some((v) => v < 0)) {
      return UnitTargetValidator.refused({ kind: 'task-type-mismatch', declared: task.kind, observed: 'negative values' });
    }
    return { status: 'valid', observedLevels: distinct.size, eligibleRows: rows.length, censoredRows: counts.censoredRowsExcluded };
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * @module prediction-unit/unit-versioning
 *
 * Creating unit versions. Version 1 is its own lineage root; every later version copies the latest version,
 * applies the changes, takes Version = latest + 1 and LabelVersion = previous + 1 exactly when the outcome definition
 * changed. A saved version is never updated (the server subclass refuses it).
 */
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { UserInfo } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { MJPredictionUnitEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { PredictionUnit, type Actor, type CensoringRule, type ChangeHistoryPolicy, type DecisionSpec, type IncumbentHeuristic, type LabelRule, type TaskType, type TemporalSpec, type UnitRows } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { IEntityFactory } from '../training/types';

export interface PredictionUnitDraft {
  readonly Name: string;
  readonly Description: string | null;
  readonly UnitRows: UnitRows;
  readonly LabelRule: LabelRule;
  readonly LabelWindowDays: number;
  readonly LabelGapDays: number;
  readonly TaskType: TaskType;
  readonly Censoring: CensoringRule;
  readonly ChangeHistoryPolicy: ChangeHistoryPolicy;
  readonly GroupKey: string | null;
  readonly TemporalSpec: TemporalSpec | null;
  readonly DecisionSpec: DecisionSpec;
  readonly IncumbentHeuristic: IncumbentHeuristic;
}

export interface UnitVersionColumns {
  readonly ID: string | null;
  readonly LineageRootID: string;
  readonly Version: number;
  readonly LabelVersion: number;
  readonly Name: string;
  readonly Description: string | null;
  readonly UnitRows: string;
  readonly LabelRule: string;
  readonly LabelWindowDays: number;
  readonly LabelGapDays: number;
  readonly TaskType: string;
  readonly Censoring: string;
  readonly ChangeHistoryPolicy: string;
  readonly GroupKey: string | null;
  readonly TemporalSpec: string | null;
  readonly DecisionSpec: string;
  readonly IncumbentHeuristic: string;
  readonly AuthoredBy: string;
}

/**
 * Creating unit versions: build, assign and save version rows (static members on one owner, coding standards
 * §2).
 */
export class PredictionUnitVersioning {
  /** The outcome definition (rule, window, gap, task) — the same fields `PredictionUnit.LabelDefinitionChanged` compares. */
  private static labelKey(d: PredictionUnitDraft): string {
    return JSON.stringify([d.LabelRule, d.LabelWindowDays, d.LabelGapDays, d.TaskType]);
  }

  private static columnsOf(d: PredictionUnitDraft): Omit<UnitVersionColumns, 'ID' | 'LineageRootID' | 'Version' | 'LabelVersion' | 'AuthoredBy'> {
    return {
      Name: d.Name, Description: d.Description, UnitRows: JSON.stringify(d.UnitRows), LabelRule: JSON.stringify(d.LabelRule),
      LabelWindowDays: d.LabelWindowDays, LabelGapDays: d.LabelGapDays, TaskType: JSON.stringify(d.TaskType),
      Censoring: JSON.stringify(d.Censoring), ChangeHistoryPolicy: JSON.stringify(d.ChangeHistoryPolicy), GroupKey: d.GroupKey,
      TemporalSpec: d.TemporalSpec ? JSON.stringify(d.TemporalSpec) : null, DecisionSpec: JSON.stringify(d.DecisionSpec),
      IncumbentHeuristic: JSON.stringify(d.IncumbentHeuristic),
    };
  }

  /** Pure: the columns of the next version. */
  public static BuildNextVersionColumns(
    lineage: { readonly lineageRootId: string; readonly latestVersion: number; readonly previousLabelVersion: number; readonly previous: PredictionUnitDraft },
    changes: Partial<PredictionUnitDraft>,
    actor: Actor,
  ): UnitVersionColumns {
    const next: PredictionUnitDraft = { ...lineage.previous, ...changes };
    return {
      ID: null,
      LineageRootID: lineage.lineageRootId,
      Version: lineage.latestVersion + 1,
      LabelVersion: lineage.previousLabelVersion + (PredictionUnitVersioning.labelKey(next) === PredictionUnitVersioning.labelKey(lineage.previous) ? 0 : 1),
      AuthoredBy: JSON.stringify(actor),
      ...PredictionUnitVersioning.columnsOf(next),
    };
  }

  private static assign(entity: MJPredictionUnitEntity, c: UnitVersionColumns): void {
    if (c.ID) entity.ID = c.ID;
    entity.LineageRootID = c.LineageRootID;
    entity.Version = c.Version;
    entity.LabelVersion = c.LabelVersion;
    entity.Name = c.Name;
    entity.Description = c.Description;
    entity.UnitRows = c.UnitRows;
    entity.LabelRule = c.LabelRule;
    entity.LabelWindowDays = c.LabelWindowDays;
    entity.LabelGapDays = c.LabelGapDays;
    entity.TaskType = c.TaskType;
    entity.Censoring = c.Censoring;
    entity.ChangeHistoryPolicy = c.ChangeHistoryPolicy;
    entity.GroupKey = c.GroupKey;
    entity.TemporalSpec = c.TemporalSpec;
    entity.DecisionSpec = c.DecisionSpec;
    entity.IncumbentHeuristic = c.IncumbentHeuristic;
    entity.AuthoredBy = c.AuthoredBy;
  }

  private static async saveOrThrow(entity: MJPredictionUnitEntity, what: string): Promise<MJPredictionUnitEntity> {
    if (!(await entity.Save())) throw new Error(`Saving ${what} failed: ${entity.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
    return entity;
  }

  public static async CreatePredictionUnitV1(draft: PredictionUnitDraft, actor: Actor, entityFactory: IEntityFactory, contextUser?: UserInfo): Promise<MJPredictionUnitEntity> {
    const id = randomUUID().toUpperCase();
    const entity = await entityFactory.getEntityObject<MJPredictionUnitEntity>('MJ: Prediction Units', contextUser);
    PredictionUnitVersioning.assign(entity, { ID: id, LineageRootID: id, Version: 1, LabelVersion: 1, AuthoredBy: JSON.stringify(actor), ...PredictionUnitVersioning.columnsOf(draft) });
    return PredictionUnitVersioning.saveOrThrow(entity, `Prediction Unit "${draft.Name}" v1`);
  }

  /** Read a saved version back into a draft (the inverse of `columnsOf`), through the same parser that validated it. */
  public static DraftFromUnitRow(row: MJPredictionUnitEntity): PredictionUnitDraft {
    const parsed = PredictionUnit.ParsePredictionUnitRow(row);
    if (!parsed.Ok) throw new Error(`Prediction Unit ${row.ID} does not parse: ${parsed.Errors.join('; ')}`);
    const s = parsed.Value;
    return {
      Name: s.name, Description: row.Description, UnitRows: s.rows, LabelRule: s.label.rule, LabelWindowDays: s.label.windowDays,
      LabelGapDays: s.label.gapDays, TaskType: s.label.outcome, Censoring: s.censoring, ChangeHistoryPolicy: s.history,
      GroupKey: s.groupKey, TemporalSpec: s.temporal, DecisionSpec: s.decision, IncumbentHeuristic: s.incumbent,
    };
  }

  public static async CreateNextPredictionUnitVersion(
    latest: MJPredictionUnitEntity,
    changes: Partial<PredictionUnitDraft>,
    actor: Actor,
    entityFactory: IEntityFactory,
    contextUser?: UserInfo,
  ): Promise<MJPredictionUnitEntity> {
    const columns = PredictionUnitVersioning.BuildNextVersionColumns(
      { lineageRootId: latest.LineageRootID, latestVersion: latest.Version, previousLabelVersion: latest.LabelVersion, previous: PredictionUnitVersioning.DraftFromUnitRow(latest) },
      changes,
      actor,
    );
    const entity = await entityFactory.getEntityObject<MJPredictionUnitEntity>('MJ: Prediction Units', contextUser);
    PredictionUnitVersioning.assign(entity, columns);
    return PredictionUnitVersioning.saveOrThrow(entity, `Prediction Unit "${columns.Name}" v${columns.Version}`);
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * @module prediction-unit/unit-store
 *
 * Loading unit versions for training, and writing a unit onto a pipeline (the legacy TargetEntityID/TargetVariable/
 * ProblemType columns are derived from the unit and checked by the pipeline's ValidateAsync).
 */
import { RunView, type IMetadataProvider, type UserInfo } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, MJPredictionUnitEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { PredictionUnit, TaskTypeRules, type PredictionUnitSpec } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { IAssemblyMetadata } from '../feature-assembly/assembly-metadata';

export interface IPredictionUnitStore {
  Load(unitId: string): Promise<MJPredictionUnitEntity | null>;
  LatestVersion(lineageRootId: string): Promise<MJPredictionUnitEntity | null>;
}

/** Reads unit versions through the request's provider (never the global one: coding standards §6). */
export class RunViewPredictionUnitStore implements IPredictionUnitStore {
  private readonly runView: RunView;
  constructor(provider: IMetadataProvider, private readonly contextUser?: UserInfo) {
    this.runView = RunView.FromMetadataProvider(provider);
  }
  /** The unit version with this ID, or null. */
  public async Load(unitId: string): Promise<MJPredictionUnitEntity | null> {
    const r = await this.runView.RunView<MJPredictionUnitEntity>({ EntityName: 'MJ: Prediction Units', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(unitId)}'`, ResultType: 'entity_object' }, this.contextUser);
    if (!r.Success) throw new Error(`Loading Prediction Unit ${unitId} failed: ${r.ErrorMessage}`);
    return r.Results[0] || null;
  }
  /** The highest Version of a lineage, or null. */
  public async LatestVersion(lineageRootId: string): Promise<MJPredictionUnitEntity | null> {
    const r = await this.runView.RunView<MJPredictionUnitEntity>({ EntityName: 'MJ: Prediction Units', ExtraFilter: `LineageRootID='${EscapeSQLString(lineageRootId)}'`, OrderBy: 'Version DESC', MaxRows: 1, ResultType: 'entity_object' }, this.contextUser);
    if (!r.Success) throw new Error(`Loading the latest version of ${lineageRootId} failed: ${r.ErrorMessage}`);
    return r.Results[0] || null;
  }

  /** Point a pipeline at a unit version and derive its legacy target columns. */
  public static ApplyUnitToPipeline(pipeline: MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, unitId: string, spec: PredictionUnitSpec, metadata: IAssemblyMetadata): void {
  const rowEntity = metadata.Entity(PredictionUnit.UnitRowEntityName(spec.rows));
  if (!rowEntity) throw new Error(`Prediction Unit row entity "${PredictionUnit.UnitRowEntityName(spec.rows)}" is not registered`);
  pipeline.PredictionUnitID = unitId;
  pipeline.TargetEntityID = rowEntity.ID;
  pipeline.TargetVariable = PredictionUnit.DescribeLabelRule(spec);
  pipeline.ProblemType = TaskTypeRules.LegacyProblemTypeForTask(spec.label.outcome);
  }
}
```

```ts
/** A training run refused before (or instead of) fitting; the run row records `refusal` and the operation surfaces the sentence. */
import type { TrainingRefusal } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';

export class TrainingRefusedError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly Refusal: TrainingRefusal) {
    super(TrainingRefusedError.DescribeTrainingRefusal(Refusal));
    this.name = 'TrainingRefusedError';
  }

  /** The one sentence a refusal is shown as (run Notes, operation error). Callers branch on `Refusal`, never on this text. */
  public static DescribeTrainingRefusal(r: TrainingRefusal): string {
    const reason = r.reason;
    switch (reason.kind) {
      case 'single-valued-target': return `Refused (single-valued-target): the outcome is "${reason.value}" for all ${reason.rows} resolved rows; a model needs at least two outcomes.`;
      case 'task-type-mismatch': return `Refused (task-type-mismatch): the unit declares ${reason.declared} but the outcome is ${reason.observed}.`;
      case 'unresolved-reference': return `Refused (unresolved-reference): ${reason.entity}${reason.field ? `.${reason.field}` : ''} is not registered.`;
      case 'missing-decision-date': return `Refused (missing-decision-date): ${reason.rows} rows of ${reason.entity} have no decision date; filter them out in the unit.`;
      case 'no-resolved-rows': return `Refused (no-resolved-rows): no row is resolved (${reason.censored} censored, ${reason.labelKnown} label known at decision, ${reason.emptyLabel} empty).`;
      case 'lag-inside-horizon': return `Refused (lag-inside-horizon): lag ${reason.lag} < horizon ${reason.horizonPeriods}.`;
      case 'rolling-window-inside-horizon': return `Refused (rolling-window-inside-horizon): endLag ${reason.endLag} < horizon ${reason.horizonPeriods}.`;
      case 'unit-required': return `Refused (unit-required): pipeline ${reason.pipelineId} — ${reason.why}`;
      case 'protocol-required': return `Refused (protocol-required): pipeline ${reason.pipelineId} has no Evaluation Protocol.`;
      case 'input-not-accepted': return `Refused (input-not-accepted): ${reason.input} — ${reason.why}`;
      case 'unit-invalid': return `Refused (unit-invalid): Prediction Unit ${reason.unitId}: ${reason.errors.join('; ')}`;
      default: return `Refused (${reason.kind}): ${JSON.stringify(reason)}`;
    }
  }
}
```

  kind so the switch is exhaustive.)
