  `trainLegacyPipeline` is the existing body (from PR 2's as-of refusal `if (AsOfSettingHasNoEffectError.WouldBeIgnored(resolved.asOf))`
  to the end, so the refusal and the `MajorityBaselineRule` parse still run before the run row is written), moved
  verbatim. The unit path (PR 2's seeded, label-stratified `carveLockedHoldout(matrix, resolved, seed)` and its
  `LockedHoldoutSplit` until M4.4's carver replaces the call, D3-70; PR 2's `EvaluationRecord` on the model and the run
  notes):

```ts
  private async trainUnitPipeline(resolved: ResolvedPipeline, unitId: string, input: TrainModelInput, deps: TrainingDeps): Promise<TrainModelResult> {
    const majorityBaselineRule = EvaluationLineage.ParseMajorityBaselineRule(resolved.validation.MajorityBaselineRule);
    const run = await this.createRunRow(resolved, input, deps);
    try {
      if (input.maxRows !== null && input.maxRows !== undefined) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'pipeline', reason: { kind: 'input-not-accepted', input: 'maxRows', why: 'a Prediction Unit pipeline reads every unit row; a capped read is not a complete read' } });
      if (input.labelEventDates) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'pipeline', reason: { kind: 'input-not-accepted', input: 'labelEventDates', why: 'decision dates come from the Prediction Unit' } });
      const unit = await this.loadUnitSpec(unitId, deps);
      const metadata = deps.assemblyMetadata || new ProviderAssemblyMetadata(this.requireProvider(deps));
      // requireProvider: the unit path never falls back to RunViewDataAccess's global `new RunView()` (coding standards §6).
      const dataAccess = deps.dataAccess || new RunViewDataAccess(deps.contextUser, this.requireProvider(deps));
      const unitRead = await this.unitReader.Read(unit, { DataAccess: dataAccess, Metadata: metadata, Read: { mode: 'complete' }, Now: deps.now?.() || new Date() });
      if (unitRead.Status === 'refused') throw new TrainingRefusedError(unitRead.Refusal);
      const validation = UnitTargetValidator.ValidateUnitTargets(unitRead.Rows, unit.label.outcome, unitRead.Counts);
      if (validation.status === 'refused') throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'unit', reason: validation.reason });

      // The existing executor assembles the unit's rows until the as-of assembler replaces this call.
      const records: SourceRow[] = unitRead.Rows.map((r) => ({ ...r.Source, [LABEL_COLUMN]: r.Label }));
      const assembly = await this.assembler.assemble({
        targetEntityName: unitRead.RowEntity.Name, records, sources: resolved.sourceBindings, steps: resolved.featureSteps,
        asOf: { Mode: 'none' }, leakageGuard: resolved.leakageGuard, targetVariable: LABEL_COLUMN,
        primaryKeyField: unitRead.RowEntity.PrimaryKey, context: 'train', contextUser: deps.contextUser, provider: deps.provider, dataAccess,
      });
      const unitResolved: ResolvedPipeline = { ...resolved, targetEntityName: unitRead.RowEntity.Name, targetVariable: LABEL_COLUMN, problemType: TaskTypeRules.LegacyProblemTypeForTask(unit.label.outcome) };
      const split = this.carveLockedHoldout(assembly.matrix, unitResolved, DEFAULT_SPLIT_SEED);
      const trainRequest = this.buildTrainRequest(unitResolved, assembly, split.Training, this.buildValidationConfig(resolved.validation));
      const response = await deps.sidecar.train(trainRequest, split.LockedHoldout);
      const evaluation = EvaluationLineage.Build(resolved.validation, {
        ValidationOutOfSample: response.validation_out_of_sample === true,
        ImportanceKind: response.feature_importance_kind || null,
        MajorityBaselineRule: majorityBaselineRule,
      });
      const dominance = this.checkLeakage(response, resolved.leakageGuard);
      const model = await this.createModelRow(unitResolved, input, assembly, split, response, evaluation, deps, this.unitLineage(unit, resolved));
      await this.finalizeUnitRunSuccess(run, model, assembly, unitResolved, response, dominance, evaluation, unitRead.Counts, split);
      return { model, run };
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof TrainingRefusedError) {
        await this.finalizeRunRefused(run, err);
      } else {
        await this.finalizeRunFailure(run, err, deps);
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }

  private async loadUnitSpec(unitId: string, deps: TrainingDeps): Promise<PredictionUnitSpec> {
    const store = deps.predictionUnits || new RunViewPredictionUnitStore(this.requireProvider(deps), deps.contextUser);
    const row = await store.Load(unitId);
    if (!row) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'pipeline', reason: { kind: 'unit-invalid', unitId, errors: ['not found'] } });
    const parsed = PredictionUnit.ParsePredictionUnitRow(row);
    if (!parsed.Ok) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'pipeline', reason: { kind: 'unit-invalid', unitId, errors: parsed.Errors } });
    return parsed.Value;
  }

  private unitLineage(unit: PredictionUnitSpec, resolved: ResolvedPipeline): Record<string, string | number> {
    return { predictionUnitId: unit.id, predictionUnitVersion: unit.version, labelVersion: unit.label.labelVersion, featureSpecVersion: resolved.pipeline.Version };
  }

  private async finalizeRunRefused(run: MJMLTrainingRunEntity, err: TrainingRefusedError): Promise<void> {
    const results: TrainingRunResults = { schema: TRAINING_RUN_RESULTS_SCHEMA, status: 'refused', refusal: err.Refusal };
    run.Status = 'Failed';
    run.CompletedAt = new Date();
    run.ValidationResults = JSON.stringify(results);
    run.Notes = err.message;
    if (!(await run.Save())) {
      LogError(`TrainingEngine: failed to record the refusal on run ${run.ID}: ${run.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
    }
  }
```

  `createModelRow` gains an optional last parameter `extraLineage: Record<string, string | number> = {}` spread into
  `buildLineage`'s object. `finalizeUnitRunSuccess` writes the v2 envelope:

```ts
  private async finalizeUnitRunSuccess(run: MJMLTrainingRunEntity, model: MJMLModelEntity, assembly: FeatureAssemblyResult, resolved: ResolvedPipeline,
    response: TrainResponse, dominance: DominanceResult, evaluation: EvaluationRecord, counts: UnitResolutionCounts, split: LockedHoldoutSplit): Promise<void> {
    const results: TrainingRunResults = {
      schema: TRAINING_RUN_RESULTS_SCHEMA, status: 'completed', unitResolution: counts,
      legacy: { metrics: response.metrics ?? {}, holdoutMetrics: response.holdout_metrics ?? null, trainingRowCount: split.TrainingRowCount, holdoutRowCount: split.HoldoutRowCount },
    };
    run.ResultingModelID = model.ID;
    run.FeaturesUsed = JSON.stringify(assembly.featureSchema.map((s) => s.Name));
    run.Hyperparameters = JSON.stringify(resolved.hyperparameters);
    run.ValidationResults = JSON.stringify(results);
    run.Status = 'Completed';
    run.CompletedAt = new Date();
    run.Notes = this.buildRunNotes(dominance, evaluation);
    await this.saveOrThrow(run, 'finalize ML Training Run');
  }
```

`IT/src/checks/ps-gates/ps-gate-prediction-units.ts` (the measurements, verbatim; each returns a `GateMeasurement`):

```ts
/**
 * Prediction Unit gate measurements. Each trains through MJAPI exactly as a user would
 * (`h.Train`, the PredictiveStudio.TrainModel remote operation) and reads the stored rows; the unit-row checks also
 * run the same reader in-process. Each returns a GateMeasurement and throws only when it cannot measure.
 */
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { RunView } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { EscapeSQLString, UUIDsEqual } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { MJMLModelEntity, MJMLTrainingRunEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { JsonParse, TrainingRunResultsParser, type PredictionUnitSpec } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { PredictionUnitRowReader, ProviderAssemblyMetadata, RunViewDataAccess, PredictionUnitVersioning, type UnitRowReadResult } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio';
import { C1CorpusFixture, C1_CORPUS_DIR, UnitFixtures, type GateMeasurement, type TruthHarness } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-truth-suite';

/**
 * The Prediction Unit gate bodies (G1.1, G1.2, G1.3, G1.6, G1.7, G1.8); static members on one owner (coding
 * standards §2).
 */
export class PredictionUnitGates {
  private static async readUnitRows(h: TruthHarness, unit: PredictionUnitSpec): Promise<UnitRowReadResult> {
    return new PredictionUnitRowReader().Read(unit, {
      DataAccess: new RunViewDataAccess(h.User, h.Provider),
      Metadata: new ProviderAssemblyMetadata(h.Provider),
      Read: { mode: 'complete' },
      Now: new Date(),
    });
  }

  /** G1.1 C1 → S1.1 */
  public static async MeasureC1UnitKeys(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    const { Unit: unit } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionC1RenewalPipeline(h);
    const read = await PredictionUnitGates.readUnitRows(h, unit);
    if (read.Status !== 'read') return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: `unit refused: ${JSON.stringify(read.Refusal)}` };
    const keys = await C1CorpusFixture.ReadC1CorpusCsv(join(C1_CORPUS_DIR, 'person_years_keys.csv'));
    const expected = new Set(keys.Rows.map((k) => `${k.person_id.toLowerCase()}|${k.period_index}`));
    const actual = new Set(read.Rows.map((r) => `${r.EntityKey.toLowerCase()}|${String(r.Source.PeriodIndex)}`));
    const matched = [...expected].filter((k) => actual.has(k)).length;
    const extra = [...actual].filter((k) => !expected.has(k)).length;
    return { Passed: matched === 4873 && expected.size === 4873 && extra === 0, Measured: { matched, expected: expected.size, extra }, Detail: `${matched} of ${expected.size} matched, ${extra} extra` };
  }

  /** G1.2 C1 → S2.2 */
  public static async MeasureC1CensoredExcluded(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionC1RenewalPipeline(h);
    await h.Train(pipeline);
    const run = await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID);
    const results = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults(run.ValidationResults);
    const stored = results.Ok && results.Value.status === 'completed' ? results.Value.unitResolution.censoredRowsExcluded : -1;
    const resolved = results.Ok && results.Value.status === 'completed' ? results.Value.unitResolution.resolvedRows : -1;
    return { Passed: stored === 1756 && resolved === 4873, Measured: { censoredRowsExcluded: stored, resolvedRows: resolved }, Detail: `stored excluded count ${stored}` };
  }

  /** G1.3 W5 → S2.2. The scored model is promoted to Validated first: scoring refuses Draft models. */
  public static async MeasureW5Censoring(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    const w5 = await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'world', ID: 'W5-censor', Seed: 42 });
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionWorldRenewalPipeline(h, 'W5-censor', { features: ['EventsAttended', 'AutoRenew', 'IncomeK'] });
    await h.Train(pipeline);
    const run = await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID);
    const results = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults(run.ValidationResults);
    if (!results.Ok || results.Value.status !== 'completed' || !results.Value.legacy) return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: 'run did not complete' };
    const { unitResolution, legacy } = results.Value;
    const censoredInMatrix = unitResolution.resolvedRows - (legacy.trainingRowCount + legacy.holdoutRowCount);
    const truth = await h.ReadWorldTruth(w5);
    const newest = [...truth.values()].filter((t) => t.Censored);
    if (!run.ResultingModelID) return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: `run ${run.ID} produced no model` };
    const promoted = await h.Promote(run.ResultingModelID, 'Validated', 'G1.3: dry-run preview of the newest cycle');
    if (!promoted.Promoted) return { Passed: false, Measured: { modelStatus: promoted.Status }, Detail: `model ${run.ResultingModelID} could not be validated for the dry run` };
    const scores = await h.Score(run.ResultingModelID, { scope: { filter: { entityName: w5.Entity.Name, extraFilter: '[Year] = 2026' } }, dryRun: true });
    if (!scores.Ok || scores.Predictions.length === 0) throw new Error(`dry-run scoring of W5 2026 failed: ${scores.ErrorMessage || 'no predictions'}`);
    const meanPrediction = scores.Predictions.reduce((s, p) => s + p.Score, 0) / scores.Predictions.length;
    const meanTrue = newest.reduce((s, t) => s + t.TrueP, 0) / newest.length;
    const passed = unitResolution.censoredRowsExcluded === 2147 && censoredInMatrix === 0 && Math.abs(meanPrediction - meanTrue) <= 0.05;
    return { Passed: passed, Measured: { censoredRowsExcluded: unitResolution.censoredRowsExcluded, censoredInMatrix, meanPrediction, meanTrue }, Detail: `newest cycle mean prediction ${meanPrediction.toFixed(4)} vs true ${meanTrue.toFixed(4)}` };
  }

  /** G1.6 C1 → S2.3 */
  public static async MeasureC1LabelVersioning(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    const { Pipeline: pipeline, UnitRow: unitRow } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionC1RenewalPipeline(h);
    await h.Train(pipeline);
    const run = await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID);
    const rv = RunView.FromMetadataProvider(h.Provider);
    const models = await rv.RunView<Pick<MJMLModelEntity, 'Lineage'>>({ EntityName: 'MJ: ML Models', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(run.ResultingModelID)}'`, Fields: ['Lineage'], ResultType: 'simple' }, h.User);
    // Typed read of the two lineage keys (no cast of JSON.parse's result).
    const lineageJson = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(models.Results[0]?.Lineage || '{}', 'Lineage');
    const lineage = lineageJson.Ok && JsonParse.IsJsonObject(lineageJson.Value) ? lineageJson.Value : {};
    const modelUnitId = JsonParse.JsonString(lineage, 'predictionUnitId');
    const modelUnitVersion = JsonParse.JsonInteger(lineage, 'predictionUnitVersion');
    const v2 = await PredictionUnitVersioning.CreateNextPredictionUnitVersion(unitRow, { LabelWindowDays: 365 }, { kind: 'human', userId: h.User.ID }, UnitFixtures.EntityFactory(h), h.User);
    unitRow.LabelWindowDays = 365;
    const inPlaceRefused = !(await unitRow.Save());
    const passed = v2.Version === 2 && v2.LabelVersion === 2 && UUIDsEqual(v2.LineageRootID, unitRow.ID) && UUIDsEqual(modelUnitId, unitRow.ID) && modelUnitVersion === 1 && inPlaceRefused;
    return { Passed: passed, Measured: { v2Version: v2.Version, v2LabelVersion: v2.LabelVersion, modelUnitVersion: modelUnitVersion === null ? -1 : modelUnitVersion, inPlaceRefused }, Detail: 'model still references version 1' };
  }

  /** G1.7 W1 → S1.4 */
  public static async MeasureW1OneClassRefused(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'world', ID: 'W1-signal', Seed: 42 });
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionWorldRenewalPipeline(h, 'W1-signal', { features: ['EventsAttended'], oneClassVariant: true });
    const attempt = await h.Train(pipeline);
    const error = attempt.Ok ? null : (attempt.ErrorMessage || 'refused without a message');
    const run = await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID);
    const results = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults(run.ValidationResults);
    const kind = results.Ok && results.Value.status === 'refused' ? results.Value.refusal.reason.kind : 'none';
    return { Passed: kind === 'single-valued-target' && run.ResultingModelID === null && error !== null, Measured: { refusal: kind, modelCreated: run.ResultingModelID !== null }, Detail: error || 'trained' };
  }

  /** G1.8 R3 → S1.4 */
  public static async MeasureR3CountTaskType(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'scenario', ID: 'R3', Seed: UnitFixtures.ScenarioBaseSeed('R3') });
    const asContinuous = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionScenarioPipeline(h, 'R3', { kind: 'continuous' });
    await h.Train(asContinuous.Pipeline);
    const r1 = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults((await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, asContinuous.Pipeline.ID)).ValidationResults);
    const asCount = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionScenarioPipeline(h, 'R3', { kind: 'count' });
    await h.Train(asCount.Pipeline);
    const run2: MJMLTrainingRunEntity = await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, asCount.Pipeline.ID);
    const refusedContinuous = r1.Ok && r1.Value.status === 'refused' && r1.Value.refusal.reason.kind === 'task-type-mismatch';
    return { Passed: refusedContinuous && run2.Status === 'Completed', Measured: { refusedContinuous, countRunStatus: run2.Status }, Detail: 'continuous refused, count accepted' };
  }
}
```

  `TruthSuite/src/harness/world-truth.ts` (§5.4 `HarnessWorldTruth`; M4.6 adds `provenance.ts` and `sidecar.ts` beside it):

```ts
/** The planted truth of a world seed, read from its cache directory (the `ReadWorldTruth` harness member). */
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { TruthCsv } from '../db/csv';
import type { LoadedDataset, WorldTruthRow } from './types';

/** The implementation behind `TruthHarness.ReadWorldTruth` (one line in `RunFixtures.harnessFrom`'s literal calls it). */
export class HarnessWorldTruth {
  /**
   * The planted truth of a loaded W1–W8 seed, keyed by lower-cased MembershipYearID. Read from the seed's cache
   * directory (`LoadedDataset.Dir`); truth never enters the database, so gate measurements read it only here.
   */
  public static async ReadWorldTruth(dataset: LoadedDataset): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, WorldTruthRow>> {
    if (dataset.Ref.Kind !== 'world' || dataset.Ref.ID === 'W9-multiclass') {
      throw new Error(`ReadWorldTruth reads W1–W8 truth files; got ${dataset.Ref.Kind} ${dataset.Ref.ID}`);
    }
    const { header, rows } = TruthCsv.Parse(readFileSync(path.join(dataset.Dir, 'truth.csv'), 'utf8'));
    const col = (name: string): number => {
      const i = header.indexOf(name);
      if (i < 0) throw new Error(`${dataset.Dir}/truth.csv has no ${name} column`);
      return i;
    };
    const [id, cycle, trueP, censored] = [col('MembershipYearID'), col('Cycle'), col('TrueP'), col('Censored')];
    const out = new Map<string, WorldTruthRow>();
    for (const r of rows) out.set(r[id].toLowerCase(), { Cycle: Number(r[cycle]), TrueP: Number(r[trueP]), Censored: r[censored] === '1' });
    return out;
  }
}
```

  `TruthSuite/src/fixtures/unit-fixtures.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Prediction Unit + pipeline fixtures for the Prediction Unit, assembly, snapshot and protocol gates. Units are created through the product's own versioning
 * helpers and saved through the API (so the server subclasses validate them); pipelines get their legacy target
 * columns from the unit (ApplyUnitToPipeline). Every fixture takes the TruthHarness.
 */
import { RunView } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { MJMLAlgorithmEntity, MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, MJMLTrainingRunEntity, MJPredictionUnitEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { PredictionUnit, type PredictionUnitSpec, type TaskType } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { RunViewPredictionUnitStore, PredictionUnitVersioning, MetadataEntityFactory, ProviderAssemblyMetadata, type IEntityFactory, type PredictionUnitDraft } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio';
import type { ScenarioID, TruthHarness } from '../harness/types';
import { DatasetSeeds } from '../data/seeds';

export interface ProvisionedUnitPipeline {
  readonly UnitRow: MJPredictionUnitEntity;
  readonly Unit: PredictionUnitSpec;
  readonly Pipeline: MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity;
}

/**
 * Prediction Unit and pipeline fixtures for the gates (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). Later
 * provisioners are added here too.
 */
export class UnitFixtures {
  /** The product's entity factory over the harness's provider (Engine `training/seams.ts`). */
  public static EntityFactory(h: TruthHarness): IEntityFactory {
    return new MetadataEntityFactory(h.Provider);
  }

  /** A scenario's base seed (its spec seed; the `base` seed set). */
  public static ScenarioBaseSeed(id: ScenarioID): number {
    return DatasetSeeds.SeedSet('scenario', id, 'base')[0];
  }

  /** The per-world table prefix: 'W5-censor' → 'W5' (tables W5_Person, W5_MembershipYear). */
  public static WorldTablePrefix(world: string): string {
    return world.split('-')[0];
  }

  /** The pstruth entity registered for a base table (names come from the test schema's CodeGen config, so they are looked up). */
  public static TruthEntityName(h: TruthHarness, baseTable: string): string {
    const e = h.Provider.Entities.find((x) => x.SchemaName === 'pstruth' && x.BaseTable === baseTable);
    if (!e) throw new Error(`pstruth.${baseTable} is not registered; run truth:provision`);
    return e.Name;
  }

  public static C1RenewalUnitDraft(h: TruthHarness): PredictionUnitDraft {
    return {
      Name: 'C1 renewal (person x dues period)', Description: 'Renewed = the next dues period within 400 days of this one (Task 7 reference unit).',
      UnitRows: { kind: 'grain-x-periods', grainEntity: UnitFixtures.TruthEntityName(h, 'C1Person'), childEntity: UnitFixtures.TruthEntityName(h, 'C1DuesPeriod'), foreignKey: 'PersonID', periodDate: 'OrderDate', filter: [] },
      LabelRule: { kind: 'next-period', periodIndexField: 'PeriodIndex', offset: 1 }, LabelWindowDays: 400, LabelGapDays: 0,
      TaskType: { kind: 'binary', classOrder: ['0', '1'], adverseIndex: 0 },
      Censoring: { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'corpus-end', entity: UnitFixtures.TruthEntityName(h, 'C1OrderHeader'), field: 'OrderDate' } },
      ChangeHistoryPolicy: { onUncoveredRow: 'refuse', externalSourceRows: 'ineligible' }, GroupKey: 'PersonID', TemporalSpec: null,
      DecisionSpec: { action: 'renewal outreach', actorRole: 'membership team', capacityPerPeriod: 150, period: 'month' },
      IncumbentHeuristic: { kind: 'rule', name: 'renewed last year', scoreExpression: 'prior_dues_periods_400d >= 2' },
    };
  }

  /** W1/W4/W5 renewal: one row per membership year, decided on 1 December, outcome observed by 1 January. */
  public static WorldRenewalUnitDraft(h: TruthHarness, world: string, oneClassVariant: boolean): PredictionUnitDraft {
    const years = UnitFixtures.TruthEntityName(h, `${UnitFixtures.WorldTablePrefix(world)}_MembershipYear`);
    const fullyResolved = world !== 'W5-censor';
    return {
      Name: `${world} renewal (person x membership year)${oneClassVariant ? ' — one-class variant' : ''}`, Description: null,
      UnitRows: { kind: 'grain', grainEntity: years, decisionDate: { kind: 'column-offset', column: 'StartDate', offsetDays: 334 }, filter: oneClassVariant ? [{ field: 'Renewed', op: 'eq', values: [true] }] : [] },
      LabelRule: { kind: 'column', column: 'Renewed' }, LabelWindowDays: 31, LabelGapDays: 0,
      TaskType: { kind: 'binary', classOrder: ['0', '1'], adverseIndex: 0 },
      // W5's 2026 outcomes are unknown at its corpus end (the newest StartDate); every other world's outcomes are drawn (resolved).
      Censoring: fullyResolved ? { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'fixed', at: '2027-02-01' } } : { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'corpus-end', entity: years, field: 'StartDate' } },
      ChangeHistoryPolicy: { onUncoveredRow: 'refuse', externalSourceRows: 'ineligible' }, GroupKey: 'PersonID', TemporalSpec: null,
      DecisionSpec: { action: 'renewal outreach', actorRole: 'membership team', capacityPerPeriod: null, period: 'year' },
      IncumbentHeuristic: { kind: 'none' },
    };
  }

  /** A cross-sectional planted scenario (no dates): one decision moment for every row. */
  public static ScenarioUnitDraft(h: TruthHarness, scenario: string, task: TaskType): PredictionUnitDraft {
    return {
      Name: `${scenario} (${task.kind})`, Description: null,
      UnitRows: { kind: 'grain', grainEntity: UnitFixtures.TruthEntityName(h, `Scn_${scenario.replace('-', '')}`), decisionDate: { kind: 'fixed', date: '2020-01-01' }, filter: [] },
      LabelRule: { kind: 'column', column: 'Target' }, LabelWindowDays: 1, LabelGapDays: 0, TaskType: task,
      Censoring: { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'fixed', at: '2020-12-31' } },
      ChangeHistoryPolicy: { onUncoveredRow: 'refuse', externalSourceRows: 'ineligible' }, GroupKey: null, TemporalSpec: null,
      DecisionSpec: { action: 'scenario', actorRole: 'test', capacityPerPeriod: null, period: 'year' }, IncumbentHeuristic: { kind: 'none' },
    };
  }

  private static async algorithmId(h: TruthHarness, name: string): Promise<string> {
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(h.Provider).RunView<Pick<MJMLAlgorithmEntity, 'ID'>>({ EntityName: 'MJ: ML Algorithms', ExtraFilter: `Name='${EscapeSQLString(name)}'`, Fields: ['ID'], ResultType: 'simple' }, h.User);
    if (!r.Success || !r.Results[0]) throw new Error(`ML Algorithm "${name}" not found`);
    return r.Results[0].ID;
  }

  private static async provision(h: TruthHarness, draft: PredictionUnitDraft, features: readonly string[], algorithm: string): Promise<ProvisionedUnitPipeline> {
    const factory = UnitFixtures.EntityFactory(h);
    const unitRow = await PredictionUnitVersioning.CreatePredictionUnitV1(draft, { kind: 'human', userId: h.User.ID }, factory, h.User);
    const parsed = PredictionUnit.ParsePredictionUnitRow(unitRow);
    if (!parsed.Ok) throw new Error(parsed.Errors.join('; '));
    const pipeline = await factory.getEntityObject<MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity>('MJ: ML Training Pipelines', h.User);
    pipeline.Name = `${draft.Name} — ${algorithm} — ${h.RunID}`;
    pipeline.AlgorithmID = await UnitFixtures.algorithmId(h, algorithm);
    pipeline.FeatureSteps = JSON.stringify({ Steps: [{ Id: 'select', Kind: 'select', Columns: features }] });
    pipeline.ValidationStrategy = JSON.stringify({ Strategy: 'train_test_split', TestSize: 0.2, LockedHoldoutFraction: 0.2 });
    RunViewPredictionUnitStore.ApplyUnitToPipeline(pipeline, unitRow.ID, parsed.Value, new ProviderAssemblyMetadata(h.Provider));
    if (!(await pipeline.Save())) throw new Error(`Saving pipeline failed: ${pipeline.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage}`);
    return { UnitRow: unitRow, Unit: parsed.Value, Pipeline: pipeline };
  }

  public static ProvisionC1RenewalPipeline(h: TruthHarness): Promise<ProvisionedUnitPipeline> {
    return UnitFixtures.provision(h, UnitFixtures.C1RenewalUnitDraft(h), ['PeriodIndex'], 'Logistic Regression');
  }

  public static ProvisionWorldRenewalPipeline(h: TruthHarness, world: string, o: { readonly features: readonly string[]; readonly oneClassVariant?: boolean; readonly algorithm?: string }): Promise<ProvisionedUnitPipeline> {
    return UnitFixtures.provision(h, UnitFixtures.WorldRenewalUnitDraft(h, world, o.oneClassVariant === true), o.features, o.algorithm || 'Logistic Regression');
  }

  public static ProvisionScenarioPipeline(h: TruthHarness, scenario: string, task: TaskType): Promise<ProvisionedUnitPipeline> {
    return UnitFixtures.provision(h, UnitFixtures.ScenarioUnitDraft(h, scenario, task), ['PastEventsZ', 'Member', 'DistanceZ'], 'Ridge Regression');
  }

  /** The newest training run of a pipeline (an entity: callers read ValidationResults, Status and ResultingModelID). */
  public static async LatestRun(h: TruthHarness, pipelineId: string): Promise<MJMLTrainingRunEntity> {
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(h.Provider).RunView<MJMLTrainingRunEntity>({ EntityName: 'MJ: ML Training Runs', ExtraFilter: `PipelineID='${EscapeSQLString(pipelineId)}'`, OrderBy: '__mj_CreatedAt DESC', MaxRows: 1, ResultType: 'entity_object' }, h.User);
    if (!r.Success || !r.Results[0]) throw new Error(`No training run for pipeline ${pipelineId}`);
    return r.Results[0];
  }

  /** A saved unit version, parsed. */
  public static async LoadUnitSpec(h: TruthHarness, unitId: string): Promise<PredictionUnitSpec> {
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(h.Provider).RunView<MJPredictionUnitEntity>({ EntityName: 'MJ: Prediction Units', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(unitId)}'`, ResultType: 'simple' }, h.User);
    const parsed = r.Results[0] ? PredictionUnit.ParsePredictionUnitRow(r.Results[0]) : null;
    if (!parsed || !parsed.Ok) throw new Error(`Prediction Unit ${unitId} missing or invalid`);
    return parsed.Value;
  }
}
```

### M3 — As-of Feature Assembly  ·  parallel-safe: no  ·  depends on: M2

**Outcome:** a unit pipeline's features are assembled by one function, `AsOfFeatureAssembler`, for training and for
scoring, reading every value as it stood at the row's decision date: fields declared immutable are read directly
(and refused if Record Changes show them changing after the decision), fields updated in place are replayed from
`MJ: Record Changes` with a coverage and continuity check, aggregates are computed over dated child tables inside a
declared window, series lags are read only from periods at or before t − h, and no value is ever coerced to 0.0:
each column is typed from its field (numeric, categorical, date parts, boolean, identifier), a text value in a numeric
column stops the run naming the column, and every column gets an imputer plus a missing indicator. The executor's
cross-entity hydration is not used by unit models; a scoring scope on another entity is refused. The Train
operation's `asOf`/`labelEventDates` inputs are refused by name. Gates G1.4, G1.5, G1.9, G1.12 are flipped `Active` and pass.
Closes F-PIT-2, F-PIT-3, F-PIT-4, F-PIT-5, F-PIT-7, F-MC-8, F-MC-6, F-MC-1, F-SC-13.

**Milestone start:** the §6 preamble's steps.

**Day semantics (all of M3).** The as-of instant of a row is the **end of its decision day**: a Record Changes row
counts when `ChangedAt < DecisionDate + 1 day`; a child row counts when its date is `<= DecisionDate` (inclusive, as
the reference builder does, `build_person_years.py:282-300`). Window `(d − windowDays, d]`.

  `Engine/src/feature-assembly/as-of/feature-resolution.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * @module feature-assembly/as-of/feature-resolution
 *
 * Turns a unit pipeline's FeatureSteps into typed FeatureColumnSpecs (C2): each column's dated source comes from
 * metadata (AllowUpdateAPI = false → immutable-field, else record-changes), its encoding from the field type unless
 * declared, and every column gets an imputer with a missing indicator. Preprocessing steps must target a produced
 * column (F-MC-1). Steps with no as-of semantics are refused.
 */
import type { AssemblyRefusal, ColumnEncoding, ColumnEncodingKind, FeatureColumnSpec, FeatureStep, FeatureStepGraph, MissingValuePolicy, PredictionUnitSpec, PreprocessingOp, ProtocolExclusions } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { PredictionUnit } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { AssemblyEntityInfo, AssemblyFieldInfo, IAssemblyMetadata } from '../assembly-metadata';

export type FeatureResolution =
  | { readonly Status: 'resolved'; readonly Columns: readonly FeatureColumnSpec[]; readonly ExplicitOps: readonly PreprocessingOp[] }
  | { readonly Status: 'refused'; readonly Refusal: AssemblyRefusal };

export const CATEGORICAL_CARDINALITY_CAP = 50;

/** Ends resolution at the first refusal; caught by `ResolveFeatureColumns` with `instanceof` (never by message). */
class ResolutionRefused extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly Refusal: AssemblyRefusal) { super(Refusal.kind); }
}

/**
 * Resolves one unit pipeline's steps into columns. One instance per call holds the columns and ops built so far; each
 * step kind has its own protected method, so a subclass can change one kind without copying the rest.
 */
export class FeatureResolver {
  private readonly deny: ReadonlySet<string>;
  private readonly denySources: ReadonlySet<string>;
  private readonly columns: FeatureColumnSpec[] = [];
  private readonly ops: PreprocessingOp[] = [];
  private readonly byName = new Map<string, number>();

  protected constructor(
    protected readonly Unit: PredictionUnitSpec,
    protected readonly RowEntity: AssemblyEntityInfo,
    protected readonly Metadata: IAssemblyMetadata,
    exclusions: ProtocolExclusions,
  ) {
    this.deny = new Set(exclusions.denyFields.map((x) => x.toLowerCase()));
    this.denySources = new Set(exclusions.denySources.map((x) => x.toLowerCase()));
  }

  /** Resolves every step in order; the first refusal ends resolution (no partial column list). */
  public static ResolveFeatureColumns(
    graph: FeatureStepGraph,
    unit: PredictionUnitSpec,
    rowEntity: AssemblyEntityInfo,
    metadata: IAssemblyMetadata,
    exclusions: ProtocolExclusions,
  ): FeatureResolution {
    const resolver = new FeatureResolver(unit, rowEntity, metadata, exclusions);
    try {
      for (const step of graph.Steps) resolver.ResolveStep(step);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof ResolutionRefused) return { Status: 'refused', Refusal: e.Refusal };
      throw e;
    }
    return { Status: 'resolved', Columns: resolver.columns, ExplicitOps: resolver.ops };
  }

  /** The encoding a column gets: the declared one, else from the field type (no variant maps a date, ID or string to 0). */
  public static EncodingFor(field: AssemblyFieldInfo, declared: ColumnEncodingKind | undefined): ColumnEncoding {
    switch (declared) {
      case 'numeric': return { kind: 'numeric', nonNumericValue: 'fail' };
      case 'categorical': return { kind: 'categorical', cardinalityCap: CATEGORICAL_CARDINALITY_CAP, method: 'onehot' };
      case 'date-parts': return { kind: 'date-parts', parts: ['days-since-decision'] };
      case 'boolean': return { kind: 'boolean' };
      case 'identifier': return { kind: 'identifier', policy: 'exclude' };
    }
    if (field.IsPrimaryKey) return { kind: 'identifier', policy: 'exclude' };
    switch (field.TSType) {
      case 'number': return { kind: 'numeric', nonNumericValue: 'fail' };
      case 'boolean': return { kind: 'boolean' };
      case 'Date': return { kind: 'date-parts', parts: ['days-since-decision'] };
      case 'string':
        return field.SqlType.toLowerCase() === 'uniqueidentifier' && field.RelatedEntity === null
          ? { kind: 'identifier', policy: 'exclude' }
          : { kind: 'categorical', cardinalityCap: CATEGORICAL_CARDINALITY_CAP, method: 'onehot' };
    }
  }

  /** Every column gets an imputer and a missing indicator; mode for categories and booleans, median otherwise. */
  public static DefaultMissing(encoding: ColumnEncoding): MissingValuePolicy {
    return { impute: encoding.kind === 'categorical' || encoding.kind === 'boolean' ? 'mode' : 'median', indicator: true, constant: null };
  }

  /** Dispatches one step to its kind's method. */
  protected ResolveStep(step: FeatureStep): void {
    switch (step.Kind) {
      case 'select': return this.ResolveSelect(step);
      case 'windowed-aggregate': return this.ResolveWindowedAggregate(step);
      case 'series': return this.ResolveSeries(step);
      case 'llm-derived':
        throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'unpinned-feature-version', featureName: (step.Columns || [])[0] || step.Id });
      case 'embedding':
      case 'flow-agent':
      case 'vision-llm':
        throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'unsupported-step-kind', stepId: step.Id, stepKind: step.Kind });
      case 'impute': {
        const index = this.byName.get(step.Column);
        if (index === undefined) throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: this.RowEntity.Name, field: step.Column });
        // `??`: a FillValue of 0 or '' is a legitimate fill; only an absent one becomes null.
        this.columns[index] = { ...this.columns[index], missing: { impute: step.Strategy, indicator: true, constant: step.FillValue ?? null } };
        return;
      }
      case 'standardize':
        for (const col of step.Columns) this.requireColumn(col);
        this.ops.push({ op: 'standardize', cols: step.Columns.filter((col) => !this.deny.has(col.toLowerCase())) });
        return;
      case 'onehot':
        this.requireColumn(step.Column);
        return;   // categorical columns are one-hot encoded by AsOfFeatureAssembler.BuildPreprocessingOps
      case 'bin':
        this.requireColumn(step.Column);
        this.ops.push({ op: 'bin', col: step.Column, bins: step.Bins });
        return;
    }
  }

  /** `select`: one typed column per field, read from the row entity or (through a key field) another entity. */
  protected ResolveSelect(step: Extract<FeatureStep, { Kind: 'select' }>): void {
    const entityName = step.Entity || this.RowEntity.Name;
    if (this.denySources.has(entityName.toLowerCase())) return;
    const entity = entityName === this.RowEntity.Name ? this.RowEntity : this.Metadata.Entity(entityName);
    if (!entity) throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: entityName, field: '*' });
    const keyField = entity.Name === this.RowEntity.Name ? null : this.selectKeyField(step, entity);
    for (const col of step.Columns) {
      if (this.deny.has(col.toLowerCase())) continue;
      const field = entity.Fields.find((x) => x.Name === col);
      if (!field) throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: entity.Name, field: col });
      if (entity.Name === this.RowEntity.Name) this.checkForecastOffset(step, col);
      const encoding = FeatureResolver.EncodingFor(field, step.Encodings?.[col]);
      this.add({
        name: col,
        source: field.AllowUpdateAPI ? { kind: 'record-changes', entity: entity.Name, field: col, keyField } : { kind: 'immutable-field', entity: entity.Name, field: col, keyField },
        encoding,
        missing: FeatureResolver.DefaultMissing(encoding),
      });
    }
  }

  /** `windowed-aggregate`: one numeric column summarising a dated child entity; every named child field must exist. */
  protected ResolveWindowedAggregate(step: Extract<FeatureStep, { Kind: 'windowed-aggregate' }>): void {
    const child = this.Metadata.Entity(step.ChildEntity);
    if (!child) throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: step.ChildEntity, field: '*' });
    for (const fld of [step.ForeignKey, step.DateField, step.EndDateField, step.VoidedAtField, step.ValueField].filter((x): x is string => !!x)) {
      if (!child.Fields.some((x) => x.Name === fld)) throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: child.Name, field: fld });
    }
    const encoding: ColumnEncoding = { kind: 'numeric', nonNumericValue: 'fail' };
    this.add({
      name: step.FeatureName,
      source: {
        kind: 'windowed-aggregate', childEntity: child.Name, foreignKey: step.ForeignKey, ownerKeyField: step.OwnerKeyField || null,
        dateField: step.DateField, endDateField: step.EndDateField || null, voidedAtField: step.VoidedAtField || null,
        // `??`: WindowDays 0 is passed through as declared (the window rule refuses it); only an absent one means "all".
        aggregate: step.Aggregate, valueField: step.ValueField || null, windowDays: step.WindowDays ?? null, filter: step.Filter || [],
      },
      encoding,
      missing: FeatureResolver.DefaultMissing(encoding),
    });
  }

  /** `series`: a lag or rolling window the unit's Temporal Spec declares, by index. */
  protected ResolveSeries(step: Extract<FeatureStep, { Kind: 'series' }>): void {
    const t = this.Unit.temporal;
    const max = t ? (step.Feature.kind === 'lag' ? t.lags.length : t.rollingWindows.length) : 0;
    if (!t || step.Feature.index < 0 || step.Feature.index >= max) {
      throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: PredictionUnit.UnitRowEntityName(this.Unit.rows), field: `TemporalSpec.${step.Feature.kind}[${step.Feature.index}]` });
    }
    const encoding: ColumnEncoding = { kind: 'numeric', nonNumericValue: 'fail' };
    this.add({ name: step.FeatureName, source: { kind: 'series', feature: { kind: step.Feature.kind, index: step.Feature.index } }, encoding, missing: FeatureResolver.DefaultMissing(encoding) });
  }

  /** The unit-row field holding another entity's key: declared, or the grain foreign key of a grain × periods unit. */
  private selectKeyField(step: Extract<FeatureStep, { Kind: 'select' }>, entity: AssemblyEntityInfo): string {
    const keyField = step.KeyField || (this.Unit.rows.kind === 'grain-x-periods' && entity.Name === this.Unit.rows.grainEntity ? this.Unit.rows.foreignKey : null);
    if (!keyField || !this.RowEntity.Fields.some((x) => x.Name === keyField)) throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: this.RowEntity.Name, field: keyField || 'KeyField' });
    return keyField;
  }

  /** Forecast units: a row-entity column other than the time column must be declared at least `horizon` periods back. */
  private checkForecastOffset(step: Extract<FeatureStep, { Kind: 'select' }>, col: string): void {
    const t = this.Unit.temporal;
    if (!t || this.Unit.label.outcome.kind !== 'forecast' || col === t.timeColumn) return;
    const offset = step.PeriodOffsets?.[col];
    if (offset === undefined || offset < t.horizonPeriods) {
      throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'future-period-lag', column: col, lag: offset || 0, horizonPeriods: t.horizonPeriods });
    }
  }

  private add(c: FeatureColumnSpec): void {
    const name = this.byName.has(c.name) ? `${c.name}#${this.columns.length}` : c.name;
    this.byName.set(name, this.columns.length);
    this.columns.push({ ...c, name });
  }

  private requireColumn(name: string): FeatureColumnSpec {
    const i = this.byName.get(name);
    if (i === undefined) throw new ResolutionRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: this.RowEntity.Name, field: name });
    return this.columns[i];
  }
}
```

```ts
/** Reads rows of one entity by primary key in batches and refuses when any key is missing (same code for train and score). */
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { AssemblyRefusal } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { ICountingDataAccess, SourceRow } from '../data-access';

export const READ_BY_KEYS_BATCH = 500;

export type ReadByKeysOutcome = { readonly Status: 'read'; readonly Rows: ReadonlyMap<string, SourceRow> } | { readonly Status: 'refused'; readonly Refusal: AssemblyRefusal };

export class KeyedReader {
  /**
   * The rows of `keys` (deduplicated case-insensitively), keyed by lower-cased key. The batches are independent reads and
   * run in parallel. Keys go into SQL as given (escaped), never in their lower-cased matching form.
   */
  public static async ReadByKeys(
    dataAccess: ICountingDataAccess, entityName: string, keyField: string, keys: readonly string[], fields: readonly string[],
  ): Promise<ReadByKeysOutcome> {
    const unique = new Map<string, string>();   // lower-cased → first original spelling
    for (const k of keys) if (!unique.has(k.toLowerCase())) unique.set(k.toLowerCase(), k);
    const originals = [...unique.values()];
    const batches: string[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < originals.length; i += READ_BY_KEYS_BATCH) batches.push(originals.slice(i, i + READ_BY_KEYS_BATCH));
    const results = await Promise.all(batches.map((batch) => dataAccess.fetchRows({
      EntityName: entityName,
      ExtraFilter: `[${keyField}] IN (${batch.map((k) => `'${EscapeSQLString(k)}'`).join(',')})`,
      Fields: [keyField, ...fields.filter((f) => f !== keyField)],
      MaxRows: batch.length,
    })));
    const out = new Map<string, SourceRow>();
    for (const res of results) {
      if (!res.Success) throw new Error(`Reading ${entityName} by key failed: ${res.ErrorMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
      for (const row of res.Rows) out.set(String(row[keyField]).toLowerCase(), row);
    }
    if (out.size !== unique.size) {
      return { Status: 'refused', Refusal: { kind: 'truncated-read', entity: entityName, rowsExpected: unique.size, rowsRead: out.size } };
    }
    return { Status: 'read', Rows: out };
  }
}
```

  `record-history.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * @module feature-assembly/as-of/record-history
 *
 * Replays fields updated in place from `MJ: Record Changes` (C2 `record-changes`). A record's history counts only
 * from its earliest Create or Snapshot row; before that a decision date cannot be replayed. Before each assembly the
 * last replayed value of every covered record is compared with its stored value — a mismatch (a direct-SQL update,
 * or a change made while tracking was off) marks that record-field uncovered. External-source rows are replayed at
 * detection time or are ineligible, per the unit's ChangeHistoryPolicy. Today's value never fills a gap.
 */
import { CompositeKey } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { EscapeSQLString, OrdinalCompare } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { MJRecordChangeEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import type { ChangeHistoryCoverage, ChangeHistoryPolicy, ReadPolicy } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { JsonParse } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { ICountingDataAccess, SourceRow } from '../data-access';
import { CompleteReader } from '../read-policy';
import { KeyedReader } from './read-by-keys';
import type { AssemblyEntityInfo } from '../assembly-metadata';
import type { CellValue } from '../../prediction-unit/utc-day';

export interface RecordChangeRow {
  readonly ID: string;
  readonly RecordID: string;
  readonly Type: MJRecordChangeEntity['Type'];       // derived from the generated entity, never restated
  readonly Source: MJRecordChangeEntity['Source'];
  readonly ChangedAt: Date;
  readonly ChangesJSON: string;
  readonly FullRecordJSON: string;
}

export type HistoryValue =
  | { readonly Status: 'value'; readonly Value: CellValue; readonly ChangeId: string; readonly ChangedAt: Date }
  | { readonly Status: 'uncovered'; readonly Reason: 'no-history' | 'before-history-start' | 'continuity-mismatch' | 'deleted' | 'external-ineligible' };

export interface EntityHistory {
  readonly Coverage: ChangeHistoryCoverage;
  /** The field's value in force strictly before `before`. */
  ValueAt(recordKey: string, field: string, before: Date): HistoryValue;
  /** Update rows that changed `field` at or after `after`. */
  UpdatesAfter(recordKey: string, field: string, after: Date): number;
}

export interface IRecordHistoryReader {
  Load(entity: AssemblyEntityInfo, keys: readonly string[], fields: readonly string[], policy: ChangeHistoryPolicy, now: Date): Promise<EntityHistory>;
}

/** Replay of `MJ: Record Changes` rows (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class RecordHistory {
  /**
   * The primary-key value of a RecordID, lower-cased for in-memory matching. Parsed by MJ's own `CompositeKey` (the
   * `Field|Value` URL-segment form Record Changes store); PS units have one key column, so the first pair is the key.
   */
  public static KeyOfRecordId(recordId: string): string {
    const pair = CompositeKey.FromURLSegment(null, recordId).KeyValuePairs[0];
    return (pair ? String(pair.Value) : recordId).toLowerCase();
  }

  /** Pure: index the change rows, run the continuity check against the current values, and expose replay. */
  public static BuildEntityHistory(
    entityName: string,
    changes: readonly RecordChangeRow[],
    current: ReadonlyMap<string, Readonly<Record<string, CellValue>>>,
    fields: readonly string[],
    policy: ChangeHistoryPolicy,
    now: Date,
  ): EntityHistory {
    const byKey = RecordHistory.indexByKey(changes);
    const start = RecordHistory.historyStarts(byKey);
    const continuity = RecordHistory.checkContinuity(byKey, start, current, fields);
    const allCovered = [...current.keys()].every((k) => start.has(k));
    const historyStart = allCovered && start.size > 0 ? new Date(Math.max(...[...start.values()].map((d) => d.getTime()))).toISOString() : null;
    return {
      Coverage: {
        entity: entityName,
        historyStart,
        continuity: { checkedAt: now.toISOString(), recordsReplayed: continuity.Replayed, recordsMismatched: continuity.RecordsMismatched },
        externalSourceRows: policy.externalSourceRows,
        onUncoveredRow: policy.onUncoveredRow,
      },
      ValueAt: (recordKey, field, before) => RecordHistory.valueAt(byKey, start, continuity.Mismatched, policy, recordKey, field, before),
      UpdatesAfter: (recordKey, field, after) =>
        (byKey.get(recordKey.toLowerCase()) || []).filter((c) => c.Type === 'Update' && c.ChangedAt.getTime() >= after.getTime() && RecordHistory.changedFields(c.ChangesJSON).has(field)).length,
    };
  }

  /** Change rows per record key, in ChangedAt order (ties by ID, ordinal). */
  private static indexByKey(changes: readonly RecordChangeRow[]): Map<string, RecordChangeRow[]> {
    const byKey = new Map<string, RecordChangeRow[]>();
    for (const c of [...changes].sort((a, b) => a.ChangedAt.getTime() - b.ChangedAt.getTime() || OrdinalCompare(a.ID, b.ID))) {
      const k = RecordHistory.KeyOfRecordId(c.RecordID);
      const list = byKey.get(k) || [];
      list.push(c);
      byKey.set(k, list);
    }
    return byKey;
  }

  /** A record's history starts at its earliest Create or Snapshot row; a record without one has no history. */
  private static historyStarts(byKey: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly RecordChangeRow[]>): Map<string, Date> {
    const start = new Map<string, Date>();
    for (const [k, list] of byKey) {
      const first = list.find((c) => c.Type === 'Create' || c.Type === 'Snapshot');
      if (first) start.set(k, first.ChangedAt);
    }
    return start;
  }

  /** Replays every covered record to now and compares it with the stored value; a mismatch marks that record-field. */
  private static checkContinuity(
    byKey: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly RecordChangeRow[]>, start: ReadonlyMap<string, Date>,
    current: ReadonlyMap<string, Readonly<Record<string, CellValue>>>, fields: readonly string[],
  ): { readonly Mismatched: ReadonlySet<string>; readonly Replayed: number; readonly RecordsMismatched: number } {
    const mismatched = new Set<string>();
    let replayed = 0;
    for (const [k, row] of current) {
      const list = byKey.get(k);
      if (!list || !start.has(k)) continue;
      replayed++;
      const last = list[list.length - 1];
      for (const f of fields) {
        if (RecordHistory.comparable(RecordHistory.fieldOf(last.FullRecordJSON, f)) !== RecordHistory.comparable(row[f])) mismatched.add(`${k}|${f}`);
      }
    }
    return { Mismatched: mismatched, Replayed: replayed, RecordsMismatched: new Set([...mismatched].map((x) => x.split('|')[0])).size };
  }

  /** The value in force strictly before `before`, or why it cannot be replayed. Today's value never fills a gap. */
  private static valueAt(
    byKey: ReadonlyMap<string, readonly RecordChangeRow[]>, start: ReadonlyMap<string, Date>, mismatched: ReadonlySet<string>,
    policy: ChangeHistoryPolicy, recordKey: string, field: string, before: Date,
  ): HistoryValue {
    const k = recordKey.toLowerCase();
    const list = byKey.get(k);
    const s = start.get(k);
    if (!list || !s) return { Status: 'uncovered', Reason: 'no-history' };
    if (before.getTime() <= s.getTime()) return { Status: 'uncovered', Reason: 'before-history-start' };
    if (mismatched.has(`${k}|${field}`)) return { Status: 'uncovered', Reason: 'continuity-mismatch' };
    const inForce = list.filter((c) => c.ChangedAt.getTime() < before.getTime());
    const last = inForce[inForce.length - 1];
    if (last.Type === 'Delete') return { Status: 'uncovered', Reason: 'deleted' };
    if (policy.externalSourceRows === 'ineligible' && inForce.some((c) => c.Source === 'External' && (c.Type !== 'Update' || RecordHistory.changedFields(c.ChangesJSON).has(field)))) {
      return { Status: 'uncovered', Reason: 'external-ineligible' };
    }
    return { Status: 'value', Value: RecordHistory.fieldOf(last.FullRecordJSON, field), ChangeId: last.ID, ChangedAt: last.ChangedAt };
  }

  private static fieldOf(json: string, field: string): CellValue {
    const parsed = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(json, 'FullRecordJSON');
    if (!parsed.Ok || !JsonParse.IsJsonObject(parsed.Value)) return null;
    const v = parsed.Value[field];
    return typeof v === 'string' || typeof v === 'number' || typeof v === 'boolean' ? v : null;
  }

  private static changedFields(json: string): ReadonlySet<string> {
    const parsed = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(json, 'ChangesJSON');
    return new Set(parsed.Ok && JsonParse.IsJsonObject(parsed.Value) ? Object.keys(parsed.Value) : []);
  }

  private static comparable(v: CellValue): string {
    if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return '';
    if (v instanceof Date) return v.toISOString();
    if (typeof v === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/.test(v)) return new Date(v).toISOString();
    return String(v);
  }
}

/** Production reader: one complete read of the entity's Record Changes plus the current values of the requested keys. */
export class RunViewRecordHistoryReader implements IRecordHistoryReader {
  constructor(private readonly dataAccess: ICountingDataAccess, private readonly read: ReadPolicy) {}

  public async Load(entity: AssemblyEntityInfo, keys: readonly string[], fields: readonly string[], policy: ChangeHistoryPolicy, now: Date): Promise<EntityHistory> {
    const changes = await CompleteReader.ReadCompletely(this.dataAccess, {
      EntityName: 'MJ: Record Changes', KeyField: 'ID',
      ExtraFilter: `[EntityID]='${EscapeSQLString(entity.ID)}' AND [Status]='Complete'`,
      Fields: ['ID', 'RecordID', 'Type', 'Source', 'ChangedAt', 'ChangesJSON', 'FullRecordJSON'],
    }, this.read);
    if (changes.Status === 'refused') throw new Error(`Reading Record Changes of ${entity.Name}: ${JSON.stringify(changes.Refusal)}`);
    const current = await KeyedReader.ReadByKeys(this.dataAccess, entity.Name, entity.PrimaryKey, keys, fields);
    if (current.Status === 'refused') throw new Error(`Reading current ${entity.Name} rows: ${JSON.stringify(current.Refusal)}`);
    return RecordHistory.BuildEntityHistory(entity.Name, changes.Rows.map((r) => RunViewRecordHistoryReader.toChangeRow(r)), current.Rows, fields, policy, now);
  }

  /** A Record Changes row as read; an unknown Type/Source value falls back to the conservative Update/Internal. */
  private static toChangeRow(r: SourceRow): RecordChangeRow {
    const type = String(r.Type);
    const source = String(r.Source);
    return {
      ID: String(r.ID),
      RecordID: String(r.RecordID),
      Type: type === 'Create' || type === 'Delete' || type === 'Snapshot' ? type : 'Update',
      Source: source === 'Clone' || source === 'External' || source === 'Restore' ? source : 'Internal',
      ChangedAt: r.ChangedAt instanceof Date ? r.ChangedAt : new Date(String(r.ChangedAt)),
      ChangesJSON: String(r.ChangesJSON || '{}'),
      FullRecordJSON: String(r.FullRecordJSON || '{}'),
    };
  }
```

  `RecordHistory.WriteHistorySnapshots(entityName, provider, user): Promise<number>` (same file, a static of
  `RecordHistory`): loads the entity's records with no
  `Create`/`Snapshot` change row (one `RunView` on `MJ: Record Changes` grouped in memory, one on the entity) and saves
  one `MJ: Record Changes` row per such record through `GetEntityObject<MJRecordChangeEntity>` with `Type='Snapshot'`,
  `Source='Internal'`, `Status='Complete'`, `ChangedAt=now`, `RecordID='<pk>|<value>'`, `FullRecordJSON` = the
  record's `GetAll()` JSON, `ChangesJSON='{}'`, `ChangesDescription='History snapshot for Predictive Studio as-of
  coverage'`; returns the count. It is how an entity loaded before tracking enters coverage (its history starts now —
  the assembly still refuses earlier decision dates). It uses the passed provider (`RunView.FromMetadataProvider`,
  `provider.GetEntityObject`), never the global one, reads with `ResultType: 'simple'` and `Fields` (nothing read is
  mutated), saves the new rows in parallel (`Promise.all`) and throws one error listing every failed `Save()` with its
  `LatestResult.CompleteMessage`. Unit test: a fake entity factory captures 2 saves for 2 records without history and
  0 for one that has a `Create` row.

```ts
    expect(WindowedAggregates.ComputeWindowedAggregate(index, 'A', d, spend).Value).toBe(160);
  });
  it('counts, averages and measures days since the latest row', () => {
    expect(WindowedAggregates.ComputeWindowedAggregate(index, 'A', d, { ...spend, aggregate: 'count' }).Value).toBe(3);
    expect(WindowedAggregates.ComputeWindowedAggregate(index, 'A', d, { ...spend, aggregate: 'mean' }).Value).toBeCloseTo(160 / 3, 12);
    expect(WindowedAggregates.ComputeWindowedAggregate(index, 'A', d, { ...spend, aggregate: 'days-since' }).Value).toBe(0);
    expect(WindowedAggregates.ComputeWindowedAggregate(index, 'Z', d, { ...spend, aggregate: 'days-since' }).Value).toBeNull();
    expect(WindowedAggregates.ComputeWindowedAggregate(index, 'Z', d, { ...spend, aggregate: 'count' }).Value).toBe(0);
  });
  it('counts rows active on d for active-at (e.g. certifications held)', () => {
    const certs = [{ ID: 'c1', PersonID: 'A', AwardedOn: '2020-01-01', ExpiresOn: '2024-01-31', __mj_UpdatedAt: 'x' }, { ID: 'c2', PersonID: 'A', AwardedOn: '2024-02-01', ExpiresOn: null, __mj_UpdatedAt: 'x' }];
    const spec: WindowedAggregateSource = { ...spend, childEntity: 'Certs', dateField: 'AwardedOn', endDateField: 'ExpiresOn', voidedAtField: null, aggregate: 'active-at', valueField: null, windowDays: null };
    expect(WindowedAggregates.ComputeWindowedAggregate(WindowedAggregates.BuildChildRowIndex(certs, spec, 'ID'), 'A', d, spec).Value).toBe(1);
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * @module feature-assembly/as-of/windowed-aggregate
 *
 * Summaries of a dated child table as of a decision date (C2 `windowed-aggregate`): rows dated in (d − windowDays, d]
 * (or on/before d when no window), minus rows voided on or before d, then count | sum | mean | distinct | days-since,
 * or active-at (dateField <= d and (endDateField null or >= d)). Generalises the executor's two hard-coded aggregates.
 */
import { OrdinalCompare } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { WindowedAggregateSource } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { SourceRow } from '../data-access';
import { PredictionUnitRowReader } from '../../prediction-unit/unit-row-reader';
import { MS_PER_DAY, UtcDay, type CellValue } from '../../prediction-unit/utc-day';

export interface ChildRow {
  readonly Id: string;
  readonly Day: Date;
  readonly EndDay: Date | null;
  readonly VoidedDay: Date | null;
  readonly Value: CellValue;
  readonly UpdatedAt: string;
}

export type ChildRowIndex = ReadonlyMap<string, readonly ChildRow[]>;

/** Windowed aggregates over a dated child table (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class WindowedAggregates {
  public static BuildChildRowIndex(rows: readonly SourceRow[], spec: WindowedAggregateSource, primaryKey: string): ChildRowIndex {
    const out = new Map<string, ChildRow[]>();
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (!PredictionUnitRowReader.MatchesRowFilters(r, spec.filter)) continue;
      const day = UtcDay.ToUtcDay(r[spec.dateField]);
      if (day === null) continue;
      // `??`: a numeric 0 owner key is a real key; only an absent one becomes ''.
      const owner = String(r[spec.foreignKey] ?? '').toLowerCase();
      const list = out.get(owner) || [];
      const updated = r.__mj_UpdatedAt;
      list.push({
        Id: String(r[primaryKey]),
        Day: day,
        EndDay: spec.endDateField ? UtcDay.ToUtcDay(r[spec.endDateField]) : null,
        VoidedDay: spec.voidedAtField ? UtcDay.ToUtcDay(r[spec.voidedAtField]) : null,
        Value: spec.valueField ? r[spec.valueField] : null,
        UpdatedAt: updated instanceof Date ? updated.toISOString() : String(updated || ''),
      });
      out.set(owner, list);
    }
    for (const list of out.values()) list.sort((a, b) => a.Day.getTime() - b.Day.getTime() || OrdinalCompare(a.Id, b.Id));
    return out;
  }

  public static ComputeWindowedAggregate(index: ChildRowIndex, ownerKey: string, decision: Date, spec: WindowedAggregateSource): { readonly Value: number | null; readonly Contributors: readonly ChildRow[] } {
    const d = decision.getTime();
    const all = index.get(ownerKey.toLowerCase()) || [];
    const live = all.filter((c) => c.VoidedDay === null || c.VoidedDay.getTime() > d);
    if (spec.aggregate === 'active-at') {
      const active = live.filter((c) => c.Day.getTime() <= d && (c.EndDay === null || c.EndDay.getTime() >= d));
      return { Value: active.length, Contributors: active };
    }
    const from = spec.windowDays === null ? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY : d - spec.windowDays * MS_PER_DAY;
    const inWindow = live.filter((c) => c.Day.getTime() > from && c.Day.getTime() <= d);
    const numbers = inWindow.map((c) => Number(c.Value)).filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n));
    switch (spec.aggregate) {
      case 'count': return { Value: inWindow.length, Contributors: inWindow };
      case 'sum': return { Value: numbers.reduce((s, n) => s + n, 0), Contributors: inWindow };
      case 'mean': return { Value: numbers.length > 0 ? numbers.reduce((s, n) => s + n, 0) / numbers.length : null, Contributors: inWindow };
      case 'distinct': return { Value: new Set(inWindow.map((c) => String(c.Value))).size, Contributors: inWindow };
      case 'days-since': {
        const latest = inWindow[inWindow.length - 1];
        return { Value: latest ? Math.round((d - latest.Day.getTime()) / MS_PER_DAY) : null, Contributors: latest ? [latest] : [] };
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * @module feature-assembly/as-of/series-features
 *
 * Series features declared once in the unit's Temporal Spec (C2 `series`, S-T.1): lag k reads the value k periods
 * back; rolling windows aggregate periods [t − endLag − periods + 1, t − endLag]. Every lag and endLag is >= the
 * horizon (the parser refuses otherwise), so nothing inside the horizon is ever read.
 */
import type { DatedSource, TemporalSpec } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { MS_PER_DAY } from '../../prediction-unit/utc-day';

/** A series feature reference, derived from the contract's `series` source (never restated). */
// case-violation-ok-legacy-back-compat: `kind` is DatedSource's contracts.ts wire discriminant
export type SeriesFeatureRef = Extract<DatedSource, { kind: 'series' }>['feature'];

export interface SeriesPoint { readonly EntityKey: string; readonly Period: Date; readonly Value: number; readonly RowId: string }
export type SeriesHistory = { readonly Spec: TemporalSpec; readonly ByEntity: ReadonlyMap<string, ReadonlyMap<number, SeriesPoint>> };

/** Series lags and rolling windows (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class SeriesFeatures {
  /** Calendar index of a period start (months since 1970 for monthly, days for daily, …). */
  public static PeriodIndex(period: Date, unit: TemporalSpec['period']): number {
    switch (unit) {
      case 'day': return Math.floor(period.getTime() / MS_PER_DAY);
      case 'week': return Math.floor(period.getTime() / (7 * MS_PER_DAY));
      case 'month': return period.getUTCFullYear() * 12 + period.getUTCMonth();
      case 'year': return period.getUTCFullYear();
    }
  }

  public static BuildSeriesHistory(points: readonly SeriesPoint[], spec: TemporalSpec): SeriesHistory {
    const byEntity = new Map<string, Map<number, SeriesPoint>>();
    for (const p of points) {
      const k = p.EntityKey.toLowerCase();
      const m = byEntity.get(k) || new Map<number, SeriesPoint>();
      m.set(SeriesFeatures.PeriodIndex(p.Period, spec.period), p);
      byEntity.set(k, m);
    }
    return { Spec: spec, ByEntity: byEntity };
  }

  public static ComputeSeriesFeature(
    history: SeriesHistory, entityKey: string, period: Date, spec: TemporalSpec, feature: SeriesFeatureRef,
  ): { readonly Value: number | null; readonly SourceRowIds: readonly string[] } {
    const series = history.ByEntity.get(entityKey.toLowerCase());
    const t = SeriesFeatures.PeriodIndex(period, spec.period);
    if (!series) return { Value: null, SourceRowIds: [] };
    if (feature.kind === 'lag') {
      const p = series.get(t - spec.lags[feature.index]);
      return p ? { Value: p.Value, SourceRowIds: [p.RowId] } : { Value: null, SourceRowIds: [] };
    }
    const w = spec.rollingWindows[feature.index];
    const pts: SeriesPoint[] = [];
    for (let i = t - w.endLag - w.periods + 1; i <= t - w.endLag; i++) {
      const p = series.get(i);
      if (!p) return { Value: null, SourceRowIds: [] };
      pts.push(p);
    }
    const values = pts.map((p) => p.Value);
    const value = w.aggregate === 'mean' ? values.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / values.length
      : w.aggregate === 'sum' ? values.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0)
      : w.aggregate === 'min' ? Math.min(...values) : Math.max(...values);
    return { Value: value, SourceRowIds: pts.map((p) => p.RowId) };
  }
}
```
