```ts
/**
 * @module feature-assembly/as-of/as-of-assembler
 *
 * The one assembly function for training and scoring (C2). Every value is read as of the row's decision day from a
 * dated source; every column is typed; refusals name what is wrong and there is no partial matrix. Values are read
 * by key through the same functions in both contexts, so a row assembled for training and for scoring at the same
 * decision date is identical (S3.1).
 */
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import type {
  AssemblyRefusal, ChangeHistoryCoverage, ColumnEncodingKind, ColumnProvenance, FeatureColumnSpec, PredictionUnitSpec,
  PreprocessingOp, ReadPolicy, UncoveredRowsCount, ValueProvenance, WindowedAggregateSource,
} from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { ICountingDataAccess, SourceRow } from '../data-access';
import type { AssemblyEntityInfo, IAssemblyMetadata } from '../assembly-metadata';
import { CompleteReader } from '../read-policy';
import { KeyedReader } from './read-by-keys';
import { RecordHistory, type EntityHistory, type IRecordHistoryReader } from './record-history';
import { WindowedAggregates, type ChildRowIndex } from './windowed-aggregate';
import { SeriesFeatures, type SeriesHistory } from './series-features';
import { UtcDay, MS_PER_DAY, type CellValue } from '../../prediction-unit/utc-day';

export interface AssemblyRowRef { readonly RowId: string; readonly EntityKey: string; readonly DecisionDate: Date; readonly Period: Date | null }
export type MatrixCell = string | number | null;
export interface AssembledColumn { readonly Name: string; readonly Encoding: ColumnEncodingKind; readonly SourceColumn: string; readonly FeatureName: string }
export interface AssembledRow { readonly RowId: string; readonly Values: readonly MatrixCell[]; readonly Provenance: readonly ValueProvenance[] }

export interface AsOfAssemblyInput {
  readonly Context: 'train' | 'score';
  readonly Unit: PredictionUnitSpec;
  readonly RowEntity: AssemblyEntityInfo;
  readonly Rows: readonly AssemblyRowRef[];
  readonly Features: readonly FeatureColumnSpec[];
  readonly SeriesHistory: SeriesHistory | null;
  readonly Read: ReadPolicy;
  readonly DataAccess: ICountingDataAccess;
  readonly History: IRecordHistoryReader;
  readonly Metadata: IAssemblyMetadata;
  readonly AssembledAt: Date;
  readonly ExplicitOps?: readonly PreprocessingOp[];
}

export type AsOfAssemblyResult =
  | {
      readonly Status: 'assembled';
      readonly Columns: readonly AssembledColumn[];
      readonly Rows: readonly AssembledRow[];
      readonly ExcludedRowIds: ReadonlySet<string>;
      readonly UncoveredRowsExcluded: readonly UncoveredRowsCount[];
      readonly Coverage: readonly ChangeHistoryCoverage[];
      readonly Preprocessing: readonly PreprocessingOp[];
      readonly ColumnProvenance: readonly ColumnProvenance[];
    }
  | { readonly Status: 'refused'; readonly Refusal: AssemblyRefusal };

/** Ends assembly at the first refusal; caught by `Assemble` with `instanceof` (never by message). No partial matrix. */
class AssemblyRefused extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly Refusal: AssemblyRefusal) { super(Refusal.kind); }
}

interface RawValue { readonly Value: CellValue; readonly Provenance: ValueProvenance }
type Uncovered = { readonly Uncovered: true; readonly Entity: string; readonly Field: string; readonly HistoryStart: string | null };
type FeatureReader = (row: AssemblyRowRef) => RawValue | Uncovered;
type ColumnReader = { readonly Spec: FeatureColumnSpec; readonly Read: FeatureReader };
type FieldSource = Extract<FeatureColumnSpec['source'], { kind: 'immutable-field' | 'record-changes' }>;
type FeatureValueSource = Extract<FeatureColumnSpec['source'], { kind: 'feature-value' }>;
type SeriesSource = Extract<FeatureColumnSpec['source'], { kind: 'series' }>;

export class AsOfFeatureAssembler {
  /** Impute (with a missing indicator) every column, one-hot every categorical, then the pipeline's explicit ops. */
  public static BuildPreprocessingOps(columns: readonly AssembledColumn[], features: readonly FeatureColumnSpec[], explicit: readonly PreprocessingOp[] = []): PreprocessingOp[] {
    const ops: PreprocessingOp[] = [];
    const byFeature = new Map(features.map((f) => [f.name, f]));
    for (const c of columns) {
      const f = byFeature.get(c.FeatureName);
      if (!f) continue;
      ops.push({ op: 'impute', col: c.Name, strategy: f.missing.impute, ...(f.missing.impute === 'constant' && f.missing.constant !== null ? { fillValue: f.missing.constant } : {}), indicator: true });
      if (c.Encoding === 'categorical') ops.push({ op: 'onehot', col: c.Name });
    }
    return [...ops, ...explicit];
  }

  /** Adapter for the unit training step and the legacy sidecar request: matrix + schema + preprocessing, label appended. */
  public static ToFeatureAssemblyResult(
    assembled: Extract<AsOfAssemblyResult, { Status: 'assembled' }>,
    labels: ReadonlyMap<string, string | number>,
    labelColumn: string,
  ): { matrix: { columns: string[]; rows: Array<Array<string | number | boolean | null>> }; featureSchema: { Name: string; Kind: 'numeric' | 'categorical' }[]; preprocessing: PreprocessingOp[] } {
    return {
      matrix: {
        columns: [...assembled.Columns.map((c) => c.Name), labelColumn],
        // `??`: a label of 0 is a real label (count tasks); only a missing one becomes null.
        rows: assembled.Rows.map((r) => [...r.Values, labels.get(r.RowId) ?? null]),
      },
      featureSchema: assembled.Columns.map((c) => ({ Name: c.Name, Kind: c.Encoding === 'categorical' ? 'categorical' : 'numeric' })),
      preprocessing: [...assembled.Preprocessing],
    };
  }

  public async Assemble(input: AsOfAssemblyInput): Promise<AsOfAssemblyResult> {
    try {
      return await this.assemble(input);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AssemblyRefused) return { Status: 'refused', Refusal: e.Refusal };
      throw e;
    }
  }

  private async assemble(input: AsOfAssemblyInput): Promise<AsOfAssemblyResult> {
    const coverage: ChangeHistoryCoverage[] = [];
    const readers = await this.buildReaders(input, coverage);
    const columns = readers.flatMap((r) => this.columnsFor(r.Spec));
    const assembled = this.assembleRows(input, readers);
    if (input.Unit.history.onUncoveredRow === 'refuse' && assembled.FirstUncovered !== null) {
      const u = assembled.FirstUncovered;
      throw new AssemblyRefused({ kind: 'decision-date-before-change-history', entity: u.Entity, field: u.Field, historyStart: u.HistoryStart, rowsAffected: u.Rows });
    }
    return {
      Status: 'assembled',
      Columns: columns,
      Rows: assembled.Rows,
      ExcludedRowIds: assembled.Excluded,
      UncoveredRowsExcluded: assembled.UncoveredCounts,
      Coverage: coverage,
      Preprocessing: AsOfFeatureAssembler.BuildPreprocessingOps(columns, input.Features, input.ExplicitOps || []),
      ColumnProvenance: readers.map((r) => ({ column: r.Spec.name, source: r.Spec.source.kind, sourceRef: AsOfFeatureAssembler.describeSource(r.Spec), sourceVersion: AsOfFeatureAssembler.columnVersion(r.Spec, input, coverage) })),
    };
  }

  /** One dated reader per non-identifier column; record-changes readers append their coverage. */
  private async buildReaders(input: AsOfAssemblyInput, coverage: ChangeHistoryCoverage[]): Promise<ColumnReader[]> {
    const readers: ColumnReader[] = [];
    for (const spec of input.Features) {
      if (spec.encoding.kind === 'identifier') continue;
      readers.push({ Spec: spec, Read: await this.readerFor(spec, input, coverage) });
    }
    return readers;
  }

  /**
   * Reads every row through every reader. A row with an uncovered value is excluded and counted per entity/field;
   * the first uncovered entity/field (with its row count) is returned for the `refuse` policy.
   */
  private assembleRows(input: AsOfAssemblyInput, readers: readonly ColumnReader[]): {
    readonly Rows: AssembledRow[]; readonly Excluded: Set<string>; readonly UncoveredCounts: UncoveredRowsCount[];
    readonly FirstUncovered: (Uncovered & { readonly Rows: number }) | null;
  } {
    const excluded = new Set<string>();
    const counts = new Map<string, UncoveredRowsCount & { readonly HistoryStart: string | null }>();
    const rows: AssembledRow[] = [];
    for (const row of input.Rows) {
      const values: MatrixCell[] = [];
      const provenance: ValueProvenance[] = [];
      let uncovered: Uncovered | null = null;
      for (const r of readers) {
        const raw = r.Read(row);
        if ('Uncovered' in raw) { uncovered = raw; break; }
        values.push(...this.encode(r.Spec, raw.Value, row.DecisionDate));
        provenance.push(raw.Provenance);
      }
      if (uncovered === null) {
        rows.push({ RowId: row.RowId, Values: values, Provenance: provenance });
        continue;
      }
      excluded.add(row.RowId);
      const k = `${uncovered.Entity}|${uncovered.Field}`;
      counts.set(k, { entity: uncovered.Entity, field: uncovered.Field, rows: (counts.get(k)?.rows || 0) + 1, HistoryStart: uncovered.HistoryStart });
    }
    const first = [...counts.values()][0];
    return {
      Rows: rows,
      Excluded: excluded,
      UncoveredCounts: [...counts.values()].map((c) => ({ entity: c.entity, field: c.field, rows: c.rows })),
      FirstUncovered: first ? { Uncovered: true, Entity: first.entity, Field: first.field, HistoryStart: first.HistoryStart, Rows: first.rows } : null,
    };
  }

  private columnsFor(spec: FeatureColumnSpec): AssembledColumn[] {
    const source = AsOfFeatureAssembler.describeSource(spec);
    if (spec.encoding.kind === 'date-parts') {
      return spec.encoding.parts.map((p) => ({ Name: `${spec.name}__${p.replace(/-/g, '_')}`, Encoding: 'numeric', SourceColumn: source, FeatureName: spec.name }));
    }
    return [{ Name: spec.name, Encoding: spec.encoding.kind === 'boolean' ? 'numeric' : spec.encoding.kind, SourceColumn: source, FeatureName: spec.name }];
  }

  /** Typed encoding: no variant writes 0 for a value it cannot read; non-numeric text in a numeric column refuses. */
  private encode(spec: FeatureColumnSpec, value: CellValue, decision: Date): MatrixCell[] {
    const missing = value === null || value === undefined || (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() === '');
    switch (spec.encoding.kind) {
      case 'numeric': {
        if (missing) return [null];
        const n = typeof value === 'number' ? value : typeof value === 'boolean' ? (value ? 1 : 0) : value instanceof Date ? Number.NaN : Number(value.trim());
        if (!Number.isFinite(n)) throw new AssemblyRefused({ kind: 'non-numeric-in-numeric-column', column: spec.name, sampleValue: value instanceof Date ? value.toISOString() : String(value) });
        return [n];
      }
      case 'boolean': {
        if (missing) return [null];
        if (value === true || value === 1 || value === '1' || value === 'true') return [1];
        if (value === false || value === 0 || value === '0' || value === 'false') return [0];
        throw new AssemblyRefused({ kind: 'non-numeric-in-numeric-column', column: spec.name, sampleValue: String(value) });
      }
      case 'categorical':
        return [missing ? null : value instanceof Date ? UtcDay.UtcDayIso(value) : String(value).trim()];
      case 'date-parts':
        return this.encodeDateParts(spec, spec.encoding.parts, missing ? null : value, decision);
      case 'identifier':
        return [];
    }
  }

  /** Date parts of a dated value; a value that is not a date refuses (never 0). */
  private encodeDateParts(spec: FeatureColumnSpec, parts: Extract<FeatureColumnSpec['encoding'], { kind: 'date-parts' }>['parts'], value: CellValue, decision: Date): MatrixCell[] {
    const day = value === null ? null : UtcDay.ToUtcDay(value);
    if (value !== null && day === null) throw new AssemblyRefused({ kind: 'non-numeric-in-numeric-column', column: spec.name, sampleValue: String(value) });
    return parts.map((p) => {
      if (day === null) return null;
      switch (p) {
        case 'days-since-decision': return Math.round((decision.getTime() - day.getTime()) / MS_PER_DAY);
        case 'year': return day.getUTCFullYear();
        case 'month': return day.getUTCMonth() + 1;
        case 'dow': return day.getUTCDay();
      }
    });
  }

  private async readerFor(spec: FeatureColumnSpec, input: AsOfAssemblyInput, coverage: ChangeHistoryCoverage[]): Promise<FeatureReader> {
    const source = spec.source;
    switch (source.kind) {
      case 'immutable-field':
      case 'record-changes': return this.fieldReader(spec, source, input, coverage);
      case 'windowed-aggregate': return this.aggregateReader(spec, source, input);
      case 'series': return this.seriesReader(spec, source, input);
      case 'feature-value': return this.featureValueReader(spec, source, input);
    }
  }

  /**
   * A field read as of the decision day: replayed from Record Changes (updatable fields), or read directly when the field
   * is immutable — refused if Record Changes show it changed after any row's decision date.
   */
  private async fieldReader(spec: FeatureColumnSpec, source: FieldSource, input: AsOfAssemblyInput, coverage: ChangeHistoryCoverage[]): Promise<FeatureReader> {
    const entity = source.entity === input.RowEntity.Name ? input.RowEntity : input.Metadata.Entity(source.entity);
    if (!entity) throw new AssemblyRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: source.entity, field: source.field });
    const keyOf = await this.keyResolver(source.keyField, input);
    const keys = input.Rows.map((r) => keyOf(r)).filter((k): k is string => k !== null);
    const history: EntityHistory = await input.History.Load(entity, keys, [source.field], input.Unit.history, input.AssembledAt);
    const sourceRef = (key: string | null): string => `${entity.Name}/${(key || '').toLowerCase()}/${source.field}`;
    if (source.kind === 'record-changes') {
      coverage.push(history.Coverage);
      return (row) => {
        const key = keyOf(row);
        const hv = key === null ? { Status: 'uncovered' as const, Reason: 'no-history' as const } : history.ValueAt(key, source.field, UtcDay.AddUtcDays(row.DecisionDate, 1));
        if (hv.Status === 'uncovered') return { Uncovered: true, Entity: entity.Name, Field: source.field, HistoryStart: history.Coverage.historyStart };
        return { Value: hv.Value, Provenance: { column: spec.name, source: 'record-changes', sourceRef: sourceRef(key), sourceVersion: hv.ChangeId, computedAt: hv.ChangedAt.toISOString() } };
      };
    }
    const current = await KeyedReader.ReadByKeys(input.DataAccess, entity.Name, entity.PrimaryKey, keys, [source.field, '__mj_CreatedAt']);
    if (current.Status === 'refused') throw new AssemblyRefused(current.Refusal);
    const changedAfter = input.Rows.reduce((n, r) => {
      const key = keyOf(r);
      return key === null ? n : n + history.UpdatesAfter(key, source.field, UtcDay.AddUtcDays(r.DecisionDate, 1));
    }, 0);
    if (changedAfter > 0) throw new AssemblyRefused({ kind: 'select-changes-after-decision-date', entity: entity.Name, field: source.field, changesAfter: changedAfter });
    return (row) => {
      const key = keyOf(row);
      const rec = key === null ? undefined : current.Rows.get(key.toLowerCase());
      const created = rec?.__mj_CreatedAt;
      const createdIso = created instanceof Date ? created.toISOString() : String(created || '');
      return { Value: rec ? rec[source.field] : null, Provenance: { column: spec.name, source: 'immutable-field', sourceRef: sourceRef(key), sourceVersion: `created:${createdIso}`, computedAt: createdIso } };
    };
  }

  /** A windowed aggregate over the owner's child rows; its version hashes the contributing rows and their update times. */
  private async aggregateReader(spec: FeatureColumnSpec, source: WindowedAggregateSource, input: AsOfAssemblyInput): Promise<FeatureReader> {
    const index = await this.childIndex(source, input);
    const keyOf = await this.keyResolver(source.ownerKeyField, input);
    return (row) => {
      const owner = keyOf(row) || '';
      const agg = WindowedAggregates.ComputeWindowedAggregate(index, owner, row.DecisionDate, source);
      const version = createHash('sha256').update(agg.Contributors.map((c) => `${c.Id}:${c.UpdatedAt}`).sort().join('\n')).digest('hex');
      return { Value: agg.Value, Provenance: { column: spec.name, source: 'windowed-aggregate', sourceRef: `${source.childEntity}?${source.foreignKey}=${owner.toLowerCase()}&as-of=${UtcDay.UtcDayIso(row.DecisionDate)}&aggregate=${source.aggregate}`, sourceVersion: version, computedAt: input.AssembledAt.toISOString() } };
    };
  }

  /** A declared lag or rolling window of the unit's own series. */
  private seriesReader(spec: FeatureColumnSpec, source: SeriesSource, input: AsOfAssemblyInput): FeatureReader {
    const t = input.Unit.temporal;
    const history = input.SeriesHistory;
    if (!t || !history) throw new AssemblyRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: input.RowEntity.Name, field: `TemporalSpec.${source.feature.kind}[${source.feature.index}]` });
    return (row) => {
      const s = SeriesFeatures.ComputeSeriesFeature(history, row.EntityKey, row.Period || row.DecisionDate, t, source.feature);
      return { Value: s.Value, Provenance: { column: spec.name, source: 'series', sourceRef: `${input.RowEntity.Name}/label/${s.SourceRowIds.join('+')}`, sourceVersion: `labelVersion:${input.Unit.label.labelVersion}`, computedAt: input.AssembledAt.toISOString() } };
    };
  }

  /** The latest effective-dated, pinned Feature Value at or before the decision day; an unpinned source is refused. */
  private async featureValueReader(spec: FeatureColumnSpec, source: FeatureValueSource, input: AsOfAssemblyInput): Promise<FeatureReader> {
    if (source.pin === null) throw new AssemblyRefused({ kind: 'unpinned-feature-version', featureName: source.featureName });
    const pin = source.pin;
    // Every value interpolated here comes from metadata or a pin (JSON), so each is escaped.
    const filters = [
      `[EntityID]='${EscapeSQLString(input.RowEntity.ID)}'`, `[FeatureName]='${EscapeSQLString(source.featureName)}'`,
      `[RecordProcessID]='${EscapeSQLString(pin.featurePipelineRecordProcessId)}'`, '[EffectiveAsOf] IS NOT NULL',
      ...(pin.promptVersionHash ? [`[PromptVersionHash]='${EscapeSQLString(pin.promptVersionHash)}'`] : []),
      // PR 1's Feature Value key columns (#5540, §8.2 A-PR1): a pin names the pipeline version, model and parameters it read.
      ...(pin.pipelineVersion !== null && Number.isInteger(pin.pipelineVersion) ? [`[PipelineVersion]=${pin.pipelineVersion}`] : []),
      ...(pin.aiModelId ? [`[AIModelID]='${EscapeSQLString(pin.aiModelId)}'`] : []),
      ...(pin.parametersHash ? [`[ParametersHash]='${EscapeSQLString(pin.parametersHash)}'`] : []),
    ];
    const read = await CompleteReader.ReadCompletely(input.DataAccess, { EntityName: 'MJ: Feature Values', KeyField: 'ID', ExtraFilter: filters.join(' AND '), Fields: ['ID', 'RecordID', 'EffectiveAsOf', 'ComputedAt', 'ValueNumeric', 'ValueText', 'ValueBoolean', 'ValueDate'] }, input.Read);
    if (read.Status === 'refused') throw new AssemblyRefused(read.Refusal);
    const at = (v: SourceRow): number => (v.EffectiveAsOf instanceof Date ? v.EffectiveAsOf : new Date(String(v.EffectiveAsOf))).getTime();
    const byRecord = new Map<string, SourceRow[]>();
    for (const v of read.Rows) {
      const k = RecordHistory.KeyOfRecordId(String(v.RecordID));
      const list = byRecord.get(k) || [];
      list.push(v);
      byRecord.set(k, list);
    }
    for (const list of byRecord.values()) list.sort((a, b) => at(a) - at(b));
    const version = `${pin.featurePipelineRecordProcessId}@${pin.pipelineVersion || pin.promptVersionHash || 'unversioned'}`;
    return (row) => {
      const asOf = UtcDay.AddUtcDays(row.DecisionDate, 1).getTime();
      const candidates = (byRecord.get(row.RowId.toLowerCase()) || []).filter((v) => at(v) < asOf);
      const v = candidates[candidates.length - 1];
      const computed = v?.ComputedAt instanceof Date ? v.ComputedAt.toISOString() : String(v?.ComputedAt || '');
      return {
        // `??`: 0, '' and false are real feature values; only an absent typed column falls through to the next.
        Value: v ? (v.ValueNumeric ?? v.ValueText ?? v.ValueBoolean ?? v.ValueDate ?? null) : null,
        Provenance: { column: spec.name, source: 'feature-value', sourceRef: v ? `MJ: Feature Values/${String(v.ID).toLowerCase()}` : 'none', sourceVersion: version, computedAt: computed },
      };
    };
  }

  /** How a row finds the record a source reads: its own row id, or a key field on the row entity. */
  private async keyResolver(keyField: string | null, input: AsOfAssemblyInput): Promise<(row: AssemblyRowRef) => string | null> {
    if (keyField === null) return (row) => row.RowId;
    const rowsById = await KeyedReader.ReadByKeys(input.DataAccess, input.RowEntity.Name, input.RowEntity.PrimaryKey, input.Rows.map((r) => r.RowId), [keyField]);
    if (rowsById.Status === 'refused') throw new AssemblyRefused(rowsById.Refusal);
    return (row) => {
      const v = rowsById.Rows.get(row.RowId.toLowerCase())?.[keyField];
      return v === null || v === undefined ? null : String(v);
    };
  }

  private async childIndex(source: WindowedAggregateSource, input: AsOfAssemblyInput): Promise<ChildRowIndex> {
    const child = input.Metadata.Entity(source.childEntity);
    if (!child) throw new AssemblyRefused({ kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: source.childEntity, field: '*' });
    const fields = [child.PrimaryKey, source.foreignKey, source.dateField, source.endDateField, source.voidedAtField, source.valueField, ...source.filter.map((f) => f.field), '__mj_UpdatedAt']
      .filter((f): f is string => !!f);
    const read = await CompleteReader.ReadCompletely(input.DataAccess, { EntityName: child.Name, KeyField: child.PrimaryKey, Fields: [...new Set(fields)] }, input.Read);
    if (read.Status === 'refused') throw new AssemblyRefused(read.Refusal);
    return WindowedAggregates.BuildChildRowIndex(read.Rows, source, child.PrimaryKey);
  }

  /** The per-column version summary stored on the snapshot (per-value versions are in the provenance file). */
  private static columnVersion(spec: FeatureColumnSpec, input: AsOfAssemblyInput, coverage: readonly ChangeHistoryCoverage[]): string {
    const s = spec.source;
    switch (s.kind) {
      case 'record-changes': return `history-start:${coverage.find((c) => c.entity === s.entity)?.historyStart || 'none'}`;
      case 'immutable-field': return 'immutable-after-create';
      case 'windowed-aggregate': return `window:${s.windowDays === null ? 'all' : s.windowDays};aggregate:${s.aggregate}`;
      case 'series': return `labelVersion:${input.Unit.label.labelVersion}`;
      case 'feature-value': return s.pin ? `${s.pin.featurePipelineRecordProcessId}@${s.pin.pipelineVersion || s.pin.promptVersionHash || 'unversioned'}` : 'unpinned';
    }
  }

  private static describeSource(spec: FeatureColumnSpec): string {
    const s = spec.source;
    switch (s.kind) {
      case 'immutable-field':
      case 'record-changes': return `${s.entity}.${s.field}`;
      case 'windowed-aggregate': return `${s.childEntity}.${s.valueField || s.dateField}`;
      case 'series': return `series.${s.feature.kind}[${s.feature.index}]`;
      case 'feature-value': return `feature-value.${s.featureName}`;
    }
  }
}
```

  The pinned `feature-value` read (D-018: PR 3 reads effective-dated values; PR 5 supplies the pins) is reachable only
  once a pin can be declared; its unit test is part of this task: a pinned source over two effective-dated rows of one
  record (`EffectiveAsOf` 2024-01-01 and 2024-06-01) returns the first at decision date 2024-03-01 and the second at
  2024-07-01, and a row with `EffectiveAsOf` NULL is never read; with `pin.pipelineVersion = 2` a third row of the
  same record at `PipelineVersion = 1` is never read (PR 1's key columns, §8.2 A-PR1). No gate depends on it in PR 3.
  Three more cases in the same file, so every refusal the assembler adds is exposed by a test (coding standards §13):
  an immutable field with an `Update` Record Change dated after a row's decision day → `select-changes-after-decision-date`
  naming the field and the count; a `feature-value` source with `pin: null` → `unpinned-feature-version`; a key-field
  value with no row in the keyed entity → `truncated-read` (from `KeyedReader.ReadByKeys`).

```python
class NonNumericFeatureError(ValueError):
    """A non-numeric value reached a numeric matrix column. Never coerced to 0.0 (F-MC-8, FM-6)."""

    def __init__(self, column: str, value: Any) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"Column '{column}' is numeric but holds the non-numeric value {value!r}; bind it with a categorical or date encoding")
        self.column = column
        self.value = value


def _coerce_numeric(value: Any, column: str) -> float:
    """A numeric matrix cell: numbers pass, None stays missing as 0.0 only after an imputer ran, text refuses."""
    if value is None:
        return 0.0
    f = _to_float(value)
    if f is None:
        raise NonNumericFeatureError(column, value)
    return f
```

  `_fit_impute` returns `"indicator": bool(op.get("indicator", False))` in its params; `_apply_impute(params, row, out)`
  appends `(f"{col}__missing", 1.0 if _is_missing(row.get(col)) else 0.0)` to `out` **before** filling when
  `params.get("indicator")`; `_transform_one` passes `out` to it; `_build_matrix` orders output columns as
  `[indicator columns (op order)] + [one-hot columns (op order)] + passthrough`, and calls
  `_coerce_numeric(row.get(c), c)`. In `main.py`'s `/train` and `/predict`, map `NonNumericFeatureError` to HTTP 400
  with its message (it is a `ValueError`, which both handlers already map to 400 — verify by the test below).
  `None → 0.0` remains only for a passthrough column without an imputer (legacy pipelines); unit pipelines always
  emit an imputer with an indicator (M3.4), so a unit model never conflates missing with 0.

```ts
/** As-of assembly gate measurements (W4 → S2.1 #2, T3 → S-T.1, W1 → S7.5 #2, C1 → S3.1). */
import { TrainingRunResultsParser } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { TrainingEngine, MLModelInferenceProcessor, TrainingDelegation, BuildProductionMLInferenceDeps } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio';
import { UnitFixtures, W4StatusHistory, type GateMeasurement, type TruthHarness } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-truth-suite';

const CATALOG = ['Logistic Regression', 'XGBoost', 'LightGBM', 'Random Forest'] as const;

/** The as-of assembly gate bodies (G1.4, G1.5, G1.9, G1.12); static members on one owner (coding standards §2). */
export class AsOfAssemblyGates {
  /** G1.4 W4 → S2.1 #2 */
  public static async MeasureW4AsOfStatus(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'world', ID: 'W4-pit', Seed: 42 });
    const timeline = await W4StatusHistory.WriteW4StatusHistory(h);           // Person.Status history: Create at first cycle, Update to Lapsed after the lapsing cycle
    let excluded = 0;
    for (const algorithm of CATALOG) {
      const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionWorldRenewalPipeline(h, 'W4-pit', { features: ['EventsAttended', 'AutoRenew', 'IncomeK', 'PersonStatusNow'], algorithm });
      await h.Train(pipeline);
      const r = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults((await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID)).ValidationResults);
      const reason = r.Ok && r.Value.status === 'refused' && r.Value.refusal.stage === 'assembly' ? r.Value.refusal.reason : null;
      if (reason && reason.kind === 'decision-date-before-change-history' && reason.field === 'PersonStatusNow') excluded++;
    }
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionWorldRenewalPipeline(h, 'W4-pit', { features: ['EventsAttended', 'AutoRenew', 'IncomeK'], personStatus: true });
    const assembly = await new TrainingEngine().AssembleForTraining(pipeline.ID, await TrainingDelegation.BuildTrainingDeps(h.Provider, h.User));
    if (assembly.Assembled.Status !== 'assembled') return { Passed: false, Measured: { excluded }, Detail: JSON.stringify(assembly.Assembled) };
    const statusCol = assembly.Assembled.Columns.findIndex((c) => c.FeatureName === 'Status');
    const byRow = new Map(assembly.UnitRead.Rows.map((r) => [r.RowId, r]));
    let equal = 0;
    for (const row of assembly.Assembled.Rows) {
      const unitRow = byRow.get(row.RowId);
      if (unitRow && row.Values[statusCol] === W4StatusHistory.ExpectedStatusAt(timeline, String(unitRow.Source.PersonID), unitRow.DecisionDate)) equal++;
    }
    const total = assembly.Assembled.Rows.length;
    return { Passed: excluded === 4 && total > 0 && equal === total && total === assembly.UnitRead.Rows.length, Measured: { excludedOrFlagged: excluded, asOfEqual: equal, rows: total }, Detail: `PersonStatusNow refused for ${excluded} of 4; ${equal} of ${total} as-of values equal the dated history` };
  }

  /** G1.5 T3 → S-T.1 */
  public static async MeasureT3SamePeriodRefused(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'scenario', ID: 'T3', Seed: UnitFixtures.ScenarioBaseSeed('T3') });
    const same = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionT3Pipeline(h, { columns: ['SamePeriodTarget'], periodOffsets: {} });
    await h.Train(same.Pipeline);
    const r1 = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults((await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, same.Pipeline.ID)).ValidationResults);
    const refusedByName = r1.Ok && r1.Value.status === 'refused' && r1.Value.refusal.reason.kind === 'future-period-lag' && 'column' in r1.Value.refusal.reason && r1.Value.refusal.reason.column === 'SamePeriodTarget';
    const lag = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionT3Pipeline(h, { columns: ['LagTarget'], periodOffsets: { LagTarget: 1 } });
    await h.Train(lag.Pipeline);
    const accepted = (await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, lag.Pipeline.ID)).Status === 'Completed';
    return { Passed: refusedByName && accepted, Measured: { sameRefused: refusedByName, lagAccepted: accepted }, Detail: 'SamePeriodTarget refused by name; LagTarget accepted' };
  }

  /** G1.9 W1 → S7.5 #2 */
  public static async MeasureW1StringAsNumericRefused(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'world', ID: 'W1-signal', Seed: 42 });
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionWorldRenewalPipeline(h, 'W1-signal', { features: ['EventsAttended', 'Region'], encodings: { Region: 'numeric' } });
    const attempt = await h.Train(pipeline);
    const message = attempt.Ok ? '' : (attempt.ErrorMessage || '');
    const run = await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID);
    const r = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults(run.ValidationResults);
    const reason = r.Ok && r.Value.status === 'refused' ? r.Value.refusal.reason : null;
    // The stored refusal is checked by its fields; the message check is the gate's own criterion (the user sees the column).
    const named = reason !== null && reason.kind === 'non-numeric-in-numeric-column' && reason.column === 'Region' && message.includes('Region');
    // "0 values are coerced to 0.0": the run stopped before the sidecar; no model, no matrix.
    return { Passed: named && run.ResultingModelID === null, Measured: { stoppedNamingColumn: named, modelCreated: run.ResultingModelID !== null }, Detail: message };
  }

  /** G1.12 C1 → S3.1. The model is promoted to Validated before the scoring path loads it: the scoring processor refuses Draft models. */
  public static async MeasureC1TrainScoreParity(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionC1AssemblyPipeline(h);
    await h.Train(pipeline);
    const run = await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID);
    if (!run.ResultingModelID) return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: `training run ${run.ID} produced no model: ${run.Notes || ''}` };
    const promoted = await h.Promote(run.ResultingModelID, 'Validated', 'G1.12: scoring-path assembly');
    if (!promoted.Promoted) return { Passed: false, Measured: { modelStatus: promoted.Status }, Detail: `model ${run.ResultingModelID} could not be validated for scoring` };
    const training = await new TrainingEngine().AssembleForTraining(pipeline.ID, await TrainingDelegation.BuildTrainingDeps(h.Provider, h.User));
    if (training.Assembled.Status !== 'assembled') return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: 'training assembly refused' };
    const sample = training.Assembled.Rows.filter((_, i) => i % Math.floor(training.Assembled.Rows.length / 100) === 0).slice(0, 100);
    const scoring = new MLModelInferenceProcessor({ modelId: run.ResultingModelID, deps: BuildProductionMLInferenceDeps() });
    const records = sample.map((r) => ({ ID: r.RowId }));
    const scored = await scoring.AssembleForScoring(records, { contextUser: h.User, provider: h.Provider }, 'unit-rule');
    if (scored.Status !== 'assembled') return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: 'scoring assembly refused' };
    const byId = new Map(scored.Rows.map((r) => [r.RowId.toLowerCase(), r]));
    let mismatches = 0;
    for (const r of sample) {
      const s = byId.get(r.RowId.toLowerCase());
      if (!s || JSON.stringify(s.Values) !== JSON.stringify(r.Values)) mismatches++;
    }
    return { Passed: sample.length === 100 && mismatches === 0, Measured: { compared: sample.length, mismatches }, Detail: `${mismatches} mismatches of ${sample.length}` };
  }
}
```

- [x] Step 3: Implement `w4-status-history.ts` — the dated history of `Person.Status` the W4 world implies (a person is
  `Active` from their first cycle's `StartDate` and `Lapsed` from 1 January after the first cycle they did not renew),
  written as `MJ: Record Changes` rows (`Create` + one `Update`). Program D-040 / ruling PR3-R8: rows go through the
  entity layer wherever the entity accepts them — earlier fixture rows are deleted with `BaseEntity.Delete()`, and the
  `Update` rows are saved with `GetEntityObject<MJRecordChangeEntity>` (`ChangedAt`, `Type`, `Source`, `ChangesJSON`,
  `FullRecordJSON` all have setters); only the `Create` rows are written with direct SQL, because
  `MJRecordChangeEntityServer.CheckPermissions` refuses a caller-created `Source='Internal'`, `Type='Create'` row
  ("written by the platform and cannot be created through the API",
  `packages/MJCoreEntitiesServer/src/custom/MJRecordChangeEntityServer.server.ts`), and that refusal is cited in the
  code where the DML stays:

```ts
import sql from 'mssql';
import { RunView, type BaseEntity } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { MJRecordChangeEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { UtcDay } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio';
import type { TruthHarness } from '../harness/types';
import { TruthConnection } from '../db/connection';
import { UnitFixtures } from './unit-fixtures';

export type StatusTimeline = ReadonlyMap<string, { readonly ActiveFrom: Date; readonly LapsedFrom: Date | null }>;

export class W4StatusHistory {
  /**
   * Writes the dated `Person.Status` history the W4 world implies as `MJ: Record Changes` rows for the test entity
   * `pstruth.W4_Person`: earlier rows deleted and `Update` rows saved through the entity layer; `Create` rows by direct
   * SQL only because the entity refuses them (see `writeCreateRows`).
   */
  public static async WriteW4StatusHistory(h: TruthHarness): Promise<StatusTimeline> {
    const pool: sql.ConnectionPool = await TruthConnection.OpenPool();
    try {
      const timeline = await W4StatusHistory.readTimeline(pool);
      const personEntity = h.Provider.EntityByName(UnitFixtures.TruthEntityName(h, 'W4_Person'));
      if (!personEntity) throw new Error('pstruth.W4_Person is not registered');
      await W4StatusHistory.deleteEarlierRows(h, personEntity.ID);
      await W4StatusHistory.writeCreateRows(pool, h, personEntity.ID, timeline);
      await W4StatusHistory.saveUpdateRows(h, personEntity.ID, timeline);
      return timeline;
    } finally {
      await pool.close();
    }
  }

  /** Each person's first cycle (Active from 1 January of it) and the first cycle they did not renew. */
  private static async readTimeline(pool: sql.ConnectionPool): Promise<Map<string, { ActiveFrom: Date; LapsedFrom: Date | null }>> {
    const years = await pool.request().query<{ PersonID: string; Year: number; Renewed: boolean | null }>(`SELECT PersonID, [Year], Renewed FROM pstruth.W4_MembershipYear ORDER BY PersonID, [Year]`);
    const timeline = new Map<string, { ActiveFrom: Date; LapsedFrom: Date | null }>();
    for (const y of years.recordset) {
      const k = y.PersonID.toLowerCase();
      const t = timeline.get(k) || { ActiveFrom: new Date(Date.UTC(y.Year, 0, 1)), LapsedFrom: null };
      if (y.Renewed === false && t.LapsedFrom === null) t.LapsedFrom = new Date(Date.UTC(y.Year + 1, 0, 1));
      timeline.set(k, t);
    }
    return timeline;
  }

  /** Deletes earlier fixture rows of the entity through `BaseEntity.Delete()`; a refused delete throws with its message. */
  private static async deleteEarlierRows(h: TruthHarness, entityID: string): Promise<void> {
    const res = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(h.Provider).RunView<BaseEntity>({
      EntityName: 'MJ: Record Changes', ExtraFilter: `EntityID='${EscapeSQLString(entityID)}'`, ResultType: 'entity_object', IgnoreMaxRows: true, BypassCache: true,
    }, h.User);
    if (!res.Success) throw new Error(`reading earlier W4 Record Changes failed: ${res.ErrorMessage}`);
    const failed = (await Promise.all(res.Results.map(async (r) => ((await r.Delete()) ? null : r.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'delete failed')))).filter((m): m is string => m !== null);
    if (failed.length > 0) throw new Error(`deleting earlier W4 Record Changes failed: ${failed[0]}`);
  }

  /**
   * The `Create` rows, by direct SQL: `MJRecordChangeEntityServer.CheckPermissions` refuses a caller-created
   * `Source='Internal'`, `Type='Create'` row ("written by the platform and cannot be created through the API"), so the
   * entity layer cannot write them. Confined to this fixture, the test entity's rows and the suite's own database.
   */
  private static async writeCreateRows(pool: sql.ConnectionPool, h: TruthHarness, entityID: string, timeline: StatusTimeline): Promise<void> {
    const table = new sql.Table('[__mj].[RecordChange]');
    for (const [name, type] of [['EntityID', sql.UniqueIdentifier], ['RecordID', sql.NVarChar(750)], ['UserID', sql.UniqueIdentifier], ['Type', sql.NVarChar(20)], ['Source', sql.NVarChar(20)], ['ChangedAt', sql.DateTimeOffset], ['ChangesJSON', sql.NVarChar(sql.MAX)], ['ChangesDescription', sql.NVarChar(sql.MAX)], ['FullRecordJSON', sql.NVarChar(sql.MAX)], ['Status', sql.NVarChar(50)]] as const) {
      table.columns.add(name, type, { nullable: false });
    }
    for (const [personId, t] of timeline) {
      table.rows.add(entityID, `ID|${personId.toUpperCase()}`, h.User.ID, 'Create', 'Internal', t.ActiveFrom, '{}', 'Record Created', JSON.stringify({ ID: personId.toUpperCase(), Status: 'Active' }), 'Complete');
    }
    await pool.request().bulk(table);
  }

  /** The `Update` rows (Active → Lapsed), saved through the entity layer in parallel; a failed save throws with its message. */
  private static async saveUpdateRows(h: TruthHarness, entityID: string, timeline: StatusTimeline): Promise<void> {
    const lapsed = [...timeline].filter((e): e is [string, { readonly ActiveFrom: Date; readonly LapsedFrom: Date }] => e[1].LapsedFrom !== null);
    const failed = (await Promise.all(lapsed.map(async ([personId, t]) => {
      const rc = await h.Provider.GetEntityObject<MJRecordChangeEntity>('MJ: Record Changes', h.User);
      rc.NewRecord();
      rc.EntityID = entityID;
      rc.RecordID = `ID|${personId.toUpperCase()}`;
      rc.UserID = h.User.ID;
      rc.Type = 'Update';
      rc.Source = 'Internal';
      rc.ChangedAt = t.LapsedFrom;
      rc.ChangesJSON = JSON.stringify({ Status: { field: 'Status', oldValue: 'Active', newValue: 'Lapsed' } });
      rc.ChangesDescription = 'Status: Active → Lapsed';
      rc.FullRecordJSON = JSON.stringify({ ID: personId.toUpperCase(), Status: 'Lapsed' });
      rc.Status = 'Complete';
      return (await rc.Save()) ? null : rc.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'save failed';
    }))).filter((m): m is string => m !== null);
    if (failed.length > 0) throw new Error(`saving W4 Record Change updates failed (${failed.length}): ${failed[0]}`);
  }

  /** The status the timeline says was in force at the end of a decision day. */
  public static ExpectedStatusAt(timeline: StatusTimeline, personId: string, decision: Date): string | null {
    const t = timeline.get(personId.toLowerCase());
    if (!t) return null;
    const asOf = UtcDay.AddUtcDays(decision, 1).getTime();
    if (asOf <= t.ActiveFrom.getTime()) return null;
    return t.LapsedFrom !== null && t.LapsedFrom.getTime() < asOf ? 'Lapsed' : 'Active';
  }
}
```

### M4 — Training Snapshot and provenance  ·  parallel-safe: no  ·  depends on: M3

**Outcome:** every unit-pipeline training run first freezes what it will learn from in an immutable
`MJ: Training Snapshots` row plus three write-once `MJ: Files` (matrix, row manifest, per-value provenance) stored
through `FileStorageBase`; the run references the snapshot; the content hash recomputes from the stored files; a
retrain from the snapshot and the run's logged configuration reproduces the holdout metrics within 1e-9; and every
assembled value — at training and at scoring — resolves to its source, source version and computed-at. A local
file-system storage driver makes this work on a developer machine and a CI runner. Gates G1.10 and G1.11 are
flipped `Active` and pass; G1.1–G1.3 now also assert against the snapshot.

```ts
/**
 * @module drivers/LocalFileSystemStorage
 *
 * A FileStorageBase driver over a directory of the server's file system (`STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT`, or `rootPath` in the
 * account configuration). For development machines, CI runners and single-host installs: the files are as durable as
 * that disk, and only processes on that host can read them (`CreatePreAuthDownloadUrl` returns a `file://` URL).
 * Added for Predictive Studio's Training Snapshots, usable by any MJ feature.
 */
import { copyFile, mkdir, readFile, readdir, rename, rm, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join, relative, resolve, sep } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { OrdinalCompare, RegisterClass } from '@memberjunction/global';
import {
  FileStorageBase, UnsupportedOperationError, type CreatePreAuthUploadUrlPayload, type FileSearchResultSet, type GetObjectMetadataParams,
  type GetObjectParams, type StorageListResult, type StorageObjectMetadata, type StorageProviderConfig,
} from '../generic/FileStorageBase';

/** A key that resolves outside the storage root (path traversal); typed so callers and tests never match message text. */
export class StorageRootEscapeError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly ObjectName: string) {
    super(`LocalFileSystemStorage: '${ObjectName}' escapes the storage root`);
    this.name = 'StorageRootEscapeError';
  }
}

@RegisterClass(FileStorageBase, 'Local File System Storage')
export class LocalFileSystemStorage extends FileStorageBase {
  protected readonly providerName = 'Local File System Storage';   // override keeps the base class's casing
  private root: string;

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.root = process.env.STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT ? resolve(process.env.STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT) : '';
  }

  public override async initialize(config?: StorageProviderConfig): Promise<void> {
    await super.initialize(config);
    const configured = config?.rootPath;
    if (typeof configured === 'string' && configured.length > 0) this.root = resolve(configured);
  }

  public get IsConfigured(): boolean {
    return this.root.length > 0;
  }

  private pathOf(objectName: string): string {
    if (!this.IsConfigured) throw new Error('LocalFileSystemStorage: no root directory (set STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT or rootPath)');
    const full = resolve(this.root, objectName);
    if (full !== this.root && !full.startsWith(this.root + sep)) throw new StorageRootEscapeError(objectName);
    return full;
  }

  private async metadataOf(full: string): Promise<StorageObjectMetadata> {
    const s = await stat(full);
    const rel = relative(this.root, full).split(sep).join('/');
    return { name: rel.split('/').pop() || rel, path: rel.includes('/') ? rel.slice(0, rel.lastIndexOf('/')) : '', fullPath: rel, size: s.size, contentType: 'application/octet-stream', lastModified: s.mtime, isDirectory: s.isDirectory() };
  }

  public async CreatePreAuthUploadUrl(_objectName: string): Promise<CreatePreAuthUploadUrlPayload> {
    throw new UnsupportedOperationError('CreatePreAuthUploadUrl', this.providerName);
  }
  public async CreatePreAuthDownloadUrl(objectName: string): Promise<string> {
    return pathToFileURL(this.pathOf(objectName)).href;
  }
  public async MoveObject(oldObjectName: string, newObjectName: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const to = this.pathOf(newObjectName);
    await mkdir(dirname(to), { recursive: true });
    await rename(this.pathOf(oldObjectName), to);
    return true;
  }
  public async DeleteObject(objectName: string): Promise<boolean> {
    await rm(this.pathOf(objectName), { force: true });
    return true;
  }
  public async ListObjects(prefix: string, _delimiter?: string): Promise<StorageListResult> {
    const dir = this.pathOf(prefix);
    if (!existsSync(dir)) return { objects: [], prefixes: [] };
    const entries = await readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
    const objects: StorageObjectMetadata[] = [];
    const prefixes: string[] = [];
    for (const e of entries.sort((a, b) => OrdinalCompare(a.name, b.name))) {   // stable, locale-independent listing order
      if (e.isDirectory()) prefixes.push(`${prefix.replace(/\/?$/, '/')}${e.name}/`);
      else objects.push(await this.metadataOf(join(dir, e.name)));
    }
    return { objects, prefixes };
  }
  public async CreateDirectory(directoryPath: string): Promise<boolean> {
    await mkdir(this.pathOf(directoryPath), { recursive: true });
    return true;
  }
  public async DeleteDirectory(directoryPath: string, recursive?: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
    await rm(this.pathOf(directoryPath), { recursive: recursive === true, force: true });
    return true;
  }
  public async GetObjectMetadata(params: GetObjectMetadataParams): Promise<StorageObjectMetadata> {
    return this.metadataOf(this.pathOf(params.fullPath || params.objectId || ''));
  }
  public async GetObject(params: GetObjectParams): Promise<Buffer> {
    return readFile(this.pathOf(params.fullPath || params.objectId || ''));
  }
  public async PutObject(objectName: string, data: Buffer, _contentType?: string, _metadata?: Record<string, string>): Promise<boolean> {
    const full = this.pathOf(objectName);
    await mkdir(dirname(full), { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(full, data);
    return true;
  }
  public async CopyObject(sourceObjectName: string, destinationObjectName: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const to = this.pathOf(destinationObjectName);
    await mkdir(dirname(to), { recursive: true });
    await copyFile(this.pathOf(sourceObjectName), to);
    return true;
  }
  public async ObjectExists(objectName: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return existsSync(this.pathOf(objectName));
  }
  public async DirectoryExists(directoryPath: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const full = this.pathOf(directoryPath);
    return existsSync(full) && (await stat(full)).isDirectory();
  }
  public async SearchFiles(_query: string): Promise<FileSearchResultSet> {
    throw new UnsupportedOperationError('SearchFiles', this.providerName);
  }
}
```

  module only adds the byte hash (coding standards §3: check for an existing utility before writing one):

```ts
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';

/** SHA-256 hashing of snapshot bytes and canonical-JSON strings (static member, coding standards §2). */
export class SnapshotHash {
  /** SHA-256 of bytes or a UTF-8 string, lower-case hex: every Training Snapshot file and content hash. */
  public static Sha256Hex(data: Uint8Array | string): string {
    return createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
  }
}
```

  `snapshot-serialization.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * @module snapshot/snapshot-serialization
 *
 * The three Training Snapshot files, as UTF-8 JSON Lines: matrix.jsonl (line 1: the header — format tag, every
 * column in row order, the label column, each feature column's source column and full ColumnEncoding, the optional
 * incumbent-score, reference-score and slice columns, the unit's DecisionSpec, and the legacy feature schema and
 * preprocessing recipe; then one JSON array per manifest row), manifest.jsonl (one SnapshotRowKey per row, same order:
 * matrix row i is manifest line i), provenance.jsonl (one {rowId, values} per row). Byte-identical for identical
 * content. The sidecar's `app/snapshot.py` parses exactly this format.
 */
import { z } from 'zod';
import { Canonicalize, NormalizeUUID } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { JsonParse, StoreSchemas, type JsonValue } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { ColumnEncoding, DecisionSpec, PreprocessingOp, RowProvenance, SnapshotFeatureColumn, SnapshotRowKey } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { SnapshotHash } from './snapshot-hash';

export const SNAPSHOT_MATRIX_FORMAT = 'ps-snapshot-matrix/v1';
/** The unit's incumbent heuristic evaluated per row, read by the trainer's `heuristic:<name>` baseline. */
export const INCUMBENT_SCORE_COLUMN = '__ps_incumbent_score';
/** Reserved for test fixtures that plant a reference score (the leakage audit's implausible-gain rule); the product never writes it. */
export const REFERENCE_SCORE_COLUMN = '__ps_reference_score';
/** `__ps_slice:<field>` holds the protocol's slice subgroup values as strings. */
export const SLICE_COLUMN_PREFIX = '__ps_slice:';

export type SnapshotCell = string | number | boolean | null;
export interface SnapshotFeatureColumnHeader {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly sourceColumn: string;
  readonly encoding: ColumnEncoding;
}
export interface SnapshotMatrixHeader {
  readonly format: typeof SNAPSHOT_MATRIX_FORMAT;
  readonly columns: readonly string[];
  readonly labelColumn: string;
  readonly featureColumns: readonly SnapshotFeatureColumnHeader[];
  readonly incumbentScoreColumn: typeof INCUMBENT_SCORE_COLUMN | null;
  readonly referenceScoreColumn: typeof REFERENCE_SCORE_COLUMN | null;
  readonly sliceColumns: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  readonly decision: DecisionSpec;
  /** Legacy shape read by `TrainOnSnapshot` while the legacy trainer path exists. */
  readonly featureSchema: readonly { readonly Name: string; readonly Kind: 'numeric' | 'categorical' }[];
  readonly preprocessing: readonly PreprocessingOp[];
}
export interface SnapshotContent {
  readonly Header: SnapshotMatrixHeader;
  readonly Rows: readonly (readonly SnapshotCell[])[];
  readonly Manifest: readonly SnapshotRowKey[];
  readonly Provenance: readonly RowProvenance[];
}
export interface SnapshotFileBytes { readonly Matrix: Uint8Array; readonly Manifest: Uint8Array; readonly Provenance: Uint8Array }

const encoder = new TextEncoder();
const decoder = new TextDecoder();

/**
 * The Training Snapshot file format: serialize, parse and fingerprint (static members on one owner, coding standards
 * §2).
 */
export class SnapshotFiles {
  /** JSON Lines bytes: one item per line, each line terminated by `\n`. */
  private static lines(items: readonly string[]): Uint8Array {
    return encoder.encode(items.map((l) => `${l}\n`).join(''));
  }

  public static SerializeSnapshotFiles(c: SnapshotContent): SnapshotFileBytes {
    if (c.Rows.length !== c.Manifest.length || c.Provenance.length !== c.Manifest.length) {
      throw new Error(`Snapshot rows (${c.Rows.length}), manifest (${c.Manifest.length}) and provenance (${c.Provenance.length}) must align`);
    }
    c.Rows.forEach((r, i) => {
      if (r.length !== c.Header.columns.length) throw new Error(`Snapshot row ${i} has ${r.length} cells; the header lists ${c.Header.columns.length} columns`);
    });
    return {
      Matrix: SnapshotFiles.lines([JSON.stringify(c.Header), ...c.Rows.map((r) => JSON.stringify(r))]),
      Manifest: SnapshotFiles.lines(c.Manifest.map((m) => JSON.stringify(m))),
      Provenance: SnapshotFiles.lines(c.Provenance.map((p) => JSON.stringify(p))),
    };
  }

  /**
   * The three files back to content. Every line is checked with its zod schema — a stored file is text
   * that a hash check proves unchanged, not well-formed — and a malformed line throws `SnapshotFileFormatError`
   * naming the file and the line.
   */
  public static ParseSnapshotFiles(matrix: Uint8Array, manifest: Uint8Array, provenance: Uint8Array): SnapshotContent {
    const [header, ...rows] = SnapshotFiles.jsonLines('matrix', matrix);
    if (header === undefined) throw new SnapshotFileFormatError('matrix', 1, ['the matrix file has no header line']);
    return {
      Header: SnapshotFiles.check('matrix', 1, snapshotMatrixHeaderSchema, header),
      Rows: rows.map((r, i) => SnapshotFiles.check('matrix', i + 2, snapshotRowSchema, r)),
      Manifest: SnapshotFiles.ParseManifestLines(manifest),
      Provenance: SnapshotFiles.jsonLines('provenance', provenance).map((v, i) => SnapshotFiles.check('provenance', i + 1, StoreSchemas.RowProvenance, v)),
    };
  }

  /** The manifest file's rows, each checked with `StoreSchemas.SnapshotRowKey` (also read alone by `SnapshotManifest`). */
  public static ParseManifestLines(manifest: Uint8Array): SnapshotRowKey[] {
    return SnapshotFiles.jsonLines('manifest', manifest).map((m, i) => SnapshotFiles.check('manifest', i + 1, StoreSchemas.SnapshotRowKey, m));
  }

  /** JSON Lines → parsed JSON values; a line that is not JSON throws `SnapshotFileFormatError`. */
  private static jsonLines(file: string, bytes: Uint8Array): JsonValue[] {
    return decoder.decode(bytes).split('\n').filter((l) => l.length > 0).map((line, i) => {
      const json = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(line, `${file} line ${i + 1}`);
      if (!json.Ok) throw new SnapshotFileFormatError(file, i + 1, json.Errors);
      return json.Value;
    });
  }

  /** One value checked by its zod schema; a mismatch throws `SnapshotFileFormatError` naming the file and line. */
  private static check<T>(file: string, line: number, schema: z.ZodType<T>, value: JsonValue): T {
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(value);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new SnapshotFileFormatError(file, line, parsed.error.issues.map((x) => `${x.path.join('.')}: ${x.message}`));
    return parsed.data;
  }

  public static ComputeFeatureSchemaHash(columns: readonly SnapshotFeatureColumn[]): string {
    return SnapshotHash.Sha256Hex(Canonicalize(columns.map((c) => ({ name: c.name, encoding: c.encoding, sourceColumn: c.sourceColumn }))));
  }

  /** SHA-256 over the matrix and manifest hashes, the schema hash and the unit/label/feature-spec/protocol versions (C2). */
  public static ComputeSnapshotContentHash(x: ContentHashInput): string {
    return SnapshotHash.Sha256Hex(Canonicalize({
      matrixSha256: x.MatrixSha256, rowManifestSha256: x.RowManifestSha256, featureSchemaHash: x.FeatureSchemaHash,
      predictionUnitId: NormalizeUUID(x.PredictionUnitID), labelVersion: x.LabelVersion, featureSpecVersion: x.FeatureSpecVersion,
      evaluationProtocolId: x.EvaluationProtocolID === null ? null : NormalizeUUID(x.EvaluationProtocolID), dataCutoff: x.DataCutoff,
    }));
  }
}


export interface ContentHashInput {
  readonly MatrixSha256: string;
  readonly RowManifestSha256: string;
  readonly FeatureSchemaHash: string;
  readonly PredictionUnitID: string;
  readonly LabelVersion: number;
  readonly FeatureSpecVersion: number;
  readonly EvaluationProtocolID: string | null;
  readonly DataCutoff: string;
}
```

  `SnapshotFiles.ParseSnapshotFiles` checks every line with a zod schema (program D-045, ruling PR3-R6) — never
  `JSON.parse(...) as T`: the files are written only by `SnapshotFiles.SerializeSnapshotFiles` and verified by SHA-256
  before parsing (M4.5), but a hash proves the bytes unchanged, not well-formed. Each schema is annotated with its
  TypeScript type, so `tsc` refuses one that does not fit. Create `Core/src/store-schemas.ts` (exported from Core's

```ts
/**
 * @module store-schemas
 * Zod schemas of the stores Predictive Studio writes and reads back: the snapshot manifest and provenance lines, the
 * stored class balance, and the decision spec, encodings and preprocessing the snapshot header carries. Each schema
 * is annotated with its TypeScript type, so the compiler refuses a schema that does not fit the type it checks.
 */
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { ClassBalanceEntry, ColumnEncoding, DatedSource, SnapshotRowKey, ValueProvenance } from './assembly-contract';
import type { DecisionSpec } from './prediction-unit';
import type { PreprocessingOp } from './sidecar-contract';

/** Every `DatedSource` kind; `satisfies` makes the compiler refuse a value that is not one. */
const SOURCE_KINDS = ['record-changes', 'immutable-field', 'feature-value', 'windowed-aggregate', 'series'] as const satisfies readonly DatedSource['kind'][];

/** One provenance line of `provenance.jsonl`. */
export interface RowProvenance { readonly rowId: string; readonly values: readonly ValueProvenance[] }

/** The store schemas (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class StoreSchemas {
  public static readonly SnapshotRowKey: z.ZodType<SnapshotRowKey> = z.object({
    rowId: z.string(),
    entityKey: z.string(),
    decisionDate: z.string(),
    groupKey: z.string().nullable(),
    period: z.string().nullable(),
    role: z.enum(['development', 'locked-holdout']),
  });

  public static readonly ValueProvenance: z.ZodType<ValueProvenance> = z.object({
    column: z.string(),
    source: z.enum(SOURCE_KINDS),
    sourceRef: z.string(),
    sourceVersion: z.string(),
    computedAt: z.string(),
  });

  public static readonly RowProvenance: z.ZodType<RowProvenance> = z.object({
    rowId: z.string(),
    values: z.array(StoreSchemas.ValueProvenance),
  });

  public static readonly ClassBalance: z.ZodType<ClassBalanceEntry[]> = z.array(
    z.object({ label: z.string(), rows: z.number().int().nonnegative() }),
  );

  public static readonly DecisionSpec: z.ZodType<DecisionSpec> = z.object({
    action: z.string(),
    actorRole: z.string(),
    capacityPerPeriod: z.number().nonnegative().nullable(),
    period: z.enum(['day', 'week', 'month', 'quarter', 'year']),
  });

  public static readonly ColumnEncoding: z.ZodType<ColumnEncoding> = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
    z.object({ kind: z.literal('numeric'), nonNumericValue: z.literal('fail') }),
    z.object({ kind: z.literal('categorical'), cardinalityCap: z.number().int().positive(), method: z.enum(['onehot', 'hashed', 'target-in-fold']) }),
    z.object({ kind: z.literal('date-parts'), parts: z.array(z.enum(['year', 'month', 'dow', 'days-since-decision'])) }),
    z.object({ kind: z.literal('boolean') }),
    z.object({ kind: z.literal('identifier'), policy: z.literal('exclude') }),
  ]);

  public static readonly PreprocessingOp: z.ZodType<PreprocessingOp> = z.object({
    op: z.string(),
    col: z.string().optional(),
    cols: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
    strategy: z.enum(['mean', 'median', 'mode', 'constant']).optional(),
    fillValue: z.union([z.string(), z.number()]).optional(),
    bins: z.number().int().positive().optional(),
    indicator: z.boolean().optional(),
  });
}
```

  `Core/src/incumbent-heuristic.ts` — the unit's `IncumbentHeuristic.scoreExpression` is evaluated by a small grammar,
  never as SQL or `eval` (D3-05): `<column>` (the column's value is the score) or comparisons `<column> <op> <number>`
  (`>=`, `>`, `<=`, `<`, `==`, `!=`) joined by `and`/`or` (`and` binds tighter; the result is 1 or 0):

```ts
/**
 * @module incumbent-heuristic
 *
 * Today's rule of thumb (`IncumbentHeuristic`, C1) as a per-row score over assembled columns, so the trainer can
 * score it on the same holdout rows as a named comparator and scoring can compute the same column.
 */
import { JsonParse, type ParseResult } from './json-value';

export interface IncumbentComparison { readonly Column: string; readonly Op: '>=' | '>' | '<=' | '<' | '==' | '!='; readonly Value: number }
export type IncumbentExpression =
  | { readonly Kind: 'column'; readonly Column: string }
  /** OR of AND-groups of comparisons. */
  | { readonly Kind: 'rule'; readonly Any: readonly (readonly IncumbentComparison[])[] };

const TOKEN = /\s*(>=|<=|==|!=|>|<|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/y;
const IDENT = /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/;
const NUMBER = /^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/;
const OPS: readonly IncumbentComparison['Op'][] = ['>=', '>', '<=', '<', '==', '!='];

/**
 * The incumbent-heuristic grammar: parse, list referenced columns, evaluate (static members on one owner, coding
 * standards §2).
 */
export class IncumbentExpressions {
  private static isOp(t: string): t is IncumbentComparison['Op'] {
    return OPS.some((o) => o === t);
  }

  private static tokenize(text: string): string[] | null {
    const out: string[] = [];
    let i = 0;
    while (text.slice(i).trim().length > 0) {
      TOKEN.lastIndex = i;
      const m = TOKEN.exec(text);
      if (m === null || m[1] === undefined) return null;
      out.push(m[1]);
      i = TOKEN.lastIndex;
    }
    return out;
  }

  public static ParseIncumbentExpression(text: string): ParseResult<IncumbentExpression> {
    const fail = JsonParse.ParseFail<IncumbentExpression>(`IncumbentHeuristic scoreExpression "${text}" must be <column>, or <column> <op> <number> comparisons joined by and/or`);
    const tokens = IncumbentExpressions.tokenize(text);
    if (tokens === null || tokens.length === 0) return fail;
    const only = tokens[0];
    if (tokens.length === 1 && only !== undefined && IDENT.test(only) && only !== 'and' && only !== 'or') return JsonParse.ParseOk({ Kind: 'column', Column: only });
    const any: IncumbentComparison[][] = [];
    let group: IncumbentComparison[] = [];
    let k = 0;
    for (;;) {
      const column = tokens[k];
      const op = tokens[k + 1];
      const num = tokens[k + 2];
      if (column === undefined || !IDENT.test(column) || column === 'and' || column === 'or' || op === undefined || !IncumbentExpressions.isOp(op) || num === undefined || !NUMBER.test(num)) return fail;
      group.push({ Column: column, Op: op, Value: Number(num) });
      k += 3;
      if (k === tokens.length) break;
      const joiner = tokens[k];
      if (joiner === 'or') {
        any.push(group);
        group = [];
      } else if (joiner !== 'and') {
        return fail;
      }
      k += 1;
    }
    any.push(group);
    return JsonParse.ParseOk({ Kind: 'rule', Any: any });
  }

  public static IncumbentExpressionColumns(e: IncumbentExpression): readonly string[] {
    return e.Kind === 'column' ? [e.Column] : [...new Set(e.Any.flatMap((g) => g.map((c) => c.Column)))];
  }

  private static holds(v: number, op: IncumbentComparison['Op'], x: number): boolean {
    switch (op) {
      case '>=': return v >= x;
      case '>': return v > x;
      case '<=': return v <= x;
      case '<': return v < x;
      case '==': return v === x;
      case '!=': return v !== x;
    }
  }

  /** The row's heuristic score; null when any referenced value is missing (the trainer imputes in-fold, never 0). */
  public static EvaluateIncumbentExpression(e: IncumbentExpression, value: (column: string) => number | null): number | null {
    if (e.Kind === 'column') return value(e.Column);
    let score = 0;
    for (const group of e.Any) {
      let all = true;
      for (const c of group) {
        const v = value(c.Column);
        if (v === null) return null;
        if (!IncumbentExpressions.holds(v, c.Op, c.Value)) all = false;
      }
      if (all) score = 1;
    }
    return score;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { IncumbentExpressions } from '../incumbent-heuristic';

describe('incumbent heuristic expressions', () => {
  it('scores the C1 rule "renewed last year" as 1/0 and null when the value is missing', () => {
    const r = IncumbentExpressions.ParseIncumbentExpression('prior_dues_periods_400d >= 2');
    expect(r.Ok).toBe(true);
    if (!r.Ok) return;
    const row = (v: number | null) => (c: string) => (c === 'prior_dues_periods_400d' ? v : null);
    expect([IncumbentExpressions.EvaluateIncumbentExpression(r.Value, row(3)), IncumbentExpressions.EvaluateIncumbentExpression(r.Value, row(1)), IncumbentExpressions.EvaluateIncumbentExpression(r.Value, row(null))]).toEqual([1, 0, null]);
    expect(IncumbentExpressions.IncumbentExpressionColumns(r.Value)).toEqual(['prior_dues_periods_400d']);
  });
  it('binds and tighter than or, and accepts a bare column as the score', () => {
    const r = IncumbentExpressions.ParseIncumbentExpression('a > 1 and b < 2 or c == 0');
    if (!r.Ok) throw new Error(r.Errors.join('; '));
    expect(IncumbentExpressions.EvaluateIncumbentExpression(r.Value, (c) => ({ a: 0, b: 5, c: 0 })[c] ?? null)).toBe(1);
    expect(IncumbentExpressions.EvaluateIncumbentExpression(r.Value, (c) => ({ a: 2, b: 5, c: 3 })[c] ?? null)).toBe(0);
    const bare = IncumbentExpressions.ParseIncumbentExpression('LastYearScore');
    expect(bare.Ok && bare.Value).toEqual({ Kind: 'column', Column: 'LastYearScore' });
  });
  it('refuses anything outside the grammar', () => {
    expect(IncumbentExpressions.ParseIncumbentExpression('DROP TABLE x').Ok).toBe(false);
    expect(IncumbentExpressions.ParseIncumbentExpression('a >= ').Ok).toBe(false);
    expect(IncumbentExpressions.ParseIncumbentExpression('a >= 1 xor b < 2').Ok).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * @module snapshot/snapshot-file-store
 *
 * Write-once snapshot files through FileStorageBase (design rule 1: MJ is the system of record; files are MJ: Files).
 * The provider is `PS_SNAPSHOT_STORAGE_PROVIDER` (a `MJ: File Storage Providers` Name, default "Local File System");
 * its driver is resolved by ServerDriverKey and initialised from its environment configuration.
 */
import { LogError, RunView, type IMetadataProvider, type UserInfo } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { MJFileEntity, MJFileStorageProviderEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { ResolveStorageDriver, type FileStorageBase } from '@memberjunction/storage';
import { SnapshotHash } from './snapshot-hash';
import type { IEntityFactory } from '../training/types';

export interface StoredSnapshotFile {
  readonly FileID: string;
  readonly ProviderID: string;
  readonly ProviderKey: string;
  readonly Sha256: string;
  readonly SizeBytes: number;
}

export interface ISnapshotFileStore {
  /** Upload once (an existing key is refused) and record the MJ: Files row. */
  Put(objectKey: string, name: string, bytes: Uint8Array, contentType: string): Promise<StoredSnapshotFile>;
  Get(fileId: string): Promise<Uint8Array>;
  /** The provider the files are stored with (MJ: File Storage Providers.ID). */
  ProviderID(): Promise<string>;
}

export class InMemorySnapshotFileStore implements ISnapshotFileStore {
  public readonly Saved = new Map<string, { readonly Key: string; readonly Bytes: Uint8Array }>();
  constructor(private readonly providerId: string) {}
  public async Put(objectKey: string, _name: string, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<StoredSnapshotFile> {
    if ([...this.Saved.values()].some((f) => f.Key === objectKey)) throw new Error(`snapshot object ${objectKey} already exists (write-once)`);
    const id = `mem-snapshot-file-${this.Saved.size + 1}`;
    this.Saved.set(id, { Key: objectKey, Bytes: bytes });
    return { FileID: id, ProviderID: this.providerId, ProviderKey: objectKey, Sha256: SnapshotHash.Sha256Hex(bytes), SizeBytes: bytes.byteLength };
  }
  public async Get(fileId: string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
    const f = this.Saved.get(fileId);
    if (!f) throw new Error(`snapshot file ${fileId} not found`);
    return f.Bytes;
  }
  public async ProviderID(): Promise<string> { return this.providerId; }
}

export class StorageProviderSnapshotFileStore implements ISnapshotFileStore {
  private driverPromise: Promise<{ readonly Driver: FileStorageBase; readonly Provider: MJFileStorageProviderEntity }> | null = null;
  constructor(
    private readonly entityFactory: IEntityFactory,
    private readonly provider: IMetadataProvider,
    private readonly contextUser: UserInfo | undefined,
    // An empty PS_SNAPSHOT_STORAGE_PROVIDER means "not set" as well, hence `||`.
    private readonly providerName: string = process.env.PS_SNAPSHOT_STORAGE_PROVIDER || 'Local File System',
  ) {}

  /** The provider row and its initialised driver, resolved once per store (a lazy promise, so concurrent Puts share it). */
  private driver(): Promise<{ readonly Driver: FileStorageBase; readonly Provider: MJFileStorageProviderEntity }> {
    this.driverPromise ||= this.resolveDriver();
    return this.driverPromise;
  }

  private async resolveDriver(): Promise<{ readonly Driver: FileStorageBase; readonly Provider: MJFileStorageProviderEntity }> {
    // entity_object: ResolveStorageDriver takes the provider entity.
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(this.provider).RunView<MJFileStorageProviderEntity>(
      { EntityName: 'MJ: File Storage Providers', ExtraFilter: `Name='${EscapeSQLString(this.providerName)}' AND IsActive=1`, ResultType: 'entity_object' },
      this.contextUser,
    );
    const row = r.Success ? r.Results[0] : undefined;
    if (!row) throw new Error(`Training snapshots: no active File Storage Provider named "${this.providerName}" (PS_SNAPSHOT_STORAGE_PROVIDER)`);
    const driver = ResolveStorageDriver(row);
    await driver.initialize();
    if (!driver.IsConfigured) throw new Error(`Training snapshots: storage provider "${this.providerName}" is not configured on this server`);
    return { Driver: driver, Provider: row };
  }

  /** The storage key of a snapshot's `MJ: Files` row (read-only: `'simple'`, one field). */
  private async providerKeyOf(fileId: string): Promise<string> {
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(this.provider).RunView<Pick<MJFileEntity, 'ProviderKey'>>(
      { EntityName: 'MJ: Files', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(fileId)}'`, Fields: ['ProviderKey'], ResultType: 'simple' },
      this.contextUser,
    );
    const key = r.Success ? r.Results[0]?.ProviderKey : undefined;
    if (!key) throw new Error(`Training snapshots: file ${fileId} has no storage key`);
    return key;
  }

  public async ProviderID(): Promise<string> { return (await this.driver()).Provider.ID; }

  public async Put(objectKey: string, name: string, bytes: Uint8Array, contentType: string): Promise<StoredSnapshotFile> {
    const { Driver, Provider } = await this.driver();
    if (await Driver.ObjectExists(objectKey)) throw new Error(`Training snapshots: ${objectKey} already exists; snapshot files are write-once`);
    if (!(await Driver.PutObject(objectKey, Buffer.from(bytes), contentType))) throw new Error(`Training snapshots: storage refused ${objectKey}`);
    const file = await this.entityFactory.getEntityObject<MJFileEntity>('MJ: Files', this.contextUser);
    file.Name = name;
    file.ContentType = contentType;
    file.ProviderID = Provider.ID;
    file.ProviderKey = objectKey;
    file.Status = 'Uploaded';
    file.Description = `Predictive Studio training snapshot file (${bytes.byteLength} bytes, sha256 ${SnapshotHash.Sha256Hex(bytes)})`;
    if (!(await file.Save())) {
      // Undo the upload so a retry can write the same key; a failed undo is logged, never silent.
      if (!(await Driver.DeleteObject(objectKey))) LogError(`Training snapshots: could not remove ${objectKey} after its MJ: Files row failed to save`);
      throw new Error(`Training snapshots: saving the MJ: Files row for ${objectKey} failed: ${file.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
    }
    return { FileID: file.ID, ProviderID: Provider.ID, ProviderKey: objectKey, Sha256: SnapshotHash.Sha256Hex(bytes), SizeBytes: bytes.byteLength };
  }

  public async Get(fileId: string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
    const [{ Driver }, key] = await Promise.all([this.driver(), this.providerKeyOf(fileId)]);
    return new Uint8Array(await Driver.GetObject({ fullPath: key }));
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Assigns each assembled row its manifest role before the snapshot is written (roles are part of the fingerprint).
 * The legacy carver takes the trailing fraction in decision-date order (unit rows; legacy pipelines keep the seeded,
 * label-stratified carve until they are migrated);
 * DateCarvedCarver and RollingOriginCarver carve from the Evaluation Protocol for unit pipelines.
 */
import type { SnapshotRowRole } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { AssembledRow } from '../feature-assembly/as-of/as-of-assembler';
import type { UnitRow } from '../prediction-unit/unit-row-reader';

export interface IHoldoutCarver {
  AssignRoles(rows: readonly AssembledRow[], unitRows: ReadonlyMap<string, UnitRow>): ReadonlyMap<string, SnapshotRowRole>;
}

export class TrailingFractionCarver implements IHoldoutCarver {
  constructor(private readonly fraction: number) {}
  public AssignRoles(rows: readonly AssembledRow[]): ReadonlyMap<string, SnapshotRowRole> {
    const f = Number.isFinite(this.fraction) && this.fraction > 0 ? Math.min(this.fraction, 1) : 0;
    const n = rows.length;
    const holdout = n > 1 ? Math.min(Math.max(Math.floor(n * f), f > 0 ? 1 : 0), n - 1) : 0;
    return new Map(rows.map((r, i) => [r.RowId, i >= n - holdout ? 'locked-holdout' : 'development']));
  }
}
```
