  `snapshot-builder.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * @module snapshot/snapshot-builder
 *
 * Builds the immutable Training Snapshot (C2): content (matrix + manifest + per-value provenance), the three files,
 * the fingerprint, and the `MJ: Training Snapshots` row with every count the gates read. Identical content reuses the
 * existing snapshot (unique ContentHash).
 */
import type { UserInfo } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { OrdinalCompare } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { MJTrainingSnapshotEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import {
  IncumbentExpressions, TaskTypeRules, LABEL_COLUMN,
  type ColumnEncoding, type FeatureColumnSpec, type PredictionUnitSpec, type SnapshotFeatureColumn, type SnapshotRowKey, type SnapshotRowRole,
} from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { TrainingRefusedError } from '../training/training-refusal';
import type { AsOfAssemblyResult } from '../feature-assembly/as-of/as-of-assembler';
import { AsOfFeatureAssembler } from '../feature-assembly/as-of/as-of-assembler';
import type { UnitRowReadResult } from '../prediction-unit/unit-row-reader';
import { UtcDay } from '../prediction-unit/utc-day';
import type { IEntityFactory } from '../training/types';
import { SnapshotHash } from './snapshot-hash';
import { CodeVersionInfo } from './code-version';
import {
  SnapshotFiles, INCUMBENT_SCORE_COLUMN, SLICE_COLUMN_PREFIX,
  SNAPSHOT_MATRIX_FORMAT, type SnapshotCell, type SnapshotContent, type SnapshotFeatureColumnHeader, type SnapshotFileBytes,
} from './snapshot-serialization';
import type { ISnapshotFileStore, StoredSnapshotFile } from './snapshot-file-store';

export interface SnapshotBuildInput {
  readonly PipelineID: string;
  readonly FeatureSpecVersion: number;
  readonly Unit: PredictionUnitSpec;
  readonly UnitRead: Extract<UnitRowReadResult, { Status: 'read' }>;
  readonly Features: readonly FeatureColumnSpec[];
  readonly Assembled: Extract<AsOfAssemblyResult, { Status: 'assembled' }>;
  readonly Roles: ReadonlyMap<string, SnapshotRowRole>;
  readonly EvaluationProtocolID: string | null;
  /** Write the incumbent-score column (the bound protocol declares an `incumbent-heuristic` baseline). */
  readonly IncumbentScore: boolean;
  /** The protocol's slice subgroup fields, written as `__ps_slice:<field>` columns (empty when the protocol declares none). */
  readonly SliceFields: readonly string[];
  readonly Files: ISnapshotFileStore;
  readonly EntityFactory: IEntityFactory;
  readonly ContextUser?: UserInfo;
  readonly ExistingByContentHash: (contentHash: string) => Promise<MJTrainingSnapshotEntity | null>;
}

export interface BuiltSnapshot { readonly Entity: MJTrainingSnapshotEntity; readonly Content: SnapshotContent; readonly Reused: boolean }

export class TrainingSnapshotBuilder {
  /** Content → files → fingerprint; reuses an existing snapshot with the same content hash, else writes files and row. */
  public async Build(input: SnapshotBuildInput): Promise<BuiltSnapshot> {
    const content = this.BuildContent(input);
    const files = SnapshotFiles.SerializeSnapshotFiles(content);
    const schemaColumns = input.Assembled.Columns.map((c) => ({ name: c.Name, encoding: c.Encoding, sourceColumn: c.SourceColumn }));
    const featureSchemaHash = SnapshotFiles.ComputeFeatureSchemaHash(schemaColumns);
    const contentHash = SnapshotFiles.ComputeSnapshotContentHash({
      MatrixSha256: SnapshotHash.Sha256Hex(files.Matrix), RowManifestSha256: SnapshotHash.Sha256Hex(files.Manifest), FeatureSchemaHash: featureSchemaHash,
      PredictionUnitID: input.Unit.id, LabelVersion: input.Unit.label.labelVersion, FeatureSpecVersion: input.FeatureSpecVersion,
      EvaluationProtocolID: input.EvaluationProtocolID, DataCutoff: input.UnitRead.Counts.dataCutoff,
    });
    const existing = await input.ExistingByContentHash(contentHash);
    if (existing) return { Entity: existing, Content: content, Reused: true };
    const stored = await this.WriteFiles(input.Files, contentHash, files);
    const entity = await this.SaveSnapshotRow(input, content, stored, { ContentHash: contentHash, FeatureSchemaHash: featureSchemaHash, SchemaColumns: schemaColumns });
    return { Entity: entity, Content: content, Reused: false };
  }

  /** The snapshot content: header, matrix rows (+ incumbent/slice cells), manifest in matrix order, provenance. */
  protected BuildContent(input: SnapshotBuildInput): SnapshotContent {
    const unitRows = new Map(input.UnitRead.Rows.map((r) => [r.RowId, r]));
    const labels = new Map(input.UnitRead.Rows.map((r) => [r.RowId, r.Label]));
    const shaped = AsOfFeatureAssembler.ToFeatureAssemblyResult(input.Assembled, labels, LABEL_COLUMN);
    const manifest: SnapshotRowKey[] = input.Assembled.Rows.map((a) => {
      const u = unitRows.get(a.RowId);
      if (!u) throw new Error(`Snapshot: assembled row ${a.RowId} is not a unit row`);
      return { rowId: u.RowId, entityKey: u.EntityKey, decisionDate: UtcDay.UtcDayIso(u.DecisionDate), groupKey: u.GroupKey, period: u.Period ? UtcDay.UtcDayIso(u.Period) : null, role: input.Roles.get(a.RowId) || 'development' };
    });
    const extra = this.extraColumns(input);
    return {
      Header: {
        format: SNAPSHOT_MATRIX_FORMAT,
        columns: [...shaped.matrix.columns, ...extra.Names],
        labelColumn: LABEL_COLUMN,
        featureColumns: this.featureColumns(input),
        incumbentScoreColumn: input.IncumbentScore ? INCUMBENT_SCORE_COLUMN : null,
        referenceScoreColumn: null,
        sliceColumns: Object.fromEntries(input.SliceFields.map((f) => [f, `${SLICE_COLUMN_PREFIX}${f}`])),
        decision: input.Unit.decision,
        featureSchema: shaped.featureSchema,
        preprocessing: shaped.preprocessing,
      },
      Rows: shaped.matrix.rows.map((r, i) => [...r, ...extra.Cells(i)]),
      Manifest: manifest,
      Provenance: input.Assembled.Rows.map((a) => ({ rowId: a.RowId, values: a.Provenance })),
    };
  }

  /** The three write-once files, uploaded in parallel (independent objects) under the content-hash prefix. */
  protected async WriteFiles(store: ISnapshotFileStore, contentHash: string, files: SnapshotFileBytes): Promise<StoredSnapshotFiles> {
    const prefix = `predictive-studio/training-snapshots/${contentHash}`;
    const short = contentHash.slice(0, 12);
    const [matrix, manifest, provenance] = await Promise.all([
      store.Put(`${prefix}/matrix.jsonl`, `snapshot-${short}-matrix.jsonl`, files.Matrix, 'application/x-ndjson'),
      store.Put(`${prefix}/manifest.jsonl`, `snapshot-${short}-manifest.jsonl`, files.Manifest, 'application/x-ndjson'),
      store.Put(`${prefix}/provenance.jsonl`, `snapshot-${short}-provenance.jsonl`, files.Provenance, 'application/x-ndjson'),
    ]);
    return { Matrix: matrix, Manifest: manifest, Provenance: provenance };
  }

  /** The `MJ: Training Snapshots` row with every count the gates read; a failed Save throws with CompleteMessage. */
  protected async SaveSnapshotRow(input: SnapshotBuildInput, content: SnapshotContent, stored: StoredSnapshotFiles, hashes: SnapshotHashes): Promise<MJTrainingSnapshotEntity> {
    const s = await input.EntityFactory.getEntityObject<MJTrainingSnapshotEntity>('MJ: Training Snapshots', input.ContextUser);
    s.ContentHash = hashes.ContentHash;
    s.PipelineID = input.PipelineID;
    s.PredictionUnitID = input.Unit.id;
    s.LabelVersion = input.Unit.label.labelVersion;
    s.FeatureSpecVersion = input.FeatureSpecVersion;
    s.EvaluationProtocolID = input.EvaluationProtocolID;
    s.StorageProviderID = await input.Files.ProviderID();
    s.MatrixFileID = stored.Matrix.FileID; s.MatrixSha256 = stored.Matrix.Sha256; s.MatrixSizeBytes = stored.Matrix.SizeBytes;
    s.RowManifestFileID = stored.Manifest.FileID; s.RowManifestSha256 = stored.Manifest.Sha256; s.RowManifestSizeBytes = stored.Manifest.SizeBytes;
    s.ProvenanceFileID = stored.Provenance.FileID; s.ProvenanceSha256 = stored.Provenance.Sha256; s.ProvenanceSizeBytes = stored.Provenance.SizeBytes;
    s.ManifestRowCount = content.Manifest.length;
    s.HoldoutRowCount = content.Manifest.filter((m) => m.role === 'locked-holdout').length;
    s.FeatureSpec = JSON.stringify(input.Features);
    s.FeatureSchema = JSON.stringify(hashes.SchemaColumns);
    s.FeatureSchemaHash = hashes.FeatureSchemaHash;
    s.ColumnProvenance = JSON.stringify(input.Assembled.ColumnProvenance);
    s.PinnedFeatureVersions = JSON.stringify(input.Features.flatMap((f) => (f.source.kind === 'feature-value' && f.source.pin ? [f.source.pin] : [])));
    s.RowsRead = input.UnitRead.Counts.rowsRead;
    s.ReadComplete = true;
    s.CensoredRowsExcluded = input.UnitRead.Counts.censoredRowsExcluded;
    s.LabelKnownRowsExcluded = input.UnitRead.Counts.labelKnownRowsExcluded;
    s.EmptyLabelRowsExcluded = input.UnitRead.Counts.emptyLabelRowsExcluded;
    s.UncoveredHistoryRowsExcluded = JSON.stringify(input.Assembled.UncoveredRowsExcluded);
    s.DuplicateRowsRemoved = input.UnitRead.Counts.duplicateRowsRemoved;
    s.ClassBalance = TaskTypeRules.IsClassificationTask(input.Unit.label.outcome) ? JSON.stringify(TrainingSnapshotBuilder.classBalance(input.UnitRead.Rows.filter((r) => input.Roles.has(r.RowId)).map((r) => String(r.Label)))) : null;
    s.DataCutoff = new Date(`${input.UnitRead.Counts.dataCutoff}T00:00:00Z`);
    s.AssemblyCodeVersion = CodeVersionInfo.AssemblyCodeVersion();
    if (!(await s.Save())) throw new Error(`Saving the Training Snapshot failed: ${s.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
    return s;
  }

  /** Each matrix feature column with its source column and the full encoding of the feature it came from. */
  private featureColumns(input: SnapshotBuildInput): SnapshotFeatureColumnHeader[] {
    const byFeature = new Map(input.Features.map((f) => [f.name, f.encoding]));
    return input.Assembled.Columns.map((c) => {
      const encoding: ColumnEncoding | undefined = byFeature.get(c.FeatureName);
      if (encoding === undefined) throw new Error(`Snapshot: assembled column ${c.Name} has no feature spec ${c.FeatureName}`);
      return { name: c.Name, sourceColumn: c.SourceColumn, encoding };
    });
  }

  /** The incumbent-score and slice columns: names and the cells of assembled row i. */
  private extraColumns(input: SnapshotBuildInput): { readonly Names: readonly string[]; readonly Cells: (i: number) => SnapshotCell[] } {
    const position = new Map(input.Assembled.Columns.map((c, k) => [c.Name, k]));
    const columns = [
      ...(input.IncumbentScore ? [this.incumbentColumn(input, position)] : []),
      ...input.SliceFields.map((field) => this.sliceColumn(input, position, field)),
    ];
    return { Names: columns.map((c) => c.Name), Cells: (i) => columns.map((c) => c.Cell(i)) };
  }

  /** `__ps_incumbent_score`: the unit's rule evaluated per row; a rule naming an unassembled column is refused. */
  private incumbentColumn(input: SnapshotBuildInput, position: ReadonlyMap<string, number>): ExtraColumn {
    const rule = input.Unit.incumbent;
    if (rule.kind !== 'rule') return TrainingSnapshotBuilder.refuseColumn(input, 'IncumbentHeuristic');
    const parsed = IncumbentExpressions.ParseIncumbentExpression(rule.scoreExpression);
    if (!parsed.Ok) return TrainingSnapshotBuilder.refuseColumn(input, `IncumbentHeuristic.scoreExpression: ${parsed.Errors.join('; ')}`);
    for (const column of IncumbentExpressions.IncumbentExpressionColumns(parsed.Value)) if (!position.has(column)) TrainingSnapshotBuilder.refuseColumn(input, column);
    const numberAt = (i: number, column: string): number | null => {
      const k = position.get(column);
      const v = k === undefined ? null : input.Assembled.Rows[i]?.Values[k];
      return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
    };
    return { Name: INCUMBENT_SCORE_COLUMN, Cell: (i) => IncumbentExpressions.EvaluateIncumbentExpression(parsed.Value, (column) => numberAt(i, column)) };
  }

  /** `__ps_slice:<field>`: the field's value as a string (an assembled column, else the unit row's own field). */
  private sliceColumn(input: SnapshotBuildInput, position: ReadonlyMap<string, number>, field: string): ExtraColumn {
    const unitRows = new Map(input.UnitRead.Rows.map((r) => [r.RowId, r]));
    const k = position.get(field);
    return {
      Name: `${SLICE_COLUMN_PREFIX}${field}`,
      Cell: (i) => {
        const row = input.Assembled.Rows[i];
        const raw = k !== undefined ? row?.Values[k] : row ? unitRows.get(row.RowId)?.Source[field] : undefined;
        if (k === undefined && row !== undefined && !(field in (unitRows.get(row.RowId)?.Source || {}))) TrainingSnapshotBuilder.refuseColumn(input, field);
        if (raw === null || raw === undefined || raw === '') return '(missing)';
        return raw instanceof Date ? raw.toISOString().slice(0, 10) : String(raw);
      },
    };
  }

  private static refuseColumn(input: SnapshotBuildInput, field: string): never {
    throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'assembly', reason: { kind: 'unresolved-column', entity: input.Unit.name, field } });
  }

  private static classBalance(labels: readonly string[]): { label: string; rows: number }[] {
    const m = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const l of labels) m.set(l, (m.get(l) || 0) + 1);
    return [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => OrdinalCompare(a[0], b[0])).map(([label, rows]) => ({ label, rows }));
  }
}

interface ExtraColumn { readonly Name: string; readonly Cell: (i: number) => SnapshotCell }
interface StoredSnapshotFiles { readonly Matrix: StoredSnapshotFile; readonly Manifest: StoredSnapshotFile; readonly Provenance: StoredSnapshotFile }
interface SnapshotHashes { readonly ContentHash: string; readonly FeatureSchemaHash: string; readonly SchemaColumns: readonly SnapshotFeatureColumn[] }
```

```ts
/**
 * The one way a unit run calls the legacy trainer: rows split by manifest role, never re-carved; only the feature
 * columns of `featureSchema` and the label are sent (the incumbent-score and slice columns are the trainer's).
 * Unit pipelines train through the `/trainer` path instead; this path is for legacy pipelines only.
 */
public static async TrainOnSnapshot(content: SnapshotContent, request: LegacyRequestConfig, sidecar: ISidecarTrainer): Promise<TrainResponse> {
  const columns = [...content.Header.featureSchema.map((f) => f.Name), content.Header.labelColumn];
  const at = columns.map((c) => content.Header.columns.indexOf(c));
  if (at.some((k) => k < 0)) throw new Error('Snapshot header lists a feature-schema column that is not a matrix column');
  const dev: SnapshotCell[][] = [];
  const holdout: SnapshotCell[][] = [];
  // `??`: 0, '' and false are real cells; only an absent cell becomes null.
  content.Rows.forEach((row, i) => (content.Manifest[i].role === 'locked-holdout' ? holdout : dev).push(at.map((k) => row[k] ?? null)));
  return sidecar.train(
    { algorithm: request.algorithm, problem_type: request.problemType, hyperparameters: request.hyperparameters, validation: request.validation,
      feature_schema: content.Header.featureSchema.map((f) => ({ Name: f.Name, Kind: f.Kind })), preprocessing: [...content.Header.preprocessing],
      target: content.Header.labelColumn, data: { columns, rows: dev } },
    { columns, rows: holdout },
  );
}
```

```ts
/** A stored snapshot file whose bytes no longer match the SHA-256 on its snapshot row. */
export class SnapshotIntegrityError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly File: 'matrix' | 'manifest' | 'provenance', public readonly Expected: string, public readonly Actual: string) {
    super(`Snapshot ${File} file sha256 mismatch: stored ${Expected}, read ${Actual}`);
    this.name = 'SnapshotIntegrityError';
  }
}

export class SnapshotRetrainer {
  /** Re-runs a completed unit run from its snapshot files and logged request; reproduced when every holdout metric matches. */
  public async Retrain(trainingRunId: string, deps: TrainingDeps, tolerance = 1e-9): Promise<RetrainComparison> {
    const run = await this.load<MJMLTrainingRunEntity>('MJ: ML Training Runs', trainingRunId, deps);
    if (!run.TrainingSnapshotID) throw new Error(`Run ${trainingRunId} has no Training Snapshot`);
    const results = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults(run.ValidationResults);
    if (!results.Ok || results.Value.status !== 'completed' || !results.Value.legacy || !results.Value.legacyRequest) {
      throw new Error(`Run ${trainingRunId} has no completed v2 results with a logged request`);
    }
    const snapshot = await this.load<MJTrainingSnapshotEntity>('MJ: Training Snapshots', run.TrainingSnapshotID, deps);
    const files = deps.snapshotFiles || (deps.provider ? new StorageProviderSnapshotFileStore(deps.entityFactory, deps.provider, deps.contextUser) : null);
    if (!files) throw new Error('SnapshotRetrainer: a metadata provider or a snapshot file store is required');
    const content = await this.ReadVerifiedContent(snapshot, files);
    const recomputed = SnapshotFiles.ComputeSnapshotContentHash({
      MatrixSha256: snapshot.MatrixSha256, RowManifestSha256: snapshot.RowManifestSha256, FeatureSchemaHash: snapshot.FeatureSchemaHash,
      PredictionUnitID: snapshot.PredictionUnitID, LabelVersion: snapshot.LabelVersion, FeatureSpecVersion: snapshot.FeatureSpecVersion,
      EvaluationProtocolID: snapshot.EvaluationProtocolID, DataCutoff: snapshot.DataCutoff.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    });
    const response = await SnapshotRetrainer.TrainOnSnapshot(content, results.Value.legacyRequest, deps.sidecar);
    const original = results.Value.legacy.holdoutMetrics || {};
    const retrained = response.holdout_metrics || {};
    const diff = SnapshotRetrainer.MaxAbsDiff(original, retrained);
    return {
      TrainingRunID: run.ID, TrainingSnapshotID: snapshot.ID, FilesVerified: true, ContentHashVerified: recomputed === snapshot.ContentHash,
      Original: original, Retrained: retrained, MaxAbsDiff: diff.Value,
      Reproduced: Number.isFinite(diff.Value) && diff.Value <= tolerance && recomputed === snapshot.ContentHash && diff.Keys > 0,
    };
  }

  /** Reads the three files in parallel and refuses any whose SHA-256 differs from the snapshot row (`SnapshotIntegrityError`). */
  protected async ReadVerifiedContent(snapshot: MJTrainingSnapshotEntity, files: ISnapshotFileStore): Promise<SnapshotContent> {
    const [matrix, manifest, provenance] = await Promise.all([files.Get(snapshot.MatrixFileID), files.Get(snapshot.RowManifestFileID), files.Get(snapshot.ProvenanceFileID)]);
    for (const [name, bytes, expected] of [['matrix', matrix, snapshot.MatrixSha256], ['manifest', manifest, snapshot.RowManifestSha256], ['provenance', provenance, snapshot.ProvenanceSha256]] as const) {
      const actual = SnapshotHash.Sha256Hex(bytes);
      if (actual !== expected) throw new SnapshotIntegrityError(name, expected, actual);
    }
    return SnapshotFiles.ParseSnapshotFiles(matrix, manifest, provenance);
  }

  /**
   * The largest |original − retrained| over every metric key. `??`: a metric of 0 is a real value; a key present on one
   * side only yields NaN, so the result is not finite and the retrain is not reproduced (intended).
   */
  public static MaxAbsDiff(original: Readonly<Record<string, number>>, retrained: Readonly<Record<string, number>>): { readonly Value: number; readonly Keys: number } {
    const keys = [...new Set([...Object.keys(original), ...Object.keys(retrained)])];
    const max = keys.reduce((m, k) => Math.max(m, Math.abs((original[k] ?? Number.NaN) - (retrained[k] ?? Number.NaN))), 0);
    return { Value: Number.isFinite(max) ? max : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, Keys: keys.length };
  }
  // load<T>: RunView<T> by ID (`EscapeSQLString`), entity_object (typed entity fields are read), throws when missing.
}
```

  (`Math.max(m, NaN)` is `NaN`, so a metric present on one side only makes `MaxAbsDiff` non-finite and the result not
  reproduced — intended.) `TrainingDelegation.RetrainFromSnapshotViaEngine(trainingRunId, provider, user)` builds production deps and
  calls it.
  A third case: a fake sidecar whose retrain response omits one holdout metric → `Reproduced: false`, `MaxAbsDiff`
  `Infinity` (the one-sided-metric rule).

```ts
/** Training Snapshot gate measurements: W1 → S5.5 (snapshot reproducibility) and W1 → S3.2 (per-value provenance). */
import { RunView } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { MJTrainingSnapshotEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { TrainingDelegation, MLModelInferenceProcessor, BuildProductionMLInferenceDeps, StorageProviderSnapshotFileStore } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio';
import { UnitFixtures, type GateMeasurement, type TruthHarness } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-truth-suite';

/**
 * The Training Snapshot and provenance gate bodies (G1.10, G1.11); static members on one owner (coding standards
 * §2).
 */
export class TrainingSnapshotGates {
  /** G1.10 W1 → S5.5. The in-process retrain uses the suite's single-threaded sidecar, the one MJAPI trained on. */
  public static async MeasureW1SnapshotRetrain(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'world', ID: 'W1-signal', Seed: 42 });
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionW1ProvenancePipeline(h);
    await h.Train(pipeline);
    const run = await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID);
    if (!run.TrainingSnapshotID) return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: 'run has no snapshot' };
    const snap = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(h.Provider).RunView<Pick<MJTrainingSnapshotEntity, 'RowManifestFileID' | 'ManifestRowCount'>>(
      { EntityName: 'MJ: Training Snapshots', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(run.TrainingSnapshotID)}'`, Fields: ['RowManifestFileID', 'ManifestRowCount'], ResultType: 'simple' }, h.User);
    const s = snap.Results[0];
    if (!s) return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: `snapshot ${run.TrainingSnapshotID} not found` };
    const files = new StorageProviderSnapshotFileStore(UnitFixtures.EntityFactory(h), h.Provider, h.User);
    const manifest = await files.Get(s.RowManifestFileID);
    const manifestRows = new TextDecoder().decode(manifest).split('\n').filter((l) => l.length > 0).length;
    h.UseSuiteSidecar();
    const comparison = await TrainingDelegation.RetrainFromSnapshotViaEngine(run.ID, h.Provider, h.User);
    const passed = manifestRows === 16776 && s.ManifestRowCount === 16776 && comparison.ContentHashVerified && comparison.Reproduced;
    return { Passed: passed, Measured: { manifestRows, contentHashVerified: comparison.ContentHashVerified, maxAbsDiff: comparison.MaxAbsDiff }, Detail: `retrain max |diff| ${comparison.MaxAbsDiff}` };
  }

  /** G1.11 W1 → S3.2. The model is promoted to Validated before the scoring path loads it (scoring refuses Draft models). */
  public static async MeasureW1Provenance(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    const w1 = await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'world', ID: 'W1-signal', Seed: 42 });
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionW1ProvenancePipeline(h);
    await h.Train(pipeline);
    const run = await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID);
    if (!run.ResultingModelID) return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: 'no model' };
    const promoted = await h.Promote(run.ResultingModelID, 'Validated', 'G1.11: scoring-path provenance');
    if (!promoted.Promoted) return { Passed: false, Measured: { modelStatus: promoted.Status }, Detail: `model ${run.ResultingModelID} could not be validated for scoring` };
    const ids = await h.SampleRowIds(w1, 20, 20261012);
    const scoring = new MLModelInferenceProcessor({ modelId: run.ResultingModelID, deps: BuildProductionMLInferenceDeps() });
    const assembled = await scoring.AssembleForScoring(ids.map((ID) => ({ ID })), { contextUser: h.User, provider: h.Provider }, 'unit-rule');
    if (assembled.Status !== 'assembled') return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: 'scoring assembly refused' };
    let resolved = 0;
    for (const row of assembled.Rows) {
      const ok = await Promise.all(row.Provenance.map((p, i) => h.ResolveProvenance(p, row.Values[i])));   // see Step 3
      if (ok.every(Boolean)) resolved++;
    }
    return { Passed: resolved === 20 && assembled.Rows.length === 20, Measured: { resolved, sampled: assembled.Rows.length }, Detail: `${resolved} of 20 rows fully resolve` };
  }
}
```

```ts
/** The seeded row sampler and the provenance resolver behind two TruthHarness members (lines in RunFixtures.harnessFrom). */
import { RunView } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { ValueProvenance } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { RunContext } from './run-fixtures';
import type { LoadedDataset } from './types';
import { ProvenanceResolver } from '../fixtures/provenance-resolver';

/** `TruthHarness.SampleRowIds` and `TruthHarness.ResolveProvenance`. */
export class HarnessProvenance {
  /** Deterministic PRNG for SampleRowIds (mulberry32). */
  private static mulberry32(seed: number): () => number {
    let a = seed >>> 0;
    return () => {
      a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
      let t = a;
      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  /**
   * A seeded sample of `n` primary keys of a loaded dataset's row table: every ID read (complete read), lower-cased and
   * sorted so the order does not depend on SQL collation, shuffled with a seeded Fisher–Yates. Same seed, same loaded
   * seed (the dataset's `pstruth_dataset` stamp) → same sample.
   */
  public static async SampleRowIds(ctx: RunContext, dataset: LoadedDataset, n: number, seed: number): Promise<string[]> {
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(ctx.Provider).RunView<{ ID: string }>({ EntityName: dataset.Entity.Name, Fields: ['ID'], ResultType: 'simple', IgnoreMaxRows: true }, ctx.User);
    if (!r.Success) throw new Error(`reading ${dataset.Entity.Name} IDs failed: ${r.ErrorMessage}`);
    if (r.Results.length !== dataset.RowCount) throw new Error(`${dataset.Entity.Name}: read ${r.Results.length} IDs, the loaded seed has ${dataset.RowCount}`);
    if (n > r.Results.length) throw new Error(`cannot sample ${n} of ${r.Results.length} rows`);
    const ids = r.Results.map((x) => x.ID.toLowerCase()).sort();
    const rand = HarnessProvenance.mulberry32(seed);
    for (let i = ids.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(rand() * (i + 1));
      [ids[i], ids[j]] = [ids[j], ids[i]];
    }
    return ids.slice(0, n);
  }

  /** Whether one assembled value resolves to its source, source version and computed-at. */
  public static ResolveProvenance(ctx: RunContext, p: ValueProvenance, value: string | number | null): Promise<boolean> {
    return ProvenanceResolver.ResolveValueProvenance(ctx.Provider, ctx.User, p, value);
  }
}
```

```ts
/** The truth sidecar hook behind TruthHarness.UseSuiteSidecar. */
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { TruthSuite } from '../truth-suite';

/** `TruthHarness.UseSuiteSidecar`. */
export class HarnessSidecar {
  /**
   * Point this gate process's in-process engine calls (TrainingDelegation.RetrainFromSnapshotViaEngine) at the suite's single-threaded
   * sidecar — the one MJAPI trains on (`.run/sidecar.url`) — and return its URL. MLSidecar reads
   * PREDICTIVE_STUDIO_SIDECAR_URL when it is constructed.
   */
  public static UseSuiteSidecar(): string {
    const file = path.join(TruthSuite.Root(), '.run', 'sidecar.url');
    if (!existsSync(file)) throw new Error(`${file} is missing: start the truth sidecar (pnpm run truth:sidecar)`);
    const url = readFileSync(file, 'utf8').trim();
    process.env.PREDICTIVE_STUDIO_SIDECAR_URL = url;
    return url;
  }
}
```

### M5 — Trainer contract, in-fold encoding, repeated inner CV, determinism, cardinality  ·  parallel-safe: no  ·  depends on: M4

**Outcome:** The truth suite has the Python reference assets the trainer gates read (M5.2, D3-73): `truthsuite.paths`
over PR 2's data cache, the `truthsuite.refpipe` port of the reference pipeline, its committed ten-id summary
`fixtures/reference/p5-golden.json`, the real cases in `fixtures/real/` and the `n400` seed set, on the TruthSuite venv
with `pyarrow` and `statsmodels`. The C4 contract exists in Core (TypeScript, `Core/src/trainer-contract.ts`, the gate types in
`Core/src/gate.ts`, the typed protocol `EvaluationProtocolSpec` and its parser `EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow` in
`Core/src/evaluation-protocol.ts`) and in the sidecar (pydantic, identical field names). The sidecar can download a
snapshot (the M4.2 JSON Lines files) through pre-authorised URLs and verify both files' SHA-256; encode every column
inside the fold that is being fitted (median imputation with a missing indicator, scaling, one-hot capped at
`cardinalityCap`, hashed buckets, cross-fitted target encoding, identifiers excluded, nothing coerced to 0); build
repeated stratified, grouped or blocked-time inner folds over development rows only; train every candidate
deterministically (protocol seed, `threads`; RF and MLP `random_state`; MLP sizes parsed from the catalog's `"100"`;
Poisson/Tweedie objectives from the task, an objective override refused); score each fold with the protocol's primary
proper score; report each candidate's inner mean with a corrected resampled-t interval; choose one finalist by
refpipe's 1-SE rule; refit it on all development rows; and stop with a `failed` stage (`load-snapshot`, `inner-cv`,
`timeout`, `budget-exceeded`) and the real compute spent. The legacy `/train` route (out-of-sample since PR 2's C5.2,
cross-PR §8.3 A-PR2-FSC1) now seeds RF and MLP and trains the catalog's MLP default. Every run records
`ComputeSeconds` and `ComputeCost = ComputeSeconds × PS_COMPUTE_USD_PER_SECOND` (NULL when the rate is not configured;
D-019, D3-13). The `/trainer` route that returns a full `TrainerResult` is added in M6, when the holdout stage exists;
the engine calls it from M6.7. Closes F-SC-2, F-SC-3, F-L4-5. Gates flipped: G2.27 `W8 → S3.4`, G2.31
`W1 → S5.4 #2`, G2.32 `W1 → S5.4 #3`. G2.30 `W1 → S5.3`'s test is written here (M5.12) and flipped in M9.6.

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { EvaluationProtocol, ALLOWED_OUTCOMES, type EvaluationProtocolColumns } from '../evaluation-protocol';

function protocolRow(overrides: Partial<EvaluationProtocolColumns> = {}): EvaluationProtocolColumns {
  return {
    ID: 'P1', LineageRootID: 'P1', Version: 1, Name: 'Renewal grading',
    Holdout: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'OrderDate', cutoff: '2024-01-01', holdoutEnd: null, newEntityReport: null }),
    InnerValidation: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'repeated-stratified-kfold', folds: 5, repeats: 3 }),
    Seed: 0, HoldoutAccessBudget: 1,
    PrimaryScore: JSON.stringify({ family: 'binary', metric: 'log-loss' }),
    SecondaryMetrics: JSON.stringify(['auc', 'calibration-slope']),
    Baselines: JSON.stringify([{ kind: 'dummy', name: 'base-rate' }, { kind: 'one-feature', selection: 'best-single-feature-inner-cv' }, { kind: 'glm', family: 'logistic', penalty: 'l2' }]),
    Calibration: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'auto', thresholdRows: 1000, fitOn: 'disjoint-calibration-fold' }),
    Resampling: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'none' }),
    Intervals: JSON.stringify({ level: 0.95, method: 'bootstrap', resamples: 1000, pairedTest: 'paired-bootstrap' }),
    Promotion: JSON.stringify({ comparators: [], incumbent: 'current-published', margin: 0, lowerBoundLevel: 0.95, pairedOn: 'same-holdout-rows', decisionTable: 'Q13+Q14+Q15' }),
    AllowedOutcomes: JSON.stringify(ALLOWED_OUTCOMES),
    LeakageAudit: JSON.stringify({ singleFeatureHeldOutAucMax: 0.9, timeShiftedLabelTest: true, dropColumnTest: true, importanceAggregation: 'per-source-column', highCardinalityIdCheck: true }),
    Exclusions: JSON.stringify({ denyFields: ['Renewed2'], denySources: [] }),
    Slices: JSON.stringify({ outOfTime: true, subgroups: ['Region'] }),
    PredictionIntervals: null, ResidualDiagnostics: null,
    RetrainTriggers: JSON.stringify([]),
    SearchStrategy: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'random', candidates: 3 }),
    Budgets: JSON.stringify({ maxComputeSeconds: 600, maxTokens: 0, maxCandidates: 3, hardStop: true }),
    MinMinorityClassRows: 20, GuardFieldsEditableBy: 'non-agent',
    AuthoredBy: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'human', userId: 'U1' }),
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('ParseEvaluationProtocolRow', () => {
  it('parses a complete binary protocol row into EvaluationProtocolSpec', () => {
    const r = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(protocolRow());
    expect(r.Ok).toBe(true);
    if (!r.Ok) return;
    expect(r.Value.holdout).toEqual({ kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'OrderDate', cutoff: '2024-01-01', holdoutEnd: null, newEntityReport: null });
    expect(r.Value.primaryScore).toEqual({ family: 'binary', metric: 'log-loss' });
    expect(r.Value.search).toEqual({ kind: 'random', candidates: 3 });
    expect(r.Value.exclusions.denyFields).toEqual(['Renewed2']);
    expect(r.Value.minMinorityClassRows).toBe(20);
    expect(r.Value.guardFieldsEditableBy).toBe('non-agent');
    expect(r.Value.authoredBy).toEqual({ kind: 'human', userId: 'U1' });
    expect(r.Value.allowedOutcomes).toEqual(['model', 'keep-simple-baseline', 'no-signal']);
  });

  it('reads a missing holdoutEnd as null', () => {
    const r = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(protocolRow({ Holdout: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'D', cutoff: '2024-01-01', newEntityReport: null }) }));
    expect(r.Ok && r.Value.holdout.kind === 'date-carved' && r.Value.holdout.holdoutEnd).toBe(null);
  });

  it('reports every problem of a bad row', () => {
    const r = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(protocolRow({
      InnerValidation: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'leave-one-out' }),
      Baselines: JSON.stringify([{ kind: 'oracle' }]),
      SearchStrategy: '{not json',
      AuthoredBy: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'robot' }),
    }));
    expect(r.Ok).toBe(false);
    if (r.Ok) return;
    expect(r.Errors).toContain('InnerValidation must be repeated-stratified-kfold {folds>=2, repeats>=1}, grouped-kfold {folds>=2, repeats>=1, groupKey} or blocked-time {folds>=2, gapPeriods>=0, groupKey|null}');
    expect(r.Errors).toContain('Baselines[0] must be dummy, one-feature, glm, naive, seasonal-naive or incumbent-heuristic');
    expect(r.Errors.some((e) => e.startsWith('SearchStrategy is not valid JSON'))).toBe(true);
    expect(r.Errors.some((e) => e.startsWith('AuthoredBy must be an Actor'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('refuses a nominal coverage outside (0, 1)', () => {
    const r = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(protocolRow({ PredictionIntervals: JSON.stringify({ method: 'split-conformal', nominalCoverage: [0.8, 1.2] }) }));
    expect(r.Ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.Ok) expect(r.Errors).toContain('PredictionIntervals.nominalCoverage must be a non-empty array of numbers strictly between 0 and 1');
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * @module gate
 *
 * The publishing gate's types (contracts.ts L581–613, refpipe `run.py:365-386`). The trainer contract needs them for
 * `TrainerResult.gate` and `comparisons`; the gate adds `GateInputs`, `StoredGateIntervals`, `GateRules.BeatsByMargin`,
 * `GateRules.GateInputsFromIntervals`, `GateRules.DecideGate` and the guards to this file.
 */

export type GateBranch = 'a:beats-best-simple' | 'a:Q15-only-model-beats-dummy' | 'b:keep-simple-baseline' | 'c:no-signal';

export interface PairedComparison {
  /** Mean of (base loss − candidate loss); positive favours the candidate. */
  readonly value: number;
  readonly ci: readonly [number, number];
  /** ci[0] > margin. */
  readonly beats: boolean;
}

export type GateDecision =
  | {
      readonly outcome: 'model';
      readonly branch: 'a:beats-best-simple' | 'a:Q15-only-model-beats-dummy';
      readonly shipped: string;
      readonly shippedRole: 'model';
      readonly note: 'no simple baseline carries demonstrable signal' | null;
    }
  | {
      readonly outcome: 'keep-simple-baseline';
      readonly branch: 'b:keep-simple-baseline';
      readonly shipped: string;
      readonly shippedRole: 'simpleBaseline';
      readonly note: null;
    }
  | {
      readonly outcome: 'no-signal';
      readonly branch: 'c:no-signal';
      readonly shipped: null;
      readonly shippedRole: null;
      readonly note: null;
    };
```

In `packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/prediction-unit.ts` add the actor parser the unit parser already uses as a
public static of `PredictionUnit` (the private `parseActor(v, errors)` stays; this wrapper is what the protocol parser
calls):

```ts
  /** Parse an `Actor` JSON value (the `AuthoredBy` columns of units and protocols). */
  public static ParseActor(v: JsonValue): ParseResult<Actor> {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const actor = PredictionUnit.parseActor(v, errors);
    return actor === null ? { Ok: false, Errors: errors } : { Ok: true, Value: actor };
  }
```

Add to `packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/evaluation-protocol.ts` (and add `type JsonObject`, `type ParseResult` to its json-value import beside `JsonParse`, plus
`import { PredictionUnit, type Actor } from './prediction-unit';`). The interface and constants are module-level; the
functions become static members of M1.2's `EvaluationProtocol` class (the block below shows them as that class — merge
its members into the M1.2 class, there is one `EvaluationProtocol`):

```ts
/** The typed Evaluation Protocol version a run is graded under (no pipeline or unit reference: the pipeline binds both). */
export interface EvaluationProtocolSpec {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly lineageRootId: string;
  readonly version: number;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly holdout: HoldoutSplit;
  readonly innerValidation: InnerValidation;
  readonly seed: number;
  readonly holdoutAccessBudget: 1;
  readonly primaryScore: ProperScore;
  readonly secondaryMetrics: readonly SecondaryMetric[];
  readonly baselines: readonly BaselineSpec[];
  readonly calibration: CalibrationMethod;
  readonly resampling: ResamplingSpec;
  readonly intervals: IntervalSpec;
  readonly promotion: PromotionRule;
  readonly allowedOutcomes: typeof ALLOWED_OUTCOMES;
  readonly leakageAudit: LeakageAuditSpec;
  readonly exclusions: ProtocolExclusions;
  readonly slices: SliceSpec;
  readonly predictionIntervals: PredictionIntervalSpec | null;
  readonly residualDiagnostics: ResidualDiagnosticsSpec | null;
  readonly retrainTriggers: readonly RetrainTrigger[];
  readonly search: SearchStrategy;
  readonly budgets: Budgets;
  readonly minMinorityClassRows: number;
  readonly guardFieldsEditableBy: GuardFieldsEditableBy;
  readonly authoredBy: Actor;
}

const ISO_DAY = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const SECONDARY_METRICS: readonly SecondaryMetric[] = ['auc', 'accuracy', 'f1', 'precision', 'recall', 'r2', 'calibration-slope'];

/** Members of the EvaluationProtocol class: the typed parser and its private column parsers. */
export class EvaluationProtocol {
  private static isSecondaryMetric(s: string): s is SecondaryMetric {
    return SECONDARY_METRICS.some((m) => m === s);
  }

  private static intAtLeast(o: JsonObject, key: string, min: number): number | null {
    const v = JsonParse.JsonInteger(o, key);
    return v !== null && v >= min ? v : null;
  }

  /**
   * Parse every column of an `MJ: Evaluation Protocols` row into {@link EvaluationProtocolSpec}. All problems are
   * reported (each names its column); the shape checks ({@link GetEvaluationProtocolShapeProblems}) run first so
   * their messages are the ones a user sees for the fixed fields.
   */
  public static ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(row: EvaluationProtocolColumns): ParseResult<EvaluationProtocolSpec> {
    const errors: string[] = [...EvaluationProtocol.GetEvaluationProtocolShapeProblems(row)];
    const holdout = EvaluationProtocol.parseHoldout(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.Holdout, 'Holdout', errors), errors);
    const innerValidation = EvaluationProtocol.parseInnerValidation(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.InnerValidation, 'InnerValidation', errors), errors);
    const primaryScore = EvaluationProtocol.parsePrimaryScore(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.PrimaryScore, 'PrimaryScore', errors));
    const secondaryMetrics = EvaluationProtocol.parseSecondaryMetrics(EvaluationProtocol.arrayOf(row.SecondaryMetrics, 'SecondaryMetrics', errors), errors);
    const baselines = EvaluationProtocol.parseBaselines(EvaluationProtocol.arrayOf(row.Baselines, 'Baselines', errors), errors);
    const calibration = EvaluationProtocol.parseCalibration(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.Calibration, 'Calibration', errors), errors);
    const resampling = EvaluationProtocol.parseResampling(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.Resampling, 'Resampling', errors), errors);
    const intervals = EvaluationProtocol.parseIntervals(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.Intervals, 'Intervals', errors), errors);
    const promotionObj = EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.Promotion, 'Promotion', errors);
    const promotion = promotionObj === null ? null : EvaluationProtocol.parsePromotion(promotionObj, errors);
    const leakageAudit = EvaluationProtocol.parseLeakageAudit(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.LeakageAudit, 'LeakageAudit', errors), errors);
    const exclusions = EvaluationProtocol.parseExclusions(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.Exclusions, 'Exclusions', errors), errors);
    const slices = EvaluationProtocol.parseSlices(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.Slices, 'Slices', errors), errors);
    const predictionIntervals = EvaluationProtocol.isBlank(row.PredictionIntervals) ? null : EvaluationProtocol.parsePredictionIntervals(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.PredictionIntervals, 'PredictionIntervals', errors), errors);
    const residualDiagnostics = EvaluationProtocol.isBlank(row.ResidualDiagnostics) ? null : EvaluationProtocol.parseResidualDiagnostics(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.ResidualDiagnostics, 'ResidualDiagnostics', errors), errors);
    const retrainTriggers = EvaluationProtocol.parseRetrainTriggers(EvaluationProtocol.arrayOf(row.RetrainTriggers, 'RetrainTriggers', errors), errors);
    const search = EvaluationProtocol.parseSearch(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.SearchStrategy, 'SearchStrategy', errors), errors);
    const budgets = EvaluationProtocol.parseBudgets(EvaluationProtocol.objectOf(row.Budgets, 'Budgets', errors), errors);
    const guardFieldsEditableBy = EvaluationProtocol.IsGuardFieldsEditableBy(row.GuardFieldsEditableBy) ? row.GuardFieldsEditableBy : null;
    if (guardFieldsEditableBy === null) errors.push('GuardFieldsEditableBy must be non-agent or human-only');
    const authoredBy = EvaluationProtocol.parseAuthoredBy(row.AuthoredBy, errors);

    if (
      errors.length > 0 || holdout === null || innerValidation === null || primaryScore === null || calibration === null ||
      resampling === null || intervals === null || promotion === null || leakageAudit === null || exclusions === null ||
      slices === null || search === null || budgets === null || authoredBy === null || guardFieldsEditableBy === null
    ) {
      return { Ok: false, Errors: errors.length > 0 ? errors : ['Evaluation Protocol row is incomplete'] };
    }
    return {
      Ok: true,
      Value: {
        id: row.ID, lineageRootId: row.LineageRootID, version: row.Version, name: row.Name,
        holdout, innerValidation, seed: row.Seed, holdoutAccessBudget: 1, primaryScore, secondaryMetrics, baselines,
        calibration, resampling, intervals, promotion, allowedOutcomes: ALLOWED_OUTCOMES, leakageAudit,
        exclusions, slices, predictionIntervals, residualDiagnostics,
        retrainTriggers, search, budgets, minMinorityClassRows: row.MinMinorityClassRows, guardFieldsEditableBy,
        authoredBy,
      },
    };
  }

  private static isBlank(text: string | null): boolean {
    return text === null || text.trim().length === 0;
  }

  /** A JSON-object column; a malformed one is reported once (the shape check may already have named it). */
  private static objectOf(text: string | null, column: string, errors: string[]): JsonObject | null {
    const r = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(text, column);
    if (!r.Ok) {
      if (!errors.some((e) => e.startsWith(column))) errors.push(...r.Errors);
      return null;
    }
    if (!JsonParse.IsJsonObject(r.Value)) {
      errors.push(`${column} must be a JSON object`);
      return null;
    }
    return r.Value;
  }

  /** A JSON-array column; a malformed one is reported once. */
  private static arrayOf(text: string | null, column: string, errors: string[]): JsonValue[] | null {
    const r = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(text, column);
    if (!r.Ok) {
      if (!errors.some((e) => e.startsWith(column))) errors.push(...r.Errors);
      return null;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(r.Value)) {
      errors.push(`${column} must be a JSON array`);
      return null;
    }
    return r.Value;
  }

  private static parseSecondaryMetrics(raw: JsonValue[] | null, errors: string[]): SecondaryMetric[] {
    const out: SecondaryMetric[] = [];
    for (const m of raw || []) {
      if (typeof m === 'string' && EvaluationProtocol.isSecondaryMetric(m)) out.push(m);
      else errors.push(`SecondaryMetrics entry ${JSON.stringify(m)} is not one of ${SECONDARY_METRICS.join(', ')}`);
    }
    return out;
  }

  private static parseBaselines(raw: JsonValue[] | null, errors: string[]): BaselineSpec[] {
    const out: BaselineSpec[] = [];
    (raw || []).forEach((b, i) => {
      const parsed = JsonParse.IsJsonObject(b) ? EvaluationProtocol.parseBaseline(b) : null;
      if (parsed === null) errors.push(`Baselines[${i}] must be dummy, one-feature, glm, naive, seasonal-naive or incumbent-heuristic`);
      else out.push(parsed);
    });
    return out;
  }

  private static parseRetrainTriggers(raw: JsonValue[] | null, errors: string[]): RetrainTrigger[] {
    const out: RetrainTrigger[] = [];
    (raw || []).forEach((t, i) => {
      const parsed = JsonParse.IsJsonObject(t) ? EvaluationProtocol.parseRetrainTrigger(t) : null;
      if (parsed === null) errors.push(`RetrainTriggers[${i}] must be outcome-degradation {margin>=0, consecutivePeriods} or calibration-drift {slopeOutside:[lo,hi], consecutivePeriods}`);
      else out.push(parsed);
    });
    return out;
  }

  private static parseExclusions(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): ProtocolExclusions | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const denyFields = JsonParse.JsonStringArray(v, 'denyFields');
    const denySources = JsonParse.JsonStringArray(v, 'denySources');
    if (denyFields !== null && denySources !== null) return { denyFields, denySources };
    errors.push('Exclusions must be {denyFields: string[], denySources: string[]}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseSlices(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): SliceSpec | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const outOfTime = JsonParse.JsonBoolean(v, 'outOfTime');
    const subgroups = JsonParse.JsonStringArray(v, 'subgroups');
    if (outOfTime !== null && subgroups !== null) return { outOfTime, subgroups };
    errors.push('Slices must be {outOfTime: boolean, subgroups: string[]}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseAuthoredBy(text: string, errors: string[]): Actor | null {
    const json = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(text, 'AuthoredBy');
    if (!json.Ok) {
      if (!errors.some((e) => e.startsWith('AuthoredBy'))) errors.push(...json.Errors);
      return null;
    }
    const a = PredictionUnit.ParseActor(json.Value);
    if (a.Ok) return a.Value;
    errors.push(...a.Errors);
    return null;
  }

  private static parseHoldout(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): HoldoutSplit | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    if (kind === 'date-carved') {
      const dateColumn = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'dateColumn');
      const cutoff = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'cutoff');
      const endRaw = v['holdoutEnd'];
      const holdoutEnd = endRaw === undefined || endRaw === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'holdoutEnd');
      const reportObj = v['newEntityReport'] === null || v['newEntityReport'] === undefined ? null : JsonParse.JsonObjectField(v, 'newEntityReport');
      const groupKey = reportObj === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonString(reportObj, 'groupKey');
      const fraction = reportObj === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonNumber(reportObj, 'holdoutFraction');
      const reportOk = reportObj === null || (groupKey !== null && fraction !== null && fraction > 0 && fraction < 1);
      const endOk = holdoutEnd === null || (ISO_DAY.test(holdoutEnd) && cutoff !== null && holdoutEnd > cutoff);
      if (dateColumn && cutoff && ISO_DAY.test(cutoff) && endOk && reportOk && (endRaw === undefined || endRaw === null || holdoutEnd !== null)) {
        return {
          kind, dateColumn, cutoff, holdoutEnd,
          newEntityReport: reportObj === null || groupKey === null || fraction === null ? null : { groupKey, holdoutFraction: fraction },
        };
      }
      errors.push('Holdout date-carved needs dateColumn, cutoff yyyy-mm-dd, holdoutEnd null or a later yyyy-mm-dd, newEntityReport null or {groupKey, holdoutFraction in (0,1)}');
      return null;
    }
    if (kind === 'rolling-origin') {
      const origins = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'origins', 5);
      const horizonPeriods = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'horizonPeriods', 1);
      const gapPeriods = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'gapPeriods', 0);
      const minTrainPeriods = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'minTrainPeriods', 1);
      const window = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'window');
      if (origins !== null && horizonPeriods !== null && gapPeriods !== null && minTrainPeriods !== null && (window === 'expanding' || window === 'sliding')) {
        return { kind, origins, horizonPeriods, gapPeriods, minTrainPeriods, window };
      }
      errors.push('Holdout rolling-origin needs origins>=5, horizonPeriods>=1, gapPeriods>=0, minTrainPeriods>=1, window expanding|sliding');
      return null;
    }
    return null; // the shape check already reported an unknown kind
  }

  private static parseInnerValidation(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): InnerValidation | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    const folds = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'folds', 2);
    if (kind === 'repeated-stratified-kfold') {
      const repeats = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'repeats', 1);
      if (folds !== null && repeats !== null) return { kind, folds, repeats };
    } else if (kind === 'grouped-kfold') {
      const repeats = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'repeats', 1);
      const groupKey = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'groupKey');
      if (folds !== null && repeats !== null && groupKey) return { kind, folds, repeats, groupKey };
    } else if (kind === 'blocked-time') {
      const gapPeriods = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'gapPeriods', 0);
      const groupKey = v['groupKey'] === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'groupKey');
      if (folds !== null && gapPeriods !== null && (v['groupKey'] === null || groupKey !== null)) return { kind, folds, gapPeriods, groupKey };
    }
    errors.push('InnerValidation must be repeated-stratified-kfold {folds>=2, repeats>=1}, grouped-kfold {folds>=2, repeats>=1, groupKey} or blocked-time {folds>=2, gapPeriods>=0, groupKey|null}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parsePrimaryScore(v: JsonObject | null): ProperScore | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const family = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'family');
    const metric = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'metric');
    switch (family) {
      case 'binary': return metric === 'log-loss' || metric === 'brier' ? { family, metric } : null;
      case 'multiclass': return metric === 'multiclass-log-loss' ? { family, metric } : null;
      case 'continuous': return metric === 'rmse' || metric === 'mae' ? { family, metric } : null;
      case 'count': return metric === 'poisson-deviance' ? { family, metric } : null;
      case 'non-negative': return metric === 'tweedie-deviance' ? { family, metric } : null;
      case 'forecast': return metric === 'mase' || metric === 'rmse' ? { family, metric } : null;
      default: return null; // reported by the shape check
    }
  }

  private static parseBaseline(v: JsonObject): BaselineSpec | null {
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    switch (kind) {
      case 'dummy': {
        const name = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'name');
        return name === 'base-rate' || name === 'mean' || name === 'training-window-mean' ? { kind, name } : null;
      }
      case 'one-feature':
        return JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'selection') === 'best-single-feature-inner-cv' ? { kind, selection: 'best-single-feature-inner-cv' } : null;
      case 'glm': {
        const family = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'family');
        const ok = family === 'logistic' || family === 'multinomial' || family === 'gaussian' || family === 'poisson' || family === 'tweedie';
        return ok && JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'penalty') === 'l2' ? { kind, family, penalty: 'l2' } : null;
      }
      case 'naive':
        return { kind };
      case 'seasonal-naive': {
        const season = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'season', 1);
        return season === null ? null : { kind, season };
      }
      case 'incumbent-heuristic': {
        const name = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'name');
        return name ? { kind, name } : null;
      }
      default:
        return null;
    }
  }

  private static parseCalibration(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): CalibrationMethod | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    const fitOn = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'fitOn');
    if ((kind === 'platt' || kind === 'isotonic') && fitOn === 'disjoint-calibration-fold') return { kind, fitOn };
    if (kind === 'auto' && fitOn === 'disjoint-calibration-fold') {
      const thresholdRows = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'thresholdRows', 1);
      if (thresholdRows !== null) return { kind, thresholdRows, fitOn };
    }
    if (kind === 'not-applicable' && JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'reason') === 'regression-task') return { kind, reason: 'regression-task' };
    errors.push('Calibration must be platt|isotonic {fitOn:"disjoint-calibration-fold"}, auto {thresholdRows>=1, fitOn} or not-applicable {reason:"regression-task"}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseResampling(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): ResamplingSpec | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    if (kind === 'none') return { kind };
    const method = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'method');
    if (kind === 'in-fold' && (method === 'class-weight' || method === 'undersample' || method === 'oversample')) return { kind, method };
    errors.push('Resampling must be {kind:"none"} or {kind:"in-fold", method: class-weight|undersample|oversample}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseIntervals(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): IntervalSpec | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const level = JsonParse.JsonNumber(v, 'level');
    const method = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'method');
    const resamples = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'resamples', 100);
    const pairedTest = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'pairedTest');
    const methodOk = method === 'bootstrap' || method === 'cluster-bootstrap' || method === 'block-bootstrap' || method === 'delong';
    const testOk = pairedTest === 'paired-bootstrap' || pairedTest === 'delong' || pairedTest === 'corrected-resampled-t' || pairedTest === 'diebold-mariano';
    if (level === 0.95 && methodOk && testOk && resamples !== null) return { level: 0.95, method, resamples, pairedTest };
    errors.push('Intervals must be {level: 0.95, method: bootstrap|cluster-bootstrap|block-bootstrap|delong, resamples>=100, pairedTest: paired-bootstrap|delong|corrected-resampled-t|diebold-mariano}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parsePromotion(v: JsonObject, errors: string[]): PromotionRule | null {
    const comparators: BaselineSpec[] = [];
    for (const c of JsonParse.JsonArrayField(v, 'comparators') || []) {
      const b = JsonParse.IsJsonObject(c) ? EvaluationProtocol.parseBaseline(c) : null;
      if (b === null) {
        errors.push('Promotion.comparators entries must be baseline specs');
        return null;
      }
      comparators.push(b);
    }
    const incumbent = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'incumbent');
    const margin = JsonParse.JsonNumber(v, 'margin');
    const ok = (incumbent === 'current-published' || incumbent === 'none') && margin !== null && margin >= 0 &&
      JsonParse.JsonNumber(v, 'lowerBoundLevel') === 0.95 && JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'pairedOn') === 'same-holdout-rows' && JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'decisionTable') === 'Q13+Q14+Q15';
    if (!ok || margin === null || (incumbent !== 'current-published' && incumbent !== 'none')) {
      if (!errors.includes('Promotion margin must be a finite number >= 0')) {
        errors.push('Promotion must be {comparators, incumbent: current-published|none, margin>=0, lowerBoundLevel: 0.95, pairedOn: same-holdout-rows, decisionTable: Q13+Q14+Q15}');
      }
      return null;
    }
    return { comparators, incumbent, margin: EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(margin), lowerBoundLevel: 0.95, pairedOn: 'same-holdout-rows', decisionTable: 'Q13+Q14+Q15' };
  }

  private static parseLeakageAudit(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): LeakageAuditSpec | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const ceiling = JsonParse.JsonNumber(v, 'singleFeatureHeldOutAucMax');
    if (ceiling !== null && ceiling > 0.5 && ceiling <= 1 && JsonParse.JsonBoolean(v, 'timeShiftedLabelTest') === true &&
        JsonParse.JsonBoolean(v, 'dropColumnTest') === true && JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'importanceAggregation') === 'per-source-column' &&
        JsonParse.JsonBoolean(v, 'highCardinalityIdCheck') === true) {
      return { singleFeatureHeldOutAucMax: ceiling, timeShiftedLabelTest: true, dropColumnTest: true, importanceAggregation: 'per-source-column', highCardinalityIdCheck: true };
    }
    errors.push('LeakageAudit must be {singleFeatureHeldOutAucMax in (0.5, 1], timeShiftedLabelTest: true, dropColumnTest: true, importanceAggregation: per-source-column, highCardinalityIdCheck: true}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parsePredictionIntervals(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): PredictionIntervalSpec | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const method = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'method');
    const raw = JsonParse.JsonArrayField(v, 'nominalCoverage');
    const levels: number[] = [];
    for (const x of raw || []) if (typeof x === 'number' && Number.isFinite(x) && x > 0 && x < 1) levels.push(x);
    const coverageOk = raw !== null && raw.length > 0 && levels.length === raw.length;
    if (!coverageOk) errors.push('PredictionIntervals.nominalCoverage must be a non-empty array of numbers strictly between 0 and 1');
    if (method !== 'split-conformal' && method !== 'quantile') errors.push('PredictionIntervals.method must be split-conformal or quantile');
    return coverageOk && (method === 'split-conformal' || method === 'quantile') ? { method, nominalCoverage: levels } : null;
  }

  private static parseResidualDiagnostics(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): ResidualDiagnosticsSpec | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const acfLags = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'acfLags', 1);
    const alpha = JsonParse.JsonNumber(v, 'ljungBoxAlpha');
    if (acfLags !== null && alpha !== null && alpha > 0 && alpha < 1) return { acfLags, ljungBoxAlpha: alpha };
    errors.push('ResidualDiagnostics must be {acfLags>=1, ljungBoxAlpha in (0,1)}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseRetrainTrigger(v: JsonObject): RetrainTrigger | null {
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    const consecutivePeriods = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'consecutivePeriods', 1);
    if (consecutivePeriods === null) return null;
    if (kind === 'outcome-degradation') {
      const margin = JsonParse.JsonNumber(v, 'margin');
      return margin !== null && margin >= 0 ? { kind, margin: EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(margin), consecutivePeriods } : null;
    }
    if (kind === 'calibration-drift') {
      const range = JsonParse.JsonArrayField(v, 'slopeOutside');
      const lo = range?.[0];
      const hi = range?.[1];
      return range !== null && range.length === 2 && typeof lo === 'number' && typeof hi === 'number' && lo < hi
        ? { kind, slopeOutside: [lo, hi], consecutivePeriods } : null;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private static parseSearch(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): SearchStrategy | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const kind = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'kind');
    if (kind === 'random') {
      const candidates = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'candidates', 1);
      if (candidates !== null) return { kind, candidates };
    }
    if (kind === 'guided') {
      const method = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'method');
      const equalCostComparisonId = JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'equalCostComparisonId');
      if ((method === 'bayesian' || method === 'successive-halving') && equalCostComparisonId) return { kind, method, equalCostComparisonId };
    }
    errors.push('SearchStrategy must be {kind:"random", candidates>=1} or {kind:"guided", method: bayesian|successive-halving, equalCostComparisonId}');
    return null;
  }

  private static parseBudgets(v: JsonObject | null, errors: string[]): Budgets | null {
    if (v === null) return null;
    const maxComputeSeconds = JsonParse.JsonNumber(v, 'maxComputeSeconds');
    const maxTokens = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'maxTokens', 0);
    const maxCandidates = EvaluationProtocol.intAtLeast(v, 'maxCandidates', 1);
    if (maxComputeSeconds !== null && maxComputeSeconds > 0 && maxTokens !== null && maxCandidates !== null && JsonParse.JsonBoolean(v, 'hardStop') === true) {
      return { maxComputeSeconds, maxTokens, maxCandidates, hardStop: true };
    }
    errors.push('Budgets must be {maxComputeSeconds>0, maxTokens>=0, maxCandidates>=1, hardStop: true}');
    return null;
  }
}


```

  `ParseResult`'s failure message for malformed JSON comes from M1.1's `JsonParse.ParseJsonText` (`<column> is not valid JSON (…)`);
  `objectOf`/`arrayOf` add it only when M1's shape check did not already report that column, so each problem appears
  once.

Create `packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/trainer-contract.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * @module trainer-contract
 *
 * The C4 Trainer/Evaluator contract (P10 `contracts.ts` L703-1113 and `RunCost` L1658): the request the engine
 * sends to the Python sidecar's `POST /trainer` and the result it gets back. The sidecar's pydantic mirror is
 * `Sidecar/src/python/app/trainer_schemas.py`; field names are identical so JSON crosses without translation
 * (camelCase wire names, shared with the sidecar; identifiers are plain strings).
 *
 * Deviations from the reference contracts: the protocol is the typed
 * {@link EvaluationProtocolSpec} with no pipeline/unit reference; `CandidateSpec.driverKey` (E1, the sidecar
 * cannot resolve an `MJ: ML Algorithms` row ID); the sidecar names a time-shifted-label leak with a paired
 * `single-feature-auc` flag instead of a column on that flag (E2); `forecast` (E3) and `innerSplitContrast` (E4) on a
 * completed result; `predictionIntervalCoverage` is one entry per declared nominal level (E5).
 */
import type {
  BaselineRole,
  BaselineSpec,
  Budgets,
  CalibrationMethod,
  EvaluationProtocolSpec,
  MetricWithInterval,
} from './evaluation-protocol';
import type { GateDecision, PairedComparison } from './gate';
import type { TaskType } from './task-type';

export type HyperparameterValue = number | string | boolean | null;

export interface CandidateSpec {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly algorithmId: string;
  /** E1: the `MJ: ML Algorithms.DriverClass` of `algorithmId`, resolved by the engine (e.g. `lightgbm`). */
  readonly driverKey: string;
  readonly hyperparameters: Readonly<Record<string, HyperparameterValue>>;
}

export interface PreAuthDownload {
  readonly fileId: string;
  readonly url: string;
  /** ISO instant. */
  readonly issuedAt: string;
  readonly driverLifetimeSeconds: number;
  /** ISO instant: `issuedAt` + the driver's lifetime. */
  readonly expiresAt: string;
  /** SHA-256 (lower-case hex) of the file bytes. */
  readonly sha256: string;
}

export interface TrainerRequest {
  readonly trainingRunId: string;
  readonly snapshot: {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly contentHash: string;
    readonly matrix: PreAuthDownload;
    readonly rowManifest: PreAuthDownload;
  };
  readonly incumbent: { readonly modelId: string; readonly artifact: PreAuthDownload } | null;
  readonly protocol: EvaluationProtocolSpec;
  readonly task: TaskType;
  readonly candidates: readonly CandidateSpec[];
  readonly seed: number;
  readonly threads: number;
  readonly timeoutSeconds: number;
  readonly maxRetries: number;
}

export interface ReturnedArtifact {
  readonly candidate: string;
  readonly bytesBase64: string;
  /** SHA-256 of the decoded envelope bytes — the bytes MJ stores, so delivery registration can compare it. */
  readonly sha256: string;
  readonly featureSchemaHash: string;
  readonly classOrder: readonly string[] | null;
}

export interface CodeVersion {
  readonly psGitSha: string;
  readonly sidecarVersion: string;
  readonly libraryVersions: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  readonly threads: number;
  readonly seed: number;
}

export interface CandidateInnerScore {
  readonly candidate: string;
  readonly inner: MetricWithInterval;
  readonly folds: number;
  readonly optimistic: true;
}

export interface BaselineResult {
  readonly baseline: BaselineSpec;
  readonly role: BaselineRole;
  readonly holdout: MetricWithInterval;
}

export interface CalibrationReport {
  readonly method: CalibrationMethod['kind'];
  readonly intercept: number;
  readonly slope: number;
  readonly reliability: readonly {
    readonly binLower: number;
    readonly binUpper: number;
    readonly meanPredicted: number;
    readonly observedRate: number;
    readonly n: number;
  }[];
}

export interface SourceColumnImportance {
  readonly sourceColumn: string;
  readonly permutationImportance: MetricWithInterval;
}

export type LeakageFlag =
  | { readonly kind: 'single-feature-auc'; readonly sourceColumn: string; readonly heldOutAuc: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'time-shifted-label'; readonly scoreWithShiftedLabel: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'drop-column'; readonly sourceColumn: string; readonly scoreDrop: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'high-cardinality-id'; readonly sourceColumn: string; readonly distinctRatio: number };

export interface SliceResult {
  readonly slice:
    | { readonly kind: 'out-of-time'; readonly period: string }
    | { readonly kind: 'subgroup'; readonly field: string; readonly value: string };
  readonly primary: MetricWithInterval;
}

export interface ResidualDiagnostics {
  readonly acf: readonly number[];
  readonly ljungBox: { readonly statistic: number; readonly pValue: number; readonly lags: number };
  readonly autocorrelationFlagged: boolean;
}

export interface RunCost {
  readonly computeSeconds: number;
  readonly tokens: number;
  readonly usd: number;
  readonly budget: Budgets;
  readonly stoppedByBudget: boolean;
}

/** E5: observed coverage of the prediction interval at one declared nominal level, on the holdout rows. */
export interface PredictionIntervalCoverage {
  readonly nominal: number;
  readonly observed: number;
  readonly n: number;
}

/** E3: one outer origin of a rolling-origin backtest (period ordinals at the unit's period). */
export interface RollingOriginResult {
  readonly k: number;
  readonly lastTrainPeriod: number;
  readonly testPeriods: readonly number[];
  readonly scale: number;
  /** MASE per forecaster at this origin: `model`, `naive`, `seasonalNaive`, `mean`. */
  readonly mase: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
}

/** E3: the forecast evaluation (S-T.2, S-T.3). */
export interface ForecastEvaluation {
  readonly origins: readonly RollingOriginResult[];
  readonly dieboldMarianoVsSeasonalNaive: {
    readonly statistic: number;
    readonly pValue: number;
    readonly meanDiff: number;
    readonly n: number;
    readonly horizon: number;
  };
}

/** E4: blocked/grouped inner score beside random-row K-fold on the same rows (S-T.4). */
export interface SplitContrast {
  readonly rows: number;
  readonly blockedGroupedScore: number;
  readonly randomRowScore: number;
  readonly inflation: number;
}

export type TrainerFailureStage = 'load-snapshot' | 'inner-cv' | 'holdout' | 'baselines' | 'timeout' | 'budget-exceeded';

export type TrainerResult =
  | {
      readonly status: 'completed';
      readonly trainingRunId: string;
      readonly codeVersion: CodeVersion;
      readonly computeSeconds: number;
      readonly innerScores: readonly CandidateInnerScore[];
      readonly finalist: string;
      readonly holdoutAccess: { readonly accessedAt: string; readonly count: 1; readonly finalist: string };
      readonly holdout: { readonly primary: MetricWithInterval; readonly secondary: readonly MetricWithInterval[] };
      readonly baselines: readonly BaselineResult[];
      /** Keyed like refpipe: `modelVsDummy`, `<member>VsDummy`, `modelVs:<member>` (reserved member names). */
      readonly comparisons: Readonly<Record<string, PairedComparison>>;
      /** The sidecar's transcribed decision; the stored decision is computed in TypeScript (`GateRules`). */
      readonly gate: GateDecision;
      readonly artifacts: readonly ReturnedArtifact[];
      readonly incumbentDiff: {
        readonly incumbentModelId: string;
        readonly value: number;
        readonly lower: number;
        readonly upper: number;
      } | null;
      readonly calibration: CalibrationReport | null;
      readonly slices: readonly SliceResult[];
      readonly operatingPoint: {
        readonly capacityPerPeriod: number;
        readonly precisionAtCapacity: MetricWithInterval;
        readonly baseRate: number;
      } | null;
      readonly cost: RunCost;
      readonly importance: readonly SourceColumnImportance[];
      readonly leakageFlags: readonly LeakageFlag[];
      readonly predictionIntervalCoverage: readonly PredictionIntervalCoverage[];
      readonly residualDiagnostics: ResidualDiagnostics | null;
      readonly forecast: ForecastEvaluation | null;
      readonly innerSplitContrast: SplitContrast | null;
    }
  | {
      readonly status: 'failed';
      readonly trainingRunId: string;
      readonly stage: TrainerFailureStage;
      readonly message: string;
      readonly computeSeconds: number;
    };

export type TrainerCompleted = Extract<TrainerResult, { readonly status: 'completed' }>;
export type TrainerFailed = Extract<TrainerResult, { readonly status: 'failed' }>;

/** Libraries every run's CodeVersion must name (gate W1 → S5.4 #3). */
export const REQUIRED_LIBRARIES = ['python', 'numpy', 'scikit-learn', 'xgboost', 'lightgbm'] as const;

/**
 * Rules over the C4 trainer contract (static members on one owner, coding standards §2).
 */
export class TrainerContract {
  /** What a CodeVersion lacks for lineage: missing library versions and a thread count below 1. Empty = complete. */
  public static CodeVersionGaps(cv: CodeVersion): string[] {
    const gaps: string[] = REQUIRED_LIBRARIES.filter((lib) => {
      const v = cv.libraryVersions[lib];
      return v === undefined || v.trim().length === 0;
    }).map((lib) => `libraryVersions.${lib}`);
    if (!Number.isInteger(cv.threads) || cv.threads < 1) gaps.push('threads');
    return gaps;
  }
}
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from truthsuite import paths


def _cache(root: Path, entries: dict[str, Path]) -> None:
    """A data cache as the catalog writes it: each seed directory with its .complete marker, listed in index.json."""
    for d in entries.values():
        d.mkdir(parents=True)
        (d / ".complete").write_text("0123456789ab\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps({k: str(v) for k, v in entries.items()}), encoding="utf-8")


def test_seed_dir_reads_the_catalog_index(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    d = tmp_path / "scenario" / "C2" / "0123456789ab" / "seed-2201"
    _cache(tmp_path, {"scenario/C2/seed-2201": d})
    monkeypatch.setenv("TRUTH_DATA_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    assert paths.seed_dir("scenario", "C2", 2201) == d


def test_a_seed_missing_from_the_index_raises_key_error(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _cache(tmp_path, {"world/W1-signal/seed-42": tmp_path / "world" / "W1-signal" / "0123456789ab" / "seed-42"})
    monkeypatch.setenv("TRUTH_DATA_DIR", str(tmp_path))
```

`TS/python/truthsuite/paths.py`:

```python
"""Where the truth suite's data lives: the package root, its committed fixtures and the generated-data cache.

Generated worlds and scenarios are written by the TypeScript data catalog (`pnpm run truth:data`) under the data root,
one directory per seed, and listed in `<data root>/index.json` as `"<kind>/<id>/seed-<k>": "<seed directory>"`; a
finished directory holds a `.complete` marker. The committed real cases live in `fixtures/real/`.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal

DatasetKind = Literal["world", "scenario"]

PACKAGE_ROOT: Path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FIXTURES: Path = PACKAGE_ROOT / "fixtures"


def data_root() -> Path:
    """`$TRUTH_DATA_DIR` when set (it must be absolute: the catalog and this reader run from different directories),
    else `<package>/.data`, the catalog's default."""
    env = os.environ.get("TRUTH_DATA_DIR", "")
    if not env:
        return PACKAGE_ROOT / ".data"
    root = Path(env)
    if not root.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError(f"TRUTH_DATA_DIR must be an absolute path, got {env!r}")
    return root


def _read_index(index_path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    if not index_path.is_file():
        return {}
    raw: object = json.loads(index_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or not all(isinstance(k, str) and isinstance(v, str) for k, v in raw.items()):
        raise ValueError(f"{index_path} is not an object of seed keys to seed directories")
    return {str(k): str(v) for k, v in raw.items()}


def seed_dir(kind: DatasetKind, dataset_id: str, seed: int) -> Path:
    """The generated directory of one seed. A seed that was never generated, or whose generation did not finish,
    raises KeyError: a missing seed is a failure, never a skip."""
    key = f"{kind}/{dataset_id}/seed-{seed}"
    index_path = data_root() / "index.json"
    index = _read_index(index_path)
    if key not in index:
        raise KeyError(f"{key} is not in {index_path}; generate it with `pnpm run truth:data -- --set <base|t2|n400> --only {dataset_id}`")
    directory = Path(index[key])
    if not (directory / ".complete").is_file():
        raise KeyError(f"{key}: {directory} has no .complete marker; its generation did not finish")
    return directory


def real_fixture(name: str) -> Path:
    """A committed real case under fixtures/real/ (`person_years.parquet`, `R2-real.rows.csv`, …)."""
    path = FIXTURES / "real" / name
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{path} is not a committed real-case file")
    return path
```

`TS/src/data/seeds.ts` — replace the `SeedSetName` line and `SeedSet`'s body (the class keeps its name and signature):

```ts
export type SeedSetName = 'base' | 't2' | 'n400';
```

```ts
  /**
   * The seeds of `set` for a world or scenario: `base` from its spec file; `t2` the fixed W2-noise range s100–s159;
   * `n400` W2-noise s100–s499, or a scenario's spec seed followed by spec*1000+1 … spec*1000+399.
   */
  public static SeedSet(kind: 'world' | 'scenario', id: string, set: SeedSetName): number[] {
    if (kind === 'world') {
      const spec = SafeJSONParse<WorldSpecSeeds>(readFileSync(path.join(TruthSuite.Root(), 'fixtures', 'worlds', `${id}.json`), 'utf8'));
      if (!spec) throw new Error(`Invalid world spec JSON for ${id}`);
      if (set === 'base') return [...spec.seeds, spec.freshSeed];
      if (id !== 'W2-noise') throw new Error(`seed set ${set} is defined only for W2-noise among the worlds`);
      return DatasetSeeds.range(100, set === 't2' ? 60 : 400);
    }
    if (set === 't2') throw new Error('seed set t2 is defined only for W2-noise');
    const specId = id === 'T3-lag' ? 'T3' : id;
    const spec = SafeJSONParse<ScenarioSpecSeed>(readFileSync(path.join(TruthSuite.Root(), 'fixtures', 'scenarios', 'specs', `${specId}.json`), 'utf8'));
    if (!spec) throw new Error(`Invalid scenario spec JSON for ${specId}`);
    if (set === 'base') return [spec.seed];
    return [spec.seed, ...DatasetSeeds.range(spec.seed * 1000 + 1, 399)];
  }

  /** `count` consecutive seeds starting at `first`. */
  private static range(first: number, count: number): number[] {
    return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => first + i);
  }
```
