Create `packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Sidecar/src/python/app/forecast.py`:

```python
"""The forecast path: a rolling-origin backtest for one series (C3 HoldoutSplit rolling-origin; S-T.2, S-T.3, S-T.6,
FM-12). Selection uses inner origins inside the pre-test window only; the outer origins are the locked holdout,
scored once for the finalist; each origin trains only on periods before it (minus the gap).

Selection is refpipe's (`run.py:711-757`): a candidate whose pre-test-window residuals fail Ljung-Box (p < 0.05) is
vetoed unless all fail; the rest are ranked by pooled inner MASE; the earliest candidate (request order) within one
Newey-West standard error (h-1 lags) of the best is chosen.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple, Union

import numpy as np
import numpy.typing as npt

from . import artifacts_v2, code_version, intervals as IV, scores, snapshot as SN, temporal as T
from .evaluation import gate_model
from .failures import RunClock, TrainerFailure
from .gate import run_gate
from .trainer import EncodedLabel, TrainedPredictor, fit_predictor
from .trainer_schemas import (
    BaselineResult, CandidateInnerScore, CandidateSpec, DieboldMariano, ForecastEvaluation,
    HoldoutAccess, HoldoutScores, Interval, LjungBox, MetricWithInterval, PairedComparison, PredictionIntervalCoverage,
    ResidualDiagnostics, ReturnedArtifact, RollingOriginHoldout, RollingOriginResult, RunCost, SeasonalNaiveBaseline,
    TrainerCompleted, TrainerRequest,
)

FArr = npt.NDArray[np.float64]
IntArr = npt.NDArray[np.int64]
LB_VETO_P = 0.05


def _mwi(metric: str, value: float, lo: float, hi: float, n: int) -> MetricWithInterval:
    return MetricWithInterval(metric=metric, value=float(value), interval=Interval(level=0.95, lower=float(lo), upper=float(hi)), n=n)


def _season(req: TrainerRequest) -> int:
    for b in req.protocol.baselines:
        if isinstance(b, SeasonalNaiveBaseline):
            return b.season
    return 1


class _Fitter:
    """Fits one candidate on a window and forecasts given periods: series drivers on the target alone, tabular
    drivers on the snapshot's lag/exogenous columns (declared by the unit's TemporalSpec, lags >= horizon)."""

    def __init__(self, req: TrainerRequest, snap: SN.Snapshot, enc: EncodedLabel, order: IntArr, season: int, phase: int):
        self.req, self.snap, self.enc, self.order, self.season, self.phase = req, snap, enc, order, season, phase
        self.y = np.asarray(enc.y, dtype=np.float64)[order]
        self.X = snap.frame.iloc[order].reset_index(drop=True)

    def forecast(self, driver: str, hp_name: str, first: int, last: int, test: Sequence[int]) -> Tuple[FArr, FArr]:
        """(forecast, in-window residuals)."""
        t = np.arange(len(self.y), dtype=np.int64)
        if driver in T.SERIES_ALGOS:
            m = T.SeriesModel(driver, self.season, self.phase).fit(self.y[first:last + 1], t[first:last + 1])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            return m.forecast(np.asarray(test, dtype=np.int64)), m.resid
        spec = next(c for c in self.req.candidates if c.name == hp_name)
        idx = np.arange(first, last + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        enc = EncodedLabel(self.y, self.enc.family, None, self.enc.tweedie_power)
        model = fit_predictor(spec, self.snap.columns, self.X, enc, idx, self.req.protocol, self.req.threads)
        fitted = model.predict(self.X.iloc[idx])
        return model.predict(self.X.iloc[list(test)]), self.y[idx] - fitted


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Selection:
    finalist: str
    inner_scores: List[CandidateInnerScore]


@dataclass
class _OuterScores:
    """Scaled errors per series member over every outer origin, the finalist's raw errors, coverage and per-origin rows."""
    scaled: Dict[str, List[FArr]]
    raw_model: List[FArr]
    y_test: List[FArr]
    covered: Dict[float, List[npt.NDArray[np.bool_]]]
    origins: List[RollingOriginResult]


def run_forecast(req: TrainerRequest, snap: SN.Snapshot, enc: EncodedLabel, clock: RunClock) -> TrainerCompleted:
    p = req.protocol
    ho = p.holdout
    if not isinstance(ho, RollingOriginHoldout):   # run.refuse_invalid pairs forecast tasks with rolling-origin holdouts
        raise TrainerFailure("load-snapshot", "a forecast task needs a rolling-origin holdout")
    periods = SN.period_ordinals(snap)
    order = np.argsort(periods, kind="mergesort").astype(np.int64)
    season = _season(req)
    phase = int(periods[order[0]]) % season
    design = _checked_design(snap, ho, order)
    fit = _Fitter(req, snap, enc, order, season, phase)
    h = ho.horizonPeriods
    sel = _select_finalist(req, ho, fit, design, season, clock)
    spec = next(c for c in req.candidates if c.name == sel.finalist)
    accessed_at = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    outer = _score_outer(req, fit, design, spec, periods, order, season, phase, clock)
    E = {k: np.concatenate(v) for k, v in outer.scaled.items()}
    grp = [str(o.k) for o in design for _ in o.test]
    zero = np.zeros(len(E["model"]))
    mae = scores.primary_score("mase", None).aggregate
    R, seed = p.intervals.resamples, p.seed
    gr = run_gate(zero, mae, sel.finalist, E["model"], E["mean"], [("naive", E["naive"]), ("seasonalNaive", E["seasonalNaive"])],
                  None, p.promotion.margin, R, seed, grp, 0.95)

    def mwi(name: str, e: FArr) -> MetricWithInterval:
        lo, hi = IV.bootstrap_ci(zero, e, mae, R, seed, grp)
        return _mwi(name, float(e.mean()), lo, hi, len(e))

    baselines = [BaselineResult(baseline=b, role="dummy" if b.kind == "dummy" else "simple",
                                holdout=mwi("mase", E[{"dummy": "mean", "naive": "naive", "seasonal-naive": "seasonalNaive"}[b.kind]]))
                 for b in p.baselines if b.kind in ("dummy", "naive", "seasonal-naive")]
    dm = T.diebold_mariano(E["model"], E["seasonalNaive"], h)
    ys = np.concatenate(outer.y_test)
    rm = np.concatenate(outer.raw_model)
    secondary = []
    if "r2" in p.secondaryMetrics:
        secondary.append(_mwi("r2", scores.r2(ys, ys - rm), *IV.bootstrap_ci(ys, ys - rm, scores.r2, R, seed, grp), len(ys)))
    cost = clock.compute_seconds()
    return TrainerCompleted(
        status="completed", trainingRunId=req.trainingRunId, codeVersion=code_version.code_version(req.threads, p.seed),
        computeSeconds=cost, innerScores=sel.inner_scores, finalist=sel.finalist,
        holdoutAccess=HoldoutAccess(accessedAt=accessed_at, count=1, finalist=sel.finalist),
        holdout=HoldoutScores(primary=mwi("mase", E["model"]), secondary=secondary), baselines=baselines,
        comparisons={k: PairedComparison(value=v.value, ci=(v.lower, v.upper), beats=v.beats) for k, v in gr.comparisons.items()},
        gate=gate_model(gr.decision), artifacts=_forecast_artifacts(req, snap, enc, fit, spec, season, phase),
        incumbentDiff=None, calibration=None, slices=[], operatingPoint=None,
        cost=RunCost(computeSeconds=cost, tokens=0, usd=0.0, budget=p.budgets, stoppedByBudget=False),
        importance=[], leakageFlags=[],
        predictionIntervalCoverage=[PredictionIntervalCoverage(nominal=lv, observed=float(np.mean(np.concatenate(c))),
                                                               n=int(sum(len(x) for x in c)))
                                    for lv, c in outer.covered.items() if c],
        residualDiagnostics=_final_origin_diagnostics(req, fit, design, spec),
        forecast=ForecastEvaluation(origins=outer.origins, dieboldMarianoVsSeasonalNaive=DieboldMariano(
            statistic=dm.statistic, pValue=dm.p_value, meanDiff=dm.mean_diff, n=dm.n, horizon=h)),
    )


def _checked_design(snap: SN.Snapshot, ho: RollingOriginHoldout, order: IntArr) -> List[T.Origin]:
    """The rolling-origin design for one series; refuses a multi-series snapshot or a manifest whose roles disagree."""
    if len(set(snap.entity_keys)) != 1:
        raise TrainerFailure("load-snapshot", "a rolling-origin backtest takes one series per snapshot")
    n = len(order)
    try:
        design = T.rolling_origins(n, ho.origins, ho.horizonPeriods, ho.gapPeriods, ho.minTrainPeriods, ho.window)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise TrainerFailure("load-snapshot", str(exc)) from exc
    test_pos = {i for o in design for i in o.test}
    roles = [snap.roles[int(order[i])] for i in range(n)]
    if any((roles[i] == "locked-holdout") != (i in test_pos) for i in range(n)):
        raise TrainerFailure("load-snapshot", "row-manifest roles disagree with the protocol's rolling-origin design")
    return design


def _select_finalist(req: TrainerRequest, ho: RollingOriginHoldout, fit: _Fitter, design: Sequence[T.Origin],
                     season: int, clock: RunClock) -> _Selection:
    """Inner origins inside the pre-test window only: Ljung-Box veto, pooled inner MASE, one-SE rule (refpipe)."""
    y, h, gap = fit.y, ho.horizonPeriods, ho.gapPeriods
    first_test = design[0].test[0]
    n_inner = max(1, min(3, (first_test - ho.minTrainPeriods) // h))
    inner = [first_test - 1 - (n_inner - j) * h for j in range(n_inner)]
    errs: Dict[str, FArr] = {}
    lb_p: Dict[str, float] = {}
    for c in req.candidates:
        parts: List[FArr] = []
        try:
            for o in inner:
                test = list(range(o + 1, o + 1 + h))
                fc, _ = fit.forecast(c.driverKey, c.name, 0, o - gap, test)
                parts.append(np.abs(y[test] - fc) / T.mase_scale(y[: o - gap + 1], season))
            _, resid = fit.forecast(c.driverKey, c.name, 0, first_test - 1 - gap, [first_test])
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise TrainerFailure("inner-cv", f"candidate '{c.name}': {exc}") from exc
        errs[c.name] = np.concatenate(parts)
        lb_p[c.name] = T.ljung_box(resid, max(1, min(24, len(resid) // 5)))[1]
        clock.check(f"inner origins of '{c.name}'")
    eligible = [c.name for c in req.candidates if lb_p[c.name] >= LB_VETO_P] or [c.name for c in req.candidates]
    best = min(eligible, key=lambda nm: (float(errs[nm].mean()), eligible.index(nm)))
    finalist = next(nm for nm in eligible if float((errs[nm] - errs[best]).mean()) <= T.hac_se(errs[nm] - errs[best], h - 1))
    inner_scores = [CandidateInnerScore(candidate=nm, folds=n_inner, optimistic=True,
                                        inner=_mwi("mase", float(e.mean()), float(e.mean()) - 1.96 * T.hac_se(e, h - 1),
                                                   float(e.mean()) + 1.96 * T.hac_se(e, h - 1), len(e)))
                    for nm, e in errs.items()]
    return _Selection(finalist, inner_scores)


def _score_outer(req: TrainerRequest, fit: _Fitter, design: Sequence[T.Origin], spec: CandidateSpec, periods: IntArr,
                 order: IntArr, season: int, phase: int, clock: RunClock) -> _OuterScores:
    """The outer origins are the locked holdout, scored once for the finalist; each origin trains on its own window."""
    p = req.protocol
    y, h = fit.y, len(design[0].test)
    # E5: one coverage entry per declared nominal level (PredictionIntervalSpec.nominalCoverage is a list).
    levels: List[float] = list(p.predictionIntervals.nominalCoverage) if p.predictionIntervals is not None else []
    out = _OuterScores({k: [] for k in ("model", "mean", "naive", "seasonalNaive")}, [], [], {lv: [] for lv in levels}, [])
    for o in design:
        test = list(o.test)
        ytr = y[o.first_train: o.last_train + 1]
        scale = T.mase_scale(ytr, season)
        try:
            fc, _ = fit.forecast(spec.driverKey, spec.name, o.first_train, o.last_train, test)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise TrainerFailure("holdout", str(exc)) from exc
        yv = y[test]
        fcs = {"model": fc, "mean": T.series_mean(ytr, h), "naive": T.naive_last(ytr, h),
               "seasonalNaive": T.seasonal_naive(ytr, h, season)}
        for k, v in fcs.items():
            out.scaled[k].append(np.abs(yv - v) / scale)
        out.raw_model.append(yv - fc)
        out.y_test.append(yv)
        if levels and spec.driverKey in T.SERIES_ALGOS:
            m = T.SeriesModel(spec.driverKey, season, phase).fit(ytr, np.arange(o.first_train, o.last_train + 1, dtype=np.int64))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            for lv in levels:
                lo, hi = m.interval(np.asarray(test, dtype=np.int64), lv)
                out.covered[lv].append((yv >= lo) & (yv <= hi))
        out.origins.append(RollingOriginResult(k=o.k, lastTrainPeriod=int(periods[order[o.last_train]]),
                                               testPeriods=[int(periods[order[i]]) for i in test], scale=scale,
                                               mase={k: float(np.mean(np.abs(yv - v)) / scale) for k, v in fcs.items()}))
        clock.check(f"origin {o.k}")
    return out


def _final_origin_diagnostics(req: TrainerRequest, fit: _Fitter, design: Sequence[T.Origin],
                              spec: CandidateSpec) -> Optional[ResidualDiagnostics]:
    """S-T.6: residual ACF and Ljung-Box of the finalist at the final origin; None when the protocol declares none."""
    rd = req.protocol.residualDiagnostics
    if rd is None:
        return None
    last = design[-1]
    _, resid = fit.forecast(spec.driverKey, spec.name, last.first_train, last.last_train, [last.test[0]])
    q, pv = T.ljung_box(resid, rd.acfLags)
    return ResidualDiagnostics(acf=[float(v) for v in T.acf(resid, rd.acfLags)],
                               ljungBox=LjungBox(statistic=q, pValue=pv, lags=rd.acfLags),
                               autocorrelationFlagged=pv < rd.ljungBoxAlpha)


def _forecast_artifacts(req: TrainerRequest, snap: SN.Snapshot, enc: EncodedLabel, fit: _Fitter, spec: CandidateSpec,
                        season: int, phase: int) -> List[ReturnedArtifact]:
    """The finalist and the simple members, fitted on the whole series."""
    y = fit.y
    t_all = np.arange(len(y), dtype=np.int64)
    finalist: Union[T.SeriesModel, TrainedPredictor] = (
        T.SeriesModel(spec.driverKey, season, phase).fit(y, t_all) if spec.driverKey in T.SERIES_ALGOS  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        else fit_predictor(spec, snap.columns, fit.X, EncodedLabel(y, enc.family, None, enc.tweedie_power), t_all,
                           req.protocol, req.threads))
    members: List[Tuple[str, Union[T.SeriesModel, T.SeriesBaseline, TrainedPredictor]]] = [
        (spec.name, finalist),
        ("naive", T.SeriesBaseline("naive", season).fit(y, t_all)),
        ("seasonalNaive", T.SeriesBaseline("seasonal-naive", season).fit(y, t_all)),
    ]
    arts: List[ReturnedArtifact] = []
    for name, predictor in members:
        b = artifacts_v2.build(name, predictor, snap.columns, req.task.kind, None, snap.feature_schema_hash, None, None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        arts.append(ReturnedArtifact(candidate=b.candidate, bytesBase64=b.bytes_base64, sha256=b.sha256,
                                     featureSchemaHash=b.feature_schema_hash, classOrder=None))
    return arts
```

```python
def _t2p_cover(seed: int) -> Tuple[float, float, float]:
    """(lower, upper, planted RMSE) for one T2p seed. The planted RMSE of the shipped predictor is its expected RMSE
    under the planted process: sqrt(mean((PopulationMean - prediction)^2) + entitySd^2 + sigma^2 / (1 - phi^2))."""
    planted_spec = scenario_manifest("T2p", seed)["planted"]
    df = scenario("T2p", seed)
    hold = refpipe_carve(df)
    srv = FileServer()
    try:
        m, n = snapshot_files(df, {"UsageZ": NUMERIC, "Discount": NUMERIC}, hold)
        proto = protocol("continuous", innerValidation={"kind": "blocked-time", "folds": 5, "gapPeriods": 1, "groupKey": "EntityKey"},
                         intervals={"level": 0.95, "method": "cluster-bootstrap", "resamples": 1000, "pairedTest": "paired-bootstrap"})
        r = completed(request(srv, m, n, {"kind": "continuous"}, proto, candidates("continuous"), tag=f"t2p-{seed}"))
    finally:
        srv.close()
    shipped = r.gate.shipped or r.finalist
    art = next(a for a in r.artifacts if a.candidate == shipped)
    model, _ = artifacts.load_v2_envelope(base64.b64decode(art.bytesBase64))
    h = df.set_index("ID").loc[hold]
    truth = pd.read_csv(scenario_dir("T2p", seed) / "truth.csv", dtype={"ID": str}).set_index("ID")
    mu = truth.loc[hold, "PopulationMean"].to_numpy(float)
    yhat = model.predict(h[["UsageZ", "Discount"]])
    var_e = planted_spec["entitySd"] ** 2 + planted_spec["sigma"] ** 2 / (1 - planted_spec["phi"] ** 2)
    planted = math.sqrt(float(np.mean((mu - yhat) ** 2)) + var_e)
    shipped_metric = r.holdout.primary if r.gate.outcome == "model" else next(b.holdout for b in r.baselines if b.baseline.kind == "glm")
    return shipped_metric.interval.lower, shipped_metric.interval.upper, planted


@pytest.mark.seeds400
@pytest.mark.gate("T2p -> S-T.5")
def test_T2p_S_T_5_cluster_bootstrap_coverage() -> None:
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(WORKERS) as ex:
        seeds = _limited(seeds400("T2p"))
        out = list(ex.map(_t2p_cover, seeds))
    covered = sum(1 for lo, hi, planted in out if lo <= planted <= hi)
    low, high = _coverage_band(len(seeds))   # 372-388 of 400; scaled only under PS_SEED_LIMIT (M6.8)
    assert low <= covered <= high
```

```python
def panel_residuals(req: TrainerRequest, snap: Snapshot, dev: IntArr, finalist: TrainedPredictor, X_dev: pd.DataFrame,
                    y_dev: npt.NDArray[np.generic], periods: IntArr) -> Optional[ResidualDiagnostics]:
    """S-T.6 for entity panels: pooled within-entity autocorrelation of the finalist's in-sample training residuals
    and a Box-Pierce test (refpipe `_residual_panel`). None unless entities repeat over time and the protocol
    declares residual diagnostics."""
    rd = req.protocol.residualDiagnostics
    ent = [snap.entity_keys[int(i)] for i in dev]
    if rd is None or len(set(ent)) == len(ent) or len(set(periods[dev].tolist())) < 2:
        return None
    resid = np.asarray(y_dev, dtype=np.float64) - np.asarray(finalist.predict(X_dev), dtype=np.float64)
    rhos, ns = TM.panel_acf(resid, ent, periods[dev], rd.acfLags)
    q = float(sum(k * r * r for k, r in zip(ns, rhos)))
    pv = float(stats.chi2.sf(q, rd.acfLags))
    return ResidualDiagnostics(acf=[float(r) for r in rhos], ljungBox=LjungBox(statistic=q, pValue=pv, lags=rd.acfLags),
                               autocorrelationFlagged=pv < rd.ljungBoxAlpha)


def split_contrast(req: TrainerRequest, out: SelectionOutcome, X_dev: pd.DataFrame, enc_dev: EncodedLabel,
                   columns: Sequence[encoding.ColumnSpec]) -> Optional[SplitContrast]:
    """S-T.4: on the same validated rows, the finalist's blocked/grouped out-of-fold score beside the score random-row
    5-fold CV gives them (refpipe `_random_row_contrast`); > 0 inflation (for a loss) is what random K-fold hides."""
    if not isinstance(req.protocol.innerValidation, BlockedTime):
        return None
    primary = scores.primary_score(req.protocol.primaryScore.metric, enc_dev.tweedie_power)
    spec = next(c for c in req.candidates if c.name == out.selection.finalist)
    rand = np.empty(len(X_dev)) if enc_dev.family != "multiclass" else np.empty((len(X_dev), len(enc_dev.class_order or [])))
    for f in FO.repeated_stratified(np.asarray(enc_dev.y), 5, 1, req.protocol.seed, stratify=False):
        rand[f.valid] = fit_predictor(spec, columns, X_dev, enc_dev, f.train, req.protocol, req.threads).predict(X_dev.iloc[f.valid])
    yv = np.asarray(enc_dev.y)[out.validated]
    blocked = primary.aggregate(yv, out.cv[spec.name].oof)
    random_ = primary.aggregate(yv, rand[out.validated])
    return SplitContrast(rows=len(out.validated), blockedGroupedScore=blocked, randomRowScore=random_, inflation=blocked - random_)
```

### M9 — Evaluation Protocol behaviour, holdout and selection  ·  parallel-safe: no  ·  depends on: M8

**Outcome:** an Evaluation Protocol version is validated at save — unit-independent rules on the protocol row
(`no-signal` present, holdout read once, ≥ 5 rolling origins, a dummy baseline, for every author; guard fields never
changed by an agent tool call, and in a lineage set to `GuardFieldsEditableBy: 'human-only'` only by a user, D3-40),
unit-dependent rules wherever a pipeline binds a unit and a protocol (primary-score family = the unit's task kind,
holdout kind fits the unit, lags and rolling windows ≥ the horizon, blocked-time gap ≥ the horizon); no unit pipeline
trains without the protocol version it is bound to, and that row must exist before the run row; the locked holdout is
carved by date on the declared cutoff (optionally up to `holdoutEnd`, optionally with a new-entity report), by a seeded
row hash for units without dated rows, or as the last rolling origins for forecasts — its keys are the snapshot's
`locked-holdout` manifest rows and scoring marks records that were in training; candidates are ranked on inner-fold
means with intervals and every inner score is labelled optimistic, replacing the ranking on the holdout headline
metric (PR 2 already removed the fabricated `cvScore` and the `0.85` fallback, D3-68); the first-three cut is gone and
every approved experiment is a candidate of one search; every experiment
iteration, failed or not, counts against a hard-stopping budget tightened by the protocol's trainer budgets. The legacy
`SnapshotRetrainer.TrainOnSnapshot` branch of the unit path is deleted: every unit run goes through `/trainer`. Closes F-REF-1, F-L4-4,
F-REF-4, F-SEL-1, F-L3-3, F-L4-2, F-TR-5, F-TR-7, F-TR-8. Gates flipped: G2.4 `W2 → S5.2`, G2.6 `C1 → S6.1`, G2.23
`C2 → S2.5`, G2.24 `T2p → S2.6`, G2.25 `C1 → S2.6`, G2.29 `W1 → S5.1`, G2.30 `W1 → S5.3`, G2.41 `W6 → S6.1`.

```ts
} from '../evaluation-protocol-rules';

const human: Actor = { kind: 'human', userId: '5E3B0C2A-6E2F-4C55-9E1A-2B1D7F0A9C11' };
const agent: Actor = { kind: 'agent', agentRunId: '9A1D2C3B-4E5F-4A6B-8C7D-0E1F2A3B4C5D' };
const binary: TaskType = { kind: 'binary', classOrder: ['Lapsed', 'Renewed'], adverseIndex: 0 };
const monthly: TemporalSpec = {
  timeColumn: 'Month', horizonPeriods: 3, lags: [3, 12],
  rollingWindows: [{ endLag: 3, periods: 6, aggregate: 'mean' }], period: 'month', seasonality: 12,
};
const dateCarved: HoldoutSplit = { kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'DecisionDate', cutoff: '2024-01-01', holdoutEnd: null, newEntityReport: null };
const seededRandom: HoldoutSplit = { kind: 'seeded-random', fraction: 0.25 };
const rolling = (origins: number): HoldoutSplit => ({ kind: 'rolling-origin', origins, horizonPeriods: 3, gapPeriods: 0, minTrainPeriods: 24, window: 'expanding' });

/** A unit version as the Prediction Unit parser returns it (shape of the test unit). */
function unit(outcome: TaskType, temporal: TemporalSpec | null = null, fixedDecisionDate = false): PredictionUnitSpec {
  return {
    id: '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555', lineageRootId: '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555', version: 1, name: 'members',
    rows: fixedDecisionDate
      ? { kind: 'grain', grainEntity: 'Members', decisionDate: { kind: 'fixed', date: '2020-01-01' }, filter: [] }
      : { kind: 'grain', grainEntity: 'Members', decisionDate: { kind: 'column', column: 'DecisionDate' }, filter: [] },
    label: { rule: { kind: 'column', column: 'Renewed' }, windowDays: 365, gapDays: 0, outcome, labelVersion: 1 },
    censoring: { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'fixed', at: '2026-01-01' } },
    history: { onUncoveredRow: 'refuse', externalSourceRows: 'ineligible' },
    groupKey: null, temporal,
    decision: { action: 'call the member', actorRole: 'membership team', capacityPerPeriod: null, period: 'month' },
    incumbent: { kind: 'none' }, authoredBy: human,
  };
}

function draftFor(u: PredictionUnitSpec, holdout: HoldoutSplit = dateCarved): EvaluationProtocolDraft {
  return EvaluationProtocolRules.DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft({ Unit: u, Holdout: holdout, Candidates: 3, Seed: 42, Name: 'default' });
}

function protocol(d: EvaluationProtocolDraft, version = 1, authoredBy: Actor = human): EvaluationProtocolSpec {
  return { ...d, id: version === 1 ? 'P1' : `P${version}`, lineageRootId: 'P1', version, authoredBy };
}

describe('ValidateProtocolForUnit', () => {
  it('accepts the default protocol for every task kind', () => {
    const tabular: TaskType[] = [binary, { kind: 'multiclass', classOrder: ['A', 'B', 'C'], adverseIndices: [2] },
      { kind: 'continuous' }, { kind: 'count' }, { kind: 'non-negative', tweediePower: 1.5 }];
    for (const task of tabular) {
      const u = unit(task);
      expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(protocol(draftFor(u)), u)).toEqual([]);
      expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: protocol(draftFor(u)), Previous: null, AuthoredBy: human })).toEqual([]);
    }
    const series = unit({ kind: 'forecast', valueKind: 'continuous' }, monthly);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(protocol(draftFor(series, rolling(5))), series)).toEqual([]);
    const crossSectional = unit(binary, null, true);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(protocol(draftFor(crossSectional, seededRandom)), crossSectional)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('refuses ranking a Tweedie target by RMSE (additional coverage for G2.28 R2-real → S4.4, measured with the evaluation score gates)', () => {
    const u = unit({ kind: 'non-negative', tweediePower: 1.5 });
    const p = protocol({ ...draftFor(u), primaryScore: { family: 'continuous', metric: 'rmse' } });
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(p, u)).toEqual([{ Kind: 'primary-score-family-mismatch', Declared: 'continuous', UnitTask: 'non-negative' }]);
  });

  it('refuses a lag and a rolling window that end inside the horizon', () => {
    const u = unit({ kind: 'forecast', valueKind: 'continuous' }, { ...monthly, lags: [1, 12], rollingWindows: [{ endLag: 2, periods: 6, aggregate: 'sum' }] });
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(protocol(draftFor(u, rolling(5))), u)).toEqual([
      { Kind: 'lag-inside-horizon', Lag: 1, HorizonPeriods: 3 },
      { Kind: 'rolling-window-inside-horizon', EndLag: 2, HorizonPeriods: 3 },
    ]);
  });

  it('refuses a blocked-time inner gap shorter than the horizon', () => {
    const u = unit({ kind: 'forecast', valueKind: 'continuous' }, monthly);
    const p = protocol({ ...draftFor(u, rolling(5)), innerValidation: { kind: 'blocked-time', folds: 5, gapPeriods: 1, groupKey: null } });
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(p, u)).toEqual([{ Kind: 'inner-gap-below-horizon', GapPeriods: 1, HorizonPeriods: 3 }]);
  });

  it('refuses a holdout kind that does not fit the unit', () => {
    const series = unit({ kind: 'forecast', valueKind: 'count' }, monthly);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(protocol(draftFor(series, dateCarved)), series)).toContainEqual({ Kind: 'holdout-kind-mismatch', Holdout: 'date-carved', UnitTask: 'forecast' });
    const tabular = unit(binary);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(protocol(draftFor(tabular, rolling(5))), tabular)).toContainEqual({ Kind: 'holdout-kind-mismatch', Holdout: 'rolling-origin', UnitTask: 'binary' });
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(protocol(draftFor(tabular, seededRandom)), tabular)).toContainEqual({ Kind: 'holdout-kind-mismatch', Holdout: 'seeded-random', UnitTask: 'binary' });
    const crossSectional = unit(binary, null, true);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(protocol(draftFor(crossSectional, dateCarved)), crossSectional)).toContainEqual({ Kind: 'holdout-kind-mismatch', Holdout: 'date-carved', UnitTask: 'binary' });
  });
});

describe('ValidateEvaluationProtocol', () => {
  it('refuses fewer than five rolling origins and a protocol without a dummy baseline', () => {
    const u = unit({ kind: 'forecast', valueKind: 'continuous' }, monthly);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: protocol(draftFor(u, rolling(4))), Previous: null, AuthoredBy: human }))
      .toEqual([{ Kind: 'too-few-origins', Origins: 4, Minimum: 5 }]);
    const b = unit(binary);
    const d = draftFor(b);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: protocol({ ...d, baselines: d.baselines.filter((x) => x.kind !== 'dummy') }), Previous: null, AuthoredBy: human }))
      .toEqual([{ Kind: 'no-dummy-baseline' }]);
  });

  it('lets every non-agent author change guard fields under the default non-agent setting, and refuses an agent tool call', () => {
    const u = unit(binary);
    const v1 = protocol(draftFor(u), 1, { kind: 'system', component: 'default-protocol' });
    expect(v1.guardFieldsEditableBy).toBe('non-agent');
    const margin = { ...v1.promotion, margin: EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(0.01) };
    for (const author of [human, { kind: 'scheduled-job', scheduledJobRunId: 'J1' } as const, { kind: 'system', component: 'shipped-metadata' } as const]) {
      expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: protocol({ ...draftFor(u), promotion: margin }, 2, author), Previous: v1, AuthoredBy: author })).toEqual([]);
    }
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: protocol({ ...draftFor(u), promotion: margin }, 2, agent), Previous: v1, AuthoredBy: agent })).toEqual([
      { Kind: 'guard-field-edited-by-disallowed-author', Fields: ['promotion'], Author: 'agent', Setting: 'non-agent' },
    ]);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: protocol({ ...draftFor(u), guardFieldsEditableBy: 'human-only' }, 2, agent), Previous: v1, AuthoredBy: agent })).toEqual([
      { Kind: 'guard-field-edited-by-disallowed-author', Fields: ['guardFieldsEditableBy'], Author: 'agent', Setting: 'non-agent' },
    ]);
    const seedOnly = protocol({ ...draftFor(u), seed: 7 }, 2, agent);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: seedOnly, Previous: v1, AuthoredBy: agent })).toEqual([]);
    const series = unit({ kind: 'forecast', valueKind: 'continuous' }, monthly);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: protocol(draftFor(series, rolling(4)), 1, agent), Previous: null, AuthoredBy: agent }))
      .toEqual([{ Kind: 'too-few-origins', Origins: 4, Minimum: 5 }]);
  });

  it('in a human-only lineage accepts guard-field changes and the switch back to non-agent only from a user', () => {
    const u = unit(binary);
    const v1 = protocol({ ...draftFor(u), guardFieldsEditableBy: 'human-only' }, 1);
    const job = { kind: 'scheduled-job', scheduledJobRunId: 'J1' } as const;
    const v2 = protocol({ ...draftFor(u), guardFieldsEditableBy: 'human-only', promotion: { ...v1.promotion, margin: EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(0.01) } }, 2, job);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: v2, Previous: v1, AuthoredBy: job })).toEqual([
      { Kind: 'guard-field-edited-by-disallowed-author', Fields: ['promotion'], Author: 'scheduled-job', Setting: 'human-only' },
    ]);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: { ...v2, authoredBy: human }, Previous: v1, AuthoredBy: human })).toEqual([]);
    const relaxed = protocol({ ...draftFor(u), guardFieldsEditableBy: 'non-agent' }, 2, job);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: relaxed, Previous: v1, AuthoredBy: job })).toEqual([
      { Kind: 'guard-field-edited-by-disallowed-author', Fields: ['guardFieldsEditableBy'], Author: 'scheduled-job', Setting: 'human-only' },
    ]);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: { ...relaxed, authoredBy: human }, Previous: v1, AuthoredBy: human })).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('ValidateStoredProtocolColumns', () => {
  it('refuses a stored outcome list without no-signal and an access budget other than 1', () => {
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateStoredProtocolColumns('["model","keep-simple-baseline"]', 2)).toEqual([
      { Kind: 'missing-no-signal-outcome', Declared: ['model', 'keep-simple-baseline'] },
      { Kind: 'holdout-access-budget-not-one', Value: 2 },
    ]);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateStoredProtocolColumns('["model","keep-simple-baseline","no-signal"]', 1)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('ChangedGuardFields', () => {
  it('ignores key order inside a guard field', () => {
    const u = unit(binary);
    const v1 = protocol(draftFor(u), 1);
    const reordered = protocol({ ...draftFor(u), budgets: { hardStop: true, maxCandidates: v1.budgets.maxCandidates, maxTokens: v1.budgets.maxTokens, maxComputeSeconds: v1.budgets.maxComputeSeconds } }, 2);
    expect(EvaluationProtocolRules.ChangedGuardFields(v1, reordered)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('EvaluationProtocolColumnsFromDraft', () => {
  it('writes columns that the protocol parser reads back to the same protocol', () => {
    const d = draftFor(unit(binary));
    const columns = EvaluationProtocolRules.EvaluationProtocolColumnsFromDraft(d, { ID: 'P1', LineageRootID: 'P1', Version: 1, AuthoredBy: human });
    const parsed = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(columns);
    expect(parsed).toEqual({ Ok: true, Value: { ...d, id: 'P1', lineageRootId: 'P1', version: 1, authoredBy: human } });
  });
});
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Engine/src/protocol/__tests__/protocol-versioning.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import type { MJEvaluationProtocolEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import type { BaseEntity } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { EvaluationProtocolRules, EvaluationProtocol, type PredictionUnitSpec } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { EvaluationProtocolVersioning } from '../protocol-versioning';
import type { IEntityFactory } from '../../training/types';

/** Rows saved through the factory are kept in memory; Save() returns true and records the column values. */
class MemoryProtocolRow {
  public ID = ''; public LineageRootID = ''; public Version = 0; public Name = ''; public Description: string | null = null;
  public Holdout = ''; public InnerValidation = ''; public Seed = 0; public HoldoutAccessBudget = 0; public PrimaryScore = '';
  public SecondaryMetrics = ''; public Baselines = ''; public Calibration = ''; public Resampling = ''; public Intervals = '';
  public Promotion = ''; public AllowedOutcomes = ''; public LeakageAudit = ''; public Exclusions = ''; public Slices = '';
  public PredictionIntervals: string | null = null; public ResidualDiagnostics: string | null = null; public RetrainTriggers = '';
  public SearchStrategy = ''; public Budgets = ''; public MinMinorityClassRows = 0; public GuardFieldsEditableBy = ''; public AuthoredBy = '';
  public Saved = 0;
  public LatestResult = null;
  async Save(): Promise<boolean> { this.Saved++; return true; }
}
// The factory returns the in-memory row through the entity type the production code asks for (structural test double).
const rows: MemoryProtocolRow[] = [];
const factory: IEntityFactory = {
  async getEntityObject<T extends BaseEntity>(): Promise<T> {
    const r = new MemoryProtocolRow();
    rows.push(r);
    return r as never;
  },
};

const unit: PredictionUnitSpec = {
  id: 'U1', lineageRootId: 'U1', version: 1, name: 'members',
  rows: { kind: 'grain', grainEntity: 'Members', decisionDate: { kind: 'column', column: 'DecisionDate' }, filter: [] },
  label: { rule: { kind: 'column', column: 'Renewed' }, windowDays: 365, gapDays: 0, outcome: { kind: 'binary', classOrder: ['0', '1'], adverseIndex: 0 }, labelVersion: 1 },
  censoring: { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'fixed', at: '2026-01-01' } },
  history: { onUncoveredRow: 'refuse', externalSourceRows: 'ineligible' }, groupKey: null, temporal: null,
  decision: { action: 'call', actorRole: 'team', capacityPerPeriod: null, period: 'month' },
  incumbent: { kind: 'none' }, authoredBy: { kind: 'human', userId: 'U' },
};

describe('protocol version rows', () => {
  it('creates version 1 as its own lineage root and the next version under it', async () => {
    const draft = EvaluationProtocolRules.DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft({ Unit: unit, Holdout: { kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'DecisionDate', cutoff: '2024-01-01', holdoutEnd: null, newEntityReport: null }, Candidates: 2, Seed: 0, Name: 'renewal' });
    const v1 = await EvaluationProtocolVersioning.CreateEvaluationProtocolV1(draft, { kind: 'human', userId: 'U' }, factory);
    expect(v1.Version).toBe(1);
    expect(v1.LineageRootID).toBe(v1.ID);
    expect(EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(v1).Ok).toBe(true);
    const v2 = await EvaluationProtocolVersioning.CreateNextEvaluationProtocolVersion(v1, { seed: 7 }, { kind: 'agent', agentRunId: 'A' }, factory);
    expect([v2.Version, v2.LineageRootID, v2.Seed]).toEqual([2, v1.ID, 7]);
    expect(v2.ID).not.toBe(v1.ID);
  });
});
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/evaluation-protocol-rules.ts
/**
 * @module evaluation-protocol-rules
 *
 * Save-time and bind-time rules for Evaluation Protocols (architecture C3), the guard-field author rule (under
 * the default `non-agent` setting every author except an agent tool call — a user, a non-agent API caller, a scheduled
 * job, the system — may change holdout, promotion, leakage audit, exclusions, budgets and the setting itself, and
 * every version passes the same validation; a lineage set to `human-only` accepts those changes only in a
 * user-authored version) and the default protocol a pipeline gets when nobody declared one. Pure and browser-safe: the protocol server entity, the pipeline server entity, the training
 * engine, the agent's builder and the Explorer editor call the same functions.
 */
import { Canonicalize } from '@memberjunction/global';
import {
  ALLOWED_OUTCOMES, EvaluationProtocol,
  type BaselineSpec, type CalibrationMethod, type EvaluationProtocolColumns, type EvaluationProtocolSpec, type GuardFieldsEditableBy,
  type HoldoutSplit, type InnerValidation, type IntervalSpec, type ProperScore, type SecondaryMetric,
} from './evaluation-protocol';
import { JsonParse } from './json-value';
import type { Actor, PredictionUnitSpec } from './prediction-unit';
import type { TaskKind, TaskType } from './task-type';

/** S-T.2: a rolling-origin backtest needs at least five origins. */
export const MIN_ROLLING_ORIGINS = 5;

/** The protocol fields `GuardFieldsEditableBy` governs between versions. */
export type GuardField = 'holdout' | 'promotion' | 'leakageAudit' | 'exclusions' | 'budgets' | 'guardFieldsEditableBy';
export const GUARD_FIELDS: readonly GuardField[] = ['holdout', 'promotion', 'leakageAudit', 'exclusions', 'budgets', 'guardFieldsEditableBy'];


export type ProtocolRefusal =
  | { readonly Kind: 'too-few-origins'; readonly Origins: number; readonly Minimum: typeof MIN_ROLLING_ORIGINS }
  | { readonly Kind: 'lag-inside-horizon'; readonly Lag: number; readonly HorizonPeriods: number }
  | { readonly Kind: 'rolling-window-inside-horizon'; readonly EndLag: number; readonly HorizonPeriods: number }
  | { readonly Kind: 'inner-gap-below-horizon'; readonly GapPeriods: number; readonly HorizonPeriods: number }
  | { readonly Kind: 'primary-score-family-mismatch'; readonly Declared: ProperScore['family']; readonly UnitTask: TaskKind }
  | { readonly Kind: 'holdout-kind-mismatch'; readonly Holdout: HoldoutSplit['kind']; readonly UnitTask: TaskKind }
  | { readonly Kind: 'missing-no-signal-outcome'; readonly Declared: readonly string[] }
  | { readonly Kind: 'holdout-access-budget-not-one'; readonly Value: number | null }
  | { readonly Kind: 'no-dummy-baseline' }
  | { readonly Kind: 'guard-field-edited-by-disallowed-author'; readonly Fields: readonly GuardField[]; readonly Author: Actor['kind']; readonly Setting: GuardFieldsEditableBy };

export interface ProtocolValidationInput {
  /** The parsed protocol version being saved. */
  readonly Protocol: EvaluationProtocolSpec;
  /** The previous version in the same lineage; null for version 1. */
  readonly Previous: EvaluationProtocolSpec | null;
  /** Who is saving this version (the row's `AuthoredBy`). */
  readonly AuthoredBy: Actor;
}


/** A protocol before it has a row: everything except the row identity and the author. */
export type EvaluationProtocolDraft = Omit<EvaluationProtocolSpec, 'id' | 'lineageRootId' | 'version' | 'authoredBy'>;

export interface DefaultProtocolArgs {
  readonly Unit: PredictionUnitSpec;
  /** Date-carved (dated tabular units, panels), seeded-random (units with one fixed decision date) or rolling-origin (forecasts). */
  readonly Holdout: HoldoutSplit;
  /** Number of candidates the search will train; sets the random-search size and `maxCandidates`. */
  readonly Candidates: number;
  readonly Seed: number;
  readonly Name: string;
}


/** Row identity of a protocol version being written. */
export interface ProtocolRowMeta {
  readonly ID: string;
  readonly LineageRootID: string;
  readonly Version: number;
  readonly AuthoredBy: Actor;
}

/**
 * Save-time and bind-time protocol rules and the default protocol (static members on one owner, coding standards
 * §2).
 */
export class EvaluationProtocolRules {
  /** Whether an author may change guard fields under a setting (G3.11: never an agent tool call). */
  public static MayEditGuardFields(author: Actor, setting: GuardFieldsEditableBy): boolean {
    return setting === 'non-agent' ? author.kind !== 'agent' : author.kind === 'human';
  }

  /** Unit-independent refusals of one protocol version; an empty list means the version may be saved. */
  public static ValidateEvaluationProtocol(input: ProtocolValidationInput): readonly ProtocolRefusal[] {
    const p = input.Protocol;
    const out: ProtocolRefusal[] = [];
    if (p.holdout.kind === 'rolling-origin' && p.holdout.origins < MIN_ROLLING_ORIGINS) {
      out.push({ Kind: 'too-few-origins', Origins: p.holdout.origins, Minimum: MIN_ROLLING_ORIGINS });
    }
    if (!p.baselines.some((b) => b.kind === 'dummy')) out.push({ Kind: 'no-dummy-baseline' });
    // The setting in force for a new version is the previous version's: a version cannot lift its own
    // restriction, and the setting is itself a guard field.
    if (input.Previous !== null) {
      const setting = input.Previous.guardFieldsEditableBy;
      const changed = EvaluationProtocolRules.ChangedGuardFields(input.Previous, p);
      if (changed.length > 0 && !EvaluationProtocolRules.MayEditGuardFields(input.AuthoredBy, setting)) {
        out.push({ Kind: 'guard-field-edited-by-disallowed-author', Fields: changed, Author: input.AuthoredBy.kind, Setting: setting });
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** Refusals of a protocol used with one Prediction Unit version (pipeline binding and run start). */
  public static ValidateProtocolForUnit(p: EvaluationProtocolSpec, unit: PredictionUnitSpec): readonly ProtocolRefusal[] {
    return [...EvaluationProtocolRules.checkHoldout(p.holdout, unit), ...EvaluationProtocolRules.checkInnerGap(p.innerValidation, p.holdout, unit), ...EvaluationProtocolRules.checkFamily(p.primaryScore, unit.label.outcome)];
  }

  /** Checks of two columns as stored; the Explorer editor previews them before the row is parsed. */
  public static ValidateStoredProtocolColumns(allowedOutcomesJson: string | null, holdoutAccessBudget: number | null): readonly ProtocolRefusal[] {
    const out: ProtocolRefusal[] = [];
    const declared = EvaluationProtocolRules.parseStringArray(allowedOutcomesJson);
    if (!declared.includes('no-signal')) out.push({ Kind: 'missing-no-signal-outcome', Declared: declared });
    if (holdoutAccessBudget !== 1) out.push({ Kind: 'holdout-access-budget-not-one', Value: holdoutAccessBudget });
    return out;
  }

  /** The guard fields whose canonical JSON differs between two versions. */
  public static ChangedGuardFields(prev: EvaluationProtocolSpec, next: EvaluationProtocolSpec): readonly GuardField[] {
    return GUARD_FIELDS.filter((field) => Canonicalize(prev[field]) !== Canonicalize(next[field]));
  }

  /** One plain sentence per refusal, used as the `ValidationErrorInfo` message, the run refusal and in the editor. */
  public static DescribeProtocolRefusal(r: ProtocolRefusal): string {
    switch (r.Kind) {
      case 'too-few-origins':
        return `A rolling-origin backtest needs at least ${r.Minimum} origins; this protocol declares ${r.Origins}.`;
      case 'lag-inside-horizon':
        return `Lag ${r.Lag} reads a period inside the ${r.HorizonPeriods}-period forecast horizon; every lag must be at least the horizon.`;
      case 'rolling-window-inside-horizon':
        return `A rolling window ending ${r.EndLag} periods back reads inside the ${r.HorizonPeriods}-period horizon; its end lag must be at least the horizon.`;
      case 'inner-gap-below-horizon':
        return `Blocked-time inner folds need a gap of at least the horizon (${r.HorizonPeriods} periods); this protocol declares ${r.GapPeriods}.`;
      case 'primary-score-family-mismatch':
        return `The primary score is a ${r.Declared} score but the Prediction Unit's task is ${r.UnitTask}; candidates may only be ranked by a ${r.UnitTask} score.`;
      case 'holdout-kind-mismatch':
        return `A ${r.UnitTask} unit cannot use a ${r.Holdout} holdout: forecasts use rolling-origin, units with one fixed decision date use seeded-random, every other unit a date-carved holdout.`;
      case 'missing-no-signal-outcome':
        return `Allowed outcomes must be exactly model, keep-simple-baseline and no-signal; "no-signal" is missing (declared: ${r.Declared.join(', ') || 'none'}).`;
      case 'holdout-access-budget-not-one':
        return `The locked holdout is read exactly once; the holdout access budget must be 1, not ${r.Value === null ? 'empty' : String(r.Value)}.`;
      case 'no-dummy-baseline':
        return 'A dummy baseline (base rate or mean) is required: it is the "no signal" yardstick of the gate.';
      case 'guard-field-edited-by-disallowed-author':
        return r.Setting === 'non-agent'
          ? `An agent tool call cannot change the guard fields ${r.Fields.join(', ')}; they are set in protocol configuration (UI, a non-agent API caller, a scheduled job or shipped metadata).`
          : `This protocol is set to human-only guard fields: only a version authored by a user may change ${r.Fields.join(', ')}; this version was authored by: ${r.Author}.`;
    }
  }

  /** The proper score a task family ranks by when nobody declared one (architecture C3 "Scores"). */
  public static DefaultPrimaryScore(task: TaskType): ProperScore {
    switch (task.kind) {
      case 'binary': return { family: 'binary', metric: 'log-loss' };
      case 'multiclass': return { family: 'multiclass', metric: 'multiclass-log-loss' };
      case 'continuous': return { family: 'continuous', metric: 'rmse' };
      case 'count': return { family: 'count', metric: 'poisson-deviance' };
      case 'non-negative': return { family: 'non-negative', metric: 'tweedie-deviance' };
      case 'forecast': return { family: 'forecast', metric: 'mase' };
    }
  }

  /** The protocol a pipeline gets when nobody declared one (agent builder, legacy migration, fixtures, Explorer "new protocol"). */
  public static DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft(args: DefaultProtocolArgs): EvaluationProtocolDraft {
    const task = args.Unit.label.outcome;
    const baselines = EvaluationProtocolRules.defaultBaselines(args.Unit);
    const candidates = Math.max(args.Candidates, 1);
    return {
      name: args.Name,
      holdout: args.Holdout,
      innerValidation: EvaluationProtocolRules.defaultInnerValidation(args.Unit, args.Holdout),
      seed: args.Seed,
      holdoutAccessBudget: 1,
      primaryScore: EvaluationProtocolRules.DefaultPrimaryScore(task),
      secondaryMetrics: EvaluationProtocolRules.defaultSecondaryMetrics(task),
      baselines,
      calibration: EvaluationProtocolRules.defaultCalibration(task),
      resampling: { kind: 'none' },
      intervals: EvaluationProtocolRules.defaultIntervals(args.Unit),
      promotion: { comparators: baselines, incumbent: 'current-published', margin: EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(0), lowerBoundLevel: 0.95, pairedOn: 'same-holdout-rows', decisionTable: 'Q13+Q14+Q15' },
      allowedOutcomes: ALLOWED_OUTCOMES,
      leakageAudit: { singleFeatureHeldOutAucMax: 0.95, timeShiftedLabelTest: true, dropColumnTest: true, importanceAggregation: 'per-source-column', highCardinalityIdCheck: true },
      exclusions: { denyFields: [], denySources: [] },
      slices: { outOfTime: args.Holdout.kind === 'date-carved', subgroups: [] },
      predictionIntervals: task.kind === 'continuous' || task.kind === 'count' || task.kind === 'non-negative'
        ? { method: 'split-conformal', nominalCoverage: [0.8, 0.9] }
        : null,
      residualDiagnostics: task.kind === 'forecast' ? { acfLags: 12, ljungBoxAlpha: 0.05 } : null,
      retrainTriggers: [],
      search: { kind: 'random', candidates },
      budgets: { maxComputeSeconds: 3600, maxTokens: 0, maxCandidates: candidates, hardStop: true },
      minMinorityClassRows: 20,
      guardFieldsEditableBy: 'non-agent',
    };
  }

  /** A saved version back to a draft (the next version starts from it). */
  public static DraftFromProtocolSpec(spec: EvaluationProtocolSpec): EvaluationProtocolDraft {
    const { id: _id, lineageRootId: _root, version: _version, authoredBy: _author, ...draft } = spec;
    return draft;
  }

  /** The `MJ: Evaluation Protocols` columns of a draft (the inverse of `ParseEvaluationProtocolRow`). */
  public static EvaluationProtocolColumnsFromDraft(d: EvaluationProtocolDraft, meta: ProtocolRowMeta): EvaluationProtocolColumns {
    return {
      ID: meta.ID, LineageRootID: meta.LineageRootID, Version: meta.Version, Name: d.name,
      Holdout: JSON.stringify(d.holdout), InnerValidation: JSON.stringify(d.innerValidation), Seed: d.seed,
      HoldoutAccessBudget: d.holdoutAccessBudget, PrimaryScore: JSON.stringify(d.primaryScore),
      SecondaryMetrics: JSON.stringify(d.secondaryMetrics), Baselines: JSON.stringify(d.baselines),
      Calibration: JSON.stringify(d.calibration), Resampling: JSON.stringify(d.resampling), Intervals: JSON.stringify(d.intervals),
      Promotion: JSON.stringify(d.promotion), AllowedOutcomes: JSON.stringify(d.allowedOutcomes),
      LeakageAudit: JSON.stringify(d.leakageAudit), Exclusions: JSON.stringify(d.exclusions), Slices: JSON.stringify(d.slices),
      PredictionIntervals: d.predictionIntervals === null ? null : JSON.stringify(d.predictionIntervals),
      ResidualDiagnostics: d.residualDiagnostics === null ? null : JSON.stringify(d.residualDiagnostics),
      RetrainTriggers: JSON.stringify(d.retrainTriggers), SearchStrategy: JSON.stringify(d.search), Budgets: JSON.stringify(d.budgets),
      MinMinorityClassRows: d.minMinorityClassRows, GuardFieldsEditableBy: d.guardFieldsEditableBy, AuthoredBy: JSON.stringify(meta.AuthoredBy),
    };
  }

  /** True when every row of the unit shares one fixed decision date (cross-sectional data, no date to carve on). */
  private static hasFixedDecisionDate(unit: PredictionUnitSpec): boolean {
    return unit.rows.kind === 'grain' && unit.rows.decisionDate.kind === 'fixed';
  }

  private static checkHoldout(holdout: HoldoutSplit, unit: PredictionUnitSpec): ProtocolRefusal[] {
    const task = unit.label.outcome.kind;
    const expected: HoldoutSplit['kind'] = task === 'forecast' ? 'rolling-origin' : EvaluationProtocolRules.hasFixedDecisionDate(unit) ? 'seeded-random' : 'date-carved';
    if (holdout.kind !== expected) return [{ Kind: 'holdout-kind-mismatch', Holdout: holdout.kind, UnitTask: task }];
    if (holdout.kind !== 'rolling-origin') return [];
    const out: ProtocolRefusal[] = [];
    const h = holdout.horizonPeriods;
    for (const lag of unit.temporal?.lags ?? []) if (lag < h) out.push({ Kind: 'lag-inside-horizon', Lag: lag, HorizonPeriods: h });
    for (const w of unit.temporal?.rollingWindows ?? []) if (w.endLag < h) out.push({ Kind: 'rolling-window-inside-horizon', EndLag: w.endLag, HorizonPeriods: h });
    return out;
  }

  private static checkInnerGap(inner: InnerValidation, holdout: HoldoutSplit, unit: PredictionUnitSpec): ProtocolRefusal[] {
    if (inner.kind !== 'blocked-time') return [];
    const horizon = holdout.kind === 'rolling-origin' ? holdout.horizonPeriods : unit.temporal?.horizonPeriods ?? null;
    if (horizon === null || inner.gapPeriods >= horizon) return [];
    return [{ Kind: 'inner-gap-below-horizon', GapPeriods: inner.gapPeriods, HorizonPeriods: horizon }];
  }

  private static checkFamily(primary: ProperScore, task: TaskType): ProtocolRefusal[] {
    return primary.family === task.kind ? [] : [{ Kind: 'primary-score-family-mismatch', Declared: primary.family, UnitTask: task.kind }];
  }

  private static defaultBaselines(unit: PredictionUnitSpec): readonly BaselineSpec[] {
    const task = unit.label.outcome;
    const heuristic: BaselineSpec[] = unit.incumbent.kind === 'rule' ? [{ kind: 'incumbent-heuristic', name: unit.incumbent.name }] : [];
    if (task.kind === 'forecast') {
      return [{ kind: 'dummy', name: 'training-window-mean' }, { kind: 'naive' }, { kind: 'seasonal-naive', season: unit.temporal?.seasonality || 1 }, ...heuristic];
    }
    const classification = task.kind === 'binary' || task.kind === 'multiclass';
    return [
      { kind: 'dummy', name: classification ? 'base-rate' : 'mean' },
      { kind: 'one-feature', selection: 'best-single-feature-inner-cv' },
      { kind: 'glm', family: EvaluationProtocolRules.glmFamily(task), penalty: 'l2' },
      ...heuristic,
    ];
  }

  private static glmFamily(task: Exclude<TaskType, { readonly kind: 'forecast' }>): Extract<BaselineSpec, { readonly kind: 'glm' }>['family'] {
    switch (task.kind) {
      case 'binary': return 'logistic';
      case 'multiclass': return 'multinomial';
      case 'continuous': return 'gaussian';
      case 'count': return 'poisson';
      case 'non-negative': return 'tweedie';
    }
  }

  private static defaultInnerValidation(unit: PredictionUnitSpec, holdout: HoldoutSplit): InnerValidation {
    if (unit.label.outcome.kind === 'forecast') {
      const gap = holdout.kind === 'rolling-origin' ? holdout.horizonPeriods : unit.temporal?.horizonPeriods || 1;
      return { kind: 'blocked-time', folds: 5, gapPeriods: gap, groupKey: unit.groupKey };
    }
    if (unit.groupKey !== null) return { kind: 'grouped-kfold', folds: 5, repeats: 3, groupKey: unit.groupKey };
    return { kind: 'repeated-stratified-kfold', folds: 5, repeats: 3 };
  }

  private static defaultSecondaryMetrics(task: TaskType): readonly SecondaryMetric[] {
    switch (task.kind) {
      case 'binary': return ['auc', 'accuracy', 'f1', 'precision', 'recall', 'calibration-slope'];
      case 'multiclass': return ['accuracy', 'f1'];
      case 'continuous':
      case 'count':
      case 'non-negative': return ['r2'];
      case 'forecast': return [];
    }
  }

  private static defaultCalibration(task: TaskType): CalibrationMethod {
    return task.kind === 'binary' || task.kind === 'multiclass'
      ? { kind: 'auto', thresholdRows: 2000, fitOn: 'disjoint-calibration-fold' }
      : { kind: 'not-applicable', reason: 'regression-task' };
  }

  private static defaultIntervals(unit: PredictionUnitSpec): IntervalSpec {
    const method: IntervalSpec['method'] = unit.label.outcome.kind === 'forecast' ? 'block-bootstrap' : unit.groupKey !== null ? 'cluster-bootstrap' : 'bootstrap';
    return { level: 0.95, method, resamples: 2000, pairedTest: 'paired-bootstrap' };
  }

  /** The strings of a stored JSON array column; a blank, malformed or non-array value yields none (the rule then refuses). */
  private static parseStringArray(json: string | null): readonly string[] {
    const parsed = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(json, 'AllowedOutcomes');
    return parsed.Ok && Array.isArray(parsed.Value) ? parsed.Value.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string') : [];
  }
}
```

  (`parseStringArray` reads the column through `JsonParse.ParseJsonText` and narrows each element with a type
  predicate; the stored column is untrusted text. Guard fields are compared through `Canonicalize` from
  `@memberjunction/global` — JSON with keys sorted at every level, so key order never reads as a change (program
  D-041; no Core-local copy).) Append to `Core/src/index.ts` after `export * from './evaluation-protocol';`:

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Engine/src/protocol/protocol-versioning.ts
/**
 * @module protocol/protocol-versioning
 *
 * Evaluation Protocol version rows, mirroring the Prediction Unit versioning: version 1 is its own lineage root with a
 * client-supplied ID; "editing" saves the next version under version 1's ID. A saved version is never updated (the
 * server subclass refuses it). The guard-field author rule (the previous version's `GuardFieldsEditableBy`) is
 * enforced by the server entity's ValidateAsync from the `AuthoredBy` written here.
 */
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { UserInfo } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { MJEvaluationProtocolEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import {
  EvaluationProtocolRules, EvaluationProtocol,
  type Actor, type EvaluationProtocolColumns, type EvaluationProtocolDraft,
} from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { IEntityFactory } from '../training/types';

/** Evaluation Protocol version rows (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class EvaluationProtocolVersioning {
  private static assign(row: MJEvaluationProtocolEntity, c: EvaluationProtocolColumns): void {
    row.ID = c.ID; row.LineageRootID = c.LineageRootID; row.Version = c.Version; row.Name = c.Name;
    row.Holdout = c.Holdout; row.InnerValidation = c.InnerValidation; row.Seed = c.Seed; row.HoldoutAccessBudget = c.HoldoutAccessBudget;
    row.PrimaryScore = c.PrimaryScore; row.SecondaryMetrics = c.SecondaryMetrics; row.Baselines = c.Baselines; row.Calibration = c.Calibration;
    row.Resampling = c.Resampling; row.Intervals = c.Intervals; row.Promotion = c.Promotion; row.AllowedOutcomes = c.AllowedOutcomes;
    row.LeakageAudit = c.LeakageAudit; row.Exclusions = c.Exclusions; row.Slices = c.Slices; row.PredictionIntervals = c.PredictionIntervals;
    row.ResidualDiagnostics = c.ResidualDiagnostics; row.RetrainTriggers = c.RetrainTriggers; row.SearchStrategy = c.SearchStrategy;
    row.Budgets = c.Budgets; row.MinMinorityClassRows = c.MinMinorityClassRows; row.GuardFieldsEditableBy = c.GuardFieldsEditableBy;
    row.AuthoredBy = c.AuthoredBy;
  }

  private static async saveOrThrow(row: MJEvaluationProtocolEntity, what: string): Promise<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity> {
    if (!(await row.Save())) throw new Error(`Saving ${what} failed: ${row.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
    return row;
  }

  /** Version 1 of a new protocol lineage: its own lineage root, with a client-supplied ID. */
  public static async CreateEvaluationProtocolV1(draft: EvaluationProtocolDraft, actor: Actor, entityFactory: IEntityFactory, contextUser?: UserInfo): Promise<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity> {
    const id = randomUUID().toUpperCase();
    const row = await entityFactory.getEntityObject<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity>('MJ: Evaluation Protocols', contextUser);
    EvaluationProtocolVersioning.assign(row, EvaluationProtocolRules.EvaluationProtocolColumnsFromDraft(draft, { ID: id, LineageRootID: id, Version: 1, AuthoredBy: actor }));
    return EvaluationProtocolVersioning.saveOrThrow(row, `Evaluation Protocol "${draft.name}" v1`);
  }

  /** The next version under `latest`'s lineage: `latest` parsed back to a draft, `changes` applied, saved as a new row. */
  public static async CreateNextEvaluationProtocolVersion(
    latest: MJEvaluationProtocolEntity,
    changes: Partial<EvaluationProtocolDraft>,
    actor: Actor,
    entityFactory: IEntityFactory,
    contextUser?: UserInfo,
  ): Promise<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity> {
    const parsed = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(latest);
    if (!parsed.Ok) throw new Error(`Evaluation Protocol ${latest.ID} does not parse: ${parsed.Errors.join('; ')}`);
    const next: EvaluationProtocolDraft = { ...EvaluationProtocolRules.DraftFromProtocolSpec(parsed.Value), ...changes };
    const row = await entityFactory.getEntityObject<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity>('MJ: Evaluation Protocols', contextUser);
    EvaluationProtocolVersioning.assign(row, EvaluationProtocolRules.EvaluationProtocolColumnsFromDraft(next, { ID: randomUUID().toUpperCase(), LineageRootID: latest.LineageRootID, Version: latest.Version + 1, AuthoredBy: actor }));
    return EvaluationProtocolVersioning.saveOrThrow(row, `Evaluation Protocol "${next.name}" v${latest.Version + 1}`);
  }
}
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Engine/src/protocol/protocol-source.ts
/**
 * @module protocol/protocol-source
 * Loads the Evaluation Protocol version a training search runs under: exactly the version the pipeline's
 * `EvaluationProtocolID` names. Versions are immutable rows.
 */
import { RunView, type IMetadataProvider, type UserInfo } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { MJEvaluationProtocolEntity, MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { EvaluationProtocol, type EvaluationProtocolSpec } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { TrainingRefusedError } from '../training/training-refusal';

export interface LoadedProtocol {
  /** `MJ: Evaluation Protocols`.ID of this version's row. */
  readonly RowID: string;
  readonly Version: number;
  /** The row's `__mj_CreatedAt` (database clock). */
  readonly CreatedAt: Date;
  readonly Protocol: EvaluationProtocolSpec;
}

export interface IEvaluationProtocolSource {
  /** The version the pipeline is bound to, or null when `EvaluationProtocolID` is NULL. */
  LoadForPipeline(pipeline: Pick<MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, 'ID' | 'EvaluationProtocolID'>): Promise<LoadedProtocol | null>;
  /** One exact version row (a run pins this). */
  LoadByID(protocolId: string): Promise<LoadedProtocol | null>;
}

/** Reads protocol rows through the caller's provider (`entity_object`: the parser reads the typed entity fields). */
export class RunViewEvaluationProtocolSource implements IEvaluationProtocolSource {
  constructor(private readonly provider: IMetadataProvider, private readonly user: UserInfo | undefined) {}

  public async LoadForPipeline(pipeline: Pick<MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, 'ID' | 'EvaluationProtocolID'>): Promise<LoadedProtocol | null> {
    return pipeline.EvaluationProtocolID ? this.LoadByID(pipeline.EvaluationProtocolID) : null;
  }

  public async LoadByID(protocolId: string): Promise<LoadedProtocol | null> {
    const result = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(this.provider).RunView<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity>(
      { EntityName: 'MJ: Evaluation Protocols', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(protocolId)}'`, MaxRows: 1, ResultType: 'entity_object' },
      this.user,
    );
    if (!result.Success) throw new Error(`Loading Evaluation Protocol ${protocolId} failed: ${result.ErrorMessage}`);
    const row = result.Results[0];
    if (row === undefined) return null;
    const parsed = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(row);
    if (!parsed.Ok) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'pipeline', reason: { kind: 'protocol-invalid', protocolId: row.ID, errors: parsed.Errors } });
    return { RowID: row.ID, Version: row.Version, CreatedAt: row.__mj_CreatedAt, Protocol: parsed.Value };
  }
}
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Engine/src/protocol/search-guard.ts
/**
 * @module protocol/search-guard
 * "No protocol, no search" (S5.1): a unit pipeline's search resolves its bound protocol version before any run row or
 * candidate exists, refuses more candidates than the protocol's budget allows (F-L4-2: nothing is silently dropped),
 * checks the protocol against the unit, and the run row is checked against the protocol row's creation time on the
 * database clock.
 */
import type { MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { EvaluationProtocolRules, type PipelineRefusal, type PredictionUnitSpec } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { IEvaluationProtocolSource, LoadedProtocol } from './protocol-source';

export type ProtocolRequirement =
  | { readonly Ok: true; readonly Loaded: LoadedProtocol }
  | { readonly Ok: false; readonly Refusal: PipelineRefusal };

/** "No protocol, no search" checks (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class ProtocolSearchGuard {
  public static async RequireProtocolForSearch(
    source: IEvaluationProtocolSource,
    pipeline: Pick<MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, 'ID' | 'EvaluationProtocolID'>,
    candidates: number,
  ): Promise<ProtocolRequirement> {
    const loaded = await source.LoadForPipeline(pipeline);
    if (loaded === null) return { Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'protocol-required', pipelineId: pipeline.ID } };
    const max = loaded.Protocol.budgets.maxCandidates;
    if (candidates > max) return { Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'too-many-candidates', pipelineId: pipeline.ID, candidates, maxCandidates: max } };
    return { Ok: true, Loaded: loaded };
  }

  /** S5.1: the protocol row must exist before the run row (both instants from the database clock). */
  public static ProtocolPrecedesRun(protocolCreatedAt: Date, runCreatedAt: Date): boolean {
    return protocolCreatedAt.getTime() <= runCreatedAt.getTime();
  }

  /** The unit-dependent protocol rules as one storable refusal, or null when the protocol fits the unit. */
  public static CheckProtocolForUnit(loaded: LoadedProtocol, unit: PredictionUnitSpec): PipelineRefusal | null {
    const refusals = EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(loaded.Protocol, unit);
    return refusals.length === 0 ? null : { kind: 'protocol-unit-mismatch', protocolId: loaded.RowID, problems: refusals.map(EvaluationProtocolRules.DescribeProtocolRefusal) };
  }
}
```

```ts
  private async trainUnitPipeline(resolved: ResolvedPipeline, unitId: string, input: TrainModelInput, deps: TrainingDeps): Promise<TrainModelResult> {
    const source = deps.protocolSource || new RunViewEvaluationProtocolSource(this.requireProvider(deps), deps.contextUser);
    // `??`: an explicit empty candidate list stays empty (0), as it does where the candidates are used below.
    const requirement = await ProtocolSearchGuard.RequireProtocolForSearch(source, resolved.pipeline, input.candidates?.length ?? 1);
    if (!requirement.Ok) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'pipeline', reason: requirement.Refusal }); // no run row for a refused search
    const protocol = requirement.Loaded;
    const run = await this.createRunRow(resolved, input, deps);
    run.EvaluationProtocolID = protocol.RowID;
    try {
      if (!ProtocolSearchGuard.ProtocolPrecedesRun(protocol.CreatedAt, run.__mj_CreatedAt)) {
        throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'pipeline', reason: { kind: 'protocol-created-after-run', protocolId: protocol.RowID, protocolCreatedAt: protocol.CreatedAt.toISOString(), runCreatedAt: run.__mj_CreatedAt.toISOString() } });
      }
      // … the input refusals and loadUnitSpec, unchanged …
      const mismatch = ProtocolSearchGuard.CheckProtocolForUnit(protocol, unit);
      if (mismatch !== null) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'pipeline', reason: mismatch });
      // … the unit read and target validation, AssembleForTraining, the protocol's carver, the snapshot builder …
      // … the trainer branch, now unconditional, with protocol.Protocol and:
      //       candidates: input.candidates ?? [the single pipeline candidate],
      //       timeoutSeconds: Math.min(protocol.Protocol.budgets.maxComputeSeconds, input.timeoutSeconds ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)
      //       (`??`: 0 remaining seconds of an enclosing budget is a real value)
```

  `MJEvaluationProtocolEntityServer.server.ts` (M1.4's class) — add the unit-independent rules:

```ts
import { RunView, ValidationErrorInfo, ValidationErrorType, type ValidationResult } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { MJEvaluationProtocolEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { EvaluationProtocolRules, EvaluationProtocol, type EvaluationProtocolSpec, type ProtocolRefusal } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { VersionedRowGuard } from './MJPredictionUnitEntityServer.server';

  // ---- inside MJEvaluationProtocolEntityServer (its Validate() is unchanged) ----
  public override get DefaultSkipAsyncValidation(): boolean {
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Unit-independent protocol rules (C3): ≥ 5 rolling origins, a dummy baseline, and the guard-field author rule
   * relative to the previous version of the lineage. AllowedOutcomes and HoldoutAccessBudget are refused by
   * the entity's Validate(); the unit-dependent rules run where a pipeline binds a unit and a protocol.
   */
  public override async ValidateAsync(): Promise<ValidationResult> {
    const result = await super.ValidateAsync();
    if (!result.Success || this.IsSaved) return result; // a saved version is refused by Validate(); nothing new to check
    const parsed = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(this);
    if (!parsed.Ok) {
      for (const e of parsed.Errors) this.addError(result, 'Version', e);
      return result;
    }
    const previous = await this.loadPrevious(result);
    if (previous === undefined) return result;
    for (const r of EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: parsed.Value, Previous: previous, AuthoredBy: parsed.Value.authoredBy })) {
      this.addError(result, MJEvaluationProtocolEntityServer.refusalField(r), EvaluationProtocolRules.DescribeProtocolRefusal(r));
    }
    return result;
  }

  /** Version − 1 of this lineage (null for version 1); undefined when it could not be loaded (error recorded). */
  private async loadPrevious(result: ValidationResult): Promise<EvaluationProtocolSpec | null | undefined> {
    if (this.Version <= 1) return null;
    const provider = this.ProviderToUse;
    if (!VersionedRowGuard.IsMetadataProvider(provider)) return null;
    const rows = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(provider).RunView<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity>(
      { EntityName: 'MJ: Evaluation Protocols', ExtraFilter: `LineageRootID='${EscapeSQLString(this.LineageRootID)}' AND Version=${this.Version - 1}`, MaxRows: 1, ResultType: 'entity_object' },
      this.ContextCurrentUser,
    );
    if (!rows.Success) {
      this.addError(result, 'Version', `Version ${this.Version - 1} of this protocol lineage could not be read: ${rows.ErrorMessage}`);
      return undefined;
    }
    const row = rows.Results[0];
    if (row === undefined) {
      this.addError(result, 'Version', `Version ${this.Version - 1} of this protocol lineage was not found; versions are created in order.`);
      return undefined;
    }
    const parsed = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(row);
    if (!parsed.Ok) {
      this.addError(result, 'Version', `Version ${this.Version - 1} cannot be read: ${parsed.Errors.join('; ')}`);
      return undefined;
    }
    return parsed.Value;
  }

  private addError(result: ValidationResult, field: string, message: string): void {
    result.Errors.push(new ValidationErrorInfo(field, message, null, ValidationErrorType.Failure));
    result.Success = false;
  }

  /** The column a refusal is reported on. */
  private static refusalField(r: ProtocolRefusal): string {
    switch (r.Kind) {
      case 'too-few-origins':
      case 'holdout-kind-mismatch':
      case 'lag-inside-horizon':
      case 'rolling-window-inside-horizon':
        return 'Holdout';
      case 'inner-gap-below-horizon':
        return 'InnerValidation';
      case 'primary-score-family-mismatch':
        return 'PrimaryScore';
      case 'missing-no-signal-outcome':
        return 'AllowedOutcomes';
      case 'holdout-access-budget-not-one':
        return 'HoldoutAccessBudget';
      case 'no-dummy-baseline':
        return 'Baselines';
      case 'guard-field-edited-by-disallowed-author':
        return 'AuthoredBy';
    }
  }
```

  fixtures bind one (every fixture keeps PR 2's `h: TruthHarness` parameter, M2.7). `TruthSuite/src/fixtures/unit-fixtures.ts`:

```ts
import type { HoldoutSplit, InnerValidation, SliceSpec, TaskType } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { EvaluationProtocolRules, HoldoutCarve, type EvaluationProtocolDraft, type PredictionUnitSpec } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { EvaluationProtocolVersioning, PredictionUnitRowReader, RunViewDataAccess } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio';

/** Which protocol a fixture pipeline is bound to. */
export type ProtocolChoice =
  /** date-carved on the decision date at the reference year cutoff (YearCutoff over the unit's resolved decision dates). */
  | { readonly Kind: 'year-cutoff'; readonly NewEntityFraction?: number }
  /** a seeded row-hash holdout for units with one fixed decision date. */
  | { readonly Kind: 'seeded-random'; readonly Fraction: number }
  | { readonly Kind: 'explicit'; readonly Holdout: HoldoutSplit; readonly InnerValidation?: InnerValidation; readonly Slices?: SliceSpec }
  /** no protocol: the pipeline is refused before training (G2.29's refusal half). */
  | { readonly Kind: 'none' };

// ---- private statics of `UnitFixtures` ----
/** Columns an incumbent expression names (identifiers other than and/or); the incumbent-expression grammar. */
private static expressionColumns(expression: string): readonly string[] {
  return (expression.match(/[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*/g) ?? []).filter((t) => t !== 'and' && t !== 'or');
}

/** The draft protocol a fixture pipeline is bound to, per `ProtocolChoice`. */
private static async protocolDraft(h: TruthHarness, unit: PredictionUnitSpec, features: readonly string[], choice: Exclude<ProtocolChoice, { Kind: 'none' }>, name: string): Promise<EvaluationProtocolDraft> {
  let holdout: HoldoutSplit;
  if (choice.Kind === 'explicit') {
    holdout = choice.Holdout;
  } else if (choice.Kind === 'seeded-random') {
    holdout = { kind: 'seeded-random', fraction: choice.Fraction };
  } else {
    const read = await new PredictionUnitRowReader().Read(unit, { DataAccess: new RunViewDataAccess(h.User, h.Provider), Metadata: new ProviderAssemblyMetadata(h.Provider), Read: { mode: 'complete' }, Now: new Date() });
    if (read.Status !== 'read') throw new Error(`unit refused while choosing the cutoff: ${JSON.stringify(read.Refusal)}`);
    holdout = {
      kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'DecisionDate', cutoff: HoldoutCarve.YearCutoff(read.Rows.map((r) => r.DecisionDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10)), 0.25), holdoutEnd: null,
      newEntityReport: choice.NewEntityFraction === undefined ? null : { groupKey: unit.groupKey || 'EntityKey', holdoutFraction: choice.NewEntityFraction },
    };
  }
  const base = EvaluationProtocolRules.DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft({ Unit: unit, Holdout: holdout, Candidates: 1, Seed: 0, Name: name });
  // The snapshot refuses an incumbent expression naming a column the pipeline does not assemble: keep the
  // heuristic comparator only when every column it names is one of the pipeline's features.
  const usable = unit.incumbent.kind === 'rule' && UnitFixtures.expressionColumns(unit.incumbent.scoreExpression).every((c) => features.includes(c));
  const baselines = usable ? base.baselines : base.baselines.filter((b) => b.kind !== 'incumbent-heuristic');
  return {
    ...base, baselines, promotion: { ...base.promotion, comparators: baselines },
    ...(choice.Kind === 'explicit' && choice.InnerValidation ? { innerValidation: choice.InnerValidation } : {}),
    ...(choice.Kind === 'explicit' && choice.Slices ? { slices: choice.Slices } : {}),
  };
}
```

```ts
/** A planted scenario whose rows carry a date column (`T`): one row per scenario row, decided at that date. */
public static DatedScenarioUnitDraft(h: TruthHarness, scenario: string, task: TaskType, dateColumn: string, groupKey: string | null): PredictionUnitDraft {
  return {
    Name: `${scenario} (${task.kind}, dated)`, Description: null,
    UnitRows: { kind: 'grain', grainEntity: UnitFixtures.TruthEntityName(h, `Scn_${scenario.replace('-', '')}`), decisionDate: { kind: 'column', column: dateColumn }, filter: [] },
    LabelRule: { kind: 'column', column: 'Target' }, LabelWindowDays: 1, LabelGapDays: 0, TaskType: task,
    // Planted outcomes are fully observed: a cutoff after every scenario date censors nothing.
    Censoring: { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'fixed', at: '2099-12-31' } },
    ChangeHistoryPolicy: { onUncoveredRow: 'refuse', externalSourceRows: 'ineligible' }, GroupKey: groupKey, TemporalSpec: null,
    DecisionSpec: { action: 'scenario', actorRole: 'test', capacityPerPeriod: null, period: 'year' }, IncumbentHeuristic: { kind: 'none' },
  };
}

/** The scenario table's feature columns: every field except keys, the date, the target and planted-truth columns. */
public static ScenarioFeatureColumns(h: TruthHarness, scenario: string, dateColumn: string | null): readonly string[] {
  const entity = h.Provider.EntityByName(UnitFixtures.TruthEntityName(h, `Scn_${scenario.replace('-', '')}`));
  if (!entity) throw new Error(`scenario ${scenario} is not registered`);
  const skip = new Set(['ID', 'EntityKey', 'Target', 'TruthScore', 'WorldID', 'Seed', ...(dateColumn ? [dateColumn] : [])]);
  return entity.Fields.filter((f) => !f.IsPrimaryKey && !skip.has(f.Name) && !f.Name.startsWith('__mj') && !f.Name.startsWith('True')).map((f) => f.Name);
}

/** A scenario pipeline, dated (`dateColumn`) or with one fixed decision date, bound to `o.protocol`. */
public static ProvisionScenarioUnitPipeline(h: TruthHarness, scenario: string, task: TaskType, o: { readonly dateColumn: string | null; readonly groupKey: string | null; readonly protocol: ProtocolChoice }): Promise<ProvisionedUnitPipeline> {
  return UnitFixtures.provision(
    h,
    o.dateColumn === null ? UnitFixtures.ScenarioUnitDraft(h, scenario, task) : UnitFixtures.DatedScenarioUnitDraft(h, scenario, task, o.dateColumn, o.groupKey),
    UnitFixtures.ScenarioFeatureColumns(h, scenario, o.dateColumn),
    task.kind === 'binary' || task.kind === 'multiclass' ? 'Logistic Regression' : 'Ridge Regression',
    o.protocol,
  );
}
```
