```ts
// packages/TestingFramework/integration-test-suite/rigs/ps-train-pipeline-check.ts
/**
 * Runtime check: trains one pipeline in-process through the production engine wiring and prints the run summary
 * (or the typed refusal). Usage:
 *   PS_INTEGRATION=1 npx tsx packages/TestingFramework/integration-test-suite/rigs/ps-train-pipeline-check.ts <pipelineId>
 */
import { BootstrapAI } from './lib/ai-bootstrap';
import '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { TrainingDelegation, TrainingRefusedError } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio';

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const pipelineId = process.argv[2];
  if (!pipelineId) {
    console.error('usage: ps-train-pipeline-check.ts <pipelineId>');
    process.exit(2);
  }
  const { provider, user, pool } = await BootstrapAI();
  try {
    const result = await TrainingDelegation.TrainModelViaEngine({ pipelineId }, provider, user);
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ runId: result.run.ID, status: result.run.Status, modelId: result.model?.ID ?? null, evaluationProtocolId: result.run.EvaluationProtocolID, trainingSnapshotId: result.run.TrainingSnapshotID }));
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof TrainingRefusedError) {
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ refused: e.Refusal }));
      return;
    }
    throw e;
  } finally {
    await pool.close();
  }
}

void main();
```

`carve: HoldoutCarveSummary | null`.

The holdout replaces the legacy `LockedHoldoutFraction` carve — on `next` PR 2's seeded, label-stratified random
sample of a primary-key-ordered read (`LockedHoldoutSplitter.Carve`, anchor `m9-trailing-holdout`), which removed the
trailing slice F-REF-1 measured but is still not out of time (D3-70) — with a carve that depends only on dates, keys and
the protocol: out-of-time by construction for dated units (F-L4-4), a stored set of keys
(the manifest's `locked-holdout` rows), and scoring tells a caller which records were in training (F-REF-4).
Decisions: the holdout is every row whose carve date is **≥ cutoff** and **< holdoutEnd** when set (the reference
pipeline's `date_carve`, ties at the cutoff go to the test set; `holdoutEnd` reproduces C1's test-year carve, 1,205 keys,
370 later rows excluded); rows outside the carve are left out of the snapshot and counted; the carve date is the unit
row's decision date when `dateColumn` is `DecisionDate`, else the unit row's own `dateColumn` field (W6 carves on
`StartDate`); units with one fixed decision date (cross-sectional scenarios) cannot be carved by date and use
`seeded-random`: a row is in the holdout when the FNV-1a hash of `<seed>:<rowId>` falls below `fraction` — independent
of read order and reproducible (D3-36); forecasts hold out the last `origins × horizonPeriods` periods.

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/__tests__/holdout-carve.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import type { HoldoutSplit, SnapshotRowKey } from '../index';
import {
  HoldoutCarve,
  type CarveRow,
} from '../holdout-carve';

type DateCarved = Extract<HoldoutSplit, { readonly kind: 'date-carved' }>;
const row = (id: string, entity: string, date: string, label: string | null = 'Renewed'): CarveRow => ({ RowId: id, EntityKey: entity, CarveDate: date, Label: label });
const holdout = (cutoff: string, end: string | null = null, newEntityFraction: number | null = null): DateCarved => ({
  kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'DecisionDate', cutoff, holdoutEnd: end,
  newEntityReport: newEntityFraction === null ? null : { groupKey: 'PersonID', holdoutFraction: newEntityFraction },
});

/** Four members, one row per membership year 2019–2025 (C1's shape: person × year). */
function personYears(): CarveRow[] {
  const rows: CarveRow[] = [];
  for (const person of ['P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4']) for (let year = 2019; year <= 2025; year++) rows.push(row(`${person}:${year}`, person, `${year}-01-01`, year % 3 === 0 ? 'Lapsed' : 'Renewed'));
  return rows;
}

describe('CarveLockedHoldout (C1 → S6.1, F-REF-1, F-L4-4)', () => {
  it('holds out every row from the cutoff up to the holdout end and trains on rows before the cutoff only', () => {
    const r = HoldoutCarve.CarveLockedHoldout(personYears(), holdout('2024-01-01', '2025-01-01'));
    if (!r.Ok) throw new Error('expected a carve');
    expect([...r.Deployment.HoldoutRowIds].sort()).toEqual(['P1:2024', 'P2:2024', 'P3:2024', 'P4:2024']);
    const developmentIds = r.Deployment.Rows.filter((x) => x.Role === 'development').map((x) => x.RowId);
    expect(developmentIds).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(developmentIds.every((id) => Number(id.split(':')[1]) < 2024)).toBe(true);
    expect(r.Deployment.ExcludedAfterHoldoutEnd).toBe(4);
  });
  it('sends a row dated exactly at the cutoff to the holdout (the reference date_carve)', () => {
    const r = HoldoutCarve.CarveLockedHoldout([row('a', 'P1', '2023-12-31'), row('b', 'P1', '2024-01-01')], holdout('2024-01-01'));
    expect(r.Ok && r.Deployment.HoldoutRowIds).toEqual(['b']);
  });
  it('does not depend on the order rows were read in (no trailing slice of a key-ordered scan)', () => {
    const rows = personYears();
    expect(HoldoutCarve.CarveLockedHoldout([...rows].reverse(), holdout('2024-01-01'))).toEqual(HoldoutCarve.CarveLockedHoldout(rows, holdout('2024-01-01')));
  });
  it('counts holdout classes for the minority-class guard', () => {
    const r = HoldoutCarve.CarveLockedHoldout(personYears(), holdout('2024-01-01', '2025-01-01'));
    expect(r.Ok && r.Deployment.HoldoutClassCounts).toEqual({ Renewed: 4 });
  });
  it('refuses a cutoff that leaves no development rows and an unparseable carve date', () => {
    expect(HoldoutCarve.CarveLockedHoldout(personYears(), holdout('2019-01-01'))).toEqual({ Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'no-development-rows', cutoff: '2019-01-01' } });
    expect(HoldoutCarve.CarveLockedHoldout([row('x', 'P1', 'not-a-date')], holdout('2024-01-01'))).toEqual({ Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'unparseable-carve-date', rowId: 'x', value: 'not-a-date' } });
  });
});

describe('new-entity report (T2p/C1 → S2.6)', () => {
  it('holds out the newest entities whole, with zero keys shared with training', () => {
    const rows: CarveRow[] = [];
    for (let e = 0; e < 10; e++) for (let year = 2015 + e; year <= 2025; year++) rows.push(row(`E${e}:${year}`, `E${e}`, `${year}-06-01`));
    const r = HoldoutCarve.CarveLockedHoldout(rows, holdout('2024-01-01', null, 0.3));
    if (!r.Ok || r.NewEntity === null) throw new Error('expected a new-entity carve');
    expect([...r.NewEntity.HoldoutEntityKeys].sort()).toEqual(['E7', 'E8', 'E9']);
    expect(r.NewEntity.SharedEntityKeys).toBe(0);
    expect(r.NewEntity.TrainingRowIds.some((id) => ['E7', 'E8', 'E9'].includes(id.split(':')[0] ?? ''))).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('SeededRandomCarve and RollingOriginCarve', () => {
  it('assigns the same rows whatever the read order, at about the declared fraction', () => {
    const ids = Array.from({ length: 4000 }, (_, i) => `r${i}`);
    const a = HoldoutCarve.SeededRandomCarve(ids, 0.25, 42);
    const b = HoldoutCarve.SeededRandomCarve([...ids].reverse(), 0.25, 42);
    expect([...a.HoldoutRowIds].sort()).toEqual([...b.HoldoutRowIds].sort());
    expect(a.HoldoutRowIds.length).toBeGreaterThan(900);
    expect(a.HoldoutRowIds.length).toBeLessThan(1100);
  });

    const r = HoldoutCarve.RollingOriginCarve(periods.map((p, i) => ({ RowId: `t${i}`, Period: p })), { kind: 'rolling-origin', origins: 5, horizonPeriods: 3, gapPeriods: 0, minTrainPeriods: 24, window: 'expanding' });
    if (!r.Ok) throw new Error('expected a carve');
    expect(r.HoldoutRowIds).toHaveLength(15);
    expect(r.HoldoutRowIds[0]).toBe('t45');
    expect(HoldoutCarve.RollingOriginCarve(periods.slice(0, 30).map((p, i) => ({ RowId: `t${i}`, Period: p })), { kind: 'rolling-origin', origins: 5, horizonPeriods: 3, gapPeriods: 0, minTrainPeriods: 24, window: 'expanding' }))
      .toEqual({ Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'too-few-periods', periods: 30, origins: 5, horizonPeriods: 3, minTrainPeriods: 24 } });

describe('YearCutoff, HoldoutPeriods, TrainingEntityKeys', () => {
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { DateCarvedCarver } from '../holdout-carver';

const unitRow = (id: string, decision: string, start: string | null): UnitRow => ({
  RowId: id, EntityKey: `p-${id}`, DecisionDate: new Date(`${decision}T00:00:00Z`), WindowEnd: new Date(0), GroupKey: `p-${id}`,
  Period: null, Label: '1', Source: { ID: id, StartDate: start },
});
const assembled = (id: string): AssembledRow => ({ RowId: id, Values: [1], Provenance: [] });

describe('DateCarvedCarver', () => {
  it('carves on the declared date column of the unit row and summarises the carve', () => {
    const rows = [unitRow('a', '2023-12-01', '2023-01-01'), unitRow('b', '2024-12-01', '2024-01-01'), unitRow('c', '2025-12-01', '2025-01-01')];
    const carver = new DateCarvedCarver({ kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'StartDate', cutoff: '2024-01-01', holdoutEnd: '2025-01-01', newEntityReport: null }, 'year');
    const roles = carver.AssignRoles(rows.map((r) => assembled(r.RowId)), new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.RowId, r])));
    expect([...roles.entries()]).toEqual([['a', 'development'], ['b', 'locked-holdout']]);
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/holdout-carve.ts
/**
 * @module holdout-carve
 *
 * The locked holdout (C3 `HoldoutSplit`, S6.1). date-carved: rows whose carve date is on or after the cutoff (and before
 * `holdoutEnd`, when set) are the holdout, earlier rows are development, later rows are excluded and counted; an
 * optional new-entity report holds out the newest entities whole. seeded-random: a row-hash holdout for units with one
 * fixed decision date. rolling-origin: the last `origins × horizonPeriods` periods. Every carve depends only on dates,
 * keys and the protocol, never on read order (F-REF-1). Browser-safe (no node:crypto: FNV-1a is enough for an
 * unbiased, reproducible assignment).
 */
import { OrdinalCompare } from '@memberjunction/global';
import type { HoldoutSplit } from './evaluation-protocol';
import type { DecisionSpec } from './prediction-unit';
import type { SnapshotRowKey } from './assembly-contract';

type DateCarved = Extract<HoldoutSplit, { readonly kind: 'date-carved' }>;
type RollingOrigin = Extract<HoldoutSplit, { readonly kind: 'rolling-origin' }>;

export interface CarveRow {
  readonly RowId: string;
  readonly EntityKey: string;
  /** ISO date the protocol carves on (the decision date, or the unit row's `dateColumn`). */
  readonly CarveDate: string;
  /** The label as text for classification units; null otherwise. */
  readonly Label: string | null;
}

export interface CarvedRow { readonly RowId: string; readonly Role: 'development' | 'locked-holdout' }

export interface DeploymentCarve {
  readonly Rows: readonly CarvedRow[];             // kept rows, sorted by RowId
  readonly HoldoutRowIds: readonly string[];
  readonly DevelopmentRowCount: number;
  readonly HoldoutRowCount: number;
  readonly ExcludedAfterHoldoutEnd: number;
  readonly HoldoutClassCounts: Readonly<Record<string, number>> | null;
  readonly HoldoutCarveDates: readonly string[];
}

export interface NewEntityCarve {
  readonly HoldoutEntityKeys: readonly string[];
  readonly TrainingRowIds: readonly string[];
  readonly HoldoutRowIds: readonly string[];
  readonly ExcludedRowCount: number;
  /** Entity keys present in both sets; computed, and 0 by construction (T2p/C1 → S2.6). */
  readonly SharedEntityKeys: number;
}

/** Stored on a refused run (camelCase wire names, shared with the sidecar). */
export type CarveRefusal =
  | { readonly kind: 'unparseable-cutoff'; readonly value: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'unparseable-carve-date'; readonly rowId: string; readonly value: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'missing-carve-date'; readonly rowId: string; readonly column: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'no-development-rows'; readonly cutoff: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'no-holdout-rows'; readonly cutoff: string; readonly holdoutEnd: string | null }
  | { readonly kind: 'too-few-periods'; readonly periods: number; readonly origins: number; readonly horizonPeriods: number; readonly minTrainPeriods: number };

export type CarveResult =
  | { readonly Ok: true; readonly Deployment: DeploymentCarve; readonly NewEntity: NewEntityCarve | null }
  | { readonly Ok: false; readonly Refusal: CarveRefusal };

/** The carve as stored on the run (`ValidationResults.carve`), read by the gate (holdout class counts, periods) and the UI. */
export interface HoldoutCarveSummary {
  readonly kind: HoldoutSplit['kind'];
  readonly cutoff: string | null;
  readonly holdoutEnd: string | null;
  readonly developmentRowCount: number;
  readonly holdoutRowCount: number;
  readonly excludedAfterHoldoutEnd: number;
  readonly holdoutClassCounts: Readonly<Record<string, number>> | null;
  /** Distinct period starts of the holdout rows at the unit's decision period (one out-of-time slice each). */
  readonly holdoutPeriods: readonly string[];
  readonly newEntity: { readonly holdoutEntityKeys: number; readonly trainingRowCount: number; readonly holdoutRowCount: number; readonly excludedRowCount: number; readonly sharedEntityKeys: number } | null;
}

interface DatedRow { readonly Row: CarveRow; readonly Time: number }


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- private --

/**
 * Locked-holdout carves (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). Ordering is `OrdinalCompare` from
 * `@memberjunction/global` (locale-independent).
 */
export class HoldoutCarve {
  public static CarveLockedHoldout(rows: readonly CarveRow[], holdout: DateCarved): CarveResult {
    const cutoff = Date.parse(holdout.cutoff);
    if (Number.isNaN(cutoff)) return { Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'unparseable-cutoff', value: holdout.cutoff } };
    const end = holdout.holdoutEnd === null ? null : Date.parse(holdout.holdoutEnd);
    if (end !== null && holdout.holdoutEnd !== null && Number.isNaN(end)) return { Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'unparseable-cutoff', value: holdout.holdoutEnd } };
    const dated: DatedRow[] = [];
    for (const row of rows) {
      const time = Date.parse(row.CarveDate);
      if (Number.isNaN(time)) return { Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'unparseable-carve-date', rowId: row.RowId, value: row.CarveDate } };
      dated.push({ Row: row, Time: time });
    }
    dated.sort((a, b) => OrdinalCompare(a.Row.RowId, b.Row.RowId));
    const kept: CarvedRow[] = [];
    const held: DatedRow[] = [];
    let excluded = 0;
    for (const d of dated) {
      if (end !== null && d.Time >= end) excluded++;
      else if (d.Time >= cutoff) { kept.push({ RowId: d.Row.RowId, Role: 'locked-holdout' }); held.push(d); }
      else kept.push({ RowId: d.Row.RowId, Role: 'development' });
    }
    const developmentCount = kept.length - held.length;
    if (developmentCount === 0) return { Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'no-development-rows', cutoff: holdout.cutoff } };
    if (held.length === 0) return { Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'no-holdout-rows', cutoff: holdout.cutoff, holdoutEnd: holdout.holdoutEnd } };
    return {
      Ok: true,
      Deployment: {
        Rows: kept, HoldoutRowIds: held.map((d) => d.Row.RowId), DevelopmentRowCount: developmentCount, HoldoutRowCount: held.length,
        ExcludedAfterHoldoutEnd: excluded, HoldoutClassCounts: HoldoutCarve.classCounts(held.map((d) => d.Row.Label)), HoldoutCarveDates: held.map((d) => d.Row.CarveDate),
      },
      NewEntity: holdout.newEntityReport === null ? null : HoldoutCarve.carveNewEntities(dated, cutoff, end, holdout.newEntityReport.holdoutFraction),
    };
  }

  /** The holdout is every row whose FNV-1a hash of `<seed>:<rowId>` (as a fraction of 2^32) is below `fraction`. */
  public static SeededRandomCarve(rowIds: readonly string[], fraction: number, seed: number): { readonly HoldoutRowIds: readonly string[]; readonly DevelopmentRowIds: readonly string[] } {
    const hold: string[] = [];
    const dev: string[] = [];
    for (const id of [...rowIds].sort(OrdinalCompare)) (HoldoutCarve.fnv1a(`${seed}:${id}`) / 4294967296 < fraction ? hold : dev).push(id);
    return { HoldoutRowIds: hold, DevelopmentRowIds: dev };
  }

  /** The last `origins × horizonPeriods` distinct periods are the holdout (the trainer's outer origins). */
  public static RollingOriginCarve(
    rows: readonly { readonly RowId: string; readonly Period: string }[],
    holdout: RollingOrigin,
  ): { readonly Ok: true; readonly HoldoutRowIds: readonly string[]; readonly HoldoutPeriods: readonly string[] } | { readonly Ok: false; readonly Refusal: CarveRefusal } {
    const periods = [...new Set(rows.map((r) => r.Period))].sort(OrdinalCompare);
    const testCount = holdout.origins * holdout.horizonPeriods;
    if (periods.length - testCount - holdout.gapPeriods < holdout.minTrainPeriods) {
      return { Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'too-few-periods', periods: periods.length, origins: holdout.origins, horizonPeriods: holdout.horizonPeriods, minTrainPeriods: holdout.minTrainPeriods } };
    }
    const test = new Set(periods.slice(periods.length - testCount));
    return { Ok: true, HoldoutRowIds: rows.filter((r) => test.has(r.Period)).map((r) => r.RowId), HoldoutPeriods: [...test] };
  }

  public static DescribeCarveRefusal(r: CarveRefusal): string {
    switch (r.kind) {
      case 'unparseable-cutoff': return `The holdout cutoff "${r.value}" is not a date.`;
      case 'unparseable-carve-date': return `Row ${r.rowId} has carve date "${r.value}", which is not a date; the holdout cannot be carved.`;
      case 'missing-carve-date': return `Row ${r.rowId} has no ${r.column}; the holdout is carved on that column.`;
      case 'no-development-rows': return `No row is dated before the cutoff ${r.cutoff}; nothing would be left to train on. Choose a later cutoff.`;
      case 'no-holdout-rows': return `No row is dated on or after the cutoff ${r.cutoff}${r.holdoutEnd === null ? '' : ` and before ${r.holdoutEnd}`}; there is nothing to test on. Choose an earlier cutoff.`;
      case 'too-few-periods': return `${r.periods} periods cannot hold ${r.origins} origins of ${r.horizonPeriods} periods after ${r.minTrainPeriods} training periods.`;
    }
  }

  /** Earliest 1 January whose trailing block (dates ≥ it) holds at most `maxShare` of rows; at least the last year (refpipe `year_cutoff`). */
  public static YearCutoff(dates: readonly string[], maxShare = 0.25): string {
    const times = dates.map((d) => Date.parse(d)).filter((t) => !Number.isNaN(t));
    if (times.length === 0) throw new RangeError('YearCutoff needs at least one date.');
    const years = [...new Set(times.map((t) => new Date(t).getUTCFullYear()))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const lastYear = years[years.length - 1] ?? new Date(times[0] ?? 0).getUTCFullYear();
    let best = Date.UTC(lastYear, 0, 1);
    for (let i = years.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const start = Date.UTC(years[i] ?? lastYear, 0, 1);
      if (times.filter((t) => t >= start).length / times.length <= maxShare) best = start;
      else break;
    }
    const earliest = times.reduce((m, t) => (t < m ? t : m), Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
    if (best <= earliest) throw new RangeError('The cutoff would leave no training rows.');
    return new Date(best).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  /** The distinct period starts (ISO dates, UTC) of the given dates — one out-of-time slice per period. */
  public static HoldoutPeriods(dates: readonly string[], period: DecisionSpec['period']): readonly string[] {
    const starts = new Set<string>();
    for (const d of dates) {
      const t = Date.parse(d);
      if (!Number.isNaN(t)) starts.add(HoldoutCarve.periodStart(new Date(t), period));
    }
    return [...starts].sort();
  }

  /** Entity keys with at least one development row: a scored record with such a key "was in training" (F-REF-4). */
  public static TrainingEntityKeys(manifest: readonly SnapshotRowKey[]): ReadonlySet<string> {
    return new Set(manifest.filter((r) => r.role === 'development').map((r) => r.entityKey));
  }

  private static carveNewEntities(dated: readonly DatedRow[], cutoff: number, end: number | null, fraction: number): NewEntityCarve {
    const firstSeen = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const d of dated) {
      const prev = firstSeen.get(d.Row.EntityKey);
      if (prev === undefined || d.Time < prev) firstSeen.set(d.Row.EntityKey, d.Time);
    }
    const newestFirst = [...firstSeen.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || OrdinalCompare(a[0], b[0]));
    const held = new Set(newestFirst.slice(0, Math.max(1, Math.round(fraction * newestFirst.length))).map(([key]) => key));
    const training: string[] = [];
    const holdout: string[] = [];
    let excluded = 0;
    for (const d of dated) {
      const inWindow = d.Time >= cutoff && (end === null || d.Time < end);
      if (held.has(d.Row.EntityKey) && inWindow) holdout.push(d.Row.RowId);
      else if (!held.has(d.Row.EntityKey) && d.Time < cutoff) training.push(d.Row.RowId);
      else excluded++;
    }
    const entityOf = new Map(dated.map((d) => [d.Row.RowId, d.Row.EntityKey]));
    const trainingEntities = new Set(training.map((id) => entityOf.get(id)));
    return {
      HoldoutEntityKeys: [...held].sort(OrdinalCompare), TrainingRowIds: training, HoldoutRowIds: holdout, ExcludedRowCount: excluded,
      SharedEntityKeys: new Set(holdout.map((id) => entityOf.get(id)).filter((k) => trainingEntities.has(k))).size,
    };
  }

  private static classCounts(labels: readonly (string | null)[]): Readonly<Record<string, number>> | null {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    let labelled = 0;
    for (const l of labels) {
      if (l === null) continue;
      labelled++;
      counts[l] = (counts[l] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    return labelled === 0 ? null : counts;
  }

  private static periodStart(date: Date, period: DecisionSpec['period']): string {
    const y = date.getUTCFullYear();
    const m = date.getUTCMonth();
    switch (period) {
      case 'day': return HoldoutCarve.iso(Date.UTC(y, m, date.getUTCDate()));
      case 'week': return HoldoutCarve.iso(Date.UTC(y, m, date.getUTCDate() - ((date.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7)));
      case 'month': return HoldoutCarve.iso(Date.UTC(y, m, 1));
      case 'quarter': return HoldoutCarve.iso(Date.UTC(y, m - (m % 3), 1));
      case 'year': return HoldoutCarve.iso(Date.UTC(y, 0, 1));
    }
  }

  private static fnv1a(text: string): number {
    let h = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      h ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
      h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0;
    }
    return h >>> 0;
  }

  private static iso(time: number): string {
    return new Date(time).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}
```

  `Engine/src/snapshot/holdout-carver.ts` — the interface gains the carve summary and the protocol's carvers:

```ts
import {
  HoldoutCarve,
  type DecisionSpec, type EvaluationProtocolSpec, type HoldoutCarveSummary, type HoldoutSplit, type PredictionUnitSpec, type SnapshotRowRole,
} from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { AssembledRow } from '../feature-assembly/as-of/as-of-assembler';
import type { UnitRow } from '../prediction-unit/unit-row-reader';
import { UtcDay } from '../prediction-unit/utc-day';
import { TrainingRefusedError } from '../training/training-refusal';

export interface IHoldoutCarver {
  /** Roles of the rows kept in the snapshot; a row absent from the map is left out of the snapshot (and counted in Summary). */
  AssignRoles(rows: readonly AssembledRow[], unitRows: ReadonlyMap<string, UnitRow>): ReadonlyMap<string, SnapshotRowRole>;
  /** The last carve's stored summary; null for the legacy trailing-fraction carver. */
  Summary(): HoldoutCarveSummary | null;
}

// TrailingFractionCarver gains: public Summary(): HoldoutCarveSummary | null { return null; }

export class DateCarvedCarver implements IHoldoutCarver {
  private last: HoldoutCarveSummary | null = null;
  constructor(private readonly holdout: Extract<HoldoutSplit, { readonly kind: 'date-carved' }>, private readonly period: DecisionSpec['period']) {}

  public AssignRoles(rows: readonly AssembledRow[], unitRows: ReadonlyMap<string, UnitRow>): ReadonlyMap<string, SnapshotRowRole> {
    const carveRows = rows.map((a) => {
      const u = HoldoutCarvers.UnitRowOf(unitRows, a.RowId);
      const day = this.holdout.dateColumn === 'DecisionDate' ? u.DecisionDate : UtcDay.ToUtcDay(u.Source[this.holdout.dateColumn]);
      if (day === null) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'carve', reason: { kind: 'missing-carve-date', rowId: u.RowId, column: this.holdout.dateColumn } });
      return { RowId: u.RowId, EntityKey: u.EntityKey, CarveDate: UtcDay.UtcDayIso(day), Label: typeof u.Label === 'string' ? u.Label : null };
    });
    const carve = HoldoutCarve.CarveLockedHoldout(carveRows, this.holdout);
    if (!carve.Ok) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'carve', reason: carve.Refusal });
    const d = carve.Deployment;
    const ne = carve.NewEntity;
    this.last = {
      kind: 'date-carved', cutoff: this.holdout.cutoff, holdoutEnd: this.holdout.holdoutEnd, developmentRowCount: d.DevelopmentRowCount,
      holdoutRowCount: d.HoldoutRowCount, excludedAfterHoldoutEnd: d.ExcludedAfterHoldoutEnd, holdoutClassCounts: d.HoldoutClassCounts,
      holdoutPeriods: HoldoutCarve.HoldoutPeriods(d.HoldoutCarveDates, this.period),
      newEntity: ne === null ? null : { holdoutEntityKeys: ne.HoldoutEntityKeys.length, trainingRowCount: ne.TrainingRowIds.length, holdoutRowCount: ne.HoldoutRowIds.length, excludedRowCount: ne.ExcludedRowCount, sharedEntityKeys: ne.SharedEntityKeys },
    };
    return new Map(d.Rows.map((r) => [r.RowId, r.Role]));
  }

  public Summary(): HoldoutCarveSummary | null { return this.last; }
}

export class SeededRandomCarver implements IHoldoutCarver {
  private last: HoldoutCarveSummary | null = null;
  constructor(private readonly fraction: number, private readonly seed: number) {}

  public AssignRoles(rows: readonly AssembledRow[], unitRows: ReadonlyMap<string, UnitRow>): ReadonlyMap<string, SnapshotRowRole> {
    const carve = HoldoutCarve.SeededRandomCarve(rows.map((r) => r.RowId), this.fraction, this.seed);
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const id of carve.HoldoutRowIds) {
      const label = HoldoutCarvers.UnitRowOf(unitRows, id).Label;
      if (typeof label === 'string') counts[label] = (counts[label] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    this.last = {
      kind: 'seeded-random', cutoff: null, holdoutEnd: null, developmentRowCount: carve.DevelopmentRowIds.length, holdoutRowCount: carve.HoldoutRowIds.length,
      excludedAfterHoldoutEnd: 0, holdoutClassCounts: Object.keys(counts).length > 0 ? counts : null, holdoutPeriods: [], newEntity: null,
    };
    return new Map<string, SnapshotRowRole>([...carve.DevelopmentRowIds.map((id): [string, SnapshotRowRole] => [id, 'development']), ...carve.HoldoutRowIds.map((id): [string, SnapshotRowRole] => [id, 'locked-holdout'])]);
  }

  public Summary(): HoldoutCarveSummary | null { return this.last; }
}

export class RollingOriginCarver implements IHoldoutCarver {
  private last: HoldoutCarveSummary | null = null;
  constructor(private readonly holdout: Extract<HoldoutSplit, { readonly kind: 'rolling-origin' }>) {}

  public AssignRoles(rows: readonly AssembledRow[], unitRows: ReadonlyMap<string, UnitRow>): ReadonlyMap<string, SnapshotRowRole> {
    const dated = rows.map((a) => {
      const u = HoldoutCarvers.UnitRowOf(unitRows, a.RowId);
      return { RowId: u.RowId, Period: UtcDay.UtcDayIso(u.Period ?? u.DecisionDate) };
    });
    const carve = HoldoutCarve.RollingOriginCarve(dated, this.holdout);
    if (!carve.Ok) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'carve', reason: carve.Refusal });
    const held = new Set(carve.HoldoutRowIds);
    this.last = {
      kind: 'rolling-origin', cutoff: carve.HoldoutPeriods[0] ?? null, holdoutEnd: null, developmentRowCount: rows.length - held.size,
      holdoutRowCount: held.size, excludedAfterHoldoutEnd: 0, holdoutClassCounts: null, holdoutPeriods: carve.HoldoutPeriods, newEntity: null,
    };
    return new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.RowId, held.has(r.RowId) ? 'locked-holdout' : 'development']));
  }

  public Summary(): HoldoutCarveSummary | null { return this.last; }
}

/** Shared carver helpers (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class HoldoutCarvers {
  /** The carver a protocol declares (the training engine's only carver for unit pipelines). */
  public static CarverForProtocol(protocol: EvaluationProtocolSpec, unit: PredictionUnitSpec): IHoldoutCarver {
    const h = protocol.holdout;
    switch (h.kind) {
      case 'date-carved': return new DateCarvedCarver(h, unit.decision.period);
      case 'seeded-random': return new SeededRandomCarver(h.fraction, protocol.seed);
      case 'rolling-origin': return new RollingOriginCarver(h);
    }
  }

  /** The unit row behind an assembled row; an assembled row without one is a programming error. */
  public static UnitRowOf(unitRows: ReadonlyMap<string, UnitRow>, rowId: string): UnitRow {
    const u = unitRows.get(rowId);
    if (!u) throw new Error(`Holdout carve: assembled row ${rowId} is not a unit row`);
    return u;
  }
}
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Engine/src/snapshot/snapshot-manifest.ts
/** Reads a snapshot's row manifest through the file store, verifying the stored SHA-256 first (the snapshot file rule). */
import type { MJTrainingSnapshotEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import type { SnapshotRowKey } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { SnapshotHash } from './snapshot-hash';
import type { ISnapshotFileStore } from './snapshot-file-store';
import { SnapshotIntegrityError } from './snapshot-retrainer';
import { SnapshotFiles } from './snapshot-serialization';

/** Snapshot manifest reads (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class SnapshotManifest {
  /** The manifest rows; a file whose SHA-256 differs from the snapshot row is refused (`SnapshotIntegrityError`). */
  public static async ReadSnapshotManifest(snapshot: Pick<MJTrainingSnapshotEntity, 'RowManifestFileID' | 'RowManifestSha256'>, files: ISnapshotFileStore): Promise<readonly SnapshotRowKey[]> {
    const bytes = await files.Get(snapshot.RowManifestFileID);
    const actual = SnapshotHash.Sha256Hex(bytes);
    if (actual !== snapshot.RowManifestSha256) throw new SnapshotIntegrityError('manifest', snapshot.RowManifestSha256, actual);
    return SnapshotFiles.ParseManifestLines(bytes);
  }
}
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Engine/src/scoring/training-keys.ts
import { RunView, type IMetadataProvider, type UserInfo, type BaseEntity } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { MJMLTrainingRunEntity, MJTrainingSnapshotEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { HoldoutCarve } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { SnapshotManifest } from '../snapshot/snapshot-manifest';
import { StorageProviderSnapshotFileStore } from '../snapshot/snapshot-file-store';

/** Training-membership lookups for scoring (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class TrainingKeys {
  /** Entity keys the model trained on, from its training run's snapshot manifest (F-REF-4). Empty when the model has no snapshot. */
  public static async LoadTrainingEntityKeys(modelId: string, provider: IMetadataProvider, user: UserInfo): Promise<ReadonlySet<string>> {
    const rv = RunView.FromMetadataProvider(provider);
    const runs = await rv.RunView<Pick<MJMLTrainingRunEntity, 'TrainingSnapshotID'>>({ EntityName: 'MJ: ML Training Runs', ExtraFilter: `ResultingModelID='${EscapeSQLString(modelId)}'`, Fields: ['TrainingSnapshotID'], MaxRows: 1, ResultType: 'simple' }, user);
    if (!runs.Success) throw new Error(`Loading the training run of model ${modelId} failed: ${runs.ErrorMessage}`);
    const snapshotId = runs.Results[0]?.TrainingSnapshotID || null;
    if (snapshotId === null) return new Set<string>();
    const snaps = await rv.RunView<Pick<MJTrainingSnapshotEntity, 'RowManifestFileID' | 'RowManifestSha256'>>({ EntityName: 'MJ: Training Snapshots', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(snapshotId)}'`, Fields: ['RowManifestFileID', 'RowManifestSha256'], MaxRows: 1, ResultType: 'simple' }, user);
    if (!snaps.Success) throw new Error(`Loading Training Snapshot ${snapshotId} of model ${modelId} failed: ${snaps.ErrorMessage}`);
    const snapshot = snaps.Results[0];
    if (!snapshot) throw new Error(`Training Snapshot ${snapshotId} of model ${modelId} was not found`);
    const files = new StorageProviderSnapshotFileStore({ getEntityObject: <T extends BaseEntity>(name: string, u?: UserInfo) => provider.GetEntityObject<T>(name, u) }, provider, user);
    return HoldoutCarve.TrainingEntityKeys(await SnapshotManifest.ReadSnapshotManifest(snapshot, files));
  }
}
```

repeated inner fold, refpipe's 1-SE rule, the holdout read once for the finalist); the engine re-checks the trainer's report before anything is stored, and the builder runs one search
over all approved experiments (F-SEL-1, F-L4-2, F-L3-3). The 1-SE rule may pick a candidate other than the lowest mean,
so the check verifies what the protocol guarantees — every candidate scored on every fold with an interval, labelled
optimistic, the holdout read once for the finalist — not "finalist = lowest mean". Metric direction comes only from

```ts
  it('refuses a pruned candidate, a missing interval and a holdout read for another candidate', () => {
    expect(InnerScoreSelection.CheckSelection([...scores, inner('rf', 'log-loss', 0.45, 0.43, 0.47, 5)], 'glm', { count: 1, finalist: 'glm' }))
      .toEqual({ Ok: false, Reason: 'candidate-pruned', Detail: 'rf was scored on 5 folds, the others on 15' });
    expect(InnerScoreSelection.CheckSelection([inner('glm', 'log-loss', 0.4, 0.41, 0.42)], 'glm', { count: 1, finalist: 'glm' }).Ok).toBe(false);
    expect(InnerScoreSelection.CheckSelection(scores, 'glm', { count: 1, finalist: 'xgb' }).Ok).toBe(false);
    expect(InnerScoreSelection.CheckSelection(scores, 'nope', { count: 1, finalist: 'nope' })).toEqual({ Ok: false, Reason: 'finalist-not-a-candidate', Detail: 'finalist nope has no inner score' });
  });
});

describe('LeaderboardFromInnerScores', () => {
  it('carries the interval, labels every inner score optimistic and marks the finalist', () => {
    expect(InnerScoreSelection.LeaderboardFromInnerScores([inner('xgb', 'log-loss', 0.41, 0.39, 0.43), inner('glm', 'log-loss', 0.40, 0.38, 0.42)], 'glm')).toEqual([

      { Rank: 2, Candidate: 'xgb', Metric: 'log-loss', Mean: 0.41, Lower: 0.39, Upper: 0.43, Folds: 15, Optimistic: true, IsFinalist: false },
    ]);
  });
});
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/selection.ts
/**
 * @module selection
 * Candidates are ranked on repeated inner-fold means over development rows only (S5.2, S5.3); every inner score is
 * optimistic and labelled so; the locked holdout is read once, for the finalist (F-SEL-1). The trainer selects
 * in the sidecar; the engine re-checks its report before anything is stored, and the UI ranks with the same direction.
 */
import { OrdinalCompare } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { METRIC_DIRECTION, type MetricKey } from './evaluation-protocol';
import type { CandidateInnerScore } from './trainer-contract';


export type SelectionCheck =
  | { readonly Ok: true; readonly Finalist: string }
  | {
      readonly Ok: false;
      readonly Reason: 'missing-inner-scores' | 'finalist-not-a-candidate' | 'candidate-pruned' | 'interval-missing' | 'holdout-not-read-once-for-finalist';
      readonly Detail: string;
    };


export interface LeaderboardRow {
  readonly Rank: number;
  readonly Candidate: string;
  readonly Metric: MetricKey;
  readonly Mean: number;
  readonly Lower: number;
  readonly Upper: number;
  readonly Folds: number;
  /** Always true: an inner-CV mean of a selected candidate is optimistically biased (S5.3). */
  readonly Optimistic: true;
  readonly IsFinalist: boolean;
}

/** Inner-CV ranking and the selection check (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class InnerScoreSelection {
  public static RankByInnerScore(scores: readonly CandidateInnerScore[]): readonly CandidateInnerScore[] {
    return [...scores].sort((a, b) => {
      const diff = InnerScoreSelection.orderValue(a) - InnerScoreSelection.orderValue(b);
      return diff !== 0 ? diff : OrdinalCompare(a.candidate, b.candidate);
    });
  }

  /** S5.3: every candidate scored on every fold with an interval (0 pruned), the holdout read once for the finalist. */
  public static CheckSelection(scores: readonly CandidateInnerScore[], finalist: string, holdoutAccess: { readonly count: number; readonly finalist: string }): SelectionCheck {
    if (scores.length === 0) return { Ok: false, Reason: 'missing-inner-scores', Detail: 'the trainer returned no inner-CV scores' };
    if (!scores.some((s) => s.candidate === finalist)) return { Ok: false, Reason: 'finalist-not-a-candidate', Detail: `finalist ${finalist} has no inner score` };
    const folds = Math.max(...scores.map((s) => s.folds));
    const pruned = scores.find((s) => s.folds < folds);
    if (pruned) return { Ok: false, Reason: 'candidate-pruned', Detail: `${pruned.candidate} was scored on ${pruned.folds} folds, the others on ${folds}` };
    const bad = scores.find((s) => !(Number.isFinite(s.inner.interval.lower) && Number.isFinite(s.inner.interval.upper) && s.inner.interval.lower <= s.inner.value && s.inner.value <= s.inner.interval.upper));
    if (bad) return { Ok: false, Reason: 'interval-missing', Detail: `${bad.candidate}'s inner score has no valid 95% interval` };
    if (holdoutAccess.count !== 1 || holdoutAccess.finalist !== finalist) {
      return { Ok: false, Reason: 'holdout-not-read-once-for-finalist', Detail: `holdout read ${holdoutAccess.count} time(s) for ${holdoutAccess.finalist}` };
    }
    return { Ok: true, Finalist: finalist };
  }

  public static LeaderboardFromInnerScores(scores: readonly CandidateInnerScore[], finalist: string): readonly LeaderboardRow[] {
    return InnerScoreSelection.RankByInnerScore(scores).map((s, i) => ({
      Rank: i + 1, Candidate: s.candidate, Metric: s.inner.metric, Mean: s.inner.value, Lower: s.inner.interval.lower,
      Upper: s.inner.interval.upper, Folds: s.folds, Optimistic: true, IsFinalist: s.candidate === finalist,
    }));
  }

  private static orderValue(s: CandidateInnerScore): number {
    switch (METRIC_DIRECTION[s.inner.metric]) {
      case 'lower-is-better': return s.inner.value;
      case 'higher-is-better': return -s.inner.value;
      case 'closer-to-one': return Math.abs(1 - s.inner.value);
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
// pipeline-builder.ts — imports, the module constant, then the static and private members of PredictiveStudioPipelineBuilder
import { LogStatus, RunView, type IMetadataProvider, type UserInfo } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { MJMLAlgorithmEntity, MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, MJPredictionUnitEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import {
  EvaluationProtocolRules, InnerScoreSelection, PredictionUnit, TrainingRunResultsParser, HoldoutCarve,
  type CandidateSpec, type HoldoutSplit, type HyperparameterValue,
} from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { ProposedExperiment } from '../experiment/types';
import { EvaluationProtocolVersioning } from '../protocol';
import { PredictionUnitRowReader } from '../prediction-unit';
import { ProviderAssemblyMetadata, RunViewDataAccess } from '../feature-assembly';

/** Baseline member names a candidate may not take; the sidecar refuses them too. */
export const RESERVED_CANDIDATE_NAMES: readonly string[] = ['dummy', 'oneFeature', 'glm', 'naive', 'seasonalNaive'];

// ---- inside PredictiveStudioPipelineBuilder ----
  /** Every approved experiment becomes one candidate of the single search (F-L4-2). Nested hyperparameter objects are dropped. */
  public static BuildCandidateSpecs(experiments: readonly ProposedExperiment[], algorithms: ReadonlyMap<string, { readonly ID: string; readonly DriverClass: string }>): readonly CandidateSpec[] {
    return experiments.map((e) => {
      if (RESERVED_CANDIDATE_NAMES.includes(e.Label) || e.Label.startsWith('heuristic:')) throw new Error(`Experiment label '${e.Label}' is reserved for a baseline member; rename the experiment.`);
      const algorithm = algorithms.get(e.AlgorithmName);
      if (algorithm === undefined) throw new Error(`Algorithm '${e.AlgorithmName}' of experiment '${e.Label}' was not resolved.`);
      const hyperparameters: Record<string, HyperparameterValue> = {};
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(e.Hyperparameters ?? {})) {
        if (value === null || typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'boolean') hyperparameters[key] = value;
      }
      return { name: e.Label, algorithmId: algorithm.ID, driverKey: algorithm.DriverClass, hyperparameters };
    });
  }

  /** Resolve each distinct algorithm name once, in parallel (keys are the names as written in the plan; matched on Name or DriverClass). */
  private async resolveAlgorithms(names: readonly string[], provider: IMetadataProvider, user: UserInfo): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, { readonly ID: string; readonly DriverClass: string }>> {
    const rv = RunView.FromMetadataProvider(provider);
    const resolved = await Promise.all([...new Set(names)].map(async (name) => {
      const safe = EscapeSQLString(name);
      const r = await rv.RunView<Pick<MJMLAlgorithmEntity, 'ID' | 'DriverClass'>>({ EntityName: 'MJ: ML Algorithms', ExtraFilter: `Name='${safe}' OR DriverClass='${safe}'`, Fields: ['ID', 'DriverClass'], MaxRows: 1, ResultType: 'simple' }, user);
      if (!r.Success) throw new Error(`Loading ML Algorithm '${name}' failed: ${r.ErrorMessage}`);
      const a = r.Results[0];
      if (!a) throw new Error(`ML Algorithm '${name}' not found`);
      return [name, { ID: a.ID, DriverClass: a.DriverClass }] as const;
    }));
    return new Map(resolved);
  }

  /**
   * Bind version 1 of a default Evaluation Protocol when the pipeline has none — always before the first candidate
   * trains (S5.1). The date-carved cutoff is the reference year cutoff over the unit's resolved decision dates.
   */
  private async ensureProtocol(pipeline: MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, candidates: number, provider: IMetadataProvider, user: UserInfo): Promise<void> {
    if (pipeline.EvaluationProtocolID) return;
    const unitRow = await provider.GetEntityObject<MJPredictionUnitEntity>('MJ: Prediction Units', user);
    if (!pipeline.PredictionUnitID || !(await unitRow.Load(pipeline.PredictionUnitID))) throw new Error(`Prediction Unit ${pipeline.PredictionUnitID ?? '(none)'} not found.`);
    const parsed = PredictionUnit.ParsePredictionUnitRow(unitRow);
    if (!parsed.Ok) throw new Error(`Prediction Unit cannot be read: ${parsed.Errors.join('; ')}`);
    const unit = parsed.Value;
    let holdout: HoldoutSplit;
    if (unit.label.outcome.kind === 'forecast') {
      holdout = { kind: 'rolling-origin', origins: 5, horizonPeriods: unit.temporal?.horizonPeriods || 1, gapPeriods: 0, minTrainPeriods: 12, window: 'expanding' };
    } else if (unit.rows.kind === 'grain' && unit.rows.decisionDate.kind === 'fixed') {
      holdout = { kind: 'seeded-random', fraction: 0.25 };
    } else {
      const read = await new PredictionUnitRowReader().Read(unit, { DataAccess: new RunViewDataAccess(user, provider), Metadata: new ProviderAssemblyMetadata(provider), Read: { mode: 'complete' }, Now: new Date() });
      if (read.Status !== 'read') throw new Error(`Prediction Unit rows could not be read to choose the holdout cutoff: ${JSON.stringify(read.Refusal)}`);
      holdout = { kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'DecisionDate', cutoff: HoldoutCarve.YearCutoff(read.Rows.map((r) => r.DecisionDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10)), 0.25), holdoutEnd: null, newEntityReport: null };
    }
    const draft = EvaluationProtocolRules.DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft({ Unit: unit, Holdout: holdout, Candidates: candidates, Seed: 42, Name: `${pipeline.Name} — protocol` });
    const row = await EvaluationProtocolVersioning.CreateEvaluationProtocolV1(draft, { kind: 'system', component: 'pipeline-builder' }, { getEntityObject: (n, u) => provider.GetEntityObject(n, u) }, user);
    pipeline.EvaluationProtocolID = row.ID;
    if (!(await pipeline.Save())) throw new Error(`Binding the Evaluation Protocol failed: ${pipeline.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'unknown error'}`);
  }
```

```ts
// packages/Angular/Generic/artifacts/src/lib/components/plugins/ml-leaderboard-rows.ts
/**
 * Leaderboard rows for the ML experiment results viewer. The inner-CV interval is shown; a `cvScore` stored by an
 * older artifact is ignored. `Metric` (canonical) is read before `score`, an unmeasured row has a null score, and
 * without a stated winner rank 1 wins only when it was measured.
 */
export interface LeaderboardEntryInput {
  readonly IterationID?: string;
  readonly Metric?: number | null;
  readonly rank?: number;
  readonly algorithm?: string;
  readonly algorithmName?: string;
  readonly featureSet?: string;
  readonly score?: number | null;
  readonly metricName?: string | null;
  readonly innerLower?: number | null;
  readonly innerUpper?: number | null;
  readonly optimistic?: boolean;
  readonly modelId?: string;
  readonly ModelID?: string;
  readonly isWinner?: boolean;
  readonly cvScore?: number;
}

export interface NormalizedLeaderboardRow {
  readonly rank: number;
  readonly algorithm: string;
  readonly featureSet: string;
  readonly score: number | null;
  readonly interval: readonly [number, number] | null;
  readonly optimistic: boolean;
  readonly modelId: string | null;
  readonly isWinner: boolean;
}

/** Leaderboard normalisation for the viewer (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class LeaderboardRows {
  public static NormalizeLeaderboardRows(entries: readonly LeaderboardEntryInput[]): readonly NormalizedLeaderboardRow[] {
    const rows = entries.map((e, i) => ({
      rank: e.rank ?? i + 1,   // canonical leaderboards are best-first; a missing rank takes the position
      algorithm: e.algorithm ?? e.algorithmName ?? 'Unknown',
      featureSet: e.featureSet ?? '',
      // canonical `Metric` first, then lowercase `score`; an unmeasured row stays null (a score of 0 is a real score)
      score: LeaderboardRows.isNumber(e.Metric) ? e.Metric : LeaderboardRows.isNumber(e.score) ? e.score : null,
      interval: LeaderboardRows.isNumber(e.innerLower) && LeaderboardRows.isNumber(e.innerUpper) ? [e.innerLower, e.innerUpper] as const : null,
      optimistic: e.optimistic === true,
      modelId: e.ModelID ?? e.modelId ?? null,
      isWinner: e.isWinner === true,
    })).sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);
    // Entries that do not say which one won: rank 1 wins, but only when it has a measured score.
    const winnerStated = entries.some((e) => e.isWinner !== undefined);
    if (!winnerStated && rows.length > 0 && rows[0].score !== null) rows[0] = { ...rows[0], isWinner: true };
    return rows;
  }

  private static isNumber(v: number | null | undefined): v is number {
    return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);
  }
}
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Engine/src/experiment/budget.ts
import type { Budget, Budgets } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import type { IEvaluationProtocolSource } from '../protocol';
import { TrainingRefusedError } from '../training/training-refusal';

/** A failed training attempt that still spent compute (the stored `trainer-failed` refusal's `computeSeconds`). */
export class TrainingAttemptFailedError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly ComputeSeconds: number) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'TrainingAttemptFailedError';
  }
}

/** Experiment-session budget arithmetic (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class ExperimentBudget {
  /** The session budget: the plan's (or override's) bounds, tightened by the protocol's trainer budgets. */
  public static EffectiveBudget(planBudget: Budget, protocolBudgets: Budgets | null): Budget {
    if (protocolBudgets === null) return planBudget;
    return {
      MaxRuns: ExperimentBudget.minDefined(planBudget.MaxRuns, protocolBudgets.maxCandidates),
      MaxComputeCost: ExperimentBudget.minDefined(planBudget.MaxComputeCost, protocolBudgets.maxComputeSeconds),
      MaxWallclockMinutes: planBudget.MaxWallclockMinutes,
    };
  }

  /** Compute seconds left before the hard stop, or null when the budget has no compute bound. */
  public static RemainingComputeSeconds(budget: Budget, spent: number): number | null {
    return budget.MaxComputeCost === undefined ? null : Math.max(0, budget.MaxComputeCost - spent);
  }

  /**
   * The trainer budgets of the protocol a pipeline is bound to — what a session over that pipeline passes as
   * `ExperimentRunOptions.protocolBudgets`. A pipeline with no protocol is refused before any iteration exists.
   */
  public static async ProtocolBudgetsFor(
    pipeline: Pick<MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, 'ID' | 'EvaluationProtocolID'>,
    source: IEvaluationProtocolSource,
  ): Promise<Budgets> {
    const loaded = await source.LoadForPipeline(pipeline);
    if (loaded === null) throw new TrainingRefusedError({ stage: 'pipeline', reason: { kind: 'protocol-required', pipelineId: pipeline.ID } });
    return loaded.Protocol.budgets;
  }

  private static minDefined(a: number | undefined, b: number): number {
    return a === undefined ? b : Math.min(a, b);
  }
}
```

```python
"""Extract the reference pipeline's C1 test keys (split.testIds of the truth suite's refpipe C1 result, '<PersonID>:<period index>')
into c1_reference_test_keys.csv (person_id,period_index). usage: python -I extract_c1_test_keys.py <C1.json> <out.csv>"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys


def main(src: str, out: str) -> None:
    with open(src, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        ids: list[str] = json.load(fh)["split"]["testIds"]
    if len(ids) != 1205:   # a real check: `python -O` strips asserts
        raise SystemExit(f"expected 1205 C1 test ids, got {len(ids)}")
    rows = sorted((i.rsplit(":", 1)[0].upper(), int(i.rsplit(":", 1)[1])) for i in ids)
    with open(out, "w", newline="") as fh:
        fh.write("person_id,period_index\n")
        for person, period in rows:
            fh.write(f"{person},{period}\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
```

```ts
// IT/src/checks/ps-gates/ps-gate-evaluation-protocols.ts
/**
 * Evaluation Protocol gate measurements (protocol, holdout, carve). Each trains through MJAPI exactly as a user would
 * (`h.Train`, PredictiveStudio.TrainModel) and reads the stored rows: the run, its snapshot and manifest, its `carve`
 * and `trainer`. Each returns a GateMeasurement.
 */
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { RunView } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { MJEvaluationProtocolEntity, MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, MJMLTrainingRunEntity, MJTrainingSnapshotEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { JsonParse, StoreSchemas, TrainingRunResultsParser, type ClassBalanceEntry, type SnapshotRowKey, type TrainingRunResults } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { SnapshotManifest, StorageProviderSnapshotFileStore } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { C1CorpusFixture, C1_CORPUS_DIR, ContainmentProbe, UnitFixtures, type GateMeasurement, type ProvisionedUnitPipeline, type TruthHarness } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-truth-suite';
import { PsGatePytest, type PytestRunResult } from './ps-gate-pytest';

type Completed = Extract<TrainingRunResults, { status: 'completed' }>;
const W_FEATURES = ['Year', 'Plan', 'EventsAttended', 'IncomeK', 'AutoRenew', 'Region', 'Noise1', 'Noise2', 'Noise3', 'Noise4', 'Noise5'] as const;
const FOLD_NODES = ['tests/test_folds.py::test_grouped_folds_share_zero_keys_and_repeat', 'tests/test_folds.py::test_blocked_time_folds_keep_gap_and_groups'] as const;
const IN_FOLD_RESAMPLING_NODE = 'tests/test_selection.py::test_in_fold_undersampling_never_touches_validation_rows';
type RunTimes = Pick<MJMLTrainingRunEntity, 'ID' | 'EvaluationProtocolID' | '__mj_CreatedAt'>;

/** Evaluation Protocol gate bodies (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class EvaluationProtocolGates {
  /** A pytest half passes when every requested node was collected and every collected case passed (D3-61). */
  private static pytestPassed(r: PytestRunResult): boolean {
    return r.NotCollected.length === 0 && r.Failed + r.Errors === 0 && r.Collected > 0 && r.Passed === r.Collected;
  }

  private static async train(h: TruthHarness, pipeline: MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity): Promise<MJMLTrainingRunEntity> {
    await h.Train(pipeline);
    return UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID);
  }

  private static async stored(h: TruthHarness, run: MJMLTrainingRunEntity): Promise<{ readonly Results: Completed; readonly Snapshot: MJTrainingSnapshotEntity; readonly Manifest: readonly SnapshotRowKey[] } | string> {
    const parsed = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults(run.ValidationResults);
    if (!parsed.Ok || parsed.Value.status !== 'completed') return `run ${run.ID} did not complete (${run.Notes || ''})`;
    if (!run.TrainingSnapshotID) return `run ${run.ID} has no snapshot`;
    const snaps = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(h.Provider).RunView<MJTrainingSnapshotEntity>({ EntityName: 'MJ: Training Snapshots', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(run.TrainingSnapshotID)}'`, ResultType: 'entity_object' }, h.User);
    if (!snaps.Success) return `snapshot ${run.TrainingSnapshotID} could not be read: ${snaps.ErrorMessage}`;
    const snap = snaps.Results[0];
    if (!snap) return `snapshot ${run.TrainingSnapshotID} not found`;
    const manifest = await SnapshotManifest.ReadSnapshotManifest(snap, new StorageProviderSnapshotFileStore(UnitFixtures.EntityFactory(h), h.Provider, h.User));
    return { Results: parsed.Value, Snapshot: snap, Manifest: manifest };
  }

  private static fail(detail: string): GateMeasurement {
    return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: detail };
  }

  /** A pipeline's runs (id, protocol, creation time), read-only; a failed read is a message. */
  private static async runsOf(h: TruthHarness, pipelineId: string): Promise<readonly RunTimes[] | string> {
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(h.Provider).RunView<RunTimes>({ EntityName: 'MJ: ML Training Runs', ExtraFilter: `PipelineID='${EscapeSQLString(pipelineId)}'`, Fields: ['ID', 'EvaluationProtocolID', '__mj_CreatedAt'], ResultType: 'simple' }, h.User);
    return r.Success ? r.Results : `runs of pipeline ${pipelineId} could not be read: ${r.ErrorMessage}`;
  }

  /** Creation time of each protocol row, keyed by upper-case ID, in one read. */
  private static async protocolCreatedAt(h: TruthHarness, ids: readonly string[]): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, Date> | string> {
    if (ids.length === 0) return new Map();
    const list = [...new Set(ids)].map((id) => `'${EscapeSQLString(id)}'`).join(',');
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(h.Provider).RunView<Pick<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity, 'ID' | '__mj_CreatedAt'>>({ EntityName: 'MJ: Evaluation Protocols', ExtraFilter: `ID IN (${list})`, Fields: ['ID', '__mj_CreatedAt'], ResultType: 'simple' }, h.User);
    if (!r.Success) return `protocol rows could not be read: ${r.ErrorMessage}`;
    return new Map(r.Results.map((p) => [p.ID.toUpperCase(), new Date(p.__mj_CreatedAt)]));
  }

  /** W1 → S5.1: every run references a protocol row created before it; a search with no protocol is refused. */
  public static async MeasureW1ProtocolPrecedesRuns(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'world', ID: 'W1-signal', Seed: 42 });
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionWorldRenewalPipeline(h, 'W1-signal', { features: ['EventsAttended', 'AutoRenew', 'IncomeK'] });
    await EvaluationProtocolGates.train(h, pipeline);
    await EvaluationProtocolGates.train(h, pipeline);
    const runs = await EvaluationProtocolGates.runsOf(h, pipeline.ID);
    if (typeof runs === 'string') return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail(runs);
    const created = await EvaluationProtocolGates.protocolCreatedAt(h, runs.map((r) => r.EvaluationProtocolID).filter((id): id is string => !!id));
    if (typeof created === 'string') return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail(created);
    const precede = runs.filter((r) => {
      const at = r.EvaluationProtocolID ? created.get(r.EvaluationProtocolID.toUpperCase()) : undefined;
      return at !== undefined && at.getTime() <= new Date(r.__mj_CreatedAt).getTime();
    }).length;
    const bare = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionWorldRenewalPipeline(h, 'W1-signal', { features: ['EventsAttended', 'AutoRenew', 'IncomeK'], protocol: { Kind: 'none' } });
    const bareAttempt = await h.Train(bare.Pipeline);
    // The refusal's code (Step 1b, D3-60), never its text.
    const refused = ContainmentProbe.WasRefusedBeforeTraining(bareAttempt, 'PROTOCOL_REQUIRED');
    const bareRunRows = await EvaluationProtocolGates.runsOf(h, bare.Pipeline.ID);
    if (typeof bareRunRows === 'string') return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail(bareRunRows);
    const bareRuns = bareRunRows.length;
    return {
      Passed: runs.length === 2 && precede === 2 && refused && bareRuns === 0,
      Measured: { runs: runs.length, protocolBeforeRun: precede, refusedWithoutProtocol: refused, runsWithoutProtocol: bareRuns },
      Detail: `${precede} of ${runs.length} runs reference a protocol created before them; no-protocol search refused=${refused}`,
    };
  }

  /** C1 → S6.1: date-carved after the cutoff, stored keys after it, none in training, equal to the reference's 1,205. */
  public static async MeasureC1DateCarvedHoldout(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    const cutoff = '2024-01-01';
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionC1RenewalPipeline(h, { Kind: 'explicit', Holdout: { kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'DecisionDate', cutoff, holdoutEnd: '2025-01-01', newEntityReport: null } });
    const s = await EvaluationProtocolGates.stored(h, await EvaluationProtocolGates.train(h, pipeline));
    if (typeof s === 'string') return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail(s);
    const holdout = s.Manifest.filter((k) => k.role === 'locked-holdout');
    const development = new Set(s.Manifest.filter((k) => k.role === 'development').map((k) => k.rowId));
    const afterCutoff = holdout.filter((k) => k.decisionDate >= cutoff).length;
    const inTraining = holdout.filter((k) => development.has(k.rowId)).length;
    const periodRead = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(h.Provider).RunView<{ ID: string; PersonID: string; PeriodIndex: number }>(
      { EntityName: UnitFixtures.TruthEntityName(h, 'C1DuesPeriod'), Fields: ['ID', 'PersonID', 'PeriodIndex'], ResultType: 'simple' }, h.User);
    if (!periodRead.Success) return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail(`C1 dues periods could not be read: ${periodRead.ErrorMessage}`);
    const periods = periodRead.Results;
    const keyOf = new Map(periods.map((p) => [p.ID.toLowerCase(), `${p.PersonID.toLowerCase()}|${p.PeriodIndex}`]));
    const actual = new Set(holdout.map((k) => keyOf.get(k.rowId.toLowerCase()) ?? `unmapped:${k.rowId}`));
    const reference = await C1CorpusFixture.ReadC1CorpusCsv(join(C1_CORPUS_DIR, 'c1_reference_test_keys.csv'));
    const expected = new Set(reference.Rows.map((r) => `${r.person_id.toLowerCase()}|${r.period_index}`));
    const matched = [...expected].filter((k) => actual.has(k)).length;
    const extra = [...actual].filter((k) => !expected.has(k)).length;
    return {
      Passed: holdout.length === 1205 && afterCutoff === holdout.length && inTraining === 0 && matched === 1205 && extra === 0,
      Measured: { holdoutKeys: holdout.length, afterCutoff, inTraining, matchedReference: matched, extra },
      Detail: `${afterCutoff} of ${holdout.length} holdout keys after ${cutoff}; ${matched} of 1205 reference keys matched, ${extra} extra`,
    };
  }

  /** W6 → S6.1: out_of_time on StartDate at 2024-01-01 — 6,950 holdout rows, AUC within 0.02 of 0.6447, drift ≥ +0.15. */
  public static async MeasureW6OutOfTime(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'world', ID: 'W6-drift', Seed: 42 });
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionWorldRenewalPipeline(h, 'W6-drift', {
      features: [...W_FEATURES],
      protocol: { Kind: 'explicit', Holdout: { kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'StartDate', cutoff: '2024-01-01', holdoutEnd: null, newEntityReport: null } },
    });
    const s = await EvaluationProtocolGates.stored(h, await EvaluationProtocolGates.train(h, pipeline));
    if (typeof s === 'string') return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail(s);
    const trainer = s.Results.trainer;
    if (trainer === null) return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail('run stored no trainer result');
    const auc = trainer.holdout.secondary.find((m) => m.metric === 'auc')?.value ?? Number.NaN;
    const bins = trainer.calibration?.reliability ?? [];
    const n = bins.reduce((t, b) => t + b.n, 0);
    const drift = n === 0 ? Number.NaN : bins.reduce((t, b) => t + b.n * (b.meanPredicted - b.observedRate), 0) / n;
    return {
      Passed: s.Snapshot.HoldoutRowCount === 6950 && Math.abs(auc - 0.6447) <= 0.02 && drift >= 0.15,
      Measured: { holdoutRows: s.Snapshot.HoldoutRowCount, auc, meanPredictedMinusObserved: drift },
      Detail: `holdout ${s.Snapshot.HoldoutRowCount} rows, AUC ${auc.toFixed(4)}, predicted − observed ${drift.toFixed(3)}`,
    };
  }

  /** Wilson 95% interval for a rate p observed on n rows. */
  private static wilson(p: number, n: number): readonly [number, number] {
    const z = 1.96;
    const centre = (p + (z * z) / (2 * n)) / (1 + (z * z) / n);
    const half = (z * Math.sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / n + (z * z) / (4 * n * n))) / (1 + (z * z) / n);
    return [centre - half, centre + half];
  }

  /** C2 → S2.5: holdout positive rate inside the population interval; resampling only in-fold; 0 row ids shared. */
  public static async MeasureC2HoldoutRate(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'scenario', ID: 'C2', Seed: UnitFixtures.ScenarioBaseSeed('C2') });
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionScenarioUnitPipeline(h, 'C2', { kind: 'binary', classOrder: ['0', '1'], adverseIndex: 1 }, { dateColumn: null, groupKey: null, protocol: { Kind: 'seeded-random', Fraction: 0.25 } });
    const s = await EvaluationProtocolGates.stored(h, await EvaluationProtocolGates.train(h, pipeline));
    if (typeof s === 'string') return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail(s);
    const carve = s.Results.carve;
    const balanceJson = s.Snapshot.ClassBalance ? JsonParse.ParseJsonText(s.Snapshot.ClassBalance, 'ClassBalance') : null;
    if (balanceJson !== null && !balanceJson.Ok) return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail(`snapshot ${s.Snapshot.ID} ClassBalance is not JSON: ${balanceJson.Errors.join('; ')}`);
    const parsedBalance = StoreSchemas.ClassBalance.safeParse(balanceJson === null ? [] : balanceJson.Value);
    if (!parsedBalance.success) return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail(`snapshot ${s.Snapshot.ID} ClassBalance is malformed: ${parsedBalance.error.issues[0]?.message || 'unknown'}`);
    const balance: readonly ClassBalanceEntry[] = parsedBalance.data;
    const population = balance.reduce((t, b) => t + b.rows, 0);
    const popRate = (balance.find((b) => b.label === '1')?.rows ?? 0) / population;
    const holdRows = carve?.holdoutRowCount ?? 0;
    const holdRate = (carve?.holdoutClassCounts?.['1'] ?? 0) / holdRows;
    const [lo, hi] = EvaluationProtocolGates.wilson(popRate, holdRows);
    const dev = new Set(s.Manifest.filter((k) => k.role === 'development').map((k) => k.rowId));
    const shared = s.Manifest.filter((k) => k.role === 'locked-holdout' && dev.has(k.rowId)).length;
    const inFoldRun = await PsGatePytest.Run([IN_FOLD_RESAMPLING_NODE]);
    const inFold = EvaluationProtocolGates.pytestPassed(inFoldRun);
    return {
      Passed: holdRows > 0 && holdRate >= lo && holdRate <= hi && shared === 0 && inFold,
      Measured: { populationRate: popRate, holdoutRate: holdRate, lower: lo, upper: hi, sharedRowIds: shared, inFoldResampling: inFold },
      Detail: `holdout rate ${holdRate.toFixed(4)} in [${lo.toFixed(4)}, ${hi.toFixed(4)}]; ${shared} shared row ids; in-fold node ${inFoldRun.Passed} of ${inFoldRun.Collected} passed`,
    };
  }

  private static async newEntityGate(h: TruthHarness, provision: () => Promise<ProvisionedUnitPipeline>): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await provision();
    const s = await EvaluationProtocolGates.stored(h, await EvaluationProtocolGates.train(h, pipeline));
    if (typeof s === 'string') return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail(s);
    const ne = s.Results.carve?.newEntity ?? null;
    if (ne === null) return EvaluationProtocolGates.fail('the stored carve has no new-entity report');
    const foldRun = await PsGatePytest.Run(FOLD_NODES);
    const folds = EvaluationProtocolGates.pytestPassed(foldRun) && foldRun.Collected === FOLD_NODES.length;
    return {
      Passed: ne.sharedEntityKeys === 0 && ne.holdoutRowCount > 0 && ne.trainingRowCount > 0 && folds,
      Measured: { sharedEntityKeys: ne.sharedEntityKeys, trainingRows: ne.trainingRowCount, holdoutRows: ne.holdoutRowCount, innerFoldsDisjoint: folds },
      Detail: `new-entity report ${ne.trainingRowCount} / ${ne.holdoutRowCount} rows, ${ne.sharedEntityKeys} shared keys; fold nodes ${foldRun.Passed} of ${foldRun.Collected} passed`,
    };
  }

  /** T2p → S2.6: new-entity mode shares 0 entity keys with training, and inner folds 0 across a boundary. */
  public static async MeasureT2pNewEntity(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'scenario', ID: 'T2p', Seed: UnitFixtures.ScenarioBaseSeed('T2p') });
    return EvaluationProtocolGates.newEntityGate(h, () => UnitFixtures.ProvisionScenarioUnitPipeline(h, 'T2p', { kind: 'continuous' }, { dateColumn: 'T', groupKey: 'EntityKey', protocol: { Kind: 'year-cutoff', NewEntityFraction: 0.3 } }));
  }

  /** C1 → S2.6: the same on C1's members. */
  public static async MeasureC1NewEntity(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    return EvaluationProtocolGates.newEntityGate(h, () => UnitFixtures.ProvisionC1RenewalPipeline(h, {
      Kind: 'explicit',
      Holdout: { kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'DecisionDate', cutoff: '2024-01-01', holdoutEnd: '2025-01-01', newEntityReport: { groupKey: 'PersonID', holdoutFraction: 0.15 } },
    }));
  }
}
```

**Outcome:** Core carries the gate as a strictly typed port of `contracts.ts` (`GateRules.DecideGate` = contracts `decideGate`,
`GateInputs`, `GateRules.GateInputsFromIntervals`, `GateRules.BeatsByMargin`, with `GateDecision`/`PairedComparison` from M5.1 and
`EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative` from M1.2), proven equal to the reference pipeline's `gate_decision` and to the sidecar's copy of it
(`app/gate.py`, M6.3) on 5,000 (seed 7) and 20,000 (seed 424242) seeded cases plus the interval loop, 0 mismatches
(D-024, D3-23). Two guards sit outside the transcription (so it stays exact): a classification holdout whose rarest class
has fewer rows than the protocol's `MinMinorityClassRows` (default 20) never ships, and a binary model whose holdout AUC
interval contains 0.5 (or is missing) never ships. TypeScript is authoritative for the stored outcome: every completed
unit training run stores a `StoredGateRecord` as the `gate` member of its `ps-run-results/v2` envelope in
`MJ: ML Training Runs.ValidationResults` — the paired intervals, the pinned margin and protocol version row, the
transcribed and the final decision, its reason in words, the guard inputs, the incumbent diff and slice coverage — and a

is created from the shipped artifact only (none under `no-signal`). Publication stays PR 4 (cross-PR, §8.3 A-PR4).

```ts
import type { MetricKey, MetricWithInterval, PairedComparison, TrainerCompleted } from '../../index';

/** Typed trainer-result fixtures the Core tests share (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class TrainerResultFixtures {
  /** One metric with a 95% interval (n defaults to C1's 1,205 holdout rows). */
  public static Mwi(metric: MetricKey, value: number, lower: number, upper: number, n = 1205): MetricWithInterval {
    return { metric, value, interval: { level: 0.95, lower, upper }, n };
  }

  /** A paired comparison that beats when its lower bound is above 0. */
  public static Cmp(value: number, lower: number, upper: number): PairedComparison {
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/__tests__/gate.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  GateRules,
  type GateGuardInputs, type GateInputs, type StoredGateIntervals,
} from '../gate';
import { EvaluationProtocol } from '../evaluation-protocol';
import { TrainerResultFixtures } from './fixtures/trainer-result';

const keepIn: GateInputs = { modelName: 'xgb', modelBeatsDummy: false, modelBeatsBestSimple: false, memberBeatsDummy: { glm: true }, memberScores: { glm: 0.3 }, deliveredMember: null };
const keepIv: StoredGateIntervals = {
  modelName: 'xgb',
  modelVsDummy: { value: 0, lower: -0.01, upper: 0.01 },
  modelVsBestSimple: { value: -0.01, lower: -0.02, upper: 0 },
  memberVsDummy: { glm: { value: 0.03, lower: 0.01, upper: 0.05 } },
  memberScores: { glm: 0.3 },
  deliveredMember: null,
};
const noGuards = (taskKind: GateGuardInputs['taskKind']): GateGuardInputs => ({ taskKind, holdoutClassCounts: null, modelAucInterval: null, minMinorityClassRows: 20 });
const binaryGuards = (counts: Readonly<Record<string, number>>, auc: { lower: number; upper: number } | null): GateGuardInputs =>
  ({ taskKind: 'binary', holdoutClassCounts: counts, modelAucInterval: auc === null ? null : { level: 0.95, ...auc }, minMinorityClassRows: 20 });

describe('DecideGate — the decision table (Rulings Q13 + Q14 + Q15)', () => {
  it('row 1: ships the model that beats the dummy and the best simple member', () => {
    expect(GateRules.DecideGate({ ...keepIn, modelBeatsDummy: true, modelBeatsBestSimple: true })).toEqual(
      { outcome: 'model', branch: 'a:beats-best-simple', shipped: 'xgb', shippedRole: 'model', note: null });
  });
  it('row 1 does not apply when the selected model is itself a simple member', () => {
    expect(GateRules.DecideGate({ ...keepIn, modelBeatsDummy: true, modelBeatsBestSimple: true, deliveredMember: 'glm' }).outcome).toBe('keep-simple-baseline');
  });
  it('row 2 (Q15): ships the model when it beats the dummy and no simple member does', () => {
    expect(GateRules.DecideGate({ ...keepIn, modelBeatsDummy: true, memberBeatsDummy: { glm: false } })).toEqual(
      { outcome: 'model', branch: 'a:Q15-only-model-beats-dummy', shipped: 'xgb', shippedRole: 'model', note: 'no simple baseline carries demonstrable signal' });
  });
  it('row 3 (Q14): keeps the eligible member with the lowest score, ties by name', () => {
    expect(GateRules.DecideGate({ ...keepIn, memberBeatsDummy: { oneFeature: true, glm: true }, memberScores: { oneFeature: 0.3783, glm: 0.3652 } }).shipped).toBe('glm');
    expect(GateRules.DecideGate({ ...keepIn, memberBeatsDummy: { oneFeature: true, glm: true }, memberScores: { oneFeature: 0.3, glm: 0.3 } }).shipped).toBe('glm');
  });
  it('row 4: no-signal when nothing beats the dummy', () => {
    expect(GateRules.DecideGate({ ...keepIn, memberBeatsDummy: { glm: false } })).toEqual(
      { outcome: 'no-signal', branch: 'c:no-signal', shipped: null, shippedRole: null, note: null });
  });
});

describe('GateInputsFromIntervals and the margin', () => {
  it('re-derives the keep-simple inputs from stored intervals (contracts N9 check)', () => {
    expect(GateRules.GateInputsFromIntervals(keepIv, EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(0.005))).toEqual(keepIn);
  });
  it('a lower bound equal to the margin does not beat', () => {
    expect(GateRules.BeatsByMargin({ value: 0.01, lower: 0.005, upper: 0.02 }, EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(0.005))).toBe(false);
  });
  it('without a best-simple interval the model never beats the best simple', () => {
    expect(GateRules.GateInputsFromIntervals({ ...keepIv, modelVsBestSimple: null, modelVsDummy: { value: 0.05, lower: 0.04, upper: 0.06 } }, EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(0)).modelBeatsBestSimple).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('ApplyGateGuards (W7 → S4.2 #2: an interval containing 0.5 or a minority below MinMinorityClassRows never ships)', () => {
  const model = GateRules.DecideGate({ ...keepIn, modelBeatsDummy: true, modelBeatsBestSimple: true });
  const keep = GateRules.DecideGate(keepIn);
  it('downgrades to no-signal when the holdout minority class has fewer rows than the protocol minimum', () => {
    const g = GateRules.ApplyGateGuards(model, binaryGuards({ Lapsed: 12, Renewed: 88 }, { lower: 0.55, upper: 0.7 }));
    expect(g.Decision.outcome).toBe('no-signal');
    expect(g.GuardRefusal).toEqual({ kind: 'minority-class-below-minimum', classLabel: 'Lapsed', rows: 12, minimum: 20 });
    expect(g.Transcribed).toEqual(model);
    expect(GateRules.ApplyGateGuards(keep, binaryGuards({ Lapsed: 12, Renewed: 88 }, null)).Decision.outcome).toBe('no-signal');
    expect(GateRules.ApplyGateGuards(model, { ...binaryGuards({ Lapsed: 12, Renewed: 88 }, { lower: 0.55, upper: 0.7 }), minMinorityClassRows: 10 }).Decision).toEqual(model);
  });
  it('downgrades a model whose AUC interval contains 0.5, or whose AUC interval is missing', () => {
    expect(GateRules.ApplyGateGuards(model, binaryGuards({ Lapsed: 30, Renewed: 70 }, { lower: 0.48, upper: 0.66 })).GuardRefusal)
      .toEqual({ kind: 'auc-interval-contains-chance', lower: 0.48, upper: 0.66 });
    expect(GateRules.ApplyGateGuards(model, binaryGuards({ Lapsed: 30, Renewed: 70 }, null)).GuardRefusal).toEqual({ kind: 'auc-interval-missing' });
  });
  it('keeps a model that clears both guards, and applies no AUC guard to a continuous task', () => {
    expect(GateRules.ApplyGateGuards(model, binaryGuards({ Lapsed: 30, Renewed: 70 }, { lower: 0.52, upper: 0.7 })).Decision).toEqual(model);
    expect(GateRules.ApplyGateGuards(model, noGuards('continuous')).Decision).toEqual(model);
  });
});

describe('StoredGateIntervalsFromResult (C1 → S4.2 shape)', () => {
  it('maps the trainer comparisons to stored intervals and decides keep-simple-baseline (GLM)', () => {
    const r = GateRules.StoredGateIntervalsFromResult(TrainerResultFixtures.C1KeepSimpleResult());
    expect(r.Ok).toBe(true);
    if (!r.Ok) return;
    expect(r.Intervals.memberScores).toEqual({ oneFeature: 0.3783, glm: 0.3652 });
    expect(r.Intervals.modelVsBestSimple).toEqual({ value: -0.006, lower: -0.017, upper: 0.005 });
    expect(r.Intervals.deliveredMember).toBeNull();
    const g = GateRules.DecideGuardedGate(r.Intervals, EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(0), noGuards('binary'));
    expect(g.Decision).toEqual({ outcome: 'keep-simple-baseline', branch: 'b:keep-simple-baseline', shipped: 'glm', shippedRole: 'simpleBaseline', note: null });
    const reason = GateRules.DescribeGate(r.Intervals, g, 'log-loss');
    expect(reason.code).toBe('simple-baseline-carries-signal');
    expect(reason.text).toContain('0.0239 [0.0110, 0.0360]');
  });
  it('names a missing comparison instead of guessing', () => {
    const result = TrainerResultFixtures.C1KeepSimpleResult();
    const { glmVsDummy: _dropped, ...rest } = result.comparisons;
    expect(GateRules.StoredGateIntervalsFromResult({ ...result, comparisons: rest })).toEqual({ Ok: false, MissingComparison: 'glmVsDummy' });
  });
  it('treats the unit incumbent heuristic as a simple member (C1 → S1.3)', () => {
    expect(GateRules.BaselineMemberName({ kind: 'incumbent-heuristic', name: 'renewed last year' })).toBe('heuristic:renewed last year');
    const result = TrainerResultFixtures.C1KeepSimpleResult();
    const withRule = {

      comparisons: { ...result.comparisons, 'heuristic:renewed last yearVsDummy': { value: 0.029, ci: [0.015, 0.043] as const, beats: true }, 'modelVs:heuristic:renewed last year': { value: -0.011, ci: [-0.02, -0.002] as const, beats: false } },
    };
    const r = GateRules.StoredGateIntervalsFromResult(withRule);
    if (!r.Ok) throw new Error(r.MissingComparison);
    const g = GateRules.DecideGuardedGate(r.Intervals, EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(0), noGuards('binary'));
    expect(g.Decision.shipped).toBe('heuristic:renewed last year');
```
