```ts
import type { BaselineSpec, Interval, MetricKey, NonNegative } from './evaluation-protocol';
import type { TaskKind } from './task-type';
import type { TrainerCompleted } from './trainer-contract';

/** contracts.ts L619. Each boolean is `PairedComparison.beats` computed with the protocol's margin. */
export interface GateInputs {
  readonly modelName: string;
  readonly modelBeatsDummy: boolean;
  readonly modelBeatsBestSimple: boolean;
  readonly memberBeatsDummy: Readonly<Record<string, boolean>>;
  readonly memberScores: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
  readonly deliveredMember: string | null;
}

/** contracts.ts L632: mean and 95% bounds of (comparator loss − candidate loss) on the same holdout rows. */
export interface StoredInterval {
  readonly value: number;
  readonly lower: number;
  readonly upper: number;
}

/** contracts.ts L644: what a training run stores for the gate (intervals, never booleans; N9). */
export interface StoredGateIntervals {
  readonly modelName: string;
  readonly modelVsDummy: StoredInterval;
  readonly modelVsBestSimple: StoredInterval | null;
  readonly memberVsDummy: Readonly<Record<string, StoredInterval>>;
  readonly memberScores: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
  readonly deliveredMember: string | null;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- guards (outside the table) --

/** What the two guards read; stored with the decision so publish re-verification can re-run them. */
export interface GateGuardInputs {
  readonly taskKind: TaskKind;
  /** Holdout rows per class (classification); null for other tasks. From the run's carve. */
  readonly holdoutClassCounts: Readonly<Record<string, number>> | null;
  /** The finalist's holdout AUC interval (binary); null when the trainer did not report one. */
  readonly modelAucInterval: Interval | null;
  /** The protocol's `MinMinorityClassRows` (F-SEL-2 / D11; default 20). */
  readonly minMinorityClassRows: number;
}

export type GateGuardRefusal =
  | { readonly kind: 'minority-class-below-minimum'; readonly classLabel: string; readonly rows: number; readonly minimum: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'auc-interval-contains-chance'; readonly lower: number; readonly upper: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'auc-interval-missing' };

export interface GuardedGateDecision {
  /** `GateRules.DecideGate`'s output, unchanged (what the parity tests prove and what the sidecar must agree with). */
  readonly Transcribed: GateDecision;
  /** The stored decision: the transcription, or no-signal when a guard refused. */
  readonly Decision: GateDecision;
  readonly GuardRefusal: GateGuardRefusal | null;
}

const NO_SIGNAL: GateDecision = { outcome: 'no-signal', branch: 'c:no-signal', shipped: null, shippedRole: null, note: null };



// ------------------------------------------------------------------- from a trainer result to stored intervals --


/** The fields the gate reads; satisfied by the live `TrainerCompleted` and by the stored `StoredTrainerResult`. */
export type CompletedTrainerResult = Pick<TrainerCompleted, 'finalist' | 'baselines' | 'comparisons' | 'holdout' | 'gate' | 'slices' | 'incumbentDiff' | 'operatingPoint'>;

export type IntervalsFromResult =
  | { readonly Ok: true; readonly Intervals: StoredGateIntervals }
  | { readonly Ok: false; readonly MissingComparison: string };


// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- the reason --

export type GateReasonCode =
  | 'model-beats-best-simple'
  | 'only-model-beats-dummy'
  | 'simple-baseline-carries-signal'
  | 'heuristic-carries-signal'
  | 'nothing-beats-dummy'
  | 'minority-class-below-minimum'
  | 'auc-interval-contains-chance'
  | 'auc-interval-missing';

export interface GateReason {
  readonly code: GateReasonCode;
  /** One or two plain sentences generated from the stored numbers (never typed by hand). */
  readonly text: string;
}

/**
 * The gate: the contracts.ts transcriptions (`GateRules.BeatsByMargin`, `GateRules.GateInputsFromIntervals`, `GateRules.DecideGate`), the stored
 * decision with its guards (`GateRules.DecideGuardedGate`), member names, stored intervals and the reason — static members on
 * one owner (coding standards §2), with no free-function aliases.
 */
export class GateRules {
  /** contracts.ts `beatsByMargin` (L656): "beats" = the lower bound is strictly above the margin. */
  public static BeatsByMargin(iv: StoredInterval, margin: NonNegative): boolean {
    return iv.lower > margin;
  }

  /** contracts.ts `gateInputsFromIntervals` (L661). */
  public static GateInputsFromIntervals(iv: StoredGateIntervals, margin: NonNegative): GateInputs {
    const memberBeatsDummy: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    for (const [member, interval] of Object.entries(iv.memberVsDummy)) {
      memberBeatsDummy[member] = GateRules.BeatsByMargin(interval, margin);
    }
    return {
      modelName: iv.modelName,
      modelBeatsDummy: GateRules.BeatsByMargin(iv.modelVsDummy, margin),
      modelBeatsBestSimple: iv.modelVsBestSimple !== null && GateRules.BeatsByMargin(iv.modelVsBestSimple, margin),
      memberBeatsDummy,
      memberScores: iv.memberScores,
      deliveredMember: iv.deliveredMember,
    };
  }

  /**
   * contracts.ts `decideGate` (L677): a line-for-line transcription of refpipe `gate_decision` (run.py:370-386) and of the
   * sidecar's `app/gate.py`. Do not edit any of the three without running the gate parity tests.
   */
  public static DecideGate(i: GateInputs): GateDecision {
    const eligible = Object.keys(i.memberBeatsDummy).sort().filter((k) => i.memberBeatsDummy[k] === true);
    if (i.deliveredMember === null && i.modelBeatsDummy && i.modelBeatsBestSimple) {
      return { outcome: 'model', branch: 'a:beats-best-simple', shipped: i.modelName, shippedRole: 'model', note: null };
    }
    if (i.modelBeatsDummy && eligible.length === 0) {
      return {
        outcome: 'model',
        branch: 'a:Q15-only-model-beats-dummy',
        shipped: i.modelName,
        shippedRole: 'model',
        note: 'no simple baseline carries demonstrable signal',
      };
    }
    const first = eligible[0];
    if (first !== undefined) {
      const best = eligible.reduce<string>((acc, k) => {
        const a = i.memberScores[acc] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        const b = i.memberScores[k] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        return b < a || (b === a && k < acc) ? k : acc;
      }, first);
      return { outcome: 'keep-simple-baseline', branch: 'b:keep-simple-baseline', shipped: best, shippedRole: 'simpleBaseline', note: null };
    }
    return { outcome: 'no-signal', branch: 'c:no-signal', shipped: null, shippedRole: null, note: null };
  }

  /** The stored decision: the transcribed table over the stored intervals, then the two guards. */
  public static DecideGuardedGate(intervals: StoredGateIntervals, margin: NonNegative, guards: GateGuardInputs): GuardedGateDecision {
    return GateRules.ApplyGateGuards(GateRules.DecideGate(GateRules.GateInputsFromIntervals(intervals, margin)), guards);
  }

  /**
   * The two guards outside the transcribed table (F-SEL-2, F-TR-1, F-TR-2, F-TR-4): the rarest holdout class must have at
   * least `minMinorityClassRows` rows, and a binary model whose holdout AUC interval contains 0.5 (or is missing) never
   * ships. Guards only ever downgrade to no-signal. `PublishRules.ReverifyPublish` calls `GateRules.DecideGuardedGate`, not `GateRules.DecideGate`,
   * with the stored guard inputs.
   */
  public static ApplyGateGuards(gate: GateDecision, guards: GateGuardInputs): GuardedGateDecision {
    if (gate.outcome === 'no-signal') return { Transcribed: gate, Decision: gate, GuardRefusal: null };
    const minority = GateRules.rarestClass(guards.holdoutClassCounts);
    if (minority !== null && minority.rows < guards.minMinorityClassRows) {
      return {
        Transcribed: gate,
        Decision: NO_SIGNAL,
        GuardRefusal: { kind: 'minority-class-below-minimum', classLabel: minority.label, rows: minority.rows, minimum: guards.minMinorityClassRows },
      };
    }
    if (gate.outcome === 'model' && guards.taskKind === 'binary') {
      const auc = guards.modelAucInterval;
      if (auc === null) return { Transcribed: gate, Decision: NO_SIGNAL, GuardRefusal: { kind: 'auc-interval-missing' } };
      if (auc.lower <= 0.5 && auc.upper >= 0.5) {
        return { Transcribed: gate, Decision: NO_SIGNAL, GuardRefusal: { kind: 'auc-interval-contains-chance', lower: auc.lower, upper: auc.upper } };
      }
    }
    return { Transcribed: gate, Decision: gate, GuardRefusal: null };
  }

  /** Outcome, branch and shipped member equal (what check_gate_parity.sh compares). */
  public static SameGate(a: GateDecision, b: GateDecision): boolean {
    return a.outcome === b.outcome && a.branch === b.branch && a.shipped === b.shipped;
  }

  /** The comparison-key name of a baseline (the sidecar's `baselines.py` uses the same strings). */
  public static BaselineMemberName(spec: BaselineSpec): string {
    switch (spec.kind) {
      case 'dummy':
        return 'dummy';
      case 'one-feature':
        return 'oneFeature';
      case 'glm':
        return 'glm';
      case 'naive':
        return 'naive';
      case 'seasonal-naive':
        return 'seasonalNaive';
      case 'incumbent-heuristic':
        return `heuristic:${spec.name}`;
    }
  }

  /** The intervals the run stores, read from the trainer's paired comparisons (keys as in refpipe `outcome_gate`). */
  public static StoredGateIntervalsFromResult(result: CompletedTrainerResult): IntervalsFromResult {
    const memberScores: Record<string, number> = {};
    const memberVsDummy: Record<string, StoredInterval> = {};
    for (const b of result.baselines) {
      if (b.role !== 'simple') continue;
      const name = GateRules.BaselineMemberName(b.baseline);
      const vsDummy = result.comparisons[`${name}VsDummy`];
      if (vsDummy === undefined) return { Ok: false, MissingComparison: `${name}VsDummy` };
      memberScores[name] = b.holdout.value;
      memberVsDummy[name] = GateRules.toStored(vsDummy);
    }
    const modelVsDummy = result.comparisons['modelVsDummy'];
    if (modelVsDummy === undefined) return { Ok: false, MissingComparison: 'modelVsDummy' };
    const best = GateRules.bestSimpleMember(memberScores);
    let modelVsBestSimple: StoredInterval | null = null;
    if (best !== null) {
      const vsBest = result.comparisons[`modelVs:${best}`];
      if (vsBest === undefined) return { Ok: false, MissingComparison: `modelVs:${best}` };
      modelVsBestSimple = GateRules.toStored(vsBest);
    }
    return {
      Ok: true,
      Intervals: {
        modelName: result.finalist,
        modelVsDummy: GateRules.toStored(modelVsDummy),
        modelVsBestSimple,
        memberVsDummy,
        memberScores,
        deliveredMember: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(memberScores, result.finalist) ? result.finalist : null,
      },
    };
  }

  public static DescribeGate(iv: StoredGateIntervals, guarded: GuardedGateDecision, metric: MetricKey): GateReason {
    const refusal = guarded.GuardRefusal;
    if (refusal !== null) {
      switch (refusal.kind) {
        case 'minority-class-below-minimum':
          return { code: refusal.kind, text: `The test set has only ${refusal.rows} rows of "${refusal.classLabel}"; at least ${refusal.minimum} are needed to tell a model from chance, so nothing ships.` };
        case 'auc-interval-contains-chance':
          return { code: refusal.kind, text: `The model's AUC interval on the test set, [${GateRules.f4(refusal.lower)}, ${GateRules.f4(refusal.upper)}], contains 0.5 (a coin flip), so it does not ship.` };
        case 'auc-interval-missing':
          return { code: refusal.kind, text: 'The trainer reported no AUC interval for the model, so it cannot be shown to beat a coin flip; nothing ships.' };
      }
    }
    const d = guarded.Decision;
    switch (d.branch) {
      case 'a:beats-best-simple':
        return { code: 'model-beats-best-simple', text: `The model beats the flat guess by ${GateRules.fmt(iv.modelVsDummy)} and the best simple baseline by ${GateRules.fmt(iv.modelVsBestSimple)} (${metric}, lower is better).` };
      case 'a:Q15-only-model-beats-dummy':
        return { code: 'only-model-beats-dummy', text: `The model beats the flat guess by ${GateRules.fmt(iv.modelVsDummy)} (${metric}); no simple baseline carries demonstrable signal.` };
      case 'b:keep-simple-baseline': {
        const shipped = d.shipped;
        const vsDummy = iv.memberVsDummy[shipped];
        if (shipped.startsWith('heuristic:')) {
          return { code: 'heuristic-carries-signal', text: `The existing rule "${shipped.slice('heuristic:'.length)}" beats the flat guess by ${GateRules.fmt(vsDummy)} (${metric}) and the model does not beat it by the margin: keep the rule.` };
        }
        return { code: 'simple-baseline-carries-signal', text: `The simple baseline ${shipped} beats the flat guess by ${GateRules.fmt(vsDummy)} (${metric}); the trained model does not beat it, so the simple baseline is kept.` };
      }
      case 'c:no-signal':
        return { code: 'nothing-beats-dummy', text: `Neither the model (${GateRules.fmt(iv.modelVsDummy)}) nor any simple baseline beats the flat guess on ${metric}: no signal.` };
    }
  }

  private static toStored(c: PairedComparison): StoredInterval {
    return { value: c.value, lower: c.ci[0], upper: c.ci[1] };
  }

  /** refpipe: `best = min(sorted(scores), key=lambda k: scores[k])` — the lowest score, first in name order. */
  private static bestSimpleMember(scores: Readonly<Record<string, number>>): string | null {
    let best: string | null = null;
    for (const name of Object.keys(scores).sort()) {
      const score = scores[name];
      const bestScore = best === null ? undefined : scores[best];
      if (score !== undefined && (bestScore === undefined || score < bestScore)) best = name;
    }
    return best;
  }

  private static rarestClass(counts: Readonly<Record<string, number>> | null): { readonly label: string; readonly rows: number } | null {
    if (counts === null) return null;
    let rarest: { label: string; rows: number } | null = null;
    for (const label of Object.keys(counts).sort()) {
      const rows = counts[label] ?? 0;
      if (rarest === null || rows < rarest.rows) rarest = { label, rows };
    }
    return rarest;
  }

  private static fmt(iv: StoredInterval | null | undefined): string {
    return iv === null || iv === undefined ? 'an unreported amount' : `${GateRules.f4(iv.value)} [${GateRules.f4(iv.lower)}, ${GateRules.f4(iv.upper)}]`;
  }

  private static f4(x: number): string {
    return x.toFixed(4);
  }
}
```

  A binary holdout that contains only one class has a single key in `holdoutClassCounts`; that is a single-valued
  holdout, which M2.4's `UnitTargetValidator.ValidateUnitTargets` refuses before training (`single-valued-target`), so the guard does not
  handle it. Export: `Core/src/index.ts` already exports `./gate` (M5.1).

```python
# packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Sidecar/src/python/tests/test_gate_parity.py
"""Port of ps-review probes/architecture/check_gate_parity.sh.

The TypeScript GateRules.DecideGate / GateRules.GateInputsFromIntervals (@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core, built dist) generate
seeded random gate inputs and decisions with the original generator; this test recomputes every decision with
app.gate.gate_decision (the sidecar's copy of the reference pipeline's function) and every interval boolean as lower > margin.
Expected: 0 mismatches at seed 7 x 5,000 and seed 424242 x 20,000, and every branch exercised.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TypedDict

import pytest

from app.gate import GATE_BRANCHES, gate_decision

SIDECAR_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
SCRIPT = SIDECAR_ROOT / "scripts" / "gate-parity-cases.mjs"


class CaseInputs(TypedDict):
    modelName: str
    modelBeatsDummy: bool
    modelBeatsBestSimple: bool
    memberBeatsDummy: dict[str, bool]
    memberScores: dict[str, float]
    deliveredMember: str | None


class Case(TypedDict):
    i: CaseInputs
    g: list[str | None]


class StoredIv(TypedDict):
    value: float
    lower: float
    upper: float


class Stored(TypedDict):
    modelName: str
    modelVsDummy: StoredIv
    modelVsBestSimple: StoredIv | None
    memberVsDummy: dict[str, StoredIv]
    memberScores: dict[str, float]
    deliveredMember: str | None


class IntervalCase(TypedDict):
    s: Stored
    margin: float
    b: list[bool | dict[str, bool]]
    g: list[str | None]


class Cases(TypedDict):
    out: list[Case]
    iv: list[IntervalCase]


def _cases(seed: int, n: int) -> Cases:
    node = shutil.which("node")
    assert node is not None, "node is required: the TypeScript side of the parity check runs under Node"
    done = subprocess.run([node, str(SCRIPT), str(seed), str(n)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=SIDECAR_ROOT)
    data: Cases = json.loads(done.stdout)
    return data


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("seed", "n"), [(7, 5000), (424242, 20000)])
def test_decide_gate_matches_reference(seed: int, n: int) -> None:
    cases = _cases(seed, n)
    assert len(cases["out"]) == n
    bad = 0
    branches: Counter[str] = Counter()
    for k in cases["out"]:
        i = k["i"]
        py = list(gate_decision(i["modelBeatsDummy"], i["modelBeatsBestSimple"], i["memberBeatsDummy"], i["memberScores"], i["deliveredMember"]))
        branches[str(py[1])] += 1
        bad += py != k["g"]
    assert bad == 0
    assert set(branches) == set(GATE_BRANCHES)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("seed", "n"), [(7, 5000), (424242, 20000)])
def test_gate_inputs_from_intervals_matches_reference(seed: int, n: int) -> None:
    cases = _cases(seed, n)
    assert len(cases["iv"]) == n
    bad = 0
    for k in cases["iv"]:
        s, mg = k["s"], k["margin"]
        mbd = s["modelVsDummy"]["lower"] > mg
        best = s["modelVsBestSimple"]
        mbs = best is not None and best["lower"] > mg
        memb = {m: v["lower"] > mg for m, v in s["memberVsDummy"].items()}
        py = list(gate_decision(mbd, mbs, memb, s["memberScores"], s["deliveredMember"]))
        derived: list[bool | dict[str, bool]] = [mbd, mbs, memb]
        bad += derived != k["b"] or py != k["g"]
    assert bad == 0
```

```js
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Sidecar/scripts/gate-parity-cases.mjs  (run with `node`; no shebang needed)
/**
 * Case generator for tests/test_gate_parity.py — the generator of ps-review probes/architecture/check_gate_parity.sh
 * (same LCG, same draws, same order), calling the built @memberjunction/predictive-studio-core.
 * Usage: node scripts/gate-parity-cases.mjs <seed> <cases>   → JSON {out, iv} on stdout.
 */
import { EvaluationProtocol, GateRules } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';

let seed = Number(process.argv[2] ?? '7');
const N = Number(process.argv[3] ?? '5000');
const r = () => (seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648) / 2147483648;

const out = [];
for (let n = 0; n < N; n++) {
  const members = ['glm', 'oneFeature'].filter(() => r() < 0.9);
  const mb = {}, sc = {};
  for (const m of members) { mb[m] = r() < 0.5; sc[m] = Math.round(r() * 4) / 4; }
  const dm = r() < 0.3 && members.length ? members[Math.floor(r() * members.length)] : null;
  const i = { modelName: 'M', modelBeatsDummy: r() < 0.5, modelBeatsBestSimple: r() < 0.5, memberBeatsDummy: mb, memberScores: sc, deliveredMember: dm };
  const g = GateRules.DecideGate(i);
  out.push({ i, g: [g.outcome, g.branch, g.outcome === 'keep-simple-baseline' ? g.shipped : null] });
}

const iv = [];
const lower = () => Math.round((r() - 0.5) * 40) / 1000;
const itv = () => { const lo = lower(); return { value: lo + 0.01, lower: lo, upper: lo + 0.02 }; };
for (let n = 0; n < N; n++) {
  const margin = Math.round(r() * 10) / 1000;
  const members = ['glm', 'oneFeature'].filter(() => r() < 0.9);
  const mv = {}, sc = {};
  for (const m of members) { mv[m] = itv(); sc[m] = Math.round(r() * 4) / 4; }
  const dm = r() < 0.3 && members.length ? members[Math.floor(r() * members.length)] : null;
  const s = { modelName: 'M', modelVsDummy: itv(), modelVsBestSimple: members.length && r() < 0.95 ? itv() : null, memberVsDummy: mv, memberScores: sc, deliveredMember: dm };
  const gi = GateRules.GateInputsFromIntervals(s, EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(margin));
  const g = GateRules.DecideGate(gi);
  iv.push({ s, margin, b: [gi.modelBeatsDummy, gi.modelBeatsBestSimple, gi.memberBeatsDummy], g: [g.outcome, g.branch, g.outcome === 'keep-simple-baseline' ? g.shipped : null] });
}

process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ out, iv }));
```

  TruthSuite `package.json` scripts
  `"test:gate-parity-refpipe": "node scripts/run-pytest.mjs -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_gate_parity_refpipe.py"`.

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/run-evaluation.ts
/**
 * @module run-evaluation
 *
 * The gate record a completed unit training run stores as the `gate` member of its `ps-run-results/v2` envelope
 * (`MJ: ML Training Runs.ValidationResults`, §5.1): the paired intervals (never booleans; N9), the pinned margin and
 * protocol version row, the transcribed and the final decision with its reason, the guard inputs, the incumbent diff and
 * slice coverage. The trainer's evaluation itself lives in the envelope's `trainer` member; this record copies
 * none of it. TypeScript is authoritative for the stored outcome; a sidecar decision that differs from the
 * transcription refuses the run. Publish re-verification re-derives the decision from this record and the pinned protocol row.
 */
import type { EvaluationProtocolSpec, MetricKey } from './evaluation-protocol';
import {
  GateRules,
  type CompletedTrainerResult, type GateDecision, type GateGuardInputs, type GateGuardRefusal, type GateReason, type StoredGateIntervals,
} from './gate';
import type { TaskType } from './task-type';
import type { TrainerCompleted } from './trainer-contract';
import { TrainingRunResultsParser } from './training-run-results';

export interface SliceCoverage {
  /** Declared `slices.subgroups` fields with no subgroup slice in the trainer result. */
  readonly missingSubgroups: readonly string[];
  /** Holdout periods (from the run's carve) with no out-of-time slice, when `slices.outOfTime` is declared. */
  readonly missingPeriods: readonly string[];
  /** Slices whose primary score lacks a finite lower or upper bound. */
  readonly slicesWithoutInterval: number;
}

export interface StoredGateRecord {
  readonly evaluationProtocolId: string;
  readonly margin: number;
  readonly primaryMetric: MetricKey;
  readonly holdoutRows: number;
  readonly intervals: StoredGateIntervals;
  readonly guards: GateGuardInputs;
  readonly transcribed: GateDecision;
  readonly decision: GateDecision;
  readonly guardRefusal: GateGuardRefusal | null;
  readonly reason: GateReason;
  readonly incumbentDiff: TrainerCompleted['incumbentDiff'];
  readonly sliceCoverage: SliceCoverage;
}

export interface GateRecordArgs {
  /** The live result (the trainer branch calls this before the artifacts are stored) or the stored one. */
  readonly Result: CompletedTrainerResult;
  /** The protocol version row the run's `EvaluationProtocolID` names. */
  readonly Protocol: EvaluationProtocolSpec;
  readonly Task: TaskType;
  /** The run's holdout carve (envelope `carve`): class counts and holdout periods; null for rolling-origin. */
  readonly Carve: { readonly holdoutClassCounts: Readonly<Record<string, number>> | null; readonly holdoutPeriods: readonly string[] } | null;
}

export type GateStageRefusal =
  | { readonly kind: 'sidecar-gate-mismatch'; readonly sidecar: GateDecision; readonly engine: GateDecision }
  | { readonly kind: 'missing-comparison'; readonly comparison: string };

export type GateRecordBuild =
  | { readonly Ok: true; readonly Record: StoredGateRecord }
  | { readonly Ok: false; readonly Refusal: GateStageRefusal };

/** Building and reading the stored gate record (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class GateRecords {
  /** The record a completed run stores; refuses a missing comparison or a sidecar decision that differs from the transcription. */
  public static BuildStoredGateRecord(a: GateRecordArgs): GateRecordBuild {
    const r = a.Result;
    const intervals = GateRules.StoredGateIntervalsFromResult(r);
    if (!intervals.Ok) return { Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'missing-comparison', comparison: intervals.MissingComparison } };
    const guards: GateGuardInputs = {
      taskKind: a.Task.kind,
      holdoutClassCounts: a.Carve?.holdoutClassCounts ?? null,
      modelAucInterval: r.holdout.secondary.find((m) => m.metric === 'auc')?.interval ?? null,
      minMinorityClassRows: a.Protocol.minMinorityClassRows,
    };
    const margin = a.Protocol.promotion.margin;
    const guarded = GateRules.DecideGuardedGate(intervals.Intervals, margin, guards);
    if (!GateRules.SameGate(guarded.Transcribed, r.gate)) {
      return { Ok: false, Refusal: { kind: 'sidecar-gate-mismatch', sidecar: r.gate, engine: guarded.Transcribed } };
    }
    return {
      Ok: true,
      Record: {
        evaluationProtocolId: a.Protocol.id,
        margin,
        primaryMetric: a.Protocol.primaryScore.metric,
        holdoutRows: r.holdout.primary.n,
        intervals: intervals.Intervals,
        guards,
        transcribed: guarded.Transcribed,
        decision: guarded.Decision,
        guardRefusal: guarded.GuardRefusal,
        reason: GateRules.DescribeGate(intervals.Intervals, guarded, a.Protocol.primaryScore.metric),
        incumbentDiff: r.incumbentDiff,
        sliceCoverage: GateRecords.sliceCoverage(a.Protocol, r.slices, a.Carve?.holdoutPeriods ?? []),
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * The stored gate record of a run, or null for a legacy blob, a refused run, or a run stored before gate records existed. The envelope
   * is written only by `TrainingEngine` from typed values and checked by `ParseTrainingRunResults`.
   */
  public static ParseStoredGateRecord(validationResults: string | null): StoredGateRecord | null {
    if (validationResults === null || validationResults.trim().length === 0) return null;
    const parsed = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults(validationResults);
    if (!parsed.Ok || parsed.Value.status !== 'completed') return null;
    return parsed.Value.gate ?? null;
  }

  private static sliceCoverage(protocol: EvaluationProtocolSpec, slices: CompletedTrainerResult['slices'], periods: readonly string[]): SliceCoverage {
    const subgroupFields = new Set(slices.flatMap((s) => (s.slice.kind === 'subgroup' ? [s.slice.field] : [])));
    const outOfTime = new Set(slices.flatMap((s) => (s.slice.kind === 'out-of-time' ? [s.slice.period] : [])));
    return {
      missingSubgroups: protocol.slices.subgroups.filter((f) => !subgroupFields.has(f)),
      missingPeriods: protocol.slices.outOfTime ? periods.filter((p) => !outOfTime.has(p)) : [],
      slicesWithoutInterval: slices.filter((s) => !(Number.isFinite(s.primary.interval.lower) && Number.isFinite(s.primary.interval.upper))).length,
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
const TASK_KIND_VALUES = ['binary', 'multiclass', 'continuous', 'count', 'non-negative', 'forecast'] as const satisfies readonly TaskKind[];
const GATE_REASON_CODES = [
  'model-beats-best-simple', 'only-model-beats-dummy', 'simple-baseline-carries-signal', 'heuristic-carries-signal',
  'nothing-beats-dummy', 'minority-class-below-minimum', 'auc-interval-contains-chance', 'auc-interval-missing',
] as const satisfies readonly GateReasonCode[];

const storedIntervalSchema: z.ZodType<StoredInterval> = z.object({ value: z.number(), lower: z.number(), upper: z.number() });
const storedGateIntervalsSchema: z.ZodType<StoredGateIntervals> = z.object({
  modelName: z.string(),
  modelVsDummy: storedIntervalSchema,
  modelVsBestSimple: storedIntervalSchema.nullable(),
  memberVsDummy: z.record(storedIntervalSchema),
  memberScores: z.record(z.number()),
  deliveredMember: z.string().nullable(),
});
const gateGuardInputsSchema: z.ZodType<GateGuardInputs> = z.object({
  taskKind: z.enum(TASK_KIND_VALUES),
  holdoutClassCounts: z.record(z.number().int().nonnegative()).nullable(),
  modelAucInterval: intervalSchema.nullable(),
  minMinorityClassRows: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
});
const gateGuardRefusalSchema: z.ZodType<GateGuardRefusal> = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('minority-class-below-minimum'), classLabel: z.string(), rows: z.number().int(), minimum: z.number().int() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('auc-interval-contains-chance'), lower: z.number(), upper: z.number() }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal('auc-interval-missing') }),
]);
const gateReasonSchema: z.ZodType<GateReason> = z.object({ code: z.enum(GATE_REASON_CODES), text: z.string() });
const sliceCoverageSchema: z.ZodType<SliceCoverage> = z.object({
  missingSubgroups: z.array(z.string()), missingPeriods: z.array(z.string()), slicesWithoutInterval: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
});
```

```sql
SELECT p.Name, r.Status,
       JSON_VALUE(r.ValidationResults,'$.gate.decision.outcome')    AS Outcome,
       JSON_VALUE(r.ValidationResults,'$.gate.decision.shipped')    AS Shipped,
       JSON_VALUE(r.ValidationResults,'$.gate.transcribed.outcome') AS Transcribed,
       JSON_VALUE(r.ValidationResults,'$.gate.reason.code')         AS ReasonCode,
       JSON_VALUE(r.ValidationResults,'$.gate.holdoutRows')         AS HoldoutRows,
       ep.Version AS ProtocolRowVersion, r.ResultingModelID
FROM __mj.MLTrainingRun r
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/trust.ts  (whole file)
/**
 * @module trust
 *
 * The trust verdict is a **rendering** of the gate decision stored on the model's training run
 * (the `gate` member of `MJ: ML Training Runs.ValidationResults`). It grades nothing itself: no AUC or R² bands, no accuracy
 * fallback, no in-sample metrics. A run without a stored decision is "not evaluated" and cannot be acted on. Every
 * number in the copy comes from the stored paired comparison ("beats the flat guess by X [lo, hi]").
 * One rule for the business UI and the agent's builder.
 */
import type { GateOutcome, MetricKey } from './evaluation-protocol';
import { GateRecords } from './run-evaluation';

export interface TrustInput {
  /** The model's training run's `ValidationResults`. */
  readonly ValidationResults: string | null;
}

export interface TrustComparison {
  readonly Against: 'the flat guess';
  readonly Shipped: string;
  readonly Value: number;
  readonly Lower: number;
  readonly Upper: number;
  readonly Metric: MetricKey;
}

export type TrustVerdict =
  | {
      readonly Kind: 'not-evaluated';
      readonly Outcome: null;
      readonly CanAct: false;
      readonly Headline: string;
      readonly Reason: string;
      readonly Comparison: null;
      readonly HoldoutRows: null;
    }
  | {
      readonly Kind: 'evaluated';
      readonly Outcome: GateOutcome;
      readonly CanAct: boolean;
      readonly Headline: string;
      readonly Reason: string;
      readonly Comparison: TrustComparison | null;
      readonly HoldoutRows: number;
    };

const NOT_EVALUATED: TrustVerdict = {
  Kind: 'not-evaluated',
  Outcome: null,
  CanAct: false,
  Headline: 'Not evaluated yet.',
  Reason: 'This model was not trained under an Evaluation Protocol, so there is no measured comparison with a flat guess. Retrain it to get one.',
  Comparison: null,
  HoldoutRows: null,
};


/** The titles {@link TrustVerdicts.OutcomeTitle} returns — a literal union, so a stored grade is never widened to `string`. */
export type OutcomeTitleText =
  | 'Ships — the model beats the flat guess'
  | 'Ships — a simple baseline'
  | 'No signal — not usable'
  | 'Not evaluated yet';

/**
 * The trust verdict and its copy (static members on one owner, coding standards §2): the verdict, the evidence line and
 * the copy helpers.
 */
export class TrustVerdicts {
  /** The verdict of a model: the stored gate decision of its training run rendered as plain copy. */
  public static DeriveTrustVerdict(input: TrustInput): TrustVerdict {
    const record = GateRecords.ParseStoredGateRecord(input.ValidationResults);
    if (record === null) return NOT_EVALUATED;
    const d = record.decision;
    if (d.outcome === 'no-signal') {
      return {
        Kind: 'evaluated',
        Outcome: 'no-signal',
        CanAct: false,
        Headline: record.guardRefusal === null ? 'No signal: nothing beats the flat guess.' : 'Not shipped: the test set cannot tell this model from chance.',
        Reason: record.reason.text,
        Comparison: null,
        HoldoutRows: record.holdoutRows,
      };
    }
    const iv = d.outcome === 'model' ? record.intervals.modelVsDummy : record.intervals.memberVsDummy[d.shipped];
    if (iv === undefined) return NOT_EVALUATED;
    const by = `${TrustVerdicts.F4(iv.value)} [${TrustVerdicts.F4(iv.lower)}, ${TrustVerdicts.F4(iv.upper)}]`;
    const metric = record.primaryMetric;
    return {
      Kind: 'evaluated',
      Outcome: d.outcome,
      CanAct: true,
      Headline: d.outcome === 'model'
        ? `Beats the flat guess by ${by} (${metric}).`
        : `A simple baseline (${TrustVerdicts.MemberLabel(d.shipped)}) beats the flat guess by ${by} (${metric}); the trained model did not beat it.`,
      Reason: record.reason.text,
      Comparison: { Against: 'the flat guess', Shipped: d.shipped, Value: iv.value, Lower: iv.lower, Upper: iv.upper, Metric: metric },
      HoldoutRows: record.holdoutRows,
    };
  }

  /** A short title for a verdict (badge / banner heading). */
  public static OutcomeTitle(v: TrustVerdict): OutcomeTitleText {
    switch (v.Outcome) {
      case 'model':
        return 'Ships — the model beats the flat guess';
      case 'keep-simple-baseline':
        return 'Ships — a simple baseline';
      case 'no-signal':
        return 'No signal — not usable';
      case null:
        return 'Not evaluated yet';
    }
  }

  /** How a shipped member is named in copy: a heuristic rule by its own name. */
  public static MemberLabel(member: string): string {
    return member.startsWith('heuristic:') ? `the existing rule "${member.slice('heuristic:'.length)}"` : member;
  }

  /** Four decimals, the precision every stored interval is shown at. */
  public static F4(x: number): string {
    return x.toFixed(4);
  }

  /** "Checked against N past members it had never seen." — never fabricates a number. */
  public static TrustEvidenceLine(opts?: TrustEvidenceOptions): string {
    const noun = opts?.noun?.trim() || 'records';
    const count = opts?.count;
    if (count !== null && count !== undefined && Number.isFinite(count) && count > 0) {
      return `Checked against ${Math.round(count).toLocaleString('en-US')} past ${noun} it had never seen.`;
    }
    return `Checked against past ${noun} it had never seen.`;
  }
}

/** Optional context for the evidence line. */
export interface TrustEvidenceOptions {
  /** Rows in the locked holdout (`TrustVerdict.HoldoutRows`). */
  count?: number | null;  // case-violation-ok-legacy-back-compat: existing exported option shape
  /** What the rows are, in plain words (e.g. "members"). */
  noun?: string;  // case-violation-ok-legacy-back-compat: existing exported option shape
}


```

```ts
// packages/Angular/Explorer/dashboards/src/PredictiveStudio/business-predictions.view-models.ts — replace the import,
// BusinessPredictionInput, ToBusinessPredictionCard, GRADE_ORDER, BuildBusinessCatalog and the @deprecated lowercase aliases
// toBusinessPredictionCard / buildBusinessCatalog with the class below (keep the BusinessPredictionCard interface). Callers
// on `next` move to the statics in the same commit: `src/__tests__/business-predictions.test.ts:2,10,18,24,31,37` and
// `resources/ps-predictions-resource.component.ts:11,542`.
import { TrustVerdicts, type TrustInput, type TrustVerdict } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';

export interface BusinessPredictionInput extends TrustInput {
  modelId: string;  // case-violation-ok-legacy-back-compat: the type is named in an exported signature, so consumers build object literals against it; an interface has no runtime carrier for a stub
  name: string;  // case-violation-ok-legacy-back-compat: the type is named in an exported signature, so consumers build object literals against it; an interface has no runtime carrier for a stub
  UpdatedAt?: Date | null;
}

/**
 * The business catalog's cards (static members on one owner, coding standards §2).
 */
export class BusinessPredictions {
  public static ToBusinessPredictionCard(input: BusinessPredictionInput): BusinessPredictionCard {
    const trust = TrustVerdicts.DeriveTrustVerdict(input);
    return {
      modelId: input.modelId,
      title: input.name?.trim() || 'Untitled prediction',
      trust,
      canOpen: trust.CanAct,
      blockedReason: trust.CanAct
        ? null
        : trust.Kind === 'not-evaluated'
          ? 'Not evaluated under an Evaluation Protocol yet — an analyst needs to retrain it.'
          : trust.Reason,
      updatedAt: input.UpdatedAt ?? null,
    };
  }

  public static BuildBusinessCatalog(inputs: BusinessPredictionInput[]): BusinessPredictionCard[] {
    return inputs.map((i) => BusinessPredictions.ToBusinessPredictionCard(i))
      .sort((a, b) => BusinessPredictions.catalogRank(a.trust) - BusinessPredictions.catalogRank(b.trust));
  }

  private static catalogRank(t: TrustVerdict): number {
    switch (t.Outcome) {
      case 'model':
        return 0;
      case 'keep-simple-baseline':
        return 1;
      case 'no-signal':
        return 2;
      case null:
        return 3;
    }
  }
}
```

- [ ] Step 1: Write the measurements and the seven check files (the §6 preamble's harness form for G2.5, G2.7, G2.22, its
  pytest form for G2.1, G2.2, G2.3, G2.8; names from Step 3's table):

```ts
// IT/src/checks/ps-gates/ps-gate-outcomes.ts
/**
 * Gate outcome gate measurements read the gate record stored on the training run: W7 → S4.2 #2 (guards), C1 → S4.2 (the
 * reference-grade outcome) and C1 → S1.3 (the incumbent heuristic as a named comparator). Each trains through MJAPI
 * exactly as a user would (`h.Train`, PredictiveStudio.TrainModel). StoredRunCoverage measures the stored halves of
 * G2.21, G2.33, G2.36 and G2.37 (measured with the evaluation score gates) as additional coverage: reported in `measured`, never part of `passed`.
 */
import { GateRecords, TrainingRunResultsParser, type MetricWithInterval, type StoredGateRecord, type StoredTrainerResult } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import type { MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, MJMLTrainingRunEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { UnitFixtures, type GateMeasurement, type TruthHarness } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-truth-suite';

interface StoredRun { readonly Run: MJMLTrainingRunEntity; readonly Gate: StoredGateRecord | null; readonly Trainer: StoredTrainerResult | null }
const W7_SEEDS = [42, 43, 44] as const;

/** Gate outcome gate measurements (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class GateOutcomeMeasures {
  private static async trainAndRead(h: TruthHarness, pipeline: MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity): Promise<StoredRun> {
    await h.Train(pipeline);
    const run = await UnitFixtures.LatestRun(h, pipeline.ID);
    const envelope = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults(run.ValidationResults);
    const trainer = envelope.Ok && envelope.Value.status === 'completed' ? envelope.Value.trainer : null;
    return { Run: run, Gate: GateRecords.ParseStoredGateRecord(run.ValidationResults), Trainer: trainer };
  }

  private static finite(m: MetricWithInterval): boolean {
    return Number.isFinite(m.interval.lower) && Number.isFinite(m.interval.upper);
  }

  /** Additional coverage: every stored number has both bounds (G2.33), slices cover the protocol (G2.36/G2.37), and precision at capacity is stored when the unit declares a capacity (G2.21). */
  public static StoredRunCoverage(s: StoredRun): Record<string, number | boolean> {
    if (s.Gate === null || s.Trainer === null) return { coverageReadable: false };
    const t = s.Trainer;
    const metrics: MetricWithInterval[] = [t.holdout.primary, ...t.holdout.secondary, ...t.baselines.map((b) => b.holdout)];
    const comparisonsWithoutBounds = Object.values(t.comparisons).filter((c) => !(Number.isFinite(c.ci[0]) && Number.isFinite(c.ci[1]))).length;
    return {
      coverageReadable: true,
      metricsWithoutBounds: metrics.filter((m) => !GateOutcomeMeasures.finite(m)).length + comparisonsWithoutBounds,
      missingSubgroups: s.Gate.sliceCoverage.missingSubgroups.length,
      missingPeriods: s.Gate.sliceCoverage.missingPeriods.length,
      slicesWithoutInterval: s.Gate.sliceCoverage.slicesWithoutInterval,
      precisionAtCapacityStored: t.operatingPoint !== null && GateOutcomeMeasures.finite(t.operatingPoint.precisionAtCapacity),
    };
  }

  /** W7 → S4.2 #2: 0 of 3 seeds return `model` while the holdout AUC interval contains 0.5 or the minority class is below the protocol minimum. */
  public static async MeasureW7GuardedOutcomes(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    let violations = 0;
    let stored = 0;
    let models = 0;
    let boundsMissing = 0;
    for (const seed of W7_SEEDS) {   // sequential: each seed reloads the one W7 world table the next training reads
      await h.EnsureLoaded({ Kind: 'world', ID: 'W7-small-imbalanced', Seed: seed });
      const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionWorldRenewalPipeline(h, 'W7-small-imbalanced', { features: ['EventsAttended', 'AutoRenew', 'IncomeK'] });
      const s = await GateOutcomeMeasures.trainAndRead(h, pipeline);
      if (s.Gate === null) continue;
      stored++;
      const g = s.Gate;
      const counts = g.guards.holdoutClassCounts === null ? [] : Object.values(g.guards.holdoutClassCounts);
      const minority = counts.length === 0 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : Math.min(...counts);
      const auc = g.guards.modelAucInterval;
      const aucContainsChance = auc === null || (auc.lower <= 0.5 && auc.upper >= 0.5);
      if (g.decision.outcome === 'model') {
        models++;
        if (aucContainsChance || minority < g.guards.minMinorityClassRows) violations++;
      }
      const cov = GateOutcomeMeasures.StoredRunCoverage(s);
      boundsMissing += typeof cov.metricsWithoutBounds === 'number' ? cov.metricsWithoutBounds : 1;
    }
    return {
      Passed: stored === W7_SEEDS.length && violations === 0,
      Measured: { seeds: W7_SEEDS.length, stored, models, violations, storedMetricsWithoutBounds: boundsMissing },
      Detail: `${violations} of ${stored} stored W7 decisions ship a model the guards forbid (${models} model outcomes)`,
    };
  }

  /** C1 → S4.2: the stored decision on C1 is keep-simple-baseline (the reference keeps its GLM). */
  public static async MeasureC1GateOutcome(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    const { Pipeline: pipeline } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionC1AssemblyPipeline(h);
    const s = await GateOutcomeMeasures.trainAndRead(h, pipeline);
    if (s.Gate === null) return { Passed: false, Measured: { runStatus: s.Run.Status }, Detail: `run ${s.Run.ID} stored no gate record` };
    const g = s.Gate;
    const glm = g.intervals.memberVsDummy['glm'];
    return {
      Passed: g.decision.outcome === 'keep-simple-baseline',
      Measured: {
        outcome: g.decision.outcome, shipped: g.decision.shipped ?? 'none', reason: g.reason.code,
        glmVsDummy: glm === undefined ? 'absent' : `${glm.value.toFixed(4)} [${glm.lower.toFixed(4)}, ${glm.upper.toFixed(4)}]`,
        ...GateOutcomeMeasures.StoredRunCoverage(s),
      },
      Detail: `C1 stored ${g.decision.outcome} (${g.decision.shipped ?? 'nothing'}); reference: keep-simple-baseline, GLM beats one-feature by 0.0130 [0.0015, 0.0229]`,
    };
  }

  /**
   * C1 → S1.3: the unit's declared heuristic ("renewed last year", C1RenewalUnitDraft) is scored on the same holdout as a
   * named comparator (stored baseline row with both bounds and its `heuristic:<name>VsDummy` comparison), and when the
   * model does not beat it by the margin the stored outcome is not `model` and carries its reason —
   * `heuristic-carries-signal` when the heuristic is the member kept.
   */
  public static async MeasureC1IncumbentHeuristic(h: TruthHarness): Promise<GateMeasurement> {
    const { Pipeline: pipeline, Unit: unit } = await UnitFixtures.ProvisionC1AssemblyPipeline(h);
    if (unit.incumbent.kind !== 'rule') return { Passed: false, Measured: {}, Detail: 'the C1 unit declares no incumbent heuristic' };
    const member = `heuristic:${unit.incumbent.name}`;
    const s = await GateOutcomeMeasures.trainAndRead(h, pipeline);
    if (s.Gate === null || s.Trainer === null) return { Passed: false, Measured: { runStatus: s.Run.Status }, Detail: `run ${s.Run.ID} stored no gate record` };
    const g = s.Gate;
    const row = s.Trainer.baselines.find((b) => b.baseline.kind === 'incumbent-heuristic' && b.baseline.name === unit.incumbent.name);
    const vsDummy = s.Trainer.comparisons[`${member}VsDummy`];
    const modelVsRule = s.Trainer.comparisons[`modelVs:${member}`];
    const scored = row !== undefined && GateOutcomeMeasures.finite(row.holdout) && vsDummy !== undefined;
    const modelBeatsRule = modelVsRule !== undefined && modelVsRule.ci[0] > g.margin;
    const outcomeConsistent = modelBeatsRule
      || (g.decision.outcome !== 'model' && g.reason.text.length > 0 && (g.decision.shipped !== member || g.reason.code === 'heuristic-carries-signal'));
    return {
      Passed: scored && outcomeConsistent,
      Measured: { scored, modelBeatsRule, outcome: g.decision.outcome, shipped: g.decision.shipped ?? 'none', reason: g.reason.code },
      Detail: `heuristic ${scored ? 'scored' : 'not scored'} on the holdout; stored ${g.decision.outcome} (${g.reason.code})`,
    };
  }
}
```

### M11 — UI, migration of existing pipelines, operations, docs  ·  parallel-safe: yes — either run M11.1–M11.5 sequentially on `ps/pr-3-honest-training`, or branch `ps/pr-3-honest-training--m11b` (M11.3–M11.5) after M11.1 Step 3 commits `Core/src/protocol-rows.ts` (which M11.3 imports) while `ps/pr-3-honest-training--m11a` completes M11.1 Step 4–M11.2 (`program/conventions.md` §3); M11.3 Step 6 (legacy-path deletion) runs after both sub-branches are merged back  ·  depends on: M10

**Outcome:** analysts author and view Prediction Units and Evaluation Protocols in Explorer — versions are immutable rows
and "edit" saves the next version (protocol guard fields governed by the protocol's `GuardFieldsEditableBy` setting,
`non-agent` by default — never an agent tool call, D3-40; the label version bumped when the outcome definition
changes) — bind a pipeline to the unit and protocol versions it trains under, and see each training run's
protocol results: scores with intervals, baselines, improvement over the flat guess, the gate outcome and its reason,
calibration and leakage flags, with the winner's inner score labelled optimistic. Every existing pipeline is migrated by a
dry-run-first Action to a version-1 Prediction Unit (from `TargetEntity`/`TargetVariable`/`ProblemType`/`AsOfStrategy`)
and a version-1 Evaluation Protocol (from `ValidationStrategy`/`LeakageGuard`), or archived with the reason in its
description when it cannot be expressed; the legacy training path is then deleted and a pipeline without a unit or a
protocol is refused (§5.5). `PredictiveStudio.TrainModel` and the Train ML Model Action return the stored gate decision,
the snapshot and the protocol; the retired inputs are gone. The Predictive Studio guide sections this milestone changes
describe what ships. M11 flips no gate and closes no finding.

**Milestone start:** the §6 preamble's steps (on each sub-branch, from the PR branch head after M10).

**Layering of this task:** every component this task adds under `components/` is written to the L1 discipline, so a
later extraction of the whole PS widget set into its own package is a mechanical move and its own decision (D3-64): L1 (presentational:
`evaluation-results`, `protocol-summary`, `protocol-editor`, `unit-summary`, `unit-editor`) or L2 (`protocol-versions`,
`unit-versions`, `pipeline-bindings`, `run-evaluation`, `versioned-list`: extend `BaseAngularComponent`, read and save only
through `this.ProviderToUse`, and emit events instead of navigating). No file imports `@angular/router`, `NavigationService` or
another Explorer package; L1 components take inputs and emit events and read no data. The Core L0 helpers are browser-safe (no Node imports): new version rows get their ID from
`globalThis.crypto.randomUUID()`, available in every supported browser and in Node ≥ 19.

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { EvaluationProtocolRules, type EvaluationProtocolSpec, type PredictionUnitSpec } from '../index';

const unit: PredictionUnitSpec = {
  id: '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555', lineageRootId: '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555', version: 1, name: 'Event visits',
  rows: { kind: 'grain', grainEntity: 'Members', decisionDate: { kind: 'column', column: 'DecisionDate' }, filter: [] },
  label: { rule: { kind: 'column', column: 'Visits' }, windowDays: 365, gapDays: 0, outcome: { kind: 'count' }, labelVersion: 1 },
  censoring: { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'now' } }, history: { onUncoveredRow: 'refuse', externalSourceRows: 'ineligible' },
  groupKey: null, temporal: null,
  decision: { action: 'call', actorRole: 'team', capacityPerPeriod: null, period: 'month' },
  incumbent: { kind: 'none' }, authoredBy: { kind: 'human', userId: '5E3B0C2A-6E2F-4C55-9E1A-2B1D7F0A9C11' },
};
const base: EvaluationProtocolSpec = {
  ...EvaluationProtocolRules.DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft({
    Unit: unit, Name: 'Visits protocol',
    Holdout: { kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'DecisionDate', cutoff: '2024-01-01', holdoutEnd: null, newEntityReport: null },
    Candidates: 3, Seed: 42,
  }),
  id: '33333333-4444-4555-8666-777777777777', lineageRootId: '33333333-4444-4555-8666-777777777777', version: 1,
  authoredBy: { kind: 'human', userId: '5E3B0C2A-6E2F-4C55-9E1A-2B1D7F0A9C11' },
};

describe('protocol editing (a new version from the previous one)', () => {
  it('offers only primary scores of the protocol family (no RMSE for a count protocol)', () => {
    expect(ProtocolEdits.PrimaryMetricOptions(base.primaryScore.family)).toEqual(['poisson-deviance']);
  });
  it('applies the form-editable fields and keeps the rest of the previous version', () => {
    const form = { ...ProtocolEdits.ProtocolEditFormFrom(base), Cutoff: '2023-07-01', HoldoutEnd: '2024-07-01', Margin: 0.002, MaxCandidates: 6, GuardFieldsEditableBy: 'human-only' as const };
    const r = ProtocolEdits.ApplyProtocolEdits(base, form);
    if (!r.Ok) throw new Error(r.Error);
    expect(r.Draft.holdout).toEqual({ ...base.holdout, cutoff: '2023-07-01', holdoutEnd: '2024-07-01' });
    expect(r.Draft.promotion.margin).toBe(0.002);
    expect(r.Draft.budgets).toEqual({ ...base.budgets, maxCandidates: 6 });
    expect(r.Draft.guardFieldsEditableBy).toBe('human-only');
    expect(ProtocolEdits.ProtocolEditFormFrom(base).GuardFieldsEditableBy).toBe('non-agent');
    expect(r.Draft.baselines).toEqual(base.baselines);
    expect(r.Draft.exclusions).toEqual(base.exclusions);
    expect(Object.keys(r.Draft)).not.toContain('id');
    expect(Object.keys(r.Draft)).not.toContain('authoredBy');
  });
  it('refuses a negative margin, a malformed date and a metric from another family', () => {
    expect(ProtocolEdits.ApplyProtocolEdits(base, { ...ProtocolEdits.ProtocolEditFormFrom(base), Margin: -0.1 })).toMatchObject({ Ok: false });
    expect(ProtocolEdits.ApplyProtocolEdits(base, { ...ProtocolEdits.ProtocolEditFormFrom(base), Cutoff: '2024-1-1' })).toEqual({ Ok: false, Error: 'The test-set start must be a date yyyy-mm-dd (got "2024-1-1").' });
    expect(ProtocolEdits.ApplyProtocolEdits(base, { ...ProtocolEdits.ProtocolEditFormFrom(base), PrimaryMetric: 'rmse' })).toEqual({ Ok: false, Error: 'rmse is not a count score; choose one of: poisson-deviance.' });
  });
});
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/__tests__/unit-edit.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import type { PredictionUnitSpec } from '../index';
import { UnitEdits, type UnitEditForm } from '../unit-edit';

const form: UnitEditForm = {
  Name: 'Member renewal', GrainEntity: 'Membership Years', DecisionDateColumn: 'StartDate', LabelColumn: 'Renewed',
  WindowDays: 365, GapDays: 0, TaskKind: 'binary', ClassOrder: 'Lapsed, Renewed', AdverseClass: 'Lapsed', TweediePower: 1.5,
  CensoringMode: 'now', CensoringFixedAt: '', GroupKey: 'PersonID',
};

function asSpec(r: ReturnType<typeof UnitEdits.ApplyUnitEdits>, version: number): PredictionUnitSpec {
  if (!r.Ok) throw new Error(r.Error);
  const d = r.Draft;
  return {
    id: '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555', lineageRootId: '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555', version, name: d.Name,
    rows: d.UnitRows, label: { rule: d.LabelRule, windowDays: d.LabelWindowDays, gapDays: d.LabelGapDays, outcome: d.TaskType, labelVersion: r.LabelVersion },
    censoring: d.Censoring, history: d.ChangeHistoryPolicy, groupKey: d.GroupKey, temporal: d.TemporalSpec, decision: d.DecisionSpec,
    incumbent: d.IncumbentHeuristic, authoredBy: { kind: 'human', userId: '5E3B0C2A-6E2F-4C55-9E1A-2B1D7F0A9C11' },
  };
}

describe('unit editing', () => {
  it('builds version 1 with label version 1 and the adverse class as an index into the class order', () => {
    const r = UnitEdits.ApplyUnitEdits(null, form);
    if (!r.Ok) throw new Error(r.Error);
    expect(r.Draft.TaskType).toEqual({ kind: 'binary', classOrder: ['Lapsed', 'Renewed'], adverseIndex: 0 });
    expect(r.Draft.LabelRule).toEqual({ kind: 'column', column: 'Renewed' });
    expect(r.LabelVersion).toBe(1);
    expect(r.Draft.GroupKey).toBe('PersonID');
  });
  it('bumps the label version when the outcome definition changes and keeps it otherwise (S2.3)', () => {
    const v1 = asSpec(UnitEdits.ApplyUnitEdits(null, form), 1);
    const relabel = UnitEdits.ApplyUnitEdits(v1, { ...UnitEdits.UnitEditFormFrom(v1), WindowDays: 400 });
    const regroup = UnitEdits.ApplyUnitEdits(v1, { ...UnitEdits.UnitEditFormFrom(v1), GroupKey: '' });
    expect(relabel.Ok && relabel.LabelVersion).toBe(2);
    expect(regroup.Ok && regroup.LabelVersion).toBe(1);
  });
  it('refuses a binary unit whose class order is not two classes or whose adverse class is not one of them', () => {
    expect(UnitEdits.ApplyUnitEdits(null, { ...form, ClassOrder: 'A, B, C' })).toEqual({ Ok: false, Error: 'A binary outcome needs exactly two classes in artifact order, e.g. "Lapsed, Renewed".' });
    expect(UnitEdits.ApplyUnitEdits(null, { ...form, AdverseClass: 'Gone' })).toEqual({ Ok: false, Error: 'The adverse class "Gone" is not one of: Lapsed, Renewed.' });
  });
});
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/__tests__/protocol-rows.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { EvaluationProtocolRules, EvaluationProtocol, type PredictionUnitSpec } from '../index';
import { ProtocolRows, type EvaluationProtocolRowTarget } from '../protocol-rows';

const unit: PredictionUnitSpec = {
  id: '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555', lineageRootId: '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555', version: 3, name: 'Spend',
  rows: { kind: 'grain', grainEntity: 'Members', decisionDate: { kind: 'column', column: 'DecisionDate' }, filter: [] },
  label: { rule: { kind: 'column', column: 'Spend' }, windowDays: 1, gapDays: 0, outcome: { kind: 'continuous' }, labelVersion: 1 },
  censoring: { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'now' } }, history: { onUncoveredRow: 'refuse', externalSourceRows: 'ineligible' },
  groupKey: null, temporal: null,
  decision: { action: 'a', actorRole: 'r', capacityPerPeriod: null, period: 'year' },
  incumbent: { kind: 'none' }, authoredBy: { kind: 'system', component: 'C1-prediction-unit' },
};

function emptyRow(): EvaluationProtocolRowTarget {
  return {
    ID: '', LineageRootID: '', Version: 0, Name: '', Description: null, Holdout: '', InnerValidation: '', Seed: 0, HoldoutAccessBudget: 0,
    PrimaryScore: '', SecondaryMetrics: '', Baselines: '', Calibration: '', Resampling: '', Intervals: '', Promotion: '',
    AllowedOutcomes: '', LeakageAudit: '', Exclusions: '', Slices: '', PredictionIntervals: null, ResidualDiagnostics: null,
    RetrainTriggers: '', SearchStrategy: '', Budgets: '', MinMinorityClassRows: 0, GuardFieldsEditableBy: '', AuthoredBy: '',
  };
}

describe('ApplyProtocolDraftToRow', () => {
  it('writes every column of a version-1 row that is its own lineage root and parses back to the same protocol', () => {
    const draft = EvaluationProtocolRules.DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft({
      Unit: unit, Name: 'Spend protocol',
      Holdout: { kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'DecisionDate', cutoff: '2024-01-01', holdoutEnd: null, newEntityReport: null },
      Candidates: 1, Seed: 7,
    });
    const row = emptyRow();
    const id = ProtocolRows.NewVersionRowID();
    ProtocolRows.ApplyProtocolDraftToRow(row, draft, { ID: id, LineageRootID: id, Version: 1, AuthoredBy: { kind: 'human', userId: '5E3B0C2A-6E2F-4C55-9E1A-2B1D7F0A9C11' } });
    expect(row.ID).toBe(id);
    expect(row.LineageRootID).toBe(id);
    expect(row.Name).toBe('Spend protocol');
    expect(JSON.parse(row.AllowedOutcomes)).toEqual(['model', 'keep-simple-baseline', 'no-signal']);
    expect(JSON.parse(row.PredictionIntervals ?? 'null')).toEqual({ method: 'split-conformal', nominalCoverage: [0.8, 0.9] });
    expect(EvaluationProtocol.GetEvaluationProtocolShapeProblems(row)).toEqual([]);
    const parsed = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(row);
    expect(parsed.Ok && parsed.Value.holdout).toEqual(draft.holdout);
    expect(parsed.Ok && parsed.Value.authoredBy).toEqual({ kind: 'human', userId: '5E3B0C2A-6E2F-4C55-9E1A-2B1D7F0A9C11' });
  });
  it('leaves the ID to the database for a later version, which points at version 1', () => {
    const draft = EvaluationProtocolRules.DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft({
      Unit: unit, Name: 'Spend protocol',
      Holdout: { kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn: 'DecisionDate', cutoff: '2024-01-01', holdoutEnd: null, newEntityReport: null },
      Candidates: 1, Seed: 7,
    });
    const row = emptyRow();
    ProtocolRows.ApplyProtocolDraftToRow(row, draft, { ID: null, LineageRootID: '33333333-4444-4555-8666-777777777777', Version: 2, AuthoredBy: { kind: 'human', userId: 'U' } });
    expect(row.ID).toBe('');
    expect([row.Version, row.LineageRootID]).toEqual([2, '33333333-4444-4555-8666-777777777777']);

});
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/protocol-rows.ts
/**
 * @module protocol-rows
 * Writes a protocol draft or a unit draft into the columns of a new version row (every version is its own row;
 * version 1 is its own lineage root, a later version carries version 1's ID in `LineageRootID`). The row targets are
 * structural: the generated `MJEvaluationProtocolEntity` / `MJPredictionUnitEntity` satisfy them without a cast.
 * Browser-safe; the Explorer widgets and the server-side migration both use it.
 */
import type { Actor, CensoringRule, ChangeHistoryPolicy, DecisionSpec, IncumbentHeuristic, LabelRule, TemporalSpec, UnitRows } from './prediction-unit';
import type { TaskType } from './task-type';
import { EvaluationProtocolRules, type EvaluationProtocolDraft, type ProtocolRowMeta } from './evaluation-protocol-rules';


export interface EvaluationProtocolRowTarget {
  ID: string;
  LineageRootID: string;
  Version: number;
  Name: string;
  Description: string | null;
  Holdout: string;
  InnerValidation: string;
  Seed: number;
  HoldoutAccessBudget: number;
  PrimaryScore: string;
  SecondaryMetrics: string;
  Baselines: string;
  Calibration: string;
  Resampling: string;
  Intervals: string;
  Promotion: string;
  AllowedOutcomes: string;
  LeakageAudit: string;
  Exclusions: string;
  Slices: string;
  PredictionIntervals: string | null;
  ResidualDiagnostics: string | null;
  RetrainTriggers: string;
  SearchStrategy: string;
  Budgets: string;
  MinMinorityClassRows: number;
  GuardFieldsEditableBy: string;
  AuthoredBy: string;
}

/**
 * Row identity of a version written into an existing row object. Differs from `ProtocolRowMeta` (whose `ID` is
 * always supplied) only in letting a later version leave `ID` to the database; a separate name keeps Core's
 * `export *` free of a duplicate member.
 */
export interface ProtocolRowWriteMeta extends Omit<ProtocolRowMeta, 'ID'> {
  /** Version 1: the client-supplied ID (= LineageRootID). Later versions: null (the database default assigns it). */
  readonly ID: string | null;
  readonly Description?: string | null;
}


/**
 * The columns of a unit version before it has a row identity. Field-for-field the same shape as the Engine's
 * `PredictionUnitDraft`, so a `UnitDraft` can be passed to `CreatePredictionUnitV1` unchanged.
 */
export interface UnitDraft {
  readonly Name: string;
  readonly Description: string | null;
  readonly UnitRows: UnitRows;
  readonly LabelRule: LabelRule;
  readonly LabelWindowDays: number;
  readonly LabelGapDays: number;
  readonly TaskType: TaskType;
  readonly Censoring: CensoringRule;
  readonly ChangeHistoryPolicy: ChangeHistoryPolicy;
  readonly GroupKey: string | null;
  readonly TemporalSpec: TemporalSpec | null;
  readonly DecisionSpec: DecisionSpec;
  readonly IncumbentHeuristic: IncumbentHeuristic;
}

export interface PredictionUnitRowTarget {
  ID: string;
  LineageRootID: string;
  Version: number;
  LabelVersion: number;
  Name: string;
  Description: string | null;
  UnitRows: string;
  LabelRule: string;
  LabelWindowDays: number;
  LabelGapDays: number;
  TaskType: string;
  Censoring: string;
  ChangeHistoryPolicy: string;
  GroupKey: string | null;
  TemporalSpec: string | null;
  DecisionSpec: string;
  IncumbentHeuristic: string;
  AuthoredBy: string;
}

export interface UnitRowMeta {
  readonly ID: string | null;
  readonly LineageRootID: string;
  readonly Version: number;
  readonly LabelVersion: number;
  readonly AuthoredBy: Actor;
}

/** Writing drafts into new version rows (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class ProtocolRows {
  /** A new row ID for version 1 of a lineage (the client supplies it so LineageRootID = ID, CK_*_LineageRoot). */
  public static NewVersionRowID(): string {
    return globalThis.crypto.randomUUID().toUpperCase();
  }

  public static ApplyProtocolDraftToRow(row: EvaluationProtocolRowTarget, d: EvaluationProtocolDraft, meta: ProtocolRowWriteMeta): void {
    // One serialisation of a draft (the protocol writer's, the inverse of the protocol parser): this writer only adds the row-identity rules.
    const { ID, ...columns } = EvaluationProtocolRules.EvaluationProtocolColumnsFromDraft(d, { ID: meta.ID || '', LineageRootID: meta.LineageRootID, Version: meta.Version, AuthoredBy: meta.AuthoredBy });
    Object.assign(row, columns);
    if (meta.ID !== null) row.ID = ID;
    row.Description = meta.Description ?? null;   // `??`: an empty description is kept as written
  }

  public static ApplyPredictionUnitDraftToRow(row: PredictionUnitRowTarget, d: UnitDraft, meta: UnitRowMeta): void {
    if (meta.ID !== null) row.ID = meta.ID;
    row.LineageRootID = meta.LineageRootID;
    row.Version = meta.Version;
    row.LabelVersion = meta.LabelVersion;
    row.Name = d.Name;
    row.Description = d.Description;
    row.UnitRows = JSON.stringify(d.UnitRows);
    row.LabelRule = JSON.stringify(d.LabelRule);
    row.LabelWindowDays = d.LabelWindowDays;
    row.LabelGapDays = d.LabelGapDays;
    row.TaskType = JSON.stringify(d.TaskType);
    row.Censoring = JSON.stringify(d.Censoring);
    row.ChangeHistoryPolicy = JSON.stringify(d.ChangeHistoryPolicy);
    row.GroupKey = d.GroupKey;
    row.TemporalSpec = d.TemporalSpec === null ? null : JSON.stringify(d.TemporalSpec);
    row.DecisionSpec = JSON.stringify(d.DecisionSpec);
    row.IncumbentHeuristic = JSON.stringify(d.IncumbentHeuristic);
    row.AuthoredBy = JSON.stringify(meta.AuthoredBy);
  }
}
```

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/protocol-edit.ts
/**
 * @module protocol-edit
 * The form-editable fields of a protocol version and how they apply to the previous version. Every other field is
 * carried over unchanged; the server's ValidateAsync remains the authority. A protocol's primary-score family
 * is fixed by its first version (a family change is a different protocol, bound to a different unit).
 */
import { EvaluationProtocol, PROPER_SCORES_BY_FAMILY, type EvaluationProtocolSpec, type GuardFieldsEditableBy, type ProperScore } from './evaluation-protocol';
import type { EvaluationProtocolDraft } from './evaluation-protocol-rules';

const ISO_DAY = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

export interface ProtocolEditForm {
  Name: string;
  Cutoff: string;
  /** '' = no holdout end. */
  HoldoutEnd: string;
  Folds: number;
  Repeats: number;
  PrimaryMetric: ProperScore['metric'];
  Margin: number;
  MaxComputeSeconds: number;
  MaxCandidates: number;
  Seed: number;
  /** Who may change the guard fields in the version after this one. */
  GuardFieldsEditableBy: GuardFieldsEditableBy;
}


export type ProtocolEditResult = { readonly Ok: true; readonly Draft: EvaluationProtocolDraft } | { readonly Ok: false; readonly Error: string };

/** Protocol editing from a form (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class ProtocolEdits {
  public static ProtocolEditFormFrom(p: EvaluationProtocolSpec): ProtocolEditForm {
    const h = p.holdout;
    const iv = p.innerValidation;
    return {
      Name: p.name,
      Cutoff: h.kind === 'date-carved' ? h.cutoff : '',
      HoldoutEnd: h.kind === 'date-carved' ? h.holdoutEnd ?? '' : '',
      Folds: iv.folds,
      Repeats: iv.kind === 'blocked-time' ? 1 : iv.repeats,
      PrimaryMetric: p.primaryScore.metric,
      Margin: p.promotion.margin,
      MaxComputeSeconds: p.budgets.maxComputeSeconds,
      MaxCandidates: p.budgets.maxCandidates,
      Seed: p.seed,
      GuardFieldsEditableBy: p.guardFieldsEditableBy,
    };
  }

  /** The primary scores a protocol of this family may rank by (one source: PROPER_SCORES_BY_FAMILY). */
  public static PrimaryMetricOptions(family: ProperScore['family']): readonly ProperScore['metric'][] {
    return PROPER_SCORES_BY_FAMILY[family];
  }

  public static ApplyProtocolEdits(base: EvaluationProtocolSpec, form: ProtocolEditForm): ProtocolEditResult {
    const family = base.primaryScore.family;
    const primary = ProtocolEdits.properScoreFor(family, form.PrimaryMetric);
    if (primary === null) {
      return { Ok: false, Error: `${form.PrimaryMetric} is not a ${family} score; choose one of: ${ProtocolEdits.PrimaryMetricOptions(family).join(', ')}.` };
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(form.Folds) || form.Folds < 2 || !Number.isInteger(form.Repeats) || form.Repeats < 1) {
      return { Ok: false, Error: 'Folds must be a whole number of at least 2 and repeats at least 1.' };
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(form.MaxCandidates) || form.MaxCandidates < 1 || !(form.MaxComputeSeconds > 0)) {
      return { Ok: false, Error: 'The budget needs at least one candidate and a positive number of compute seconds.' };
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(form.Margin) || form.Margin < 0) {
      return { Ok: false, Error: `The margin must be a number >= 0 (got ${String(form.Margin)}).` };
    }
    if (form.Name.trim().length === 0) return { Ok: false, Error: 'The protocol needs a name.' };
    const holdout = base.holdout;
    if (holdout.kind === 'date-carved') {
      if (!ISO_DAY.test(form.Cutoff)) return { Ok: false, Error: `The test-set start must be a date yyyy-mm-dd (got "${form.Cutoff}").` };
      const end = form.HoldoutEnd.trim();
      if (end !== '' && (!ISO_DAY.test(end) || end <= form.Cutoff)) {
        return { Ok: false, Error: `The test-set end must be a date yyyy-mm-dd after the start (got "${end}").` };
      }
    }
    const { id: _id, lineageRootId: _root, version: _version, authoredBy: _author, ...carried } = base;
    const innerValidation = base.innerValidation;
    return {
      Ok: true,
      Draft: {
        ...carried,
        name: form.Name.trim(),
        holdout: holdout.kind === 'date-carved'
          ? { ...holdout, cutoff: form.Cutoff, holdoutEnd: form.HoldoutEnd.trim() === '' ? null : form.HoldoutEnd.trim() }
          : holdout,
        innerValidation: innerValidation.kind === 'blocked-time'
          ? { ...innerValidation, folds: form.Folds }
          : { ...innerValidation, folds: form.Folds, repeats: form.Repeats },
        primaryScore: primary,
        seed: form.Seed,
        promotion: { ...base.promotion, margin: EvaluationProtocol.ToNonNegative(form.Margin) },
        budgets: { ...base.budgets, maxComputeSeconds: form.MaxComputeSeconds, maxCandidates: form.MaxCandidates },
        guardFieldsEditableBy: form.GuardFieldsEditableBy,
      },
    };
  }

  private static properScoreFor(family: ProperScore['family'], metric: ProperScore['metric']): ProperScore | null {
    switch (family) {
      case 'binary':
        return metric === 'log-loss' || metric === 'brier' ? { family, metric } : null;
      case 'multiclass':
        return metric === 'multiclass-log-loss' ? { family, metric } : null;
      case 'continuous':
        return metric === 'rmse' || metric === 'mae' ? { family, metric } : null;
      case 'count':
        return metric === 'poisson-deviance' ? { family, metric } : null;
      case 'non-negative':
        return metric === 'tweedie-deviance' ? { family, metric } : null;
      case 'forecast':
        return metric === 'mase' || metric === 'rmse' ? { family, metric } : null;
    }
  }
}
```

  (The destructuring drops the row identity and author: a draft has neither; the editor's caller supplies them through

  `^_` names.)

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/unit-edit.ts
/**
 * @module unit-edit
 * Authoring a Prediction Unit version from a form. The form edits grain units whose decision date is a column and whose
 * outcome is a column of the row; a grain-x-periods row rule, a next-period or child-event outcome rule, the Temporal
 * Spec, the decision and the incumbent heuristic are carried over from the previous version unchanged (they are edited
 * as JSON on the generated record form). The label version is bumped when the outcome rule, window, gap or task
 * changes (S2.3) — the same rule as `BuildNextVersionColumns`.
 */
import type { CensoringRule, LabelRule, PredictionUnitSpec, UnitRows } from './prediction-unit';
import type { TaskType } from './task-type';
import type { UnitDraft } from './protocol-rows';

const ISO_DAY = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

export interface UnitEditForm {
  Name: string;
  GrainEntity: string;
  DecisionDateColumn: string;
  LabelColumn: string;
  WindowDays: number;
  GapDays: number;
  TaskKind: 'binary' | 'multiclass' | 'continuous' | 'count' | 'non-negative';
  /** Comma-separated class labels in artifact order (classification). */
  ClassOrder: string;
  /** Binary: one class; multiclass: a comma-separated list. */
  AdverseClass: string;
  TweediePower: number;
  /** `corpus-end` is offered only when the previous version used it (its entity and field are carried over). */
  CensoringMode: 'now' | 'fixed' | 'corpus-end';
  /** yyyy-mm-dd when CensoringMode is `fixed`. */
  CensoringFixedAt: string;
  /** '' = no group key. */
  GroupKey: string;
}

export type UnitEditResult =
  | { readonly Ok: true; readonly Draft: UnitDraft; readonly LabelVersion: number }
  | { readonly Ok: false; readonly Error: string };

/** Unit authoring from a form (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class UnitEdits {
  public static UnitEditFormFrom(u: PredictionUnitSpec): UnitEditForm {
    const o = u.label.outcome;
    const cutoff = u.censoring.cutoff;
    return {
      Name: u.name,
      GrainEntity: u.rows.grainEntity,
      DecisionDateColumn: u.rows.kind === 'grain' && u.rows.decisionDate.kind === 'column' ? u.rows.decisionDate.column : '',
      LabelColumn: u.label.rule.kind === 'column' ? u.label.rule.column : '',
      WindowDays: u.label.windowDays,
      GapDays: u.label.gapDays,
      TaskKind: o.kind === 'forecast' ? (o.valueKind === 'continuous' ? 'continuous' : o.valueKind) : o.kind,
      ClassOrder: o.kind === 'binary' || o.kind === 'multiclass' ? o.classOrder.join(', ') : '',
      AdverseClass: o.kind === 'binary' ? o.classOrder[o.adverseIndex] : o.kind === 'multiclass' ? o.adverseIndices.map((i) => o.classOrder[i] ?? '').join(', ') : '',
      TweediePower: o.kind === 'non-negative' ? o.tweediePower : 1.5,
      CensoringMode: cutoff.kind,
      CensoringFixedAt: cutoff.kind === 'fixed' ? cutoff.at : '',
      GroupKey: u.groupKey ?? '',
    };
  }

  /** The label version of the next version of `base` (1 for a new lineage). */
  public static NextLabelVersion(base: PredictionUnitSpec | null, next: Pick<UnitDraft, 'LabelRule' | 'LabelWindowDays' | 'LabelGapDays' | 'TaskType'>): number {
    if (base === null) return 1;
    const before = JSON.stringify([base.label.rule, base.label.windowDays, base.label.gapDays, base.label.outcome]);
    const after = JSON.stringify([next.LabelRule, next.LabelWindowDays, next.LabelGapDays, next.TaskType]);
    return before === after ? base.label.labelVersion : base.label.labelVersion + 1;
  }

  public static ApplyUnitEdits(base: PredictionUnitSpec | null, form: UnitEditForm): UnitEditResult {
    if (form.Name.trim().length === 0) return { Ok: false, Error: 'The unit needs a name.' };
    if (!Number.isInteger(form.WindowDays) || form.WindowDays < 1) return { Ok: false, Error: 'The outcome window must be a whole number of days, at least 1.' };
    if (!Number.isInteger(form.GapDays) || form.GapDays < 0) return { Ok: false, Error: 'The gap must be a whole number of days, 0 or more.' };
    const task = base !== null && base.label.outcome.kind === 'forecast' ? base.label.outcome : UnitEdits.outcomeFrom(form);
    if (typeof task === 'string') return { Ok: false, Error: task };
    const rows = UnitEdits.rowsFrom(base, form);
    if (typeof rows === 'string') return { Ok: false, Error: rows };
    const rule = UnitEdits.ruleFrom(base, form);
    if (typeof rule === 'string') return { Ok: false, Error: rule };
    const censoring = UnitEdits.censoringFrom(base, form);
    if (typeof censoring === 'string') return { Ok: false, Error: censoring };
    const draft: UnitDraft = {
      Name: form.Name.trim(),
      Description: null,
      UnitRows: rows,
      LabelRule: rule,
      LabelWindowDays: form.WindowDays,
      LabelGapDays: form.GapDays,
      TaskType: task,
      Censoring: censoring,
      ChangeHistoryPolicy: base?.history ?? { onUncoveredRow: 'refuse', externalSourceRows: 'ineligible' },
      GroupKey: form.GroupKey.trim() === '' ? null : form.GroupKey.trim(),
      TemporalSpec: base?.temporal ?? null,
      DecisionSpec: base?.decision ?? { action: 'review', actorRole: 'analyst', capacityPerPeriod: null, period: 'month' },
      IncumbentHeuristic: base?.incumbent ?? { kind: 'none' },
    };
    return { Ok: true, Draft: draft, LabelVersion: UnitEdits.NextLabelVersion(base, draft) };
  }

  private static rowsFrom(base: PredictionUnitSpec | null, form: UnitEditForm): UnitRows | string {
    if (base !== null && (base.rows.kind === 'grain-x-periods' || base.rows.decisionDate.kind !== 'column')) return base.rows;
    const entity = form.GrainEntity.trim();
    const column = form.DecisionDateColumn.trim();
    if (entity === '' || column === '') return 'Name the entity whose records are the rows and its decision-date column.';
    return { kind: 'grain', grainEntity: entity, decisionDate: { kind: 'column', column }, filter: base?.rows.filter ?? [] };
  }

  private static ruleFrom(base: PredictionUnitSpec | null, form: UnitEditForm): LabelRule | string {
    if (base !== null && base.label.rule.kind !== 'column') return base.label.rule;
    const column = form.LabelColumn.trim();
    return column === '' ? 'Name the column that holds the outcome.' : { kind: 'column', column };
  }

  private static censoringFrom(base: PredictionUnitSpec | null, form: UnitEditForm): CensoringRule | string {
    switch (form.CensoringMode) {
      case 'now':
        return { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'now' } };
      case 'fixed':
        return ISO_DAY.test(form.CensoringFixedAt)
          ? { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'fixed', at: form.CensoringFixedAt } }
          : `The censoring date must be yyyy-mm-dd (got "${form.CensoringFixedAt}").`;
      case 'corpus-end':
        return base !== null && base.censoring.cutoff.kind === 'corpus-end'
          ? base.censoring
          : 'A corpus-end cutoff names an entity and a date field; edit it as JSON on the record form.';
    }
  }

  /** A TaskType, or the error text. */
  private static outcomeFrom(form: UnitEditForm): TaskType | string {
    const classes = form.ClassOrder.split(',').map((c) => c.trim()).filter((c) => c.length > 0);
    switch (form.TaskKind) {
      case 'binary': {
        const [first, second] = classes;
        if (classes.length !== 2 || first === undefined || second === undefined) {
          return 'A binary outcome needs exactly two classes in artifact order, e.g. "Lapsed, Renewed".';
        }
        const idx = classes.indexOf(form.AdverseClass.trim());
        if (idx === 0 || idx === 1) return { kind: 'binary', classOrder: [first, second], adverseIndex: idx };
        return `The adverse class "${form.AdverseClass.trim()}" is not one of: ${classes.join(', ')}.`;
      }
      case 'multiclass': {
        if (classes.length < 3) return 'A multiclass outcome needs at least three classes.';
        const adverse = form.AdverseClass.split(',').map((c) => c.trim()).filter((c) => c.length > 0);
        const indices = adverse.map((a) => classes.indexOf(a));
        if (indices.some((i) => i < 0)) return `Every adverse class must be one of: ${classes.join(', ')}.`;
        return { kind: 'multiclass', classOrder: classes, adverseIndices: indices };
      }
      case 'continuous':
        return { kind: 'continuous' };
      case 'count':
        return { kind: 'count' };
      case 'non-negative':
        return form.TweediePower > 1 && form.TweediePower < 2 ? { kind: 'non-negative', tweediePower: form.TweediePower } : 'The Tweedie power must be between 1 and 2.';
    }
  }
}
```
