```ts
    expect(host.querySelector('[data-testid="ps-protocol-refusals"]')?.textContent).toContain('An agent tool call cannot change the guard fields promotion');
    expect((host.querySelector('[data-testid="ps-protocol-save"]') as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(true);
  });

  it('shows the human-only refusal when the author is not a user and the protocol is human-only', () => {
    const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(PSProtocolEditorComponent);
    fixture.componentInstance.Unit = unit;
    fixture.componentInstance.Author = { kind: 'system', component: 'dom-test' };
    fixture.componentInstance.Base = { ...base, guardFieldsEditableBy: 'human-only' };
    fixture.componentInstance.Form = { ...fixture.componentInstance.Form, Margin: 0.003 };
    fixture.componentInstance.Recompute();
    fixture.detectChanges();
    const host = fixture.nativeElement as HTMLElement;
    expect(host.querySelector('[data-testid="ps-protocol-refusals"]')?.textContent).toContain('only a version authored by a user may change promotion');
    expect((host.querySelector('[data-testid="ps-protocol-save"]') as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```ts
// components/evaluation-results/evaluation-view.ts  (L0 view model; no Angular)
import {
  TrustVerdicts, TrainingRunResultsParser,
  type BaselineSpec, type LeakageFlag, type MetricWithInterval,
} from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';

export interface IntervalCell {
  readonly Value: number;
  readonly Lower: number;
  readonly Upper: number;
}

export interface EvaluationView {
  readonly Outcome: 'model' | 'keep-simple-baseline' | 'no-signal';
  readonly OutcomeTitle: string;
  readonly Headline: string;
  readonly Reason: string;
  readonly Holdout: { readonly Metric: string; readonly Cell: IntervalCell; readonly Rows: number };
  readonly Secondary: readonly { readonly Metric: string; readonly Cell: IntervalCell }[];
  readonly Baselines: readonly { readonly Name: string; readonly Role: string; readonly Cell: IntervalCell }[];
  readonly VersusFlatGuess: readonly { readonly Member: string; readonly Cell: IntervalCell }[];
  readonly InnerScores: readonly { readonly Candidate: string; readonly Cell: IntervalCell; readonly IsFinalist: boolean }[];
  readonly Calibration: {
    readonly Method: string;
    readonly Slope: number;
    readonly Intercept: number;
    readonly Bins: readonly { readonly Range: string; readonly Predicted: number; readonly Observed: number; readonly N: number }[];
  } | null;
  readonly LeakageFlags: readonly string[];
  readonly OperatingPoint: { readonly Capacity: number; readonly Precision: IntervalCell; readonly BaseRate: number } | null;
}

/** The results view model (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class EvaluationViews {
  public static FormatInterval(c: IntervalCell): string {
    return `${c.Value.toFixed(4)} [${c.Lower.toFixed(4)}, ${c.Upper.toFixed(4)}]`;
  }

  private static cell(m: MetricWithInterval): IntervalCell {
    return { Value: m.value, Lower: m.interval.lower, Upper: m.interval.upper };
  }

  private static baselineName(b: BaselineSpec): string {
    switch (b.kind) {
      case 'dummy': return 'Flat guess (base rate / mean)';
      case 'one-feature': return 'Best single feature';
      case 'glm': return 'Simple model (GLM)';
      case 'naive': return 'Naive (last value)';
      case 'seasonal-naive': return 'Seasonal naive';
      case 'incumbent-heuristic': return `Existing rule "${b.name}"`;
    }
  }

  private static flagText(f: LeakageFlag): string {
    switch (f.kind) {
      case 'single-feature-auc': return `single-feature-auc: ${f.sourceColumn}`;
      case 'drop-column': return `drop-column: ${f.sourceColumn}`;
      case 'high-cardinality-id': return `high-cardinality-id: ${f.sourceColumn}`;
      case 'time-shifted-label': return 'time-shifted-label';
    }
  }

  /** The view of a run's `ValidationResults` (envelope `ps-run-results/v2`); null unless it holds a trainer result and a gate record. */
  public static BuildEvaluationView(validationResults: string | null): EvaluationView | null {
    const parsed = TrainingRunResultsParser.ParseTrainingRunResults(validationResults);
    if (!parsed.Ok || parsed.Value.status !== 'completed') return null;
    const { trainer: e, gate } = parsed.Value;
    if (e === null || gate === null || validationResults === null) return null;
    const trust = TrustVerdicts.DeriveTrustVerdict({ ValidationResults: validationResults });
    const iv = gate.intervals;
    return {
      Outcome: gate.decision.outcome,
      OutcomeTitle: TrustVerdicts.OutcomeTitle(trust),
      Headline: trust.Headline,
      Reason: gate.reason.text,
      Holdout: { Metric: e.holdout.primary.metric, Cell: EvaluationViews.cell(e.holdout.primary), Rows: e.holdout.primary.n },
      Secondary: e.holdout.secondary.map((m) => ({ Metric: m.metric, Cell: EvaluationViews.cell(m) })),
      Baselines: e.baselines.map((b) => ({ Name: EvaluationViews.baselineName(b.baseline), Role: b.role, Cell: EvaluationViews.cell(b.holdout) })),
      VersusFlatGuess: [
        { Member: `model (${iv.modelName})`, Cell: { Value: iv.modelVsDummy.value, Lower: iv.modelVsDummy.lower, Upper: iv.modelVsDummy.upper } },
        ...Object.keys(iv.memberVsDummy).sort().flatMap((member) => {
          const m = iv.memberVsDummy[member];
          return m === undefined ? [] : [{ Member: member, Cell: { Value: m.value, Lower: m.lower, Upper: m.upper } }];
        }),
      ],
      InnerScores: e.innerScores.map((s) => ({ Candidate: s.candidate, Cell: EvaluationViews.cell(s.inner), IsFinalist: s.candidate === e.finalist })),
      Calibration: e.calibration === null ? null : {
        Method: e.calibration.method,
        Slope: e.calibration.slope,
        Intercept: e.calibration.intercept,
        Bins: e.calibration.reliability.map((b) => ({ Range: `${b.binLower.toFixed(1)}–${b.binUpper.toFixed(1)}`, Predicted: b.meanPredicted, Observed: b.observedRate, N: b.n })),
      },
      LeakageFlags: e.leakageFlags.map(EvaluationViews.flagText),
      OperatingPoint: e.operatingPoint === null ? null : { Capacity: e.operatingPoint.capacityPerPeriod, Precision: EvaluationViews.cell(e.operatingPoint.precisionAtCapacity), BaseRate: e.operatingPoint.baseRate },
    };
  }
}
```

  (`Object.keys(...).sort()` gives `glm` before `oneFeature`, which the view-model test expects. Member names are M6's
  baseline member names — `dummy`, `oneFeature`, `glm`, `naive`, `seasonalNaive`, `heuristic:<name>` (D3-31). Every
  member line of `EvaluationView` is PascalCase, so no naming-gate markers are needed.)

```ts
// components/evaluation-results/evaluation-results.component.ts  (L1)
import { Component, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { EvaluationViews, type EvaluationView, type IntervalCell } from './evaluation-view';

/** A training run's protocol results: outcome and reason, scores with intervals, baselines, calibration, leakage flags. */
@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'mj-ps-evaluation-results',
  imports: [CommonModule],
  styleUrls: ['../ps-widgets.css'],
  template: `
    @if (View; as v) {
      <section class="ps-eval" data-testid="ps-eval">
        <header [class]="'ps-eval-outcome outcome-' + v.Outcome" data-testid="ps-eval-outcome">
          <strong>{{ v.OutcomeTitle }}</strong>
          <span class="ps-eval-headline">{{ v.Headline }}</span>
          <p class="ps-eval-reason" data-testid="ps-eval-reason">{{ v.Reason }}</p>
        </header>

        <h4>Test set — {{ v.Holdout.Rows }} rows, read once</h4>
        <table class="ps-eval-table" data-testid="ps-eval-scores">
          <thead><tr><th>Metric</th><th>Value [95% interval]</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr><td>{{ v.Holdout.Metric }} (primary)</td><td>{{ Cell(v.Holdout.Cell) }}</td></tr>
            @for (m of v.Secondary; track m.Metric) { <tr><td>{{ m.Metric }}</td><td>{{ Cell(m.Cell) }}</td></tr> }
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <h4>Baselines on the same rows</h4>
        <table class="ps-eval-table">
          <thead><tr><th>Baseline</th><th>Role</th><th>{{ v.Holdout.Metric }} [95% interval]</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (b of v.Baselines; track b.Name) { <tr data-testid="ps-eval-baseline"><td>{{ b.Name }}</td><td>{{ b.Role }}</td><td>{{ Cell(b.Cell) }}</td></tr> }
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <h4>Improvement over the flat guess (higher is better)</h4>
        <table class="ps-eval-table">
          <tbody>
            @for (r of v.VersusFlatGuess; track r.Member) { <tr><td>{{ r.Member }}</td><td>{{ Cell(r.Cell) }}</td></tr> }
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <h4>Candidates — inner cross-validation on development rows</h4>
        <table class="ps-eval-table">
          <tbody>
            @for (s of v.InnerScores; track s.Candidate) {
              <tr>
                <td>{{ s.Candidate }}</td><td>{{ Cell(s.Cell) }}</td>
                <td>@if (s.IsFinalist) { <span class="ps-eval-optimistic" data-testid="ps-eval-optimistic" title="The winner's inner score was the best of several tries, so it is optimistic.">finalist · optimistic</span> }</td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>

        @if (v.Calibration; as c) {
          <h4>Calibration</h4>
          <p data-testid="ps-eval-calibration">{{ c.Method }} · slope {{ c.Slope }} · intercept {{ c.Intercept }}</p>
          <table class="ps-eval-table">
            <thead><tr><th>Predicted range</th><th>Mean predicted</th><th>Observed</th><th>Rows</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (b of c.Bins; track b.Range) { <tr><td>{{ b.Range }}</td><td>{{ b.Predicted }}</td><td>{{ b.Observed }}</td><td>{{ b.N }}</td></tr> }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        }

        @if (v.OperatingPoint; as op) {
          <h4>At the review capacity</h4>
          <p data-testid="ps-eval-operating-point">Precision in the top {{ op.Capacity }}: {{ Cell(op.Precision) }} (base rate {{ op.BaseRate }})</p>
        }

        <h4>Leakage audit</h4>
        @if (v.LeakageFlags.length === 0) {
          <p data-testid="ps-eval-leakage-none">No leakage flags.</p>
        } @else {
          <ul class="ps-eval-flags" data-testid="ps-eval-leakage">
            @for (f of v.LeakageFlags; track f) { <li>{{ f }}</li> }
          </ul>
        }
      </section>
    } @else {
      <p class="ps-eval-empty" data-testid="ps-eval-empty">This run was not evaluated under an Evaluation Protocol.</p>
    }
  `,
})
export class PSEvaluationResultsComponent {
  @Input() View: EvaluationView | null = null;

  public Cell(c: IntervalCell): string {
    return EvaluationViews.FormatInterval(c);
  }
}
```

```ts
// components/protocol-summary/protocol-summary.component.ts  (L1)
import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { MJButtonDirective } from '@memberjunction/ng-ui-components';
import type { EvaluationProtocolSpec } from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';

export interface SummaryRow {
  readonly Label: string;
  readonly Value: string;
}


@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'mj-ps-protocol-summary',
  imports: [CommonModule, MJButtonDirective],
  styleUrls: ['../ps-widgets.css'],
  template: `
    @if (Protocol; as p) {
      <dl class="ps-summary" data-testid="ps-protocol-summary">
        @for (r of Rows(p); track r.Label) { <dt>{{ r.Label }}</dt><dd>{{ r.Value }}</dd> }
      </dl>
      @if (IsLatest && CanEdit) {
        <button mjButton variant="outline" size="sm" type="button" data-testid="ps-protocol-edit" (click)="EditRequested.emit()">Create version {{ p.version + 1 }}</button>
      }
    }
  `,
})
export class PSProtocolSummaryComponent {
  @Input() Protocol: EvaluationProtocolSpec | null = null;
  @Input() IsLatest = false;
  @Input() CanEdit = false;
  @Output() EditRequested = new EventEmitter<void>();

  /** The plain-language reading of one protocol version. */
  public static ProtocolSummaryRows(p: EvaluationProtocolSpec): readonly SummaryRow[] {
    const h = p.holdout;
    const iv = p.innerValidation;
    return [
      { Label: 'Test set', Value: h.kind === 'date-carved'
        ? `rows whose ${h.dateColumn} is on or after ${h.cutoff}${h.holdoutEnd ? ` and before ${h.holdoutEnd}` : ''}${h.newEntityReport ? `; new-entity report holds out ${Math.round(h.newEntityReport.holdoutFraction * 100)}% of ${h.newEntityReport.groupKey}` : ''}`
        : h.kind === 'seeded-random'
          ? `a seeded random ${Math.round(h.fraction * 100)}% of rows (one decision date for every row)`
          : `${h.origins} rolling origins, horizon ${h.horizonPeriods}, ${h.window} window` },
      { Label: 'Selection', Value: iv.kind === 'blocked-time' ? `${iv.folds} blocked-in-time folds, gap ${iv.gapPeriods}` : `${iv.folds} folds × ${iv.repeats} repeats${iv.kind === 'grouped-kfold' ? `, grouped by ${iv.groupKey}` : ''}` },
      { Label: 'Primary score', Value: `${p.primaryScore.metric} (lower is better)` },
      { Label: 'Baselines', Value: p.baselines.map((b) => b.kind).join(', ') },
      { Label: 'Ships only if', Value: `the lower 95% bound of its improvement is above ${p.promotion.margin} on the same rows` },
      { Label: 'Outcomes', Value: p.allowedOutcomes.join(' · ') },
      { Label: 'Smallest class in the test set', Value: `${p.minMinorityClassRows} rows (below that, no model ships)` },
      { Label: 'Calibration', Value: p.calibration.kind },
      { Label: 'Leakage audit', Value: `single-feature held-out AUC above ${p.leakageAudit.singleFeatureHeldOutAucMax} is flagged; time-shifted label and drop-column tests` },
      { Label: 'Never used as inputs', Value: [...p.exclusions.denyFields, ...p.exclusions.denySources].join(', ') || 'none' },
      { Label: 'Budget', Value: `${p.budgets.maxCandidates} candidates, ${p.budgets.maxComputeSeconds} s, hard stop` },
      { Label: 'Seed', Value: String(p.seed) },
      { Label: 'Guard fields changed by', Value: p.guardFieldsEditableBy === 'non-agent' ? 'protocol configuration — never an agent tool call' : 'users only (human-only)' },
    ];
  }

  public Rows(p: EvaluationProtocolSpec): readonly SummaryRow[] {
    return PSProtocolSummaryComponent.ProtocolSummaryRows(p);
  }
}
```

```ts
// components/protocol-editor/protocol-editor.component.ts  (L1)
import { Component, EventEmitter, Input, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { MJButtonDirective } from '@memberjunction/ng-ui-components';
import {
  ProtocolEdits, EvaluationProtocolRules,
  type Actor, type EvaluationProtocolDraft, type EvaluationProtocolSpec, type PredictionUnitSpec, type ProperScore, type ProtocolEditForm,
} from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';

/**
 * Edits the form fields of a protocol into the next version's draft, previewing the server's refusals: the
 * unit-independent rules always (`ValidateEvaluationProtocol`, incl. the guard-field author rule) and the
 * unit-dependent rules when a pipeline binds this protocol to a unit (`ValidateProtocolForUnit`).
 */
@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'mj-ps-protocol-editor',
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, MJButtonDirective],
  styleUrls: ['../ps-widgets.css'],
  template: `
    <form class="ps-form" (ngSubmit)="Save()">
      <label for="ps-name">Name</label><input id="ps-name" type="text" name="name" [(ngModel)]="Form.Name" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()" />
      @if (IsDateCarved) {
        <label for="ps-cutoff">Test set starts</label><input id="ps-cutoff" type="date" name="cutoff" [(ngModel)]="Form.Cutoff" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()" />
        <label for="ps-end">Test set ends (optional)</label><input id="ps-end" type="date" name="end" [(ngModel)]="Form.HoldoutEnd" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()" />
      }
      <label for="ps-folds">Folds</label><input id="ps-folds" type="number" min="2" name="folds" [(ngModel)]="Form.Folds" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()" />
      <label for="ps-repeats">Repeats</label><input id="ps-repeats" type="number" min="1" name="repeats" [(ngModel)]="Form.Repeats" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()" />
      <label for="ps-metric">Primary score</label>
      <select id="ps-metric" name="metric" data-testid="ps-protocol-metric" [(ngModel)]="Form.PrimaryMetric" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()">
        @for (m of Metrics; track m) { <option [value]="m">{{ m }}</option> }
      </select>
      <label for="ps-margin">Margin</label><input id="ps-margin" type="number" min="0" step="0.001" name="margin" [(ngModel)]="Form.Margin" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()" />
      <label for="ps-cands">Max candidates</label><input id="ps-cands" type="number" min="1" name="cands" [(ngModel)]="Form.MaxCandidates" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()" />
      <label for="ps-secs">Max compute seconds</label><input id="ps-secs" type="number" min="1" name="secs" [(ngModel)]="Form.MaxComputeSeconds" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()" />
      <label for="ps-seed">Seed</label><input id="ps-seed" type="number" name="seed" [(ngModel)]="Form.Seed" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()" />
      <label for="ps-guard">Guard fields changed by</label>
      <select id="ps-guard" name="guard" data-testid="ps-protocol-guard-policy" [(ngModel)]="Form.GuardFieldsEditableBy" (ngModelChange)="Recompute()">
        <option value="non-agent">protocol configuration (never an agent tool call)</option>
        <option value="human-only">users only</option>
      </select>
    </form>
    @if (Problems.length > 0) {
      <ul class="ps-refusals" data-testid="ps-protocol-refusals">@for (p of Problems; track p) { <li>{{ p }}</li> }</ul>
    }
    <button mjButton variant="primary" size="sm" type="button" data-testid="ps-protocol-save" [disabled]="Draft === null" (click)="Save()">Save as next version</button>
    <button mjButton variant="outline" size="sm" type="button" (click)="Cancelled.emit()">Cancel</button>
  `,
})
export class PSProtocolEditorComponent {
  private _base!: EvaluationProtocolSpec;
  private _unit: PredictionUnitSpec | null = null;
  private _author: Actor = { kind: 'system', component: 'ps-protocol-editor' };

  @Input()
  public get Base(): EvaluationProtocolSpec { return this._base; }
  public set Base(value: EvaluationProtocolSpec) {
    this._base = value;
    this.Form = ProtocolEdits.ProtocolEditFormFrom(value);
    this.Metrics = ProtocolEdits.PrimaryMetricOptions(value.primaryScore.family);
    this.Recompute();
  }

  /** The unit of a pipeline bound to this protocol lineage; null when no pipeline binds it yet. */
  @Input()
  public get Unit(): PredictionUnitSpec | null { return this._unit; }
  public set Unit(value: PredictionUnitSpec | null) {
    this._unit = value;
    if (this._base !== undefined) this.Recompute();
  }

  @Input()
  public get Author(): Actor { return this._author; }
  public set Author(value: Actor) {
    this._author = value;
    if (this._base !== undefined) this.Recompute();
  }

  @Output() SaveRequested = new EventEmitter<EvaluationProtocolDraft>();
  @Output() Cancelled = new EventEmitter<void>();

  public Form!: ProtocolEditForm;
  public Metrics: readonly ProperScore['metric'][] = [];
  public Draft: EvaluationProtocolDraft | null = null;
  public Problems: readonly string[] = [];

  public get IsDateCarved(): boolean {
    return this.Base.holdout.kind === 'date-carved';
  }

  /** Re-applies the form to the base version and previews the server's ValidateAsync refusals. */
  public Recompute(): void {
    const r = ProtocolEdits.ApplyProtocolEdits(this.Base, this.Form);
    if (!r.Ok) {
      this.Draft = null;
      this.Problems = [r.Error];
      return;
    }
    const preview: EvaluationProtocolSpec = {
      ...r.Draft, id: this.Base.id, lineageRootId: this.Base.lineageRootId, version: this.Base.version + 1, authoredBy: this.Author,
    };
    const refusals = [
      ...EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateEvaluationProtocol({ Protocol: preview, Previous: this.Base, AuthoredBy: this.Author }),
      ...(this.Unit === null ? [] : EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit(preview, this.Unit)),
    ];
    this.Problems = refusals.map(EvaluationProtocolRules.DescribeProtocolRefusal);
    this.Draft = refusals.length === 0 ? r.Draft : null;
  }

  public Save(): void {
    if (this.Draft !== null) this.SaveRequested.emit(this.Draft);
  }
}
```

```ts
// components/protocol-versions/protocol-versions.component.ts  (L2)
import { ChangeDetectorRef, Component, EventEmitter, inject, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { RunView } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { MJEvaluationProtocolEntity, MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, MJPredictionUnitEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { EscapeSQLString, UUIDsEqual } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { BaseAngularComponent } from '@memberjunction/ng-base-types';
import {
  ProtocolRows, EvaluationProtocol, PredictionUnit,
  type Actor, type EvaluationProtocolDraft, type EvaluationProtocolSpec, type PredictionUnitSpec,
} from '@memberjunction/predictive-studio-core';
import { PSProtocolSummaryComponent } from '../protocol-summary/protocol-summary.component';
import { PSProtocolEditorComponent } from '../protocol-editor/protocol-editor.component';

interface VersionedProtocolRow {
  readonly Row: MJEvaluationProtocolEntity;
  readonly Protocol: EvaluationProtocolSpec;
}

/** All versions of one protocol lineage; "edit" saves the next version as a new row. Emits VersionCreated. */
@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'mj-ps-protocol-versions',
  imports: [CommonModule, PSProtocolSummaryComponent, PSProtocolEditorComponent],
  styleUrls: ['../ps-widgets.css'],
  template: `
    @if (Error) { <p class="ps-refusals" data-testid="ps-protocol-versions-error">{{ Error }}</p> }
    <div class="ps-versions">
      <ul class="ps-version-list" data-testid="ps-protocol-version-list">
        @for (v of Versions; track v.Row.ID) {
          <li [class.active]="v === Selected" (click)="Select(v)">v{{ v.Row.Version }} · {{ v.Row.__mj_CreatedAt | date: 'yyyy-MM-dd' }}</li>
        }
      </ul>
      @if (Selected; as s) {
        <div>
          @if (Editing && Latest !== null) {
            <mj-ps-protocol-editor [Base]="Latest.Protocol" [Unit]="Unit" [Author]="Author" (SaveRequested)="Save($event)" (Cancelled)="Editing = false"></mj-ps-protocol-editor>
          } @else {
            <mj-ps-protocol-summary [Protocol]="s.Protocol" [IsLatest]="s === Latest" [CanEdit]="true" (EditRequested)="Editing = true"></mj-ps-protocol-summary>
            @if (Unit === null) { <p class="ps-muted">No pipeline binds this protocol yet; unit-dependent checks run when a pipeline binds it.</p> }
          }
        </div>
      }
    </div>
  `,
})
export class PSProtocolLineageComponent extends BaseAngularComponent implements OnInit {
  private readonly cdr = inject(ChangeDetectorRef);
  private _evaluationProtocolId: string | null = null;
  private isInitialized = false;

  /** Any version row of the lineage. */
  @Input()
  public get EvaluationProtocolID(): string | null { return this._evaluationProtocolId; }
  public set EvaluationProtocolID(value: string | null) {
    if (value === this._evaluationProtocolId) return;
    this._evaluationProtocolId = value;
    if (this.isInitialized) void this.Load();   // before init `Provider` may not be bound yet (static attributes are set first); ngOnInit loads once
  }

  public ngOnInit(): void {
    this.isInitialized = true;
    void this.Load();
  }

  /** The id of the version row just saved. */
  @Output() VersionCreated = new EventEmitter<string>();

  public Versions: readonly VersionedProtocolRow[] = [];
  public Selected: VersionedProtocolRow | null = null;
  public Unit: PredictionUnitSpec | null = null;
  public Editing = false;
  public Error: string | null = null;

  public get Latest(): VersionedProtocolRow | null {
    return this.Versions[this.Versions.length - 1] ?? null;
  }

  public get Author(): Actor {
    return { kind: 'human', userId: this.ProviderToUse.CurrentUser.ID };
  }

  public Select(v: VersionedProtocolRow): void {
    this.Selected = v;
    this.Editing = false;
  }

  public async Load(): Promise<void> {
    this.Error = null;
    if (this.EvaluationProtocolID === null) return;
    const rv = RunView.FromMetadataProvider(this.ProviderToUse);
    const first = await rv.RunView<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity>({ EntityName: 'MJ: Evaluation Protocols', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(this.EvaluationProtocolID)}'`, ResultType: 'entity_object' });
    const current = first.Success ? first.Results[0] : undefined;
    if (current === undefined) {
      this.Error = first.Success ? `Protocol ${this.EvaluationProtocolID} not found.` : first.ErrorMessage;
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
      return;
    }
    // Version 1 is its own lineage root, so one filter returns every version of the lineage.
    const all = await rv.RunView<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity>({
      EntityName: 'MJ: Evaluation Protocols', ExtraFilter: `LineageRootID='${EscapeSQLString(current.LineageRootID)}'`, OrderBy: 'Version', ResultType: 'entity_object',
    });
    if (!all.Success) {
      this.Error = all.ErrorMessage;
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
      return;
    }
    const rows: VersionedProtocolRow[] = [];
    for (const row of all.Results) {
      const parsed = EvaluationProtocol.ParseEvaluationProtocolRow(row);
      if (!parsed.Ok) {
        this.Error = `Version ${row.Version} cannot be read: ${parsed.Errors.join('; ')}`;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
        return;
      }
      rows.push({ Row: row, Protocol: parsed.Value });
    }
    this.Versions = rows;
    this.Selected = rows.find((r) => UUIDsEqual(r.Row.ID, current.ID)) ?? this.Latest;
    this.Unit = await this.loadBoundUnit(rows.map((r) => r.Row.ID));
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  public async Save(draft: EvaluationProtocolDraft): Promise<void> {
    const latest = this.Latest;
    if (latest === null) return;
    const p = this.ProviderToUse;
    const row = await p.GetEntityObject<MJEvaluationProtocolEntity>('MJ: Evaluation Protocols', p.CurrentUser);
    row.NewRecord();
    ProtocolRows.ApplyProtocolDraftToRow(row, draft, { ID: null, LineageRootID: latest.Row.LineageRootID, Version: latest.Row.Version + 1, AuthoredBy: this.Author, Description: latest.Row.Description });
    if (!(await row.Save())) {
      this.Error = row.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'The new version could not be saved.';
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
      return;
    }
    this.Editing = false;
    this.VersionCreated.emit(row.ID);
    this._evaluationProtocolId = row.ID;
    await this.Load();
  }

  /** The unit of the most recently changed pipeline that binds any version of this lineage (the pipeline binds unit and protocol). */
  private async loadBoundUnit(versionIds: readonly string[]): Promise<PredictionUnitSpec | null> {
    if (versionIds.length === 0) return null;
    const rv = RunView.FromMetadataProvider(this.ProviderToUse);
    const list = versionIds.map((id) => `'${EscapeSQLString(id)}'`).join(',');
    const pipelines = await rv.RunView<Pick<MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, 'ID' | 'PredictionUnitID'>>({
      EntityName: 'MJ: ML Training Pipelines', ExtraFilter: `EvaluationProtocolID IN (${list}) AND PredictionUnitID IS NOT NULL`,
      Fields: ['ID', 'PredictionUnitID'], OrderBy: '__mj_UpdatedAt DESC', MaxRows: 1, ResultType: 'simple',
    });
    if (!pipelines.Success) {
      this.Error = pipelines.ErrorMessage;
      return null;
    }
    const unitId = pipelines.Results[0]?.PredictionUnitID || null;
    if (unitId === null) return null;
    const units = await rv.RunView<MJPredictionUnitEntity>({ EntityName: 'MJ: Prediction Units', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(unitId)}'`, ResultType: 'entity_object' });
    if (!units.Success) {
      this.Error = units.ErrorMessage;
      return null;
    }
    const unitRow = units.Results[0];
    if (unitRow === undefined) return null;
    const parsed = PredictionUnit.ParsePredictionUnitRow(unitRow);
    return parsed.Ok ? parsed.Value : null;
  }
}
```

  The unit widgets mirror the protocol ones with the unit types and functions (using `@Input()` getter/setter pairs with an `isInitialized` flag — `ngOnInit` sets it and performs the first load once every input, `Provider` included, is bound; a setter loads only after init and only when the value changed — and `inject(ChangeDetectorRef)` + `this.cdr.detectChanges()` after `await` in async methods, never `OnChanges`/`ngOnChanges`, per `packages/Angular/CLAUDE.md`):
  - `unit-summary.component.ts` (L1, selector `mj-ps-unit-summary`): `PSUnitSummaryComponent` has
    `public static UnitSummaryRows(u: PredictionUnitSpec): readonly SummaryRow[]` (as `ProtocolSummaryRows` above); `@Input() Unit: PredictionUnitSpec | null`, `@Input() IsLatest`, `@Input() CanEdit`,
    `@Output() EditRequested`; rows: what one row is (`grain` entity + decision-date rule, or grain × periods of the
    child entity), the outcome (`PredictionUnit.DescribeLabelRule(u)`, window, gap, label version), the task (`kind`, class order, the
    scored class and adverse direction from `TaskTypeRules.ScoreSemantics(u.label.outcome)`), censoring (`cutoff.kind` and its date
    or entity.field), the change-history policy, the group key, the Temporal Spec (lags, rolling windows, horizon) when
    present, the decision (action, actor, capacity per period) and the incumbent heuristic. Its "Create version N+1"
    button carries `data-testid="ps-unit-edit"`.
  - `unit-editor.component.ts` (L1, selector `mj-ps-unit-editor`): `@Input() get/set Base: PredictionUnitSpec | null` (null =
    version 1; the setter initializes `Form` from `UnitEdits.UnitEditFormFrom` and runs `Recompute()`), `@Output() SaveRequested: EventEmitter<{ Draft: UnitDraft; LabelVersion: number }>`, `@Output()
    Cancelled`; the form fields of `UnitEditForm` (task-kind select of the five non-forecast kinds, disabled for a
    forecast base; class order and adverse class shown only for binary/multiclass; Tweedie power only for
    non-negative; censoring mode select offering `corpus-end` only when the base uses it; the entity, decision-date and
    outcome-column inputs disabled with the carried rule shown via `PredictionUnit.DescribeLabelRule` when the base's rows or rule are
    not of the form-editable kind); `Recompute()` calls `UnitEdits.ApplyUnitEdits`, shows its error in
    `[data-testid="ps-unit-error"]`, and shows "Label version will be N" from the result. The window input carries
    `data-testid="ps-unit-window"` and the save button `data-testid="ps-unit-save"` (M11.2's spec drives them).
  - `unit-versions.component.ts` (L2, selector `mj-ps-unit-versions`): `@Input() get/set UnitID: string | null` (`ngOnInit` loads first; the setter triggers `void this.Load()` after init when the value changed; `Load` calls `this.cdr.detectChanges()` after `await`),
    `@Output() VersionCreated`; its version list carries `data-testid="ps-unit-version-list"`; loads the lineage like
    `protocol-versions` (`MJ: Prediction Units`,
    `LineageRootID='<root>'`, `PredictionUnit.ParsePredictionUnitRow`), and saves the next version with
    `ProtocolRows.ApplyPredictionUnitDraftToRow(row, draft, { ID: null, LineageRootID: latest.LineageRootID, Version: latest.Version + 1, LabelVersion, AuthoredBy })`.
    With `UnitID` null it renders the editor for version 1 and saves with
    `const id = ProtocolRows.NewVersionRowID(); ProtocolRows.ApplyPredictionUnitDraftToRow(row, draft, { ID: id, LineageRootID: id, Version: 1, LabelVersion: 1, AuthoredBy })`.
    The server's M2.5 `ValidateAsync` re-checks the label version and the references.

```ts
// components/pipeline-bindings/pipeline-bindings.component.ts  (L2)
import { ChangeDetectorRef, Component, EventEmitter, inject, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { RunView } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity, MJPredictionUnitEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { BaseAngularComponent } from '@memberjunction/ng-base-types';
import { MJButtonDirective } from '@memberjunction/ng-ui-components';

interface BoundVersion {
  readonly ID: string;
  readonly Name: string;
  readonly Version: number;
  readonly LatestID: string;
  readonly LatestVersion: number;
}

type VersionFields = Pick<MJPredictionUnitEntity, 'ID' | 'Name' | 'Version' | 'LineageRootID'>;

/**
 * Which unit version and protocol version a pipeline trains under, with "use the latest version" for each.
 * Saving goes through the pipeline entity, whose ValidateAsync refuses a unit/protocol pair that disagree.
 */
@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'mj-ps-pipeline-bindings',
  imports: [CommonModule, MJButtonDirective],
  styleUrls: ['../ps-widgets.css'],
  template: `
    @if (Error) { <p class="ps-refusals" data-testid="ps-bindings-error">{{ Error }}</p> }
    <dl class="ps-summary" data-testid="ps-pipeline-bindings">
      <dt>Prediction Unit</dt>
      <dd>
        @if (Unit; as u) {
          {{ u.Name }} v{{ u.Version }}
          @if (u.Version < u.LatestVersion) { <button mjButton variant="outline" size="sm" type="button" data-testid="ps-bind-latest-unit" (click)="UseLatest('unit')">Use v{{ u.LatestVersion }}</button> }
        } @else { <span class="ps-muted">none — this pipeline cannot be trained</span> }
      </dd>
      <dt>Evaluation Protocol</dt>
      <dd>
        @if (Protocol; as p) {
          {{ p.Name }} v{{ p.Version }}
          @if (p.Version < p.LatestVersion) { <button mjButton variant="outline" size="sm" type="button" data-testid="ps-bind-latest-protocol" (click)="UseLatest('protocol')">Use v{{ p.LatestVersion }}</button> }
        } @else { <span class="ps-muted">none — this pipeline cannot be trained</span> }
      </dd>
    </dl>
  `,
})
export class PSPipelineBindingsComponent extends BaseAngularComponent implements OnInit {
  private readonly cdr = inject(ChangeDetectorRef);
  private _pipelineId: string | null = null;
  private isInitialized = false;

  @Input()
  public get PipelineID(): string | null { return this._pipelineId; }
  public set PipelineID(value: string | null) {
    if (value === this._pipelineId) return;
    this._pipelineId = value;
    if (this.isInitialized) void this.Load();   // before init `Provider` may not be bound yet (static attributes are set first); ngOnInit loads once
  }

  public ngOnInit(): void {
    this.isInitialized = true;
    void this.Load();
  }

  @Output() BindingChanged = new EventEmitter<string>();

  public Unit: BoundVersion | null = null;
  public Protocol: BoundVersion | null = null;
  public Error: string | null = null;

  public async Load(): Promise<void> {
    this.Error = null;
    const pipeline = await this.loadPipeline();
    if (pipeline === null) {
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
      return;
    }
    const unitId = pipeline.PredictionUnitID;
    const protocolId = pipeline.EvaluationProtocolID;
    [this.Unit, this.Protocol] = await Promise.all([
      unitId === null ? null : this.bound('MJ: Prediction Units', unitId),
      protocolId === null ? null : this.bound('MJ: Evaluation Protocols', protocolId),
    ]);
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  public async UseLatest(which: 'unit' | 'protocol'): Promise<void> {
    const pipeline = await this.loadPipeline();
    if (pipeline === null) {
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
      return;
    }
    if (which === 'unit' && this.Unit !== null) pipeline.PredictionUnitID = this.Unit.LatestID;
    if (which === 'protocol' && this.Protocol !== null) pipeline.EvaluationProtocolID = this.Protocol.LatestID;
    if (!(await pipeline.Save())) {
      this.Error = pipeline.LatestResult?.CompleteMessage || 'The pipeline could not be saved.';
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
      return;
    }
    this.BindingChanged.emit(pipeline.ID);
    await this.Load();
  }

  private async loadPipeline(): Promise<MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity | null> {
    if (this.PipelineID === null) return null;
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(this.ProviderToUse).RunView<MJMLTrainingPipelineEntity>({
      EntityName: 'MJ: ML Training Pipelines', ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(this.PipelineID)}'`, ResultType: 'entity_object',
    });
    const row = r.Success ? r.Results[0] : undefined;
    if (row === undefined) {
      this.Error = r.Success ? `Pipeline ${this.PipelineID} not found.` : r.ErrorMessage;
      return null;
    }
    return row;
  }

  private async bound(entity: 'MJ: Prediction Units' | 'MJ: Evaluation Protocols', id: string): Promise<BoundVersion | null> {
    const rv = RunView.FromMetadataProvider(this.ProviderToUse);
    const one = await rv.RunView<VersionFields>({ EntityName: entity, ExtraFilter: `ID='${EscapeSQLString(id)}'`, Fields: ['ID', 'Name', 'Version', 'LineageRootID'], ResultType: 'simple' });
    if (!one.Success) {
      this.Error = one.ErrorMessage;
      return null;
    }
    const row = one.Results[0];
    if (row === undefined) return null;
    const latest = await rv.RunView<VersionFields>({
      EntityName: entity, ExtraFilter: `LineageRootID='${EscapeSQLString(row.LineageRootID)}'`, Fields: ['ID', 'Name', 'Version', 'LineageRootID'], OrderBy: 'Version DESC', MaxRows: 1, ResultType: 'simple',
    });
    if (!latest.Success) {
      this.Error = latest.ErrorMessage;
      return null;
    }
    const top = latest.Results[0] ?? row;
    return { ID: row.ID, Name: row.Name, Version: row.Version, LatestID: top.ID, LatestVersion: top.Version };
  }
}
```

```ts
// components/run-evaluation/run-evaluation.component.ts  (L2)
import { ChangeDetectorRef, Component, inject, Input, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { RunView } from '@memberjunction/core';
import type { MJMLTrainingRunEntity } from '@memberjunction/core-entities';
import { EscapeSQLString } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { BaseAngularComponent } from '@memberjunction/ng-base-types';
import { EvaluationViews, type EvaluationView } from '../evaluation-results/evaluation-view';
import { PSEvaluationResultsComponent } from '../evaluation-results/evaluation-results.component';

/** Loads the training run of a model (or a run by id) and shows its protocol results. */
@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'mj-ps-run-evaluation',
  imports: [CommonModule, PSEvaluationResultsComponent],
  template: `
    @if (Error) { <p class="ps-refusals">{{ Error }}</p> }
    <mj-ps-evaluation-results [View]="View"></mj-ps-evaluation-results>
  `,
  styleUrls: ['../ps-widgets.css'],
})
export class PSRunEvaluationComponent extends BaseAngularComponent implements OnInit {
  private readonly cdr = inject(ChangeDetectorRef);
  private _modelId: string | null = null;
  private _trainingRunId: string | null = null;
  private isInitialized = false;

  @Input()
  public get ModelID(): string | null { return this._modelId; }
  public set ModelID(value: string | null) {
    if (value === this._modelId) return;
    this._modelId = value;
    if (this.isInitialized) void this.Load();   // before init `Provider` may not be bound yet (static attributes are set first); ngOnInit loads once
  }

  @Input()
  public get TrainingRunID(): string | null { return this._trainingRunId; }
  public set TrainingRunID(value: string | null) {
    if (value === this._trainingRunId) return;
    this._trainingRunId = value;
    if (this.isInitialized) void this.Load();
  }

  public ngOnInit(): void {
    this.isInitialized = true;
    void this.Load();
  }

  public View: EvaluationView | null = null;
  public Error: string | null = null;

  public async Load(): Promise<void> {
    this.Error = null;
    const filter = this.TrainingRunID !== null ? `ID='${EscapeSQLString(this.TrainingRunID)}'` : this.ModelID !== null ? `ResultingModelID='${EscapeSQLString(this.ModelID)}'` : null;
    if (filter === null) return;
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(this.ProviderToUse).RunView<Pick<MJMLTrainingRunEntity, 'ID' | 'ValidationResults'>>({
      EntityName: 'MJ: ML Training Runs', ExtraFilter: filter, Fields: ['ID', 'ValidationResults'], OrderBy: '__mj_CreatedAt DESC', MaxRows: 1, ResultType: 'simple',
    });
    if (!r.Success) {
      this.Error = r.ErrorMessage;
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
      return;
    }
    this.View = EvaluationViews.BuildEvaluationView(r.Results[0]?.ValidationResults ?? null);
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }
}
```

```ts
// components/versioned-list/versioned-list.component.ts  (L2)
import { ChangeDetectorRef, Component, EventEmitter, inject, Input, OnInit, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { RunView } from '@memberjunction/core';
import { NormalizeUUID } from '@memberjunction/global';
import { BaseAngularComponent } from '@memberjunction/ng-base-types';

export type VersionedEntityName = 'MJ: Evaluation Protocols' | 'MJ: Prediction Units';

interface VersionRowFields {
  ID: string;
  Name: string;
  Version: number;
  LineageRootID: string;
  __mj_CreatedAt: Date | string;
}

export interface LineageItem {
  readonly LatestID: string;
  readonly Name: string;
  readonly LatestVersion: number;
  readonly UpdatedAt: Date | string;
}

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  selector: 'mj-ps-versioned-list',
  imports: [CommonModule],
  styleUrls: ['../ps-widgets.css'],
  template: `
    @if (Error) { <p class="ps-refusals">{{ Error }}</p> }
    <table class="ps-eval-table" data-testid="ps-versioned-list">
      <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Latest version</th><th>Saved</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        @for (i of Items; track i.LatestID) {
          <tr (click)="OpenRecord.emit(i.LatestID)" data-testid="ps-versioned-row"><td>{{ i.Name }}</td><td>v{{ i.LatestVersion }}</td><td>{{ i.UpdatedAt | date: 'yyyy-MM-dd' }}</td></tr>
        } @empty {
          <tr><td colspan="3" class="ps-muted">None yet.</td></tr>
        }
      </tbody>
    </table>
  `,
})
export class PSVersionedListComponent extends BaseAngularComponent implements OnInit {
  private readonly cdr = inject(ChangeDetectorRef);
  private _entityName: VersionedEntityName = 'MJ: Evaluation Protocols';
  private isInitialized = false;

  @Input()
  public get EntityName(): VersionedEntityName { return this._entityName; }
  public set EntityName(value: VersionedEntityName) {
    if (value === this._entityName) return;
    this._entityName = value;
    if (this.isInitialized) void this.Load();   // before init `Provider` may not be bound yet (static attributes are set first); ngOnInit loads once
  }

  public ngOnInit(): void {
    this.isInitialized = true;
    void this.Load();
  }

  /** Emits the latest version row's id; the host decides where to open it. */
  @Output() OpenRecord = new EventEmitter<string>();
  public Items: readonly LineageItem[] = [];
  public Error: string | null = null;

  /** Latest version of each lineage, newest first (one row per lineage). */
  public static LatestPerLineage(rows: readonly VersionRowFields[]): readonly LineageItem[] {
    const latest = new Map<string, VersionRowFields>();
    for (const r of rows) {
      const key = NormalizeUUID(r.LineageRootID);
      const seen = latest.get(key);
      if (seen === undefined || r.Version > seen.Version) latest.set(key, r);
    }
    return [...latest.values()]
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.__mj_CreatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.__mj_CreatedAt).getTime())
      .map((r) => ({ LatestID: r.ID, Name: r.Name, LatestVersion: r.Version, UpdatedAt: r.__mj_CreatedAt }));
  }

  public async Load(): Promise<void> {
    const r = await RunView.FromMetadataProvider(this.ProviderToUse).RunView<VersionRowFields>({
      EntityName: this.EntityName, Fields: ['ID', 'Name', 'Version', 'LineageRootID', '__mj_CreatedAt'], ResultType: 'simple',
    });
    if (!r.Success) {
      this.Error = r.ErrorMessage;
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
      return;
    }
    this.Items = PSVersionedListComponent.LatestPerLineage(r.Results);
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }
}
```

```ts
const record = (entity: string, id: string): string => `${BASE}/resource/record/${encodeURIComponent(entity)}/${id}`;

// The record panels register when the Predictive Studio chunk loads (D3-74), so a record form is opened inside the app
// after the Studio door has loaded that chunk, never by a cold page load.
async function openRecordInApp(page: Page, entity: string, id: string): Promise<void> {
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/app/predictive-studio/Studio`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await expect(page.locator('mj-ps-studio-resource')).toBeVisible();
  const target = new URL(record(entity, id)).pathname;
  await page.evaluate((p) => { history.pushState(null, '', p); dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')); }, target);
}

async function expectReadable(page: Page, selector: string): Promise<void> {
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    await page.evaluate((t) => document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', t), theme);
    const r = await new AxeBuilder({ page }).include(selector).withRules(['color-contrast']).analyze();
    expect(r.violations.map((v) => `${theme}: ${v.id} ${v.nodes.length}`)).toEqual([]);
  }
}

  });
```

  Run: `PW_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4231 PW_API_URL=http://localhost:4031 PS_C1_CARD_NAME=… PS_W7_CARD_NAME=… PS_C1_UNIT_NAME='<C1 unit name>' PS_C1_PROTOCOL_NAME='<C1 protocol name>' PS_C1_PIPELINE_ID=<id> PS_C1_MODEL_ID=<id> PS_LEGACY_MODEL_ID=<a model trained before PR 3> npx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/specs/ps-honest-training.spec.ts`
  (with the W7 status set as in M10.4 Step 5) → `5 passed`. Then the database checks:
  1. `sqlcmd "${S[@]}" -Q "SELECT Version, LabelVersion, LineageRootID, __mj_UpdatedAt FROM __mj.PredictionUnit WHERE LineageRootID='<root id>' ORDER BY Version"`
     → the new version has `LabelVersion` one above its predecessor and the same `LineageRootID`; every earlier row's
     `__mj_UpdatedAt` is unchanged. The model trained earlier still references its unit version through its training
     run's snapshot (`SELECT s.PredictionUnitID FROM __mj.TrainingSnapshot s JOIN __mj.MLTrainingRun r ON r.TrainingSnapshotID=s.ID WHERE r.ResultingModelID='<model id>'`
     → the earlier version's ID; `C1 → S2.3` is M2's gate, re-checked here).
  2. `sqlcmd "${S[@]}" -Q "SELECT Version, JSON_VALUE(Promotion,'$.margin') AS Margin, JSON_VALUE(AuthoredBy,'$.kind') AS Author FROM __mj.EvaluationProtocol WHERE LineageRootID='<C1 protocol root>' ORDER BY Version"`
     → the newest row has margin `0.002` and author `human` (the suite's test user); the guard-field author rule of
     D3-40 is checked at the server by M9.2 Step 5.
  3. `sqlcmd "${S[@]}" -Q "SELECT p.EvaluationProtocolID, e.Version FROM __mj.MLTrainingPipeline p JOIN __mj.EvaluationProtocol e ON e.ID=p.EvaluationProtocolID WHERE p.ID='<pipeline id>'"`
     → the newest version.
  Record the command, the `5 passed` line and the three query results in §11.

#### Task M11.3: Migrate every existing pipeline to a Prediction Unit and an Evaluation Protocol; delete the legacy training path

**Decision (D3-37, amended by D3-42, D3-43 and D3-44; recorded in §9; the release step is added to
`program/release-procedure.md`):** the data migration runs as an **Action**, `Predictive Studio: Migrate Pipelines to
Prediction Units and Evaluation Protocols` (dry run by default, idempotent), executed by the release procedure's
automated step right after PR 3 is deployed (Step 7: a dry run, the real run, and assertions that the two agree — no
one reads the report to approve it). It is not a SQL migration and not metadata INSERTs because each unit needs the
target column's observed classes and the pipeline's declared outcome semantics, each protocol needs the rows' dates to
choose its cutoff, and every row must pass the server subclasses' `Validate()`/`ValidateAsync()`. Every per-pipeline
case is decided by a rule below and recorded in the report and on the pipeline row; the automated outcomes are
**migrate**, **archive** (no Prediction Unit form exists) and **hold** (a required fact cannot be derived from what
the pipeline already declares: the pipeline keeps its `Status`, its published models keep scoring through the legacy
scoring path (§5.5), training it is refused with the recorded reason, and the next run of the Action migrates it once
the fact is declared). The `ValidationStrategy`, `LeakageGuard` and `AsOfStrategy` columns stay on the pipeline, read by
nothing after this task; dropping them is a later breaking-change PR outside this program (§9.3 Q3-9).

**Mapping of a legacy pipeline (one with `PredictionUnitID` or `EvaluationProtocolID` NULL and `Status` not
`Archived`), decided here:**

| Legacy input | Prediction Unit version 1 | Note in the report |
|---|---|---|
| `TargetEntity` | `UnitRows {kind:'grain', grainEntity: TargetEntity, filter: []}` | — |
| `AsOfStrategy.Mode = 'column'` with `Column` | `decisionDate {kind:'column', column: Column}`; `LabelWindowDays 1`, `LabelGapDays 0`; censoring `{kind:'now'}` | "decision date = <Column>; the outcome is the row's TargetVariable as stored" |
| `AsOfStrategy` missing, unreadable or `Mode = 'none'` | `decisionDate {kind:'fixed', date: <migration day D, UTC yyyy-mm-dd>, advance:'each-run'}`; `LabelWindowDays 1`, `LabelGapDays 0`; censoring `{kind:'fixed', at: D + 1 day}`. Before every later run the engine saves the next unit version with the run's day as the decision date and the censoring cutoff moved with it (`DecisionDateAdvance.AdvanceFixedDecisionDate`, D3-43), so each run reads features as they stand on its own day — what the legacy pipeline did — and every run's unit version states that day | "decision date = the day of each run (advances automatically, D3-43); features are read as they stand on that day, as the legacy pipeline read them" |
| `AsOfStrategy.Mode = 'offset'` | none — **archived**: an offset before a per-row label event has no Prediction Unit form (the event dates came from the Train call's `labelEventDates`) | "archived: offset as-of cannot be expressed as a Prediction Unit" |
| `TargetVariable` | `LabelRule {kind:'column', column: TargetVariable}` | — |
| `ProblemType = 'classification'` | distinct non-empty target values read completely, sorted in ordinal string order — the legacy sidecar's label order (`main.py`: `LabelEncoder().fit_transform([str(v) for v in y_raw])`), so the legacy score P(`classOrder[1]`) keeps its meaning: 2 → `binary`, adverse class by `LegacyPipelines.LegacyAdverseClass` (D3-42, below) or **held** when no rule decides; ≥ 3 → `multiclass`, `adverseIndices` = the classes the first declaring source styles red (`[]` when none does); fewer than 2 → **archived** | "class order <a, b>; adverse class <x> (<source>: <evidence>)"; "held: adverse class undetermined …"; "archived: single-valued target" |
| `ProblemType = 'regression'` | `continuous` | "declared continuous; a count or a non-negative amount needs a new unit version with that task (S1.4)" |
| `ProblemType = 'sequence'` (#4166, D3-01) | none — **archived** | "archived: an HMM latent state has no outcome window (D3-01)" |
| — | `ChangeHistoryPolicy {onUncoveredRow:'exclude-and-count', externalSourceRows:'ineligible'}`, `GroupKey null`, `TemporalSpec null`, `DecisionSpec {action:'review', actorRole:'analyst', capacityPerPeriod:null, period:'month'}`, `IncumbentHeuristic {kind:'none'}`, `AuthoredBy {kind:'system', component:'pipeline-migration'}`, `Name "<pipeline name> — migrated unit"` | "uncovered history rows are excluded and counted, not refused" |
| `ValidationStrategy.LockedHoldoutFraction` (default 0.25, clamped to [0.05, 0.5]) | a unit with a date column: protocol holdout `date-carved` on `AsOfStrategy.Column`, `cutoff = TrailingShareCutoff(dates, share)`, `holdoutEnd null`, `newEntityReport null`; a fixed-date unit: `{kind:'seeded-random', fraction: share}` (the only holdout `EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit` accepts for one decision date, D3-36) | "test set = rows dated on or after <cutoff> (<n> rows)" or "test set = a seeded random <share> of rows"; "the legacy trailing slice in key order is gone" |
| `ValidationStrategy.Strategy = 'kfold'` with `K` | `repeated-stratified-kfold`, `folds = max(2, K)`, `repeats 3` | — |
| any other strategy | `EvaluationProtocolRules.DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft`'s inner validation | — |
| `LeakageGuard.DenyFields` / `DenySources` | `Exclusions {denyFields, denySources}` | — |
| `LeakageGuard.SingleFeatureDominanceThreshold` | not carried | "the held-out single-feature AUC audit replaces the dominance threshold" |
| — | rest of the protocol from `EvaluationProtocolRules.DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft({ Unit, Holdout, Candidates: 1, Seed: 42, Name: "<pipeline name> — migrated protocol" })`, `AuthoredBy` as the unit | — |

**The adverse class of a migrated binary unit (D3-42).** The legacy sidecar scored a binary model as P(`classOrder[1]`)
(`main.py` `_classification_prediction`: `scores[i][1]`), and the pipeline already declared what that score means through
its `OutcomeConfig` (Core `outcome-config.ts`, anchors `c1-outcome-config`, `c1-outcome-polarity`). `LegacyPipelines.LegacyAdverseClass`
reads the declaring sources in the legacy engine's own order of precedence and takes the first that decides:
1. the pipeline's explicit config — `FeatureSteps.OutcomeConfig`, `FeatureSteps.outcomeConfig`,
   `Hyperparameters.OutcomeConfig`, `Hyperparameters.outcomeConfig` (the keys `resolvePipeline` reads);
2. the `outcomeConfig` stored in the `Lineage` of the pipeline's newest Published model, else its newest model (the
   semantics users were shown when that model served);
3. `ResolveOutcomeConfig({ TargetVariable, ProblemType })` — the target-name polarity the legacy UI already applied.

Within one source: when exactly one of the two classes has `OutcomeStyles[class].BadgeColor = 'red'`, it is adverse;
else when exactly one is `'green'`, the other is adverse; else `Polarity: 'adverse'` (a higher score is worse) makes
`classOrder[1]` adverse and `Polarity: 'positive'` makes `classOrder[0]` adverse. A source with none of these does not
decide. When no source decides, the pipeline is **held** with the reason
`adverse class undetermined: no OutcomeConfig polarity or red/green class style on the pipeline, its newest model or the target name; set FeatureSteps.OutcomeConfig.Polarity (or OutcomeStyles) and run this Action again`.
The report row and the unit's `Description` name the deciding source and its evidence (e.g. `pipeline OutcomeConfig:
Polarity adverse`), so the choice is auditable from the data.

An archived pipeline gets `Status = 'Archived'` and its `Description` gains the line
`Archived by the Prediction Unit migration on <D>: <reason>.`; a held pipeline keeps its `Status` and its `Description` gains
`Held by the Prediction Unit migration on <D>: <reason>.` once (a later run that holds it again for the same reason adds nothing).
(`MJ: ML Training Pipelines` has no Notes column; `Description` is the pipeline's free-text field.) A pipeline whose
unit exists but whose protocol is NULL gets only the protocol; a pipeline with both set is `skipped / already-migrated`.

A fixed-date unit cannot be carved by date (every row has one decision date), so its protocol uses the `seeded-random`
holdout of D3-36 with the legacy share; the decision date itself advances to each run's day (D3-43), which the
`EvaluationProtocolRules.ValidateProtocolForUnit` binding check accepts because the holdout kind depends only on the decision-date kind.

```ts
// packages/AI/PredictiveStudio/Core/src/legacy-pipeline.ts
/**
 * @module legacy-pipeline
 * Maps a pre-PR-3 pipeline (TargetEntity / TargetVariable / ProblemType / AsOfStrategy, ValidationStrategy /
 * LeakageGuard, OutcomeConfig) onto a version-1 Prediction Unit and the inputs of a version-1 Evaluation Protocol
 *. Every case ends in a recorded automated outcome: unit, archive or hold.
 * Pure and browser-safe; the migration (Engine) supplies the observed classes, the rows' dates and the model lineage.
 */
import { JsonParse, type JsonObject } from './json-value';
import type { HoldoutSplit, InnerValidation, ProtocolExclusions } from './evaluation-protocol';
import { ResolveOutcomeConfig } from './outcome-config';
import type { TaskType } from './task-type';
import type { UnitDraft } from './protocol-rows';

const MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000;

/** Why a migrated binary pipeline is held; also the report reason. */
export const ADVERSE_CLASS_HOLD_REASON =
  'adverse class undetermined: no OutcomeConfig polarity or red/green class style on the pipeline, its newest model or the target name; set FeatureSteps.OutcomeConfig.Polarity (or OutcomeStyles) and run this Action again';

/** The legacy pipeline columns the mapping reads (the generated entity satisfies this structurally). */
export interface LegacyPipelineFields {
  readonly Name: string;
  readonly TargetEntity: string;
  readonly TargetVariable: string;
  /** `string`, not the two-valued union: a #4166 database also holds `sequence`. */
  readonly ProblemType: string;
  readonly AsOfStrategy: string | null;
}

/** Where a migrated unit's adverse class came from, in the legacy engine's order of precedence. */
export type AdverseClassSource = 'pipeline-outcome-config' | 'model-lineage-outcome-config' | 'target-name-polarity';

/** The outcome semantics one source declares: the score polarity and the badge colour per class name. */
export interface LegacyOutcomeSemantics {
  readonly Source: AdverseClassSource;
  readonly Polarity: 'positive' | 'adverse' | null;
  readonly Styles: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
}

/** What the migration reads to find the declared outcome semantics. */
export interface LegacyOutcomeInputs {
  readonly FeatureSteps: string | null;
  readonly Hyperparameters: string | null;
  /** `Lineage` JSON of the pipeline's newest Published model, else its newest model; null when it has none. */
  readonly ModelLineage: string | null;
  readonly TargetVariable: string;
  readonly ProblemType: string;
}

export type LegacyAdverseClassResult =
  | { readonly Kind: 'decided'; readonly AdverseIndex: 0 | 1; readonly Source: AdverseClassSource; readonly Evidence: string }
  | { readonly Kind: 'undetermined'; readonly Reason: string };

export type LegacyUnitOutcome =
  | { readonly Kind: 'unit'; readonly Draft: UnitDraft; readonly DateColumn: string | null; readonly Notes: readonly string[] }
  | { readonly Kind: 'archive'; readonly Reason: string }
  | { readonly Kind: 'hold'; readonly Reason: string };

export type LegacyProtocolOutcome =
  | {
      readonly Kind: 'protocol';
      readonly Holdout: Extract<HoldoutSplit, { readonly kind: 'date-carved' }> | Extract<HoldoutSplit, { readonly kind: 'seeded-random' }>;
      /** null = the default inner validation of DefaultEvaluationProtocolDraft. */
      readonly InnerValidation: InnerValidation | null;
      readonly Exclusions: ProtocolExclusions;
      readonly Notes: readonly string[];
    }
  | { readonly Kind: 'archive'; readonly Reason: string };

const SOURCE_LABEL: Readonly<Record<AdverseClassSource, string>> = {
  'pipeline-outcome-config': 'pipeline OutcomeConfig',
  'model-lineage-outcome-config': 'newest model OutcomeConfig',
  'target-name-polarity': 'target-name polarity',
};

/** Legacy-pipeline mapping rules for the legacy-pipeline data migration (static members on one owner, coding standards §2). */
export class LegacyPipelines {
  private static readObject(json: string | null): JsonObject | null {
    const r = JsonParse.ParseJsonText(json, 'legacy JSON');
    return r.Ok && JsonParse.IsJsonObject(r.Value) ? r.Value : null;
  }

  private static stringList(o: JsonObject | null, key: string): string[] {
    const v = o === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonArrayField(o, key);
    return v === null ? [] : v.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
  }

  private static addDays(day: string, days: number): string {
    return new Date(Date.parse(`${day}T00:00:00Z`) + days * MS_PER_DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  private static semanticsFromJson(source: AdverseClassSource, o: JsonObject): LegacyOutcomeSemantics {
    const polarity = JsonParse.JsonString(o, 'Polarity');
    const styles = new Map<string, string>();
    const styleObject = JsonParse.JsonObjectField(o, 'OutcomeStyles');
    if (styleObject !== null) {
      for (const key of Object.keys(styleObject)) {
        const style = JsonParse.JsonObjectField(styleObject, key);
        const colour = style === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonString(style, 'BadgeColor');
        if (colour !== null) styles.set(key, colour);
      }
    }
    return { Source: source, Polarity: polarity === 'positive' || polarity === 'adverse' ? polarity : null, Styles: styles };
  }

  /** The declaring sources in precedence order: the pipeline's explicit config, the newest model's lineage, the target name. */
  public static LegacyOutcomeCandidates(i: LegacyOutcomeInputs): readonly LegacyOutcomeSemantics[] {
    const out: LegacyOutcomeSemantics[] = [];
    const steps = LegacyPipelines.readObject(i.FeatureSteps);
    const hyper = LegacyPipelines.readObject(i.Hyperparameters);
    const explicit = [steps, steps, hyper, hyper]
      .map((o, k) => (o === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonObjectField(o, k % 2 === 0 ? 'OutcomeConfig' : 'outcomeConfig')))
      .find((o): o is JsonObject => o !== null) ?? null;
    if (explicit !== null) out.push(LegacyPipelines.semanticsFromJson('pipeline-outcome-config', explicit));
    const lineage = LegacyPipelines.readObject(i.ModelLineage);
    const fromModel = lineage === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonObjectField(lineage, 'outcomeConfig') ?? JsonParse.JsonObjectField(lineage, 'OutcomeConfig');
    if (fromModel !== null) out.push(LegacyPipelines.semanticsFromJson('model-lineage-outcome-config', fromModel));
    const inferred = ResolveOutcomeConfig({ TargetVariable: i.TargetVariable, ProblemType: i.ProblemType });
    const styles = new Map<string, string>(Object.entries(inferred.OutcomeStyles ?? {}).map(([name, style]) => [name, style.BadgeColor]));
    out.push({ Source: 'target-name-polarity', Polarity: inferred.Polarity ?? null, Styles: styles });
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * The adverse class of a binary unit from the first source that decides. The legacy score was
   * P(classOrder[1]), so `Polarity: 'adverse'` (higher is worse) makes classOrder[1] adverse and `'positive'` classOrder[0].
   */
  public static LegacyAdverseClass(classOrder: readonly [string, string], candidates: readonly LegacyOutcomeSemantics[]): LegacyAdverseClassResult {
    const index = (name: string): 0 | 1 => (name === classOrder[0] ? 0 : 1);
    for (const c of candidates) {
      const red = classOrder.filter((k) => c.Styles.get(k) === 'red');
      const [onlyRed] = red;
      if (red.length === 1 && onlyRed !== undefined) return { Kind: 'decided', AdverseIndex: index(onlyRed), Source: c.Source, Evidence: `OutcomeStyles ${onlyRed} red` };
      const green = classOrder.filter((k) => c.Styles.get(k) === 'green');
      const [onlyGreen] = green;
      if (green.length === 1 && onlyGreen !== undefined) {
        return { Kind: 'decided', AdverseIndex: index(onlyGreen) === 0 ? 1 : 0, Source: c.Source, Evidence: `OutcomeStyles ${onlyGreen} green` };
      }
      if (c.Polarity === 'adverse') return { Kind: 'decided', AdverseIndex: 1, Source: c.Source, Evidence: 'Polarity adverse' };
      if (c.Polarity === 'positive') return { Kind: 'decided', AdverseIndex: 0, Source: c.Source, Evidence: 'Polarity positive' };
    }
    return { Kind: 'undetermined', Reason: ADVERSE_CLASS_HOLD_REASON };
  }

  public static LegacyUnitInputs(
    p: LegacyPipelineFields,
    distinctLabels: readonly string[],
    migrationDay: string,
    outcome: readonly LegacyOutcomeSemantics[],
  ): LegacyUnitOutcome {
    if (p.ProblemType === 'sequence') return { Kind: 'archive', Reason: 'an HMM latent state has no outcome window' };
    const asOf = LegacyPipelines.readObject(p.AsOfStrategy);
    const mode = asOf === null ? 'none' : JsonParse.JsonString(asOf, 'Mode') ?? 'none';
    if (mode === 'offset') return { Kind: 'archive', Reason: 'offset as-of cannot be expressed as a Prediction Unit' };
    const column = mode === 'column' && asOf !== null ? JsonParse.JsonString(asOf, 'Column') : null;
    if (mode === 'column' && column === null) return { Kind: 'archive', Reason: 'AsOfStrategy column mode names no column' };
    const outcomeTask = p.ProblemType === 'classification'
      ? LegacyPipelines.classificationTask(distinctLabels, outcome)
      : { Kind: 'task' as const, Task: { kind: 'continuous' } as TaskType, Semantics: '', Note: 'declared continuous; a count or a non-negative amount is a different task (S1.4) and is declared in a new unit version' };
    if (outcomeTask.Kind !== 'task') return outcomeTask;
    const task = outcomeTask.Task;
    const semantics = outcomeTask.Semantics;
    const notes: string[] = [outcomeTask.Note];
    const fixed = column === null;
    if (fixed) notes.push(`decision date = the day of each run, starting ${migrationDay} (advances automatically); features are read as they stand on that day, as the legacy pipeline read them`);
    else notes.push(`decision date = ${column}; the outcome is the row's ${p.TargetVariable} as stored`);
    notes.push('uncovered history rows are excluded and counted, not refused');
    return {
      Kind: 'unit',
      DateColumn: column,
      Notes: notes,
      Draft: {
        Name: `${p.Name} — migrated unit`,
        Description: `Created by the Prediction Unit pipeline migration on ${migrationDay} from the pipeline's TargetEntity, TargetVariable, ProblemType and AsOfStrategy${semantics ? `; ${semantics}` : ''}.`,
        UnitRows: { kind: 'grain', grainEntity: p.TargetEntity, decisionDate: fixed ? { kind: 'fixed', date: migrationDay, advance: 'each-run' } : { kind: 'column', column }, filter: [] },
        LabelRule: { kind: 'column', column: p.TargetVariable },
        LabelWindowDays: 1,
        LabelGapDays: 0,
        TaskType: task,
        Censoring: fixed ? { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'fixed', at: LegacyPipelines.addDays(migrationDay, 1) } } : { rule: 'exclude-unresolved', cutoff: { kind: 'now' } },
        ChangeHistoryPolicy: { onUncoveredRow: 'exclude-and-count', externalSourceRows: 'ineligible' },
        GroupKey: null,
        TemporalSpec: null,
        DecisionSpec: { action: 'review', actorRole: 'analyst', capacityPerPeriod: null, period: 'month' },
        IncumbentHeuristic: { kind: 'none' },
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * The task of a classification pipeline from its observed labels in ordinal string order — the legacy sidecar's
   * LabelEncoder order over str(value) — so P(classOrder[1]) keeps its meaning; binary needs a deciding source.
   */
  private static classificationTask(
    distinctLabels: readonly string[],
    outcome: readonly LegacyOutcomeSemantics[],
  ): { readonly Kind: 'task'; readonly Task: TaskType; readonly Semantics: string; readonly Note: string } | Extract<LegacyUnitOutcome, { readonly Kind: 'archive' | 'hold' }> {
    const classes = [...new Set(distinctLabels.map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l.length > 0))].sort();
    const [first, second] = classes;
    if (classes.length < 2 || first === undefined || second === undefined) {
      return { Kind: 'archive', Reason: `single-valued target (${classes.length} class observed)` };
    }
    if (classes.length === 2) {
      const adverse = LegacyPipelines.LegacyAdverseClass([first, second], outcome);
      if (adverse.Kind === 'undetermined') return { Kind: 'hold', Reason: adverse.Reason };
      const semantics = `adverse class ${adverse.AdverseIndex === 0 ? first : second} (${SOURCE_LABEL[adverse.Source]}: ${adverse.Evidence})`;
      return { Kind: 'task', Task: { kind: 'binary', classOrder: [first, second], adverseIndex: adverse.AdverseIndex }, Semantics: semantics, Note: `class order ${first}, ${second}; ${semantics}` };
    }
    const declaring = outcome.find((c) => classes.some((k) => c.Styles.get(k) === 'red'));
    const adverseIndices = declaring === undefined ? [] : classes.flatMap((k, i) => (declaring.Styles.get(k) === 'red' ? [i] : []));
    const semantics = declaring === undefined
      ? 'no adverse classes declared'
      : `adverse classes ${adverseIndices.map((i) => classes[i] ?? '').join(', ')} (${SOURCE_LABEL[declaring.Source]}: red OutcomeStyles)`;
    return { Kind: 'task', Task: { kind: 'multiclass', classOrder: classes, adverseIndices }, Semantics: semantics, Note: `class order ${classes.join(', ')}; ${semantics}` };
  }

  /** Earliest day d whose trailing block (dates >= d) holds at most `share` of the rows; null when only the first day qualifies. */
  public static TrailingShareCutoff(dates: readonly string[], share: number): string | null {
    const days = dates.map((d) => d.slice(0, 10)).sort();
    const unique = [...new Set(days)];
    const n = days.length;
    let best: string | null = null;
    for (let i = unique.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
      const d = unique[i];
      if (d === undefined) break;
      const trailing = days.filter((x) => x >= d).length;
      if (trailing / n <= share) best = d;
      else break;
    }
    return best;
  }

  /** `dateColumn` null = a fixed-date unit: a seeded-random holdout of the legacy share. */
  public static LegacyProtocolInputs(validationJson: string | null, leakageJson: string | null, dateColumn: string | null, dates: readonly string[]): LegacyProtocolOutcome {
    const notes: string[] = [];
    const v = LegacyPipelines.readObject(validationJson);
    if (v === null) notes.push('ValidationStrategy missing or unreadable: defaults used.');
    const fraction = (v === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonNumber(v, 'LockedHoldoutFraction')) ?? 0.25;
    const share = Math.min(0.5, Math.max(0.05, fraction));
    let holdout: Extract<HoldoutSplit, { readonly kind: 'date-carved' }> | Extract<HoldoutSplit, { readonly kind: 'seeded-random' }>;
    if (dateColumn === null) {
      holdout = { kind: 'seeded-random', fraction: share };
      notes.push(`test set = a seeded random ${Math.round(share * 100)}% of rows (one decision date per run); the legacy trailing slice in key order is gone`);
    } else {
      const cutoff = LegacyPipelines.TrailingShareCutoff(dates, share);
      if (cutoff === null) {
        const only = dates[0]?.slice(0, 10) ?? 'none';
        return { Kind: 'archive', Reason: `every row has the same ${dateColumn} (${only}): no date cutoff leaves development rows` };
      }
      holdout = { kind: 'date-carved', dateColumn, cutoff, holdoutEnd: null, newEntityReport: null };
      notes.push(`test set = rows with ${dateColumn} on or after ${cutoff} (${dates.filter((d) => d.slice(0, 10) >= cutoff).length} rows); the legacy trailing slice in key order is gone`);
    }
    let inner: InnerValidation | null = null;
    if (v !== null && JsonParse.JsonString(v, 'Strategy') === 'kfold') {
      inner = { kind: 'repeated-stratified-kfold', folds: Math.max(2, Math.round(JsonParse.JsonNumber(v, 'K') ?? 5)), repeats: 3 };
    }
    const guard = LegacyPipelines.readObject(leakageJson);
    const threshold = guard === null ? null : JsonParse.JsonNumber(guard, 'SingleFeatureDominanceThreshold');
    if (threshold !== null) notes.push(`SingleFeatureDominanceThreshold ${threshold} not carried: the held-out single-feature AUC audit replaces it.`);
    return {
      Kind: 'protocol',
      Holdout: holdout,
      InnerValidation: inner,
      Exclusions: { denyFields: LegacyPipelines.stringList(guard, 'DenyFields'), denySources: LegacyPipelines.stringList(guard, 'DenySources') },
      Notes: notes,
    };
  }
}
```
